Infiltrating the Cult
fr: L'infiltration du Culte

en: Speak to Doomsayer Stormwind's Old Town to join the doomsday cult,then equip the Doomsday Recruit's Robe you receive.
fr: Parlez à un Auspice funeste dans la Vieille ville de Hurlevent, ou volez une robe dans une caisse près d’un Auspice funeste pour rejoindre le culte, puis revêtez la Robe de recrue de l'apocalypse que vous obtiendrez.

en: It's getting difficult to keep the cultists out of the public eye and rumors are spreading across the city. I want you to join the cult and learn as much as you can.$B$BApproach one of the doomsayers in Old Town and tell them you wish to join their group. The doomsayer will likely give you clothing and instructions to meet with other cultists in one of the group's hideouts. Follow those instructions,$N. It's the only way to gain their confidence.
fr: Il devient difficile d'empêcher les sectateurs d'approcher les habitants et des rumeurs se répandent dans toute la ville. Je veux que vous rejoigniez le culte et que vous appreniez autant de choses que possible.$B$BApprochez l'un des auspices funestes dans la Vieille ville et dites-lui que vous souhaitez rejoindre son groupe. L'auspice vous fournira probablement une tenue et des instructions pour rencontrer d'autres sectateurs dans l'une de leurs cachettes. Suivez ces instructions, $n. C'est la seule façon de gagner leur confiance.

en: Report to Overseer Sylandra at the Mirror Lake Orchard in Elwynn Forest.
fr: Faites votre rapport à la Surveillante Sylandra au Verger du lac Miroir, dans la Forêt d'Elwynn.

en: Join Doomsday Cult
The Missing
fr: Disparitions

en: While wearing your Cult Disguise,speak to Cultist Kagarn,Cultish Agtar,Cultist Tokka,and Cultist Rokaga at the Jaggedswine Farm in Durotar.
fr: Revêtez le Déguisement du Culte et allez parler aux Sectateurs Kagarn, Agtar, Tokka et Rokaga à la Ferme Rêche-pourceau, en Durotar.

en: Aside from the disturbances and the paranoia spread by the cult,we've been inundated with reports of missing people. Mothers,fathers,brothers,and sisters have seemingly disappeared,but I have a feeling that they can be found in one of the cult's compounds outside the city. If I give you the names of some of the missing people,would you try to locate them in the cultist camp at the Jaggedswine Farm south of Orgrimmar? To blend in,you'll need to get a robe from one of the doomsayers in the Drag.
fr: Non seulement le culte sème la zizanie et la paranoïa, mais on nous signale également de nombreuses disparitions. Des pères, des mères, des sœurs et des frères ont selon toute vraisemblance disparu, mais je suis persuadé que nous pourrions les trouver dans l'une des bases du culte à l'extérieur de la ville. Si je vous donne les noms de certains disparus, pourriez-vous essayer de les retrouver au camp des sectateurs à la ferme Rêche-pourceau, au sud d'Orgrimmar ? Vous aurez besoin de la robe d'un des auspices funestes de la Herse pour vous fondre dans la masse.

en: Report back to Blood Guard Torek in Orgrimmar.
fr: Faites votre rapport au Garde de sang Torek à Orgrimmar.

en: Speak to Cultist Kagarn
Speak to Cultist Agtar
Speak to Cultist Tokka
Speak to Cultist Rokaga
Press Fire
fr: Tirez !

en: Test out the Shooting Mechano-Tank weapon systems on the nearby targets.
fr: Testez les systèmes de tir du Mécano-tank canardeur sur des cibles à proximité.

en: Safety systems,online!  Motor functions,functioning!  Now all we need is to make sure that the guns will fire.$b$bThis shouldn't be too hard,$n.  The mechano-tank on the hill behind us has been loaded with harmless pellets. Just fire off a couple rounds at the nearby targets and report back to me.
fr: Systèmes de sécurité connectés ! Fonctions motrices enclenchées ! Maintenant, il ne nous reste plus qu'à nous assurer que les canons feront bien leur boulot, tirer !$b$bÇa ne devrait pas être trop difficile, $n. Le mécano-tank qui se trouve sur la colline derrière nous a été chargé avec des plombs inoffensifs. Tirez quelques balles sur les cibles autour du tank et venez me faire votre rapport.

en: Inform Captain Tread Sparknozzle of your results.
fr: Informez le Capitaine Chape Étincetuyère de vos résultats.

en: Weapon System Tested
You're In The Army Gnow!
fr: L'armée gnome

en: [ph] Log Description
fr: [ph] Log Description

en: [ph] War!
fr: [ph] War!

en: Ejection System Tested
The Master's Plan
fr: Le plan du maître

en: Learn more about the cult's plans at the altar in the eastern part of the Jaggedswine Farm.
fr: En apprendre plus sur les plans du culte devant l'autel à l'est de la Ferme Rêche-pourceau.

en: You're fitting in well here,$N,but there is more to us than daily chores and spreading the message. I'm sure you heard a little bit about it when you first joined.$B$BAs you know,this world is ending and the unprepared will die painful deaths.$B$BWe have been given a gift,an opportunity to become something greater and more powerful. Overseer Golbaz is will be preparing a ritual before the altar at the eastern end of the farm. Wait there for him,and learn more of your new brothers and sisters.
fr: Vous vous intégrez parfaitement ici, $n, mais nous faisons plus que répandre la bonne parole et vaquer à nos occupations quotidiennes. Je suis certaine que vous en avez un peu entendu parler lorsque vous êtes $garrivé:arrivée;.$B$BComme vous le savez, la fin du monde arrive, et ceux qui n'y sont pas préparés mourront dans d'atroces souffrances.$B$BNous avons reçu un don, l'opportunité de devenir quelque chose de plus grand et de plus puissant. Le surveillant Golbaz se prépare à entamer un rituel devant l'autel qui se trouve juste à l'est de la ferme. Attendez-le là-bas et apprenez-en plus sur vos nouveaux frères et sœurs.

en: Return to Overseer Jintak at the Jaggedswine Farm.
fr: Retournez voir la Surveillante Jintak à la Ferme Rêche-pourceau.

en: Cho'Gall's Revelation
The Doomsday Plan
fr: Le plan de l'apocalypse

en: Take the Elemental Devices to Blood Guard Torek in Orgrimmar's Valley of Strength.
fr: Apportez les Appareils élémentaires au Garde de sang Torek dans la Vallée de la Force, à Orgrimmar.

en: The first batch of elemental devices are ready. Your task will be to conceal them inside the city of Orgrimmar. The devices will unleash their fire elementals at the proper time. Don't worry,$N,you'll be safely away before that happens.$B$BDo not do anything that would draw attention to yourself.$B$B<The overseer hands you a package containing several of the elemental devices. This is just the kind of proof that Blood Guard Torek was hoping you'd uncover. You should probably bring the devices to him.>
fr: Le premier lot d'appareils élémentaires est prêt. Vous aurez pour tâche de les cacher dans Orgrimmar. Ces appareils libéreront des élémentaires de feu au moment opportun. Ne vous inquiétez pas, $n, vous serez loin et en sécurité lorsque cela se produira.$B$BNe faites rien qui pourrait attirer l'attention sur vous.$B$B<La surveillante vous tend un paquet contenant plusieurs de ces appareils élémentaires. C'est justement le genre de preuve que le garde de sang Torek espérait que vous découvririez. Vous devriez lui apporter les appareils.>

en: Take the Elemental Devices to Blood Guard Torek in Orgrimmar's Valley of Strength.
fr: Apportez les Appareils élémentaires au Garde de sang Torek dans la Vallée de la Force, à Orgrimmar.

en: Thwarting Twilight's Hammer
fr: Déstabiliser le Marteau du crépuscule

en: Break Elemental Devices to release their elementals. You must defeat 5 Raging Fire Elementals.
fr: Détruisez les Appareils élémentaires pour en libérer les élémentaires prisonniers. Tuez 5 Élémentaires de feu déchaînés.

en: You can't have been the only person sent into Orgrimmar to deploy those devices containing fire elementals. We have to find and disable the rest of the devices before set their captive elementals free and burn down the city.$B$BAre you familiar enough with the devices to destroy them? You need to break them open before the fire elementals inside have had time to reach full strength. They should be easy to defeat if you open the devices early. The cultists have probably put them all over the city.
fr: Vous ne devez pas être la seule personne qu'ils ont envoyée à Orgrimmar pour cacher ces appareils contenant des élémentaires de feu. Nous devons trouver et désactiver les autres appareils avant que leurs élémentaires captifs ne soient libérés et ne réduisent la ville en cendres.$B$BEn savez-vous suffisamment sur ces appareils pour les détruire ? Vous devez casser ces engins avant que les élémentaires prisonniers n'atteignent leur puissance maximale. Ils devraient être assez faciles à vaincre si vous ouvrez les appareils avant terme. Les sectateurs en ont probablement disséminé dans toute la ville.

en: Return to Blood Guard Torek in Orgrimmar's Valley of Strength.
fr: Retournez voir le Garde de sang Torek dans la Vallée de la Force, à Orgrimmar.

en: Alert The Warchief
fr: Avertir nos chefs

en: Speak with Thrall at Grommash Hold in Orgrimmar's Valley of Wisdom.
fr: Parlez à Garrosh Hurlenfer au Fort Grommash dans la Vallée de la Sagesse, à Orgrimmar.

en: You have successfully defended Orgrimmar from the threat posed by this Twilight's Hammer cult,$N,and without shedding the blood of our own people. Our enemy will not rest for long. I cannot imagine that Cho'Gall will accept defeat so easily.$B$BYou must take word to Thrall. Go to the Valley of Wisdom and speak to him in Grommash Hold. Tell the warchief that our enemies have shown themselves and we must be prepared for their return.
fr: Vous avez défendu avec succès Orgrimmar contre la menace que représentait le culte du Marteau du crépuscule, $n, et sans blesser un seul de nos citoyens. Cependant, nos ennemis ne resteront pas calmes bien longtemps. Cho'Gall n'est pas du genre à accepter facilement la défaite.$B$BGarrosh Hurlenfer est un célèbre héros de la Horde et il saura comment traiter ce problème. Allez à la vallée de la Sagesse et parlez-lui dans le fort Grommash. Dites au jeune Hurlenfer que nos ennemis se sont démasqués et que nous devons nous préparer à leur retour.

en: Spreading The Word
fr: Répandre la bonne parole

en: While wearing your Doomsday Message,visit the East Zeppelin Tower,the West Zeppelin Tower,and the town square of Razor Hill.
fr: Revêtez le Message de l'apocalypse et rendez-vous à la tour est et la tour ouest des zeppelins, ainsi que sur la place de Tranchecolline.

en: Welcome to the farm,$N. Everyone here works to earn $g his:her; keep. For some,that means caring for the animals. Others are responsible for working on our construction projects. Still others work to spread our message among the people and I think that's a good place for you to start.$B$BTake this board. It bears a short message about our beliefs. While wearing the board,visit the eastern and western zeppelin towers outside Orgrimmar's gates,as well as the town square of Razor Hill,to the south.
fr: Bienvenue dans la ferme, $n. Ici, tout le monde travaille pour gagner son pain. Certains s'occupent des animaux, tandis que d'autres sont responsables de nos projets de construction. D'autres encore transmettent notre message au peuple. Je pense que ce serait un bon début pour vous.$B$BPrenez ce panneau sur lequel est inscrit un court message présentant nos convictions. Portez-le, puis rendez-vous aux tours des zeppelins à l'est et à l'ouest des portes d'Orgrimmar, ainsi que sur la place de Tranchecolline, au sud.

en: Return to Overseer Jintak at the Jaggedswine Farm.
fr: Retournez voir la Surveillante Jintak à la Ferme Rêche-pourceau.

en: Spread Message at East Zeppelin Tower
Spread Message at West Zeppelin Tower
Spread Message in Razor Hill
Operation: Gnomeregan
fr: Opération Gnomeregan

en: Help King Mekkatorque with the assault on Gnomeregan.
fr: Aidez le Roi Mekkanivelle lors de l'assaut de Gnomeregan.

en: Momentarily,the multi-phased assault upon Gnomeregan will begin and Mekgineer Thermaplugg and his men will be brought to justice!  Too long has Thermaplugg festered in the depths of our home,defended by a corrupt and irradiated army.$B$BThe assault begins in but a moment! Be ready recruit,this fight will not be for the faint-hearted.
fr: Dans peu de temps, l'assaut de Gnomeregan en plusieurs étapes sera lancé, et le mekgénieur Thermojoncteur et ses troupes devront rendre des comptes ! Thermojoncteur a souillé les profondeurs de notre foyer pendant bien trop longtemps, défendu par une armée corrompue et irradiée.$B$BL'assaut débutera dans quelques instants ! Soyez $gprêt:prête;, recrue, ce combat n'est pas pour les âmes sensibles.

en: Talk to King Mekkatorque in Tinker Town.
fr: Parlez au Roi Mekkanivelle à Brikabrok.

en: Regain the Surface of Gnomeregan
The Missing
fr: Disparitions

en: While wearing your Doomdsay Recruit's Robe,speak to Cultist Lethelyn,Cultish Kaima,Cultist Wyman,and Cultist Orlunn at Mirror Lake Orchard in Elywnn Forest.
fr: Revêtez la Robe de recrue de l'apocalypse et allez parler aux Sectateurs Lethelyn, Kaima, Wyman et Orlunn au Verger du lac Miroir, dans la Forêt d'Elwynn.

en: The cult isn't just spreading fear and paranoia anymore. Now,I'm receiving reports of missing people. Mothers,fathers,brothers,and sisters have seemingly disappeared,but I have a feeling they can be found in one of the cult's camps outside the city. If I give you the names of some of the missing people,would you try to locate them in the cultist camp at Mirror Lake Orchard? It's southwest of the city gates. To blend in,you'll need join the cult and get a robe from one of the doomsayers in Old Town.
fr: Non seulement le culte sème la zizanie et la paranoïa, mais je reçois également de nombreux rapports de disparitions. Des pères, des mères, des sœurs et des frères ont selon toute vraisemblance disparu, mais j'ai comme l'impression que nous pourrions les trouver dans l'une des bases du culte à l'extérieur de la ville. Si je vous donne les noms de certains disparus, pourriez-vous essayer de les retrouver au camp des sectateurs au verger du lac Miroir ? Il se trouve au sud-ouest des portes de la ville. Vous aurez besoin de la robe d'un des auspices funestes de la Vieille ville pour vous fondre dans la masse.

en: Report back to Captain Anton in Stormwind's Trade District.
fr: Faites votre rapport au Capitaine Anton au Donjon de Hurlevent.

en: Speak to Cultist Lethelyn
Speak to Cultist Kaima
Speak to Cultist Wyman
Speak to Cultist Orlunn
Spreading The Word
fr: Répandre la bonne parole

en: While wearing your Doomsday Message,visit the Westbrook Garrison,the Valley of Heroes in Stormwind,and the town square of Goldshire.
fr: Revêtez le Message de l'apocalypse et rendez-vous à la Garnison du ruisseau de l'Ouest, dans la Vallée des Héros de Hurlevent et sur la place de Comté-de-l'Or.

en: Welcome to our orchard,$N. Everyone here works to earn $g his:her; keep. For some,that means tending the fruit trees. Others are responsible for working on our construction projects. Still others work to spread our message among the people and I think that's a good place for you to start.$B$BTake this board. It bears a short message about our beliefs. While wearing it,visit the Westbrook Garrison,southwest of here,the town square of Goldshire just to the east,and the Valley of Heroes in Stormwind.
fr: Bienvenue dans notre verger, $n. Ici, tout le monde travaille pour gagner son pain. Certains entretiennent les arbres fruitiers, tandis que d'autres sont responsables de nos projets de construction. D'autres encore transmettent notre message au peuple. Je pense que ce serait un bon début pour vous.$B$BPrenez ce panneau sur lequel est inscrit un court message présentant nos convictions. Portez-le, puis rendez-vous à la Garnison du ruisseau de l'Ouest, au sud-ouest d’ici, sur la place de Comté-de-l'Or, à l'est, et dans la vallée des Héros, à Hurlevent.

en: Return to Overseer Sylandra at Mirror Lake Orchard.
fr: Retournez voir la Surveillante Sylandra au Verger du lac Miroir.

en: Spread Message at Westbrook Garrison
Spread Message in Valley of Heroes
Spread Message in Goldshire
The Master's Plan
fr: Le plan du maître

en: Learn more about the cult's plans at the altar in the northern part of Mirror Lake Orchard.
fr: En apprendre plus sur les plans du culte devant l'autel, dans la partie ouest du Verger du lac Miroir.

en: You're fitting in well here,$N,but there is more to us than daily chores and spreading the message. I'm sure you heard a little bit about it when you first joined.$B$BAs you know,this world is ending and the unprepared will die painful deaths.$B$BWe have been given a gift,an opportunity to become something greater and more powerful. Overseer Talathor is preparing for a ritual at the altar just north of the orchard. Wait there for him,and learn more of your new brothers and sisters.
fr: Vous vous intégrez parfaitement ici, $n, mais nous faisons plus que répandre la bonne parole et vaquer à nos occupations quotidiennes. Je suis certaine que vous en avez un peu entendu parler lorsque vous êtes $garrivé:arrivée;.$B$BComme vous le savez, la fin du monde arrive, et ceux qui n'y sont pas préparés mourront dans d'atroces souffrances.$B$BNous avons reçu un don, l'opportunité de devenir quelque chose de plus grand et de plus puissant. Le surveillant Talathor se prépare à entamer un rituel sur l'autel qui se trouve juste à l'ouest du verger. Attendez-le là-bas et apprenez-en plus sur vos nouveaux frères et sœurs.

en: Return to Overseer Sylandra at Mirror Lake Orchard.
fr: Retournez voir la Surveillante Sylandra au Verger du lac Miroir.

en: Cho'Gall's Revelation
The Doomsday Plan
fr: Le plan de l'apocalypse

en: Take the Elemental Devices to Captain Anton in Stormwind's Trade District.
fr: Apportez les Appareils élémentaires au Capitaine Anton au Donjon de Hurlevent.

en: The first batch of elemental devices are ready. Your task will be to conceal them inside populated areas of Stormwind. The devices will unleash their elementals at the proper time. Don't worry,$N,you'll be safely away before that happens.$B$BDo not do anything that would draw attention to yourself.$B$B<The overseer hands you a package containing several of the elemental devices. This is just the kind of proof that Captain Anton was hoping you'd uncover. You should probably bring the devices to him.>
fr: Le premier lot d'appareils élémentaires est prêt. Vous aurez pour tâche de les cacher dans les quartiers habités de Hurlevent. Ces appareils libéreront des élémentaires au moment opportun. Ne vous inquiétez pas, $n, vous serez loin et en sécurité lorsque cela se produira.$B$BNe faites rien qui pourrait attirer l'attention sur vous.$B$B<La surveillante vous tend un paquet contenant plusieurs de ces appareils élémentaires. C'est justement le genre de preuve que le capitaine Anton espérait que vous découvririez. Vous devriez lui apporter les appareils.>

en: Take the Elemental Devices to Captain Anton in Stormwind's Trade District.
fr: Apportez les Appareils élémentaires au Capitaine Anton au Donjon de Hurlevent.

en: Thwarting Twilight's Hammer
fr: Déstabiliser le Marteau du crépuscule

en: Destroy Elemental Devices to release their captive elementals. Defeat 5 Raging Wind Elementals.
fr: Détruisez les Appareils élémentaires pour en libérer les élémentaires prisonniers. Tuez 5 Élémentaires de vent déchaînés.

en: You can't have been the only person sent into Stormwind to deploy those devices containing wind elementals. We have to find and disable the rest of the devices before set their captive elementals free to create storms in the city.$B$BAre you familiar enough with the devices to destroy them? Our best chance is to break the devices before the elementals inside can reach full strength. Look for the devices in the Trade District,Cathedral Square and the Mage District. Hurry!
fr: Vous ne devez pas être la seule personne qu'ils ont envoyée à Hurlevent pour cacher ces appareils contenant des élémentaires d'air. Nous devons trouver et désactiver les autres appareils avant que leurs élémentaires captifs ne soient libérés et créent des tempêtes dans toute la ville.$B$BEn savez-vous suffisamment sur ces appareils pour les détruire ? Notre meilleure chance consiste à briser ces engins avant que les élémentaires prisonniers n'atteignent leur puissance maximale. Cherchez les machines dans le quartier commerçant, sur la place de la Cathédrale et dans le quartier des Mages. Dépêchez-vous !

en: Return to Captain Anton in Stormwind's Trade District.
fr: Retournez voir le Capitaine Anton au Donjon de Hurlevent.

en: Warn King Wrynn
fr: Prévenir le roi Wrynn

en: Speak with King Varian Wrynn in Stormwind Keep.
fr: Parlez au Roi Varian Wrynn au Donjon de Hurlevent.

en: You have successfully defended Stormwind from the threat posed by this Twilight's Hammer cult,$N,and without harming our own citizens. Our enemy will not rest for long. Indeed,Cho'Gall must already be busy planning his next move.$B$BYou must take word to King Varian Wrynn. Go directly to him in the throne room of Stormwind Keep. Tell the king that our enemies have shown themselves and we must be prepared for their return.
fr: Vous avez défendu avec succès Hurlevent contre la menace que représentait le culte du Marteau du crépuscule, $n, et sans blesser un seul de nos concitoyens. Nos ennemis ne resteront pas calmes bien longtemps, cependant. Cho'Gall doit déjà être en train de prévoir son prochain coup.$B$BVous devez prévenir le roi Varian Wrynn. Allez le voir dans la salle du trône, dans le donjon de Hurlevent. Dites-lui que nos ennemis se sont démasqués et que nous devons nous préparer à leur retour.

en: Da Perfect Spies
fr: De parfaits espions

en: Capture 5 Sen'jin Frogs and attune them to Vanira's sight at her Sentry Totem.
fr: Capturez 5 Grenouilles de Sen'jin et harmonisez-les avec la vue de Vanira grâce à son Totem sentinelle.

en: Now,it would be foolish to go in blind 'ere,so I be creatin' some tiny spies to gather information for Vol'jin. He got to know what's goin' on over on de islands.$B$BI could use da help,if you be feelin' up to it. I tell ya how it's done. First,ya gotta catch de frogs. Dey like to stay in de shade of da palm trees around Sen'jin.$B$BOnce ya have de frogs,bring 'em over here to my sentry totem an' attune dem to me sight.
fr: Il faudrait être fou pour foncer tête baissée, alors j'ai commencé à créer des petits espions qui vont rassembler les informations pour Vol'jin. Il doit savoir ce qui se passe sur ces îles.$B$BJ'aurais bien besoin de votre aide, si ça vous tente. Je vous dis comment on s'y prend. D'abord, vous devez attraper des grenouilles. Les grenouilles, elles aiment bien rester à l'ombre des palmiers autour de Sen'jin.$B$BQuand vous avez les grenouilles, vous les rapportez à mon totem sentinelle et vous les harmonisez avec mes yeux.

en: Return to Vanira at the Darkspear Strand.
fr: Retournez voir Vanira sur la Grève des Sombrelances.

en: Sen'jin Frogs attuned
Zalazane's Fall
fr: La chute de Zalazane

en: Help Vol'jin take back the Echo Isles and kill Zalazane.
fr: Aidez Vol'jin à reprendre les Îles de l'Écho et à tuer Zalazane.

en: De time for battle is now!  We'd be headin' ova to da islands soon,so you'd betta be ready.$B$BZalazane doesn't have much time left.
fr: Le temps de la bataille, il est arrivé ! On va bientôt aller à l'assaut des îles, alors il vaut mieux que vous soyez $gprêt:prête;.$B$BC'est bientôt la fin de Zalazane.

en: Return to Vol'jin outside Sen'jin Village.
fr: Retournez voir Vol’jin à l’extérieur de Sen'jin.

en: Zalazane Killed
Frogs Away!
fr: Lâcher de grenouilles !

en: While riding a bat,use the Sack o' Frogs to place 12 attuned frogs on the markers in the Echo Isles.
fr: Tout en chevauchant une chauve-souris, utilisez le Sac de grenouilles pour placer 12 Grenouilles harmonisées sur les marqueurs des Îles de l'Écho.

en: Wit de frogs ready to go,I be needin' ya to help me send 'em out to the isles.$B$BOn de eastern side of Sen'jin Village,ya can find Handler Marnlek. He be handlin' all the bats for Vol'jin's scouts and he can loan ya a bat to get ya out to de isles.$B$BTake dis sack' o frogs with ya. I been askin' de spirits for guidance. Dey've sent smoke to show ya where I need de eyes most. While ridin' de bat,reach into de sack and toss de frogs toward de white smoke.
fr: Maintenant que les grenouilles, elles sont prêtes à partir, il faut que vous m'aidiez à les envoyer sur les îles.$B$BÀ l'est du village de Sen'jin, il y a le dresseur Marnlek. Il s'occupe des chauves-souris des éclaireurs de Vol'jin et il peut vous en prêter une pour voler au-dessus des îles.$B$BPrenez ce sac de grenouilles, j'ai demandé aux esprits de vous guider. Ils ont mis de la fumée là où je veux avoir des yeux. Pendant que vous serez sur la chauve-souris, prenez des grenouilles dans le sac et jetez-les vers la fumée blanche.

en: Return to Vanira in Sen'jin Village.
fr: Retournez voir Vanira au Village de Sen'jin.

en: Attuned Frogs deployed
Trollin' For Volunteers
fr: Engagez-vous, qu'ils disaient

en: Use Vol'jin's War Drums to recruit 5 Troll Citizens in Razor Hill.$B$BYou can speak to Handler Marnlek for a bat ride to Razor Hill.
fr: Utilisez les Tambours de guerre de Vol'jin pour recruter 5 Citoyens trolls à Tranchecolline.$B$BVous pouvez parler au Dresseur Marnlek pour obtenir un tour en chauve-souris jusqu'à Tranchecolline.

en: Vol'jin has given me his war drums and put  me in charge of trainin' da new recruits here. Only problem is we be short on new recruits.$B$BSupposin' I loaned ya dis drum,would ya use it to sound de call to war on Vol'jin's behalf in Razor Hill? If ya could even inspire just a few trolls to join da cause,it would make a difference. Once ya've convinced dem to volunteer,bring dem back to me for trainin'. Go over an' talk to Handler Marnlek to de south. He can lend you a bat for de ride to Razor Hill.
fr: Vol'jin, il m'a donné ses tambours de guerre et il m'a dit d'entraîner les nouvelles recrues. Le problème, c'est que des recrues, on commence à en manquer, $gmec:gamine;.$B$BSi j'vous prête ce tambour, vous voulez bien lancer l'appel aux armes pour Vol'jin à Tranchecolline ? Si vous pouvez motiver quelques trolls à rejoindre notre cause, ça fera la différence, c'est sûr. Quand les trolls, vous les aurez convaincus de se porter volontaires, ramenez-les pour leur entraînement. Allez parler au dresseur Marnlek au sud, il vous prêtera une chauve-souris qui vous emmènera à Tranchecolline.

en: Return to Champion Uru'zin at Sen'jin Village.
fr: Retournez voir le Champion Uru'zin au Village de Sen'jin.

en: Troll Volunteers recruited
Troll Volunteers delivered to Champion Uru'zin
Lady Of Da Tigers
fr: La dame des tigres

en: While imbued with the Spirit of the Tiger,lure the Tiger Matriarch out of hiding and use your new abilities to best it in combat.
fr: Pendant que vous êtes $gimprégné:imprégnée; de l'Esprit du tigre, attirez la Matriarche des tigres et utilisez vos nouvelles compétences pour l'affronter et la vaincre.

en: Remember de frogs ya made into me eyes and ears? Well,dey've found somethin' interestin'.$B$BOn an island to de southeast,dey've spied a tiger even de other cats seem to fear. Dis tiger,I've never seen anythin' like it.$B$BIt hunts wit' da instincts of a cat,but de mind of a person. It could be a powerful spirit and a strong ally.$B$BI'll be callin' down the spirit o' the tiger upon ya. Use its gifts to locate this cat and challenge it. See if ya can win its aid in our battle for the isles.
fr: Vous vous rappelez les grenouilles que vous avez fait mes yeux et mes oreilles ? Il y a un truc intéressant qu'elles ont trouvé.$B$BSur une île au sud-est, elles ont espionné un tigre que même les autres félins, ils ont peur de lui. Ce tigre, j'ai jamais rien vu de pareil.$B$BIl chasse avec les instincts du félin, mais avec l'esprit d'un troll. Il pourrait faire un très bon esprit et un allié mahous costaud.$B$BJe vais faire appel à l'esprit du tigre pour qu'il vienne sur vous. Utilisez ses dons pour trouver le fauve et pour le défier. Son aide, vous devez la gagner pour reconquérir les îles.

en: Return to Vol'jin at Sen'jin Village.
fr: Retournez voir Vol’jin à Sen’jin.

en: Challenge the Tiger Matriarch
Dance Of De Spirits
fr: La danse des esprits

en: Talk to Witch Doctor Hez'tok near the circle of ritual dancers outside Sen'jin Village when you're ready to consult the omens.
fr: Parlez au Féticheur Hez'tok près du cercle des danseurs rituels aux abords du Village de Sen'jin lorsque vous êtes $gprêt:prête; à faire appel aux augures.

en: De time has come to start thinkin' about when to make our move. Champion Uru'zin tells me his men be ready. You and Vanira done good work gatherin' information on de enemy and findin' us new allies.$B$BNow,we read de omens. We find out when to launch de attack.$B$BFind Witch Doctor Hez'tok near the circle of ritual dancers. He be startin' de ritual as soon as ya be ready.
fr: Le temps, il est venu de penser à notre prochain coup, mec. Le champion Uru'zin, il me dit que ses trolls sont prêts. Vous et Vanira, vous avez fait du bon travail pour récupérer les informations sur l'ennemi et pour trouver des nouveaux alliés.$B$BMaintenant, nous, on lit les augures. On découvrira quand on doit lancer l'attaque.$B$BTrouvez le féticheur Hez'tok, il est près du cercle des danseurs rituels. Il commencera son rituel dès que vous serez $gprêt:prête;.

en: Return to Vol'jin near Sen'jin Village.
fr: Retournez voir Vol’jin près du village de Sen’jin.

en: Dance of the Spirits
World Event Dungeon - Headless Horseman
fr: Donjon d'évènement saisonnier - Cavalier sans tête

en: World Event Dungeon - Coren Direbrew
fr: Donjon d'évènement saisonnier - Coren Navrebière

en: World Event Dungeon - Ahune
fr: Donjon d'évènement saisonnier - Ahune

en: World Event Dungeon - Hummel
fr: Donjon d'évènement saisonnier - Hummel

en: Preparin' For Battle
fr: Préparation au combat

en: Speak to Handler Marnlek for a flight to the staging area. Meet Vol'jin on the island east of the war camp.
fr: Parlez au Dresseur Marnlek pour obtenir un vol vers la zone de rassemblement. Retrouvez Vol'jin sur l'île à l'est du Camp de guerre.

en: Vol'jin be gatherin' his gear and readyin' de warriors. He ask me to tell ya to meet with him an' Vanira on de island to de east.$B$BFrom dere,he and de warriors will launch de attack on Zalazane. May de ancestors go wit' you,$N. Without ya,dis campaign would only be a shadow of what it become. Speak to Handler Marnlek,just to de south,an' he give you a bat to fly out to de stagin' area.
fr: Vol'jin, il prépare son équipement et ses guerriers. Il m'a demandé de vous dire de le retrouver avec Vanira sur l'île à l'est.$B$BDe là, lui et ses trolls, ils vont lancer l'attaque sur Zalazane. Que les ancêtres, ils soient avec vous, $n. Sans vous, la campagne qui se prépare, elle aurait été que l'ombre de ce qu'elle est maintenant. Parlez au dresseur Marnlek, il est au sud, et il vous prêtera une chauve-souris pour qu'elle vous emmène à la zone de rassemblement.

en: Words for Delivery
fr: Le discours de la libération

en: Give the speech to Captain Tread Sparknozzle at Steelgrill Depot.
fr: Apportez le discours au Capitaine Chape Étincetuyère au Dépôt de Grillacier.

en: Here we go. This is the speech, $N!$b$bIt has everything to be a great battle starter: It's inspirational, has eloquent language and speaks directly to gnomes. Never has a finer speech been written!$b$bTurn this in to Captain Tread Sparknozzle and see if there's anything else he needs of you.
fr: Nous y voilà. Voici le discours, $n!$B$BIl a tout pour motiver les troupes : il est stimulant, éloquent et il parle directement aux gnomes. On n'a jamais écrit un aussi bon discours !$B$BRapportez-le au capitaine Chape Étincetuyère et voyez s'il a besoin de quoi que ce soit d'autre.

en: Give the Speech to High Tinker Mekkatorque.
fr: Donnez le discours au Grand Bricoleur Mekkanivelle.

en: Trouble at Wyrmrest
fr: Troubles au Repos du ver

en: Speak with Krasus at Wyrmrest Temple in Dragonblight.
fr: Parlez à Krasus, au Temple du Repos du ver, dans la Désolation des dragons.

en: My old friend Krasus sends word of dire happenings at Wyrmrest, in Dragonblight. His missive was brief, but it seems that there has been some sort of attack on the Ruby Sanctum beneath the Temple.$B$BPressing business here in Dalaran keeps me from attending to the matter personally, but I have heard word of your exploits in the Lich King's Citadel and you are doubtless up to the task -- perhaps you could assist Krasus in my stead?

Fill every active slot with an enchantment of the appropriate quality.
Path to Ascension: Activating Mystic Scrolls
fr: Chemin vers l'Ascension : activation des parchemins mystiques

en: - Obtain a Mystic Enchanting Scroll by defeating enemies or trading other players.  - Interact with a Mystic Enchanting Altar found in your Capital City or in the World and select Enchant Scrolls tab.  - Activate a Mystic Scroll and apply it to an Active Enchant slot.

Mystic Enchanting Scrolls can be obtained by defeating enemies, found hidden throughout the world, or by trading other players.    Once obtained, visit a Mystic Enchanting Altar to apply a Mystic Scroll to gain its powers! Mystic Enchanting Altars can often be found summoned in Capital Cities, or you can venture into the world to visit one. Their locations are marked on the world map.    Mystic Enchants are key to unlocking your power as a Hero. Find Mystic Enchants that empower your spells or unlock whole new archetypes to increase your power.
Return to the Call Board.
Path to Ascension: Reforging and Mystic Extracts
fr: Chemin vers l'Ascension : Reforgeage et extraits mystiques

en: - Obtain an Untarnished Mystic Scroll from the Enchant Scrolls tab of the Mystic Altar.  - Reforge your Mystic Scroll to obtain new Mystic Enchants. You can continue reforging any Mystic Scroll until you find an Enchant you want to keep.  - Reforging Mystic Scrolls grants you progress towards a Mystic Extract.  - Reforge 5 times. Continue Reforging until you earn a Mystic Extract.

Visit an Altar and select the Enchant Scrolls tab, then Obtain an Untarnished Mystic Scroll.  Clicking Reforge on a Mystic Scroll will roll a new Mystic Enchant on the scroll and overwrite any existing enchant on the scroll. Reforging consumes Mystic Runes, or gold if you are out of Mystic Runes!  Each time you Reforge you earn experience towards your Mystic Enchanting level. Each level earned grants you a Mystic Extract which can be used to permanently apply Mystic Enchants to your Enchant Collection. This collection is shared across all characters on the realm!  Mystic Enchanting Altars can often be found summoned in Capital Cities, or you can venture into the world to visit one. Their locations are marked on the world map.
Return to the Call Board.
Path to Ascension: Mystic Enchant Collection
Select a Mystic Scroll from the Scrolls tab in the Mystic Altar, then hit Save to Collection.

Saving a Mystic Enchant to your collection permanently unlocks it for all characters on this realm, allowing you to apply that enchant from an Altar whenever you want without needing a scroll!  Adding Enchants to your collection destroys the scrolls and consumes a Mystic Extract. There is no limit to how many Mystic Extracts you can acquire, so be sure to save your favorite Mystic Enchants and ones critical to your build.  Select a Mystic Scroll from the Scrolls tab in the Mystic Altar, then hit Save to Collection.

To make matters worse, shortly after what happened to her girl, they stationed her husband at Windswept Watch, where he keeps guard day and night. And she, so very alone...$B$BWould you do me a kindness? Could you take her something to eat? en: A Strange Piece of Scrap
Take the Strange Piece of Scrap to the salvage engineer at the Rebel Camp or at Grom'gol Base Camp.

<The scrap is still warm and smells of machine oil. A half-scratched Venture Co. serial number is stamped on one side, and someone has scrawled "PROTOTYPE - DO NOT LOOT" beneath it.>$B$BAn engineer would know what this is. The Alliance has one at the Rebel Camp, and the Horde one at Grom'gol Base Camp.
Bring the scrap to a salvage engineer.
One Goblin's Junk

Bring Fizzlebolt Gearwhistle 6 Salvaged Gearboxes from the Venture Co. in northern Stranglethorn, a Shredder Power Core from a Venture Co. Shredder and a Volatile Fuel Canister from the Venture Co. Base Camp.

That serial number is Venture Co. stock, and the rest of it is still out there! The goblins strip this jungle for timber and ore, and they throw away more machinery than Gnomeregan ever built.$B$BI can assemble a proper salvage unit from their leftovers, but precision needs parts: six intact gearboxes from their workers, a power core out of one of their Shredders, and one of those volatile fuel canisters they stack at the Base Camp. Gently with that last one, please.
Return to Fizzlebolt Gearwhistle.
Assembly Required
Destroy the Haywire Lootbot Prototype at the Venture Co. Base Camp and bring its Calibrated Logic Core to Fizzlebolt Gearwhistle.

Gears, power, fuel... and still no brain. My logic core keeps sorting copper coins by smell.$B$BThe Venture Co. built a looting prototype of their own and lost control of it. It patrols their Base Camp, grabbing everything that isn't nailed down. Its logic core is perfectly calibrated. Destroy the machine and bring me that core.
Return to Fizzlebolt Gearwhistle.
Field Testing
Use the Lootbot Field Remote, then let the Lootbot collect 8 Field Test Samples from Venture Co. workers you defeat in Stranglethorn.

It works! At least, the schematics say it should.$B$BTake this remote and summon the Lootbot near the Venture Co. workers. Defeat them and let the Lootbot collect a field test sample from each one. Eight samples should give me enough data. Do stay close: it has not learned to be shy yet.
Return to Fizzlebolt Gearwhistle.
Licensed Salvage Assistant
Take the Salvage License Application to Baron Revilgaz in Booty Bay.

Eight perfect samples! It's ready.$B$BThere is one problem: Booty Bay owns the salvage rights along this coast, and an unlicensed Lootbot ends up as scrap on Baron Revilgaz's desk. I filled in the application. Take it to the Baron, and once it has his stamp, the Lootbot is yours.
Bring the application to Baron Revilgaz in Booty Bay.
One Goblin's Junk

Bring Grizzik Scrapsnatch 6 Salvaged Gearboxes from the Venture Co. in northern Stranglethorn, a Shredder Power Core from a Venture Co. Shredder and a Volatile Fuel Canister from the Venture Co. Base Camp.

Venture Co. junk! You know what that is, friend? Free inventory. Those Venture boys throw away more profit than Kezan makes in a year.$B$BHere's the pitch: a mechanical partner that picks up loot while you do the hard part. I need six working gearboxes from their workers, a power core out of one of their Shredders, and a fuel canister from their Base Camp. Don't shake that one.
Return to Grizzik Scrapsnatch.
Assembly Required
Destroy the Haywire Lootbot Prototype at the Venture Co. Base Camp and bring its Calibrated Logic Core to Grizzik Scrapsnatch.

Gears, power, fuel: the body's done. The brain's the expensive part.$B$BThe Venture Co. built a loot-grabbing prototype of their own and lost the remote, now it's tearing up their Base Camp. Its logic core is top quality. Smash the thing, bring me the core, and we save months of research.
Return to Grizzik Scrapsnatch.
Field Testing
Use the Lootbot Field Remote, then let the Lootbot collect 8 Field Test Samples from Venture Co. workers you defeat in Stranglethorn.

Every great product needs a field test before launch.$B$BTake this remote and summon the prototype near the Venture Co. workers. You knock them down, it picks up a sample from each one. Eight samples should convince any investor. Stay close: it hasn't figured out who it works for yet.
Return to Grizzik Scrapsnatch.
Licensed Salvage Assistant
Take the Salvage License Application to Baron Revilgaz in Booty Bay.

Eight samples! We've got a product!$B$BOne small detail: Booty Bay owns the salvage rights here, and Baron Revilgaz takes his cut of everything. I filled in the license application. Take it to the Baron in Booty Bay, get his stamp, and the Lootbot is all yours.
Bring the application to Baron Revilgaz in Booty Bay.

en: Visit an Altar and apply a Mystic Enchant from your Enchant Collection to an Active Enchant slot.

Open the Enchant Collection tab from a Mystic Altar, select an Enchant from your Enchant Collections and apply it to an Active Enchant slot, then select Save Changes to activate your Mystic Enchant.  Activating Enchants from your collection requires Mystic Orbs, which can be earned from Daily Quests on the Call Board, Dungeons and Raids, Battlegrounds or defeating enemies in the world!  1 Legendary Enchant can be applied to the large center slot in the Altar.  3 Epic Enchants can be applied in the medium slots in the inner ring.  You can apply as many Rare and Uncommon Enchants in the remaining slots as you'd like. Many of these Enchants can stack up to 3 times. en: ...Minervia?    Now there's a name I haven't heard for years. If you're here, it seems you've got a pretty good idea about her.    Before Morganth became the Mage of Ilgalar, the one who ruled this tower was a scholar of dark magics by the name of Minervia. She had studied with Mage Theocritus in Dalaran many years before, and though she was our enemy, he always spoke of her with admiration. It was years ago now that he finally managed to bring Azora's wisdom to her, and our greatest enemy turned away from Ilgalar's path.    Whatever she may have done, we seek only enlightenment, not vengeance, and all amongst us were most pleased with this outcome. Theocritus most of all.    Still, Theocritus has spoken of how much that past haunted her new life even still. I don't know what became of her, but I only hope she was able to find her own peace with that past in the end.

en:
I apologize. I hadn't expected any news of him, but I'll be fine. If he remembers my name, there might still be some hope.

Our farmstead was attacked by worgen some time back, we tried to flee, but they were faster. So my husband...he...he told me to run, and started fighting. Neither of us are fighters, but I didn't know what to do, so I listened. I ran until I found myself here...I never saw him again after that.

I haven't tried to return. There's nothing left for me there now, and I've heard even though the worgen are gone, it's been taken by bandits now.

Still, maybe there's something left there that he might recognize, some trace of his old life. It might be your best chance.

Je m'excuse. Je ne m'attendais à aucune nouvelle de lui, mais tout ira bien. S'il se souvient de mon nom, il y aura peut-être encore un peu d'espoir.

Aucun de nous n'est un combattant, mais je ne savais pas quoi faire, alors j'ai écouté. J'ai couru jusqu'à me retrouver ici... Je ne l'ai plus jamais revu après ça.

Je n'ai pas essayé de revenir. Il ne reste plus rien pour moi là-bas maintenant, et j'ai entendu dire que même si les worgens étaient partis, des bandits s'en étaient emparés.

Pourtant, il reste peut-être quelque chose qu'il pourrait reconnaître, une trace de son ancienne vie. C'est peut-être votre meilleure chance.

en: Visit an Altar and select the Enchant Scrolls tab, then Obtain an Untarnished Mystic Scroll.  Clicking Reforge on a Mystic Scroll will roll a new Mystic Enchant on the scroll and overwrite any existing enchant on the scroll. Reforging consumes Mystic Runes, or gold if you are out of Mystic Runes!  Each time you Reforge you earn experience towards your Mystic Enchanting level. Mystic Enchanting Altars can often be found summoned in Capital Cities, or you can venture into the world to visit one. Their locations are marked on the world map.

en: Path to Ascension: End Game Builds
Open the Hero Architect and load a level 70 build.

Max level builds are significantly more powerful than leveling builds. It's vital that you upgrade your build at max level to succeed in end-game content.  You can find many end-game ready builds in the Hero Architect. Hit N, then click the Hero Architect Tab, then select either Level 60 or 70 Builds depending on your current level.  You can scroll through high rated end game builds to find one that matches your playstyle!   End-game builds rely on Mystic Enchants. Each build will show the required Mystic Enchants at the bottom of the build page. You should acquire the Legendary and Epic enchants suggested immediately to ensure the build works as intended, then seek out the Blue and Green enchants as soon as possible.  It is highly recommended you try out featured builds before trying to create your own end-game build. You can also reference high rated builds when creating your own to start with a strong foundation.  Once you choose a build and begin to grow comfortable with it, don't be afraid to experiment and adjust the build to your specific style of play.

Defeat an Invasion Boss.

An invasion is a periodic World Event that spawns throughout Azeroth that scales to how many players are near the zone. en: Choosing to Prestige will reset your character to level 1 and teleport you to your starting zone.  Prestige is a great way to earn gear, Mystic Enchanting supplies, Marks of Ascension and more! Re-experience the leveling journey, Dungeons and Battlegrounds with all the knowledge you have acquired, including your saved Mystic Enchants!  What happens:  - Your current specialization is reset. - Your equipped gear will be mailed to you. - All leveling quests will be reset and available to be completed again. - Your quest log will be wiped.  Prestiging in Wildcard resets your currently selected specialization!    Your current Wildcard Specialization will: - Unlearn all spells and talents. This resets your active build! - Removes Scrolls of Fortune for that specialization. - Resets Scroll of Fortune quests at Silas for that specialization. - Removes Cases of Fortune. - All other Specs will remain locked until you reach max level. - You can activate new Skill Cards for your Prestiged Spec. - Your equipped gear will be mailed to you. - All leveling quests will be reset and available to be completed again. - Your quest log will be wiped.  You will keep all professions, gear, Marks of Ascension, currencies and items except for your Prestiged Spec's Unspent Hand of Fates. If you have advanced riding training you will receive a tome that will allow you to relearn your riding at the appropriate level.

en: Path to Ascension: Mystic Enchant Specializations

- Open your Enchant Collection from the Character Advancement menu or use an Altar.  - Click the 'Change' button at the bottom left to change your Enchant Specialization.  - Select a different Specialization then Activate.

You start with 2 Mystic Enchant Specializations. You can swap your Enchant Specialization anytime outside of combat for free!     Unlocking a new Specialization with a Tome of Specialization will also unlock a new Enchant Specialization. Use Mystic Enchant: Specialization tomes to unlock even more Enchant specs!    Mystic Enchanting Specializations allow you to create different loadouts for your Active Enchants. This allows you to:   - Swap your enchants to try out different builds on the fly.   - Maintain different Enchant loadouts if you use multi-spec to play different builds.  - Adapt to specific scenarios and encounters.  - Quickly switch between PvE and PvP Enchant loadouts.

en:
The dunes are restless.

When the sand rises and takes form, it is not anger. It is warning. The desert gathers itself when something has disturbed its balance, when footsteps linger too long or blood is spilled without reason.

Those creatures you have seen moving across the dunes are not elementals in the way you understand them. They are the dunes answering intrusion.

Face one of them. When it falls, the sand it leaves behind will still be warm with motion. That is living sand. Take only what remains. Do not scatter it. Do not linger.
fr:
Les dunes sont agitées.

Quand le sable monte et prend forme, ce n'est pas de la colère. C'est un avertissement. Le désert se rassemble quand quelque chose a perturbé son équilibre, quand les pas s'attardent trop longtemps ou quand le sang coule sans raison.

Les créatures que vous avez vues se déplacer à travers les dunes ne sont pas des élémentaires au sens où vous les comprenez. Ce sont les dunes qui répondent à l'intrusion.

Affrontez l'un d'eux. Lorsqu'il tombe, le sable qu'il laisse derrière lui sera encore chaud à cause du mouvement. C'est du sable vivant. Ne prenez que ce qui reste. Ne le dispersez pas. Ne vous attardez pas.

We have recently had our alchemists doing some unsanctioned chemical weapons research.. To sum it up, we were trying to make a poison bomb. In hindsight, maybe we shouldn't have diverted all of our resources to such a ridiculous project, but hindsight is 20/20, right? Anyways, all of our herbalists are... indisposed at the moment.. Due to some mysterious and completely unrelated mass poisoning.

We still have deadlines to meet. Our alchemists require 15 Ghost Mushrooms. Naturally, you will be handsomely rewarded for your assistance, hero.
fr:
Appel à tous les héros !

Nous avons récemment demandé à nos alchimistes de faire des recherches non autorisées sur les armes chimiques. Pour résumer, nous essayions de fabriquer une bombe empoisonnée. Avec le recul, nous n'aurions peut-être pas dû consacrer toutes nos ressources à un projet aussi ridicule, mais le recul est de 20/20, n'est-ce pas ? Quoi qu'il en soit, tous nos herboristes sont... indisposés pour le moment. À cause d'un mystérieux empoisonnement de masse sans aucun rapport.

Nous avons encore des délais à respecter. Nos alchimistes ont besoin de 15 champignons fantômes. Naturellement, vous serez généreusement récompensé pour votre aide, héros.

en: Greetings, Recruit!$B$BSome trainers cling to the old ways, sending fresh adventurers trudging across the land for what feels like forty miles uphill both ways. That won't be necessary here. You'll learn Novice Riding for a nominal fee, granting you your first mount and a steady 40% increase in speed.$B$BThere's more than enough to keep you busy on your journey, discovering treasures, honing your skills, and testing your mettle. No sense slowing you down when the world is waiting.$B$BHere, we'd rather see you ride than wear out your boots. When you've gained more skill, and coin, you may return to a riding trainer to improve your riding skill and increase your mount speed even further.

en: Keeping Evil At Bay: Invasion Point: Cataclysm (High-Risk)
Slay 8 Catacylsm Overseers and 6 Fel Reaver Sentinels.

A legion of infernals is preparing a massive assault on Shattrath City! The Skyguard will have no trouble bombing their staging ground once we eliminate the Cataclysm Overseers guarding the area. You must secure Invasion Point: Cataclysm for the Skyguard to ensure Shattrath Cities safety.
Return to the call board.
Keeping Evil At Bay: Eclipsion Fields (High-Risk)
Slay 5 Crazed Colossus.

Shadowmoon Valley has no shortage of threats to our operations in Outlands. The Colossus rarely wander from their stomping grounds, the giants in the Eclipsion Fields have grown Crazed. Simply avoiding them is no longer an option. Assemble a group of heroes and exterminate the threat.
Return to the call board.
Keeping Evil At Bay: The Path of Conquest (High-Risk)
Slay 8 Sons of Gordok and 4 Illidari Watchers.

The Blood Elves and Giants have begun cooperating in Shadowmoon Valley. This alliance is unprecedented and the consequences impossible to predict. We must investigate the issue immediately. Travel to the Path of Conquest and eliminate the Sons of Gordok and any security around Crimson Watch so our investigators can gather more information surrounding this alliance.
Return to the call board.
Keeping Evil At Bay: Arklonis Ridge (High-Risk)
Slay 6 Farahlon Giants.

Farahlon Giants have begun to assemble at Arklonis Ridge in the Netherstorm. Their numbers have grown so much that the goblins of Area 52 report a huge uptick in seismic activity. So much so that their rocket is in danger of tipping over! They assure us everything meets safety requirements, but Goblin Engineering being Goblin Engineering it is best to eliminate the giants before they unintentionally destroy Area 52.
Return to the call board.
Keeping Evil At Bay: Netherstone (High-Risk)
Slay 12 Farahlon Breakers.

The Skyguard has developed a new experimental bomb for clearing out infernal staging grounds. The good news is that these bombs are highly effective, the bad news is that they require Netherstone and the extraction process is lengthy and dangerous. Extraction becomes nearly impossible with giants stomping around smashing up the gear and workers. Clear out the Farahlon Breakers around the Netherstone in the Netherstorm.
Return to the call board.
Keeping Evil At Bay: Fallen Sky Ridge (High-Risk)
Slay 20 Raging Colossus.

We have never seen so many Colossus gathered in one area. It is unclear if the giants are gathering around Fallen Sky Ridge or somehow being created there. What is clear is that this threat must be dealt with while we still can. Travel to Hellfire Peninsula and break up the Raging Colossus.
Return to the call board.
Keeping Evil At Bay: The Forge Camps (High-Risk)
Destroy 8 Felguard Legionnaires and 8 Mo'arg Engineers.

The Skyguard has lost countless flyers in missions over Nagrand's Forge Camps. The Legion is completely entrenched and our only remaining option is a ground assault. Assault Forge Camp: Fear and Hate in Nagrand and slay the Felguards operating the Fel Cannons that have claimed so many of our flyers. Destroying the Mo'arg Enginners will disrupt the Legions attempts at rebuilding new cannons and allow our bombing missions to continue.
Return to the call board.
Keeping Evil At Bay: The Twilight Ridge (High-Risk)
Slay 5 Deathshadow Overlords and 12 Deathshadow Warlocks.

Our scouts spotted an enormous structure during a routine fly over Nagrand. They were unable to scout closer but all reports indicate that structure may be a portal. We don’t yet know the intention, but they are without a doubt hostile. Travel to the Twilight Ridge and put an end to this dark work.
Return to the call board.

After the sundering of Draenor, most life was wiped out during collapse of the barrier between Draenor and the Twisting Nether and the resulting explosion. The wildlife that survived became sickly or corrupt, and many of Ner'zhul's portals were left permanently open, allowing all manner of dangerous beings to enter Outland and threaten our presence here.  The Broken Skeleton population is becoming a real threat. Travel to The Bone Wastes and cull 30 of them.

She waits in the field beyond the fallen silvermyst tree, south-east of Vindicator Aldar's camp. Read it before you return to your duties here.
Seek out Mazhaara beyond the fallen silvermyst tree south-east of Vindicator Aldar's camp in Ammen Vale.
Speak to Mazhaara beyond the fallen silvermyst tree south-east of Vindicator Aldar's camp in Ammen Vale
Charts of the Great Dark
Seek out Astraan on the open knoll north of the graveyard in Ammen Vale.

This was left in my keeping for you, $N. It appears to be a chart of the stars, and they twinkle on the page with real starlight - the very stars we crossed aboard the Exodar.$B$BIt comes from Astraan, who reads the heavens from the open knoll north of the graveyard. Read it before you return to your duties here.
Seek out Astraan on the open knoll north of the graveyard in Ammen Vale.
Speak to Astraan on the open knoll north of the graveyard in Ammen Vale
Salvage and Schematics
Seek out Artificer Bolaan among the salvage crates inside the Crash Site in Ammen Vale.

This was left in my keeping for you, $N. It appears to be a set of schematics covered in designs for crystal-powered devices; I can hear a faint ticking from between its pages.$B$BIt comes from Artificer Bolaan, who is sorting salvage from the wreck inside the Crash Site, near Aurok. Read it before you return to your duties here.
Seek out Artificer Bolaan among the salvage crates inside the Crash Site in Ammen Vale.
Speak to Artificer Bolaan among the salvage crates inside the Crash Site in Ammen Vale
The Silent Harvest
Seek out Sorashii the Silent by the wrecked escape pod west of Botanist Taerix's tent in Ammen Vale.

This was left in my keeping for you, $N. It appears to be a letter bound in black leather that seems to draw the light out of the air around it.$B$BIt comes from Sorashii the Silent, who watches over the wrecked escape pod west of Botanist Taerix's tent, where some of our people did not survive the fall. Read it before you return to your duties here.
Seek out Sorashii the Silent by the wrecked escape pod west of Botanist Taerix's tent in Ammen Vale.
Speak to Sorashii the Silent by the wrecked escape pod west of Botanist Taerix's tent in Ammen Vale
The Elements Obey
Seek out Elduur beneath the silvermyst trees in the meadow north-west of Proenitus' camp in Ammen Vale.

This was left in my keeping for you, $N. It appears to be a scroll that crackles with raw elemental power; tiny storms, flames and tremors swirl across it.$B$BIt comes from Elduur, who commands the elements beneath the silvermyst trees in the meadow north-west of this camp. Read it before you return to your duties here.
Seek out Elduur beneath the silvermyst trees in the meadow north-west of Proenitus' camp in Ammen Vale.
Speak to Elduur beneath the silvermyst trees in the meadow north-west of Proenitus' camp in Ammen Vale
Runes Older Than Argus
Seek out Scribe Taalan at the foot of the great silvermyst crystal west of Proenitus' camp in Ammen Vale.

This was left in my keeping for you, $N. It appears to be a tablet carved with runes that glow with their own light; the symbols are older than any I learned on Argus.$B$BIt comes from Scribe Taalan, who studies them at the foot of the great silvermyst crystal, west of this camp. Read it before you return to your duties here.
Seek out Scribe Taalan at the foot of the great silvermyst crystal west of Proenitus' camp in Ammen Vale.
Speak to Scribe Taalan at the foot of the great silvermyst crystal west of Proenitus' camp in Ammen Vale
Grave-Etched Tablet
Seek out Alessia in Deathknell.

I was asked to bring this to your attention, young one. It appears to be a slab of broken headstone gouged with barbarian war-runes, and the rage in them did not die with the one who carved them. It seems to be from Alessia, who teaches the barbarian's way in Deathknell. I wouldn't hesitate to read it before you continue your duties here.
Seek out Alessia in Deathknell.
Welcome to the Warband
Kill Mortimer and return back to your trainer.

Har! Har! Welcome, $N. Glad you could join the Warband.  What is the Warband, you might be wondering? Considering your arrival, I would have assumed you'd already know. Well, little $c, this is about to be a rude awakening.  The Warband is where all barbarians, brutes, and strongmen alike come together to compete to see who is the strongest, most brutal, and most powerful individual of them all.  That's the only way we can TRULY test our mettle. THIS IS IT! You may be new to this, but absolutely nobody will go easy on you.  Your first test will be the same as all the other rookies. There's an individual who has been mucking things up and spreading rumors just because they couldn't cut it and were denied access to the Warband.  They're known as Mortimer. Kill him, hahaha! I will reward you with a weapon well-suited for a noob like yourself if you are capable of such a task.  Come back to me alive, or die.
Return to your trainer.
Soul Harvest
fr: Récolte d'âme

en: Seek out Zul’raja the Harvester in the Valley of Trials.

I was asked to bring this to your attention, young reaper. It appears to be a grim letter bound in black leather that seems to drain light from its surroundings. It seems to be from Zul’raja the Harvester, who teaches the reaper's way in the Valley of Trials. I wouldn't hesitate to read it before you continue your duties here.
Seek out Zul’raja the Harvester in the Valley of Trials.
Call of the Shadowlands
Visit Old Brokthar in the Valley of Trials.

Keep grinnin' at me helmet like dat, and dese blades gonna find ya chest, $N.    ...ya be bold, mon. I can feel ya come here to learn. I got a simple task for ya today, young $C.    In the valley is an old orc who is nearing his end. In his prime, he was a behemoth on the battlefield and took many lives. But now, he sits out his days by the burial ground east of the camp.    He will die and the Shadowlands will claim him. But today is not his day. Yet, I can feel his yearning to leave this plane, but he is unaware of what lays before him once he is gone.    You may not have expected such a task, but I would humbly ask you to pay him a visit and have a chat.
Return to your trainer.
Chat with Old Brokthar
Yes, mighty $C, I sensed your arrival. I trust you have more news to report to me about your hunt?
fr: Oui, j'ai senti votre arrivée, puissant $C. J'espère que vous avez d'autres nouvelles à me donner sur votre chasse ?

en: Oh, a shipment from my brother? Splendid! Fortune truly shines on me today!
fr: Oh ! une cargaison envoyée par mon frère. Splendide ! La chance est avec moi aujourd'hui !

en: Did you find Garrick's shack? Are we finally free of that villain?
fr: Avez-vous trouvé la cabane de Garrick ? Sommes-nous finalement débarrassés de ce scélérat ?

en: How goes the hunting, $N? Have you found and defeated those vermin?
Yes? Yes? What is it?$B$BThe forsaken; they certainly do have huge appetites. Make yourself at home... yes, rest those weary bones. My name's Renee if you need anything at all.
fr: Oui ? Oui ? Qu'est-ce que c'est ?$B$BPour une race qui n'a pas besoin de respirer sous l'eau, ils ont vraiment un appétit féroce. Faites comme chez vous... Je m'appelle Renée, si vous avez besoin de quoi que ce soit.

en: Ah, I see you're back! I hope you've been hard at work clearing those fields of those Harvest Watchers. Have you killed twenty yet?
Well, what news do you have?  You look like you've been in quite the fight... is Scrimshank alive?
fr: Bien, quelles nouvelles avez-vous ? Vous semblez avoir passé de sales moments... Scrimshank est-il vivant ?

en: Hail, $N. Have you been killing Gnolls...?
fr: Bonjour, $N. Vous avez tué des gnolls ?

en: Perhaps I did not make myself clear, pledge. In order to prove your worth as a servant to The People's Militia and to the Light you need to slay 15 Defias Trappers and 15 Defias Smugglers then return to me when the deed is done.

We have not time to talk, $N. The Defias Pillagers are denying the people of Westfall the peace and prosperity they deserve. Make sure at least 15 Defias Pillagers and 15 Defias Looters have been killed. That will send a clear message that corruption is not welcome here.

$N, now is no time for idle chatter. If you still wish to prove yourself to The People's Militia you need to slay the Defias I notified you about earlier. Return to me when you have completed your duty.
Have you been to the mines? Are you ready to report?
Farming is thirsty work, and I'm always looking for refreshing spring water.$B$BIf you have any, then I'm willing to make a trade.
Have you obtained the magenta fungus caps I need for my alchemical work? No caps - no reward!
fr: Vous avez les champignons magenta dont j'ai besoin pour mes travaux ? Pas de champignons, pas de récompense !

en: Have you gathered those bandanas for me yet?
fr: M'avez-vous déjà ramené les masques ?

en: Orc pressure from Blackrock is still tense. But have you at least rid us of Tharil'zun?
fr: La pression des orcs Rochenoire est toujours forte. Mais nous avez-vous débarrassés de Tharil'zun ?

en: Have you been slaying orcs, $N? If so, then show me...
fr: Avez-vous exterminé les orcs, $N ? Si c'est le cas, alors montrez-moi...

en: I know it's bloody work, $N, but it's vital to the safety of Northshire. Are you ready to report?
All I need for my famous meat pie are 8 Goretusk Livers!
Ah - $N - I was just thinking about you! How goes your hunting?
Greetings once again, $N! Have you come to show me proof of your hunt?
You back already? What's the situation out there - all cleared up now, thanks to you?

Have you formed your pendant for me to inspect, $N? If you need help in locating the parts, try asking the local populace for information. Not only will you find what you seek, but it will give you a reason to explore this wondrous and sacred glade.

Your return to Thunder Bluff is not without heralding, though I will need proof of your lessons learned in Moonglade before I will teach you your aquatic form.$B$BDo you have the Pendant of the Sea Lion?
I'm sorry. I don't know you... but from the look of things you have at least heard something of me. Now, what can I help you with? Do you have something for me?
Hey $N. How goes the hunt for wolves?
Is Bellygrub still at it or were you able to rid Lakeshire of the pest once and for all?
fr: Fouailleventre est-il toujours en vie, ou avez-vous débarrassé Comté-du-lac de cette nuisance une bonne fois pour toutes ?

en: I'm going to miss that Verna Furlbrow so much. I don't suppose you happened to see her on your way here?
fr: Verna Froncebouille va beaucoup me manquer. Je suppose que vous ne l'avez pas vue en venant ?

en: Come back with the following ingredients: $b $b 3 Stringy Vulture Meat $b 3 Goretusk Snouts $b 3 Murloc Eyes $b 3 Okra
fr: Rapporter les ingrédients suivants : $B $B 3 morceaux de Viande filandreuse de vautour ; $B 3 Groins de broche-tripes ; $B 3 Yeux de murloc ; $B 3 Okras.

en: How goes the hunting, $N?
fr: Alors, comment s'est passée la chasse, $N ?

en: Psst! You have that Gold Dust for me...for me?
fr: Psst ! Vous avez de la poussière d'or pour moi... pour moi ?

en: Hiccup! Ho ho! You want an encore?$B$BIn the land to the south where vines twist and creep$BLies a hidden well where the water runs deep$BPure as the Light's sacred Daughter$BBring to me now some Holy Spring Water.

Encore? Well, sure!$B$BAmber is the hue of my life's longest love$BLike the last embers of dusk in the sky above$BRetrieve for me so that my love shall be born$BOne sack of each: barley, rye and corn.

An encore for you? Well sure friend!$B$BI'll mix and mix till we have a mash$BFor this will be our own private stash$BA still must be fashioned of metal strong$BBring me some Truesilver so I can finish this song.

An encore? Why for you, anything!$B$BNot yet filtered but freshly distilled$BLike unseeded land waiting there tilled.$BNext I will fashion our pile of charcoal$BDeliver a sycamore branch, that is your next goal.
Have you killed those wolves and bears?

Sure, I'll sing it again for you, friend!$B$BMellifluous liquid clear as a baby's tears$BTurns a lovely deep amber over the years$BBut before we proceed to get lit to the hilt$BA barrel of charred oak must be built.
You have word from McBride? Northshire is a garden compared to Elwynn Forest, but I wonder what Marshal McBride has to report.$b$bHere, let me have his papers...
fr: Vous avez des nouvelles de McBride ? Comté-du-nord est un jardin d'enfant comparé à la forêt d'Elwynn, mais je me demande de quoi le maréchal McBride veut m'informer.$B$BBien, laissez-moi jeter un coup d'œil sur ces documents...

en: Is Morbent Fel defeated?!
fr: Morbent Lagangrène est-il vaincu ?

en: Have you killed those warriors and mages?
Return to me once you have killed 15 Skeletal Fiends and 15 Skeletal Horrors, $N.
I need your assistance, $N. Travel to the cemetery to the northwest and rid the eastern mausoleum of 20 Plague Spreaders.$B$BReturn to me when your task is complete.
I have been commissioned by the Stormwind Army to supply their people with cloth and leather armor.$b$bIf you have a marker for me, then I'd be happy to make you something.
fr: L'armée de Hurlevent m'a chargé de fournir ses troupes en vêtements et en armures de cuir.$B$BSi vous avez un bon, je serai ravie de faire quelque chose pour vous.

en: Did you gather those candles yet?
fr: Avez-vous déjà récupéré les bougies ?

en: Oh, a shipment from my brother? Splendid! Fortune truly shines on me today!
fr: Oh ! une cargaison envoyée par mon frère. Splendide ! La chance est avec moi aujourd'hui !

en: What do you have to report, $N? Have you been to the Fargodeep Mine?

The brazier still reflects the ambient light from the are, and the flame shifts slightly as you move closer.$B$BThe corruption along the hills seems to have kept its distance, and besides the missing components, the brazier looks prepared for the ritual to summon a cleansed manifestation of water.
Don't suppose you were able to get my watch?
fr: Je suppose que vous n'avez pas retrouvé ma montre ?

en: Ah, I remember you. You're the one who was asking about that Stalvan fellow. Did you ever find what you were looking for?
fr: Oui, je me souviens de vous. Vous êtes une des personnes qui se renseignaient sur Stalvan. Avez-vous finalement trouvé ce que vous cherchiez ?

en: What have ya got there? Let me take a look at that. . .
fr: Qu'est-ce que vous avez là ? Laissez-moi jeter un coup d'œil…

en: Hello, $N. Have you discovered the fates of Rolf and Malakai?
fr: Bonjour, $N. Avez-vous découvert ce qui est arrivé à Rolf et Malakai ?

en: What have you got there? I cannot see. My eyesight is very bad. Put it in my hands.
fr: Qu'est-ce que vous avez trouvé ? Je n'arrive pas à voir. J'ai une très mauvaise vue. Mettez-le-moi dans la main.

en: Did you find that page I mentioned, $N?
Hail, $N. What do you have to report? Have you scouted the Jasperlode Mine?
I trust that your arrival here at our camp is to deliver the bottles of ripple that are integral to the task at hand, yes?
fr: J'imagine que votre retour à notre camp signifie que vous venez livrer les bouteilles de Houle... Non ?

en: Marshal Haggard sent you? Why didn't you say so?$B$BAh, good ol' Haggard. Poor chap is going to be completely blind before long. Anyway, let me see what you've got there.
fr: Le maréchal Haggard vous envoie ? Pourquoi ne pas l'avoir dit ?$B$BAh ! c'te bon vieux Haggard. Ce pov'gars, y va devenir complètement aveugle d'ici peu. Bon, enfin, faites donc voir c'que vous avez là.

en: This better be good, $C. Let me see what you have and tell me your tale. But by the Light, be quick about it. Darkshire's defense is my number one priority. I have not the time to squander on dead-end leads.
fr: Ça a intérêt à être important, $C. Faites voir ce que vous avez et racontez-moi votre histoire. Mais par la Lumière, soyez bref. La défense de Sombre-comté est ma priorité numéro un. Je n'ai pas de temps à perdre avec des futilités.

en: Back again, $N? What do you have this time?
If you're not here to buy anything, and you're not here to deliver anything, then you're wasting my time! You better have that ripple!
fr: Si vous n'êtes pas ici pour acheter ou pour me livrer quelque chose, alors vous me faites perdre mon temps ! Vous avez intérêt à avoir cette houle !

en: You're Junior Surveyor $N, yes? Quickly now, there is a dire situation at hand! Do you have the insect parts that Fizzledowser said you would?!
fr: Vous avez le titre de géomètre novice, $N ? Alors vite, nous avons un problème grave à régler ! Avez-vous les morceaux d'insectes dont m'a parlé Radiésthéflop ?!

en: I'm running low on linen, $N. Do you have any for me?
fr: Je commence à manquer de lin, $N. Vous avez quelque chose pour moi ?

en: Ugh... I'm starving! Do you have that pie for me, $N?
I don't think it's right feeding the boy who stole my necklace in the first place, but if that's what it takes to get back what's mine, then so be it!$b$bDo you have that boar meat?
fr: Je ne pense pas que cela soit judicieux, ni très juste, de nourrir ce chenapan alors qu'il m'a volé mon collier. Mais si c'est la seule solution pour récupérer mon bijou... !$B$BAvez-vous de la Viande de sanglier ?

en: Hello, $N. Have you found my necklace?
fr: Bonjour, $N. Avez-vous trouvé mon collier ?

en: Did you see her yet? Did you get her?
fr: Alors, vous l'avez vue ? Vous l'avez eue ?

en: This bridge isn't going to build itself! Now where are those iron pikes and iron rivets?
fr: Ce pont ne va pas se construire tout seul ! Où sont mes clous et mes rivets en fer ?

en: Were you able to find 10 Lean Wolf Flanks yet? How about the herbs from Felicia in Stormwind?
fr: Avez-vous été capable de récupérer les 10 Steaks de loup ? Et pour les herbes de Felicia ?

en: Turn in 10 Shadowhide Pendants to me, and you shall be rewarded.
fr: Apportez-moi 10 Pendentifs sombrepoil, et vous serez récompensé.

en: I still need five pieces of Tough Condor Meat, five Great Goretusk Snouts and five helpings of Crisp Spider Meat.
fr: J'ai toujours besoin de 5 morceaux de Viande de condor coriace, 5 Groins de grands Broche-tripes et 5 portions de Chair croustillante d'araignée.

en: Hail, $N. Did you get those Gooey Spider Legs yet?
fr: Bonjour, $N. Avez-vous les Pattes d'araignée fondantes ?

en: This Lion Statue has sat here for decades, and keeps a lonely watch over the infamous Tower of Ilgalar.$B$BThere is a depression at the base of the statue, where a gem or glyph might be set...
fr: Cette Statue de lion est là depuis des décennies, et garde un œil sur l'infâme Tour d'Ilgalar.$B$BIl y a une cavité à la base de statue, où l'on peut placer une gemme ou un glyphe...

en: You've returned. Splendid!$B$BHow went your journey to Silverpine? Did it take you long?$B$BIt is hard for me to tell if you were successful there because so much of the land has become corrupt. Its stench overwhelms any good that you might have done. But small successes are sometimes as important as large ones. Purifying the water there was instrumental for you, and for all shamans.
Yes, $N?
fr: Oui, Silhantcat ?

en: Yes, $N?
fr: Oui, Silhantcat ?

en: Have you secured the Pyrewood Shackles yet, $N?
Bring to me 10 ghoul fangs, 10 skeleton fingers and 5 vials of spider venom. For you I shall enchant a Totem of Infliction which will harm those who attempt violent acts against you.
fr: Apportez-moi 10 crocs de goule, 10 doigts de Squelette et 5 fioles de venin d'araignée. J’enchanterai alors un Totem d'affliction qui blessera ceux qui tenteront de vous agresser.

en: Have you collected 8 paws from those treacherous Gnolls yet?
fr: Avez-vous 8 pattes de ces traîtres de gnolls ?

en: The flame will not burn for long without oil, $N.
Have you laid waste to the menace known as Old Murk-Eye yet? He has been spotted roaming the coastline of Westfall.$B$BReturn to me when the foul beast is dead.
fr: La menace que représente le Vieux Troubloeil a-t-elle été éradiquée ? On l'a repéré en train de vagabonder près du littoral de la marche de l'Ouest.$B$BRevenez quand cette immonde bête sera morte.

en: Your task has been given to you, $N. Do you have a shard from the lich's phylactery as proof of the task being accomplished?
fr: Une tâche vous a été confiée, $N. Avez-vous un éclat phylactère de la liche comme preuve de votre réussite ?

en: You have what?? Maybell is the light of my dull life. Hurry, let me see her letter!
fr: Qu'est-ce que vous avez ? Maybell est le soleil de ma vie. Vite, donnez-moi cette lettre !

en: You have a note from "Gramma" Stonefield, eh? I haven't seen Mildred in years! I wonder what she has to say...
fr: Vous avez un mot de "Mamie" Champierreux, hein ? Je n'ai pas vue Mildred depuis des lustres ! Je me demande ce qu'elle veut...

en: An... Any luck??
fr: Est-ce que par hasard...?

en: I can't wait to hear how my friends react!$B$BThey'll never expect it
Do you have that crystal kelp? I'm sure Maybell is anxious to see her beau...
fr: Avez-vous ce varech cristallin ? Je suis sûr que Maybell est impatiente de voir son galant...

en: Well Junior Surveyor $n, has ol' Pestlezugg got that report ready yet?
Did you deliver my letter to Tommy Joe? What did he say??
fr: Avez-vous remis ma lettre à Tommy Joe ? Qu'a-t-il dit ?

en: How goes your conflict with the shadowcasters? Did you find the midnight orbs?
fr: Comment se passe votre guerre contre les exhalombres ? Avez-vous trouvé les orbes de minuit ?

en: I need you to pick up a keg of Thunderbrew Lager from Grimbooze Thunderbrew in the Westfall hills, a cask of Merlot from Stormwind, a bottle of Moonshine from Darkshire and a skin of Sweet Rum from Goldshire. Bring those back to me and I will see to it you are rewarded.
fr: J'ai besoin que vous récupériez un tonneau de Tonnebière de chez Tristevin Tonnebière dans les collines de la marche de l'Ouest, un tonneau de merlot de Hurlevent, une bouteille de tord-boyaux de Sombre-comté et une outre de rhum doux de Comté-de-l’or. Rapportez-les-moi et je ferai en sorte que vous soyez récompensée.

en: Hurry, my friend, move with haste $bIn order for our rich lager to taste $bMore like beer and less like stew, $bHops are needed to make the brew.
fr: Allez-donc, mon ami, sans tarder hâtez-vous !$BPour que notre breuvage, fidèle à mes dosages,$BTienne plus de la bière que d’un mauvais ragoût,$BIl me manque du houblon pour en faire le brassage.

en: What's that? Verner sent you, you say? Well give me his note. And SPEAK UP!
fr: Qu'est-ce que c'est ? Verner vous a envoyé, dites-vous ? Bon ! Donnez-moi son message. Et PARLEZ PLUS FORT !

en: Great, you're back! Did you get the shoes?
fr: Ah ! Vous êtes de retour ! Avez-vous obtenu les fers ?

en: What have you there?
fr: Qu'avez-vous là ?

en: Did the General send news? Are reinforcements on the way?
fr: Le général a-t-il envoyé des nouvelles ? Les renforts sont-ils en chemin ?

en: I know that greedy Argus will send someone to collect his scales if I don't give them to him soon. Have you found those scales yet?
fr: Je sais que le cupide Argus va envoyer quelqu'un pour récolter ses écailles si je ne les lui donne pas de suite. Les avez-vous trouvées ?

en: What?!? We haven't had our people working the Elwynn mines for months!$B$BLet me see that note you have...
fr: Quoi ? Nos gens ne travaillent plus dans les mines depuis des mois !$B$BMontrez-moi cette note !

en: My horses still seem skittish, and I still hear that cursed wolf cry at night. Please, $N, do something about those Gnolls!
Were you able to find my tools?
fr: Avez-vous été capable de retrouver mes outils ?

en: Yowler is a dangerous creature, $N. If you're not ready for him, I understand.
fr: Couineur est une créature dangereuse, $N. Si vous ne vous sentez pas à la hauteur, je comprendrai.

en: You have some sunfish for me, eh?
fr: Vous avez mes poissons-lunes ?

en: Return once you have slain 15 Blackrock Champions.
fr: Revenez une fois que vous aurez tué 15 Champions Rochenoire.

en: Darcy sent me a lunch, did she? Such a kind heart she has. Well...let's have it!
fr: Darcy m'a fait parvenir un déjeuner ? Ne trouvez-vous pas qu'elle a bon cœur ? Allez, profitons-en !

en: Hello again, $N. Did Parker like the lunch I sent him?
fr: Bonjour à nouveau, $N. Est-ce que Parker a apprécié le repas que je lui ai envoyé ?

en: Good to see you back, $N. What did Wiley have to say for himself?
fr: Content de vous revoir, $N. Alors, qu'est-ce que Wiley avait à dire pour sa défense ?

en: I think I hear a pack of Ghouls scurrying around the back of the house - I better put that effigy up quick! Did you get those Ghoul Ribs for me?
fr: Il me semble que j'entends une horde de goules se bousculer derrière ma maison. Il vaudrait mieux que je construise rapidement cet épouvantail ! Vous avez mes côtes de goule ?
