en: As long as Overseer Gorthak lives, I will oppose him. What news from the lumber camp?
Can you feel it, $N, the touch of corruption upon the wind? If we do nothing, it will continue to advance. That is why I seek the Chalice of Elune. Were you able to find it?
fr: Vous la sentez, $N, cette pointe de corruption portée par le vent ? Si nous ne faisons rien, elle continuera à progresser. C’est pourquoi je cherche le calice d'Elune. L’avez-vous trouvé ?

en: What do you have there, $gsir:ma'am;?
fr: Qu’avez-vous ici, madame ?

en: What's that you have there, $C?
Our night elf scouts report that preparations for the attack may still be ongoing. Those dreadlords must die soon, $N!
Don't come back without some ancient relics.
fr: Et ne revenez pas sans quelques reliques anciennes !

en: Surely you have not yet planted all of my seeds?
My wife was named Thalrisa and my daughter, Magwin.
fr: Ma femme s’appelait Thalrisa et ma fille Magwin.

en: Hail, $N.
fr: Salutations, $N.

en: I love it when a plan comes together...
fr: J'adore quand un plan se déroule sans accrocs…

en: That traitor is going to wish he never messed with Alliance Naval Command!
fr: Ce traître va regretter d'avoir cherché des histoires au commandement naval de l'Alliance !

en: Are there not demons yet standing?  You call yourself a $r?  This is no time to be taking a break from the fighting!
What do you have there, scout?
fr: Qu’avez-vous ici, Éclaireur ?

en: Those dreadlords must die soon, $N!
Did you find the lying dog?
fr: Avez-vous trouvé ce chien menteur ?

en: You can hear a low-pitched hum emanating from the totem.
[Furbolg] So the prophecy of Akida is true... A hero has been delivered to us.
Have you seen the vision yet, $N?
fr: Avez-vous déjà reçu la vision, $N ?

en: Did you manage to find my equipment?
fr: Avez-vous réussi à trouver mon matériel ?

en: Do you have those samples for me to send back to Ironforge?
fr: Vous avez trouvé les échantillons, que je puisse les envoyer à Forgefer ?

en: Perhaps this old journal is what the map is referencing.
fr: C'est peut-être ce vieux journal qui était représenté sur la carte.

en: Back so soon?  Your hair looks ruffled.$B$B<Nobundo grins knowingly.>
The Light shine upon you in all your endeavors, $c. What is it you have there?
fr: La Lumière brille sur vous et sur toutes vos actions, $C. Qu’avez-vous là ?

en: They are ugly little creatures. Even the Blind Watcher could see them... and he's blind.
fr: Ce sont de vilaines petites créatures. Même le Guetteur aveugle pouvait le voir… et il est aveugle.

en: A murloc kicked me in the behind and spit on me... in broad daylight!
fr: Un murloc m’a donné un coup de pied au derrière et m’a craché dessus… en plein jour !

en: Having trouble finding the bitter?  Good old Bernie at Nethergarde Keep should stock barrels of it.$B$BUnless he's run out... that would be disastrous!
fr: Vous avez du mal à trouver la bière ? Le bon vieux Bernie au Rempart-du-Néant a probablement des réserves.$B$BÀ moins qu’il ne soit à court… ce serait désastreux.

en: Is that what I think it is?
fr: Est-ce que c'est ce que je pense ?

en: Were you successful in obtaining knowledge of the Nazzivus satyr?
fr: Êtes-vous parvenu à en apprendre davantage sur les satyres Nazzivus ?

en: <Vindicator Aalesia seems to look through you rather than at you, her mind fixed on dealing with the satyr.>$B$BHave you moved against the satyr leader as I have asked?
fr: <Les yeux du redresseur de torts Aalesia semblent regarder à travers vous. Elle ne pense visiblement qu’aux satyres.>$B$BM’avez-vous obéi ? Avez-vous combattu les satyres ?

en: <Kurz grunts at you.>
fr: <Kurz vous regarde et grogne.>

en: Hello, hero!
fr: Salut, héros !

en: $N, right?  Stok'ton told me to be expecting your report.$B$BI trust that you bring good news?
fr: $N, c’est ça ? Stok’ton m’a fait savoir que vous viendriez faire votre rapport.$B$BJ’espère que ce sont de bonnes nouvelles ?

en: Is the task complete?
Were you able to get the samples I need?
fr: Avez- vous réussi à vous procurer mes échantillons ?

en: $N, right?  Chadwick told me to be expecting your report.$B$BWHAT are you doing in my presence?!  Is your assignment complete?  Are you a complete and utter lackwit?  You make me want to vomit!$B$BNow get your worthless hide up on those ramparts and do what you were instructed to do!  Do you hear me?!
fr: $N, c’est ça ? Chadwick m’a fait savoir que vous viendriez faire votre rapport.$B$BQu'est-ce que vous faites en ma présence ? Votre mission est-elle terminée ? Qu’est-ce vous êtes au juste, l’idiot du village ? Vous me donnez envie de vomir !$B$BAlors maintenant, vous allez traîner votre peau de bon à rien-mauvais en tout sur ces remparts et faire ce qu’on vous a ordonné. Pigé ?

en: What is it you have there?
fr: Qu'avez-vous là ?

en: <Morae looks at you hopefully.>$B$BDid your search turn up any trace of Galaen?
fr: <Morae vous regarde avec espoir.>$B$BAvez-vous retrouvé la moindre trace de Galaen ?

en: How goes the hunt, $N?
fr: Comment se passe la chasse, $N ?

en: Were you able to gather the first crystal sample?
fr: Avez-vous pu récupérer le premier échantillon de cristal ?

en: Have you put down the beast?
Do you have the second crystal sample?
fr: Avez-vous le deuxième échantillon de cristal ?

en: Have you returned with the last sample for my set?
fr: Avez-vous le dernier échantillon de la série ?

en: Have you found Tavara?
What's that you have there, $g son : ma'am;?
fr: Qu'y a-t-il, mon grand ?

en: What is that letter you have there, $C?
You have that blood, darlin'?  Might be kind of important if we asked you to get it, you know?
fr: Alors, mon lapin, vous l'avez, ce sang ? Vous savez, si on vous l'a demandé, c'est que c'est important.

en: Surely you have not collected all of the blood so quickly?
fr: Vous n’avez sûrement pas encore tout le sang dont j’ai besoin ?

en: Were you able to harness the magic of the totem to befriend a barbed crawler?  They are feisty little creatures!
The timberstrider is a powerful bird, often misjudged by predators with dire results.
The nightstalker is basically a big kitty with razor sharp claws and an appetite for flesh...
Yes, $C? What is it you have there?
Have you faced your nightmares?
Welcome back, $N
All life is worth saving, if it does not oppose us. Only our enemies should be laid to rest permanently.
You have returned!
fr: Vous êtes de retour !

en: Good day, $N. Are you interested in renting a hippogryph?
fr: Bonne journée, $N. Voulez-vous louer un hippogriffe ?

en: Greetings, friend. You look like you've come a long way. How can I help you?
fr: Salutations, mon amie. Vous avez l’air d’arriver de loin. En quoi puis-je vous aider ?

en: Where are you headed, $C?
Welcome back, $N. Was Nurguni able to gather everything on the list?
fr: Heureux de vous revoir, $N. Est-ce que Nurguni a pu réunir tout ce qu’il y avait sur la liste ?

en: Private, report! Have you scouted all of the Blood Furnace yet?
fr: Soldat, au rapport ! Avez-vous reconnu la totalité de la Fournaise du sang ?

en: Have you scouted all of the Blood Furnace yet?  What do you have to tell me?
I look forward to you gathering enough of the Atal'ai artifacts so that I might begin to study them.  I'm eager to discover what happened to their once-great civilization.
fr: J’attends que vous ayez récupéré assez d’artefacts atal’ai pour commencer à les étudier. Je suis impatient de découvrir ce qui a pu arriver à cette civilisation qui a été si grande.

en: Yes? I'm very busy, $N.
fr: Oui ? J'ai beaucoup à faire, $N.

en: Were you able to locate Keltus?
Have you followed the path revealed by the voidstone?
Ah, a visitor from Quel'Thalas!  What news do you bring?
fr: Ah, une visiteuse nous arrive de Quel'Thalas ? Quelles sont les nouvelles ?

en: <Torallius adjusts his eyepatch to look at you.>$B$BThis is the best we can offer the Hand of Argus?
fr: < Torallius rajuste son couvre-œil.>$B$BEt c’est ce que nous avons de mieux à offrir à la Main d’Argus ?

en: The sand pears are getting harder to find and, of course, that means less pie and fewer treats for the elekk here. Were you able to gather all the fruit I'll need?
fr: Les poires des sables sont de plus en plus difficiles à trouver et, bien sûr, cela veut dire moins de tartes et moins de douceurs pour les elekk. Avez-vous trouvé tous les fruits dont j’ai besoin ?

en: You've come to see me, $r?  Speak and be quick.  I've no time for the formalities of your race.
Were you able to find out what was keeping the survey team from returning?
fr: Alors, savez-vous pourquoi l’équipe de reconnaissance a pris du retard ?

en: Did the device work? Have you marked the murlocs for my research?
fr: L'appareil a-t-il fonctionné ? Mes futurs sujets murlocs sont-ils marqués ?

en: Alturus sent you. The stars spoke of your arrival.
fr: Alturus vous envoie. C’était écrit dans les étoiles.

en: Greetings, $c. What have you there?
fr: Salutations, $C. Qu'avez-vous là ?

en: Welcome to Auberdine, friend. What brings you to Darkshore?
fr: Bienvenue à Auberdine. Qu'est-ce qui vous amène à Sombrivage ?

en: We must act before the ravager displaces Bloodmyst Isle's native predators. Have you begun culling the ravager population?
fr: Nous devons agir avant que les ravageurs n’aient supplanté la faune naturelle de Brume-sang. Avez-vous commencé à réduire leur population ?

en: You got those parts yet?  I've got some diving to do.
You got those parts yet?  I've got a compression coil to fix before Anchorite Ahuurn starts breathing down my neck!
fr: Alors, vous avez ces pièces ? J’ai un ressort compresseur à réparer avant que l’anachorète Ahuurn ne vienne me passer un savon !

en: Have you obtained the tomes I seek, $N?
Weren't you looking for a journal or something?
fr: Vous ne cherchiez pas un journal ou un machin de ce genre ?

en: Have you gathered crystal shards from the creatures of Bloodmyst?
fr: Avez-vous récupéré des éclats de cristal sur les créatures de Brume-sang ?

en: If you have more of the irradiated crystal shards, I'd be happy to exchange them for another of my crystals.
Did you manage to get the constrictor vines?
fr: Êtes-vous parvenu à récupérer des lianes étrangleuses ?

en: What news do you bring, $N?
You've returned! What news do you bring?
fr: Vous êtes de retour ! Quelles nouvelles amenez-vous ?

en: How can I help you, $c?
fr: Comment puis-je vous aider, $c ?

en: Have you culled the moths?
Remember, the mushrooms I requested are each unique to the different environments of Bloodmyst.
fr: N'oubliez pas que les champignons que j'ai demandés sont chacun spécifique à un environnement différent de Brume-azur.

en: Back so soon?
fr: Déjà de retour ?

en: This is no time to relax!
fr: Ce n’est pas le moment de se détendre !

en: When the towers are under our control, we will soon be able to surround the Forsaken. After that, it is only a matter of time before we can crush them.
They must be fools to think that we would allow them to establish bases so close to one of our capitals.$B$BWe will bleed their numbers until they turn tail and retreat back to the south.
Is it done?
fr: Est-ce fait ?

en: I don't have much longer, $N. They will kill me soon...
It was a terrible mess...
fr: C'était un horrible carnage...

en: Any luck?
fr: Alors ?

en: They're nasty creatures...
May the Light bend to your will in all endeavors.
fr: Puisse la Lumière se plier à votre volonté en toutes choses.

en: Have you retrieved the bone fragment I require, $N?
Do not mourn their demise, $N.
fr: Ne pleurez pas leur disparition, $N.

en: Atoph must be lured out!
Have you spoken with Magister Astalor Bloodsworn?
A Blood Knight would rather die than submit to the enemy. Remember that, $N.
The dragon wars have long since passed. All that remains are bones and the agitated remnants of Ysera's brood.
fr: Les guerres des dragons sont depuis longtemps passées. Tout ce qu'il en reste, ce sont des os et les ombres agitées de la progéniture d'Ysera.

en: It pains me to watch. Please, let us not speak of this any further.
I recommend that you bring allies, $N.
Have you done all that was asked of you?
There are so many of them that I cannot help but think that they are somehow multiplying.
fr: Ils sont si nombreux que je ne peux pas m'empêcher de penser qu'ils ont trouvé un moyen de se dédoubler.

en: I'm a bit busy here, agent $N. This better be important.
fr: Je suis un peu occupée, agent $N. Il vaudrait mieux que cela soit important.

en: <Velen smiles.>$B$BGreetings, $N. I have been expecting you.
fr: <Velen sourit.>$B$BSalutations, $N. Je vous attendais.

en: Well?
fr: Eh bien ?

en: I've been hearing reports of strange creatures appearing in the area. Whether they are mutated indigenous animals or true void anomalies is something that you need to find out.

Back so soon? Your observation of the Sporeggar sporelings is critical to my research. I hope you aren't the type to rush things. Show patience and make certain that you have explored the entirety of the Spawning Glen before giving me your final report.

Be sure that you collect all of the evidence carefully, $c!  We're fitting the pieces of a giant puzzle together here.  A mistake on your part could lead us to the wrong conclusions.$B$BThen where would we be in our understanding of Zangarmarsh's ecology?
fr: Assurez-vous de recueillir soigneusement toutes les preuves, $c ! Nous sommes en train de rassembler les pièces d'un puzzle géant. Une erreur de notre part pourrait nous conduire à des conclusions erronées.$b$bEt dans ce cas, comment pourrions-nous comprendre l'écologie du marécage de Zangar ?

en: Was the information accurate?
fr: Les informations étaient-elles exactes ?

en: What did you find, $N?
What have you got there, $N? Is that a journal?

Congratulations, $N. Achieving the rank of adept is no mean feat, believe me. I've seen the number of people who enter that building, and how few of them last long enough to visit me bearing these materials.
Do you have those samples yet?
fr: Avez-vous les échantillons ?

en: You have all of the mushrooms that we need to create a new garden for the bog lords?
We can still use more of the sanguine hibiscus from the shamblers, bog giants and underbats of the Underbog at Coilfang Reservoir.  Bring them to me in bunches of five and I will be most grateful.
Do you have all of the hibiscus that I asked you to gather?
fr: Avez-vous tous les hibiscus que je vous avais demandé de récupérer ?

en: Did you discover anything, $N?
The Underbog is a very dangerous place.  I would not consider you a coward if you were to balk at going there.  I also wouldn't be appreciative of you if you did not return with what I've asked for.
fr: La Basse-tourbière est un endroit très dangereux. Je ne vous considérerais pas comme un lâche si vous reculiez maintenant. Je ne vous serais pas non plus reconnaissant si vous ne m'apportiez pas ce que j'ai demandé.

en: Hail, $N.
fr: Salutations, $N.

en: You have returned.  Does this mean that The Black Stalker is no more?
fr: Vous êtes de retour. Cela signifie-t-il que la Traqueuse noire n'est plus ?

en: Is it done, $c?
Have you returned with the materials Magister Astalor requires?
Welcome back, $N. Have you beaten back the Scourge and their meatwagons?
Have you paid the naga a visit yet?
Have you paid the naga a visit yet?
It's good to see you again, $N.  How's your hunt for the naga going?
fr: Ça fait plaisir de vous revoir, $N. Comment se passe votre chasse aux nagas ?

en: Is Fwhoor alright? Have you recovered the ark?
You want to talk about the bounty for Haghazed?  Well, is he dead?  There isn't much else to talk about!
What news do you bring, $N?
Were you able to get the water?
Have you gathered the reagents I'll need?
Have you done as I asked and delivered my message? The false paladins of the world must surely know their time has come to an end.
Have you discovered the whereabouts of my four companions yet?
The spore sacs!  Did you get them?
fr: Les sacs de spores ! Les avez-vous ?

en: You must take out their portal controllers before you can destroy the gate itself!
Void critters grow into void anomalies. Truth be told, we really don't know what these creatures are... the name is more of a classification.
Have you rescued any more spore sacs, $R?
How's the bog lord slaying going?  Teach those brutes not to come into sporeling territory!
fr: Comment se passe le massacre de seigneurs-tourbe ? Apprenez-leur à ne plus s'aventurer en territoire sporelin !

en: You killed many giants, but there are still many more left.  And they're still attacking our spore sacs!
Their leader can't hide from us forever. We will systematically eliminate every possible hiding place until Sironas is found.
You've returned; are Kataru and the Umbrafen slavers dead?
Don't drink the water, $N!
fr: Ne buvez pas l'eau, $N !

en: Do you see any unusually brave and powerful draenei around here?
What of Kalithresh? Is he dead yet, $N?
What's that you have there, $N?
Have you obtained the armaments I seek, $N?
We will forge the naga's own steel into weapons to use against them.  Bring me all the armaments you manage to salvage from Coilfang Reservoir.
What's that, there? Been bitten by the wing bug, have ya?$B$B<Magasha chuckles at her own joke.>
fr: Ben alors ? On s’est fait piquer par la mouche des ailes d'insectes, c’est ça ?$B$B<Magasha rit de sa propre blague.>

en: I still see marshfangs, $N. Surely you can't be done so soon.
You're back, but Jyoba's not with you. What became of him?
fr: Vous êtes de retour, mais Jyoba n'est pas avec vous. Que lui est-il arrivé ?

en: Tell me you haven't come back empty-handed. $N.
fr: Dites-moi que vous ne revenez pas les mains vides, $N.

en: I see you smirking. Yes, my armor's going to look a bit odd until I've replaced all the old metal, but it's better this than unprotected.
fr: Je vous vois sourire. D’accord, mon armure aura l’air un peu bizarre tant que je n’aurai pas remplacé tout le vieux métal, mais ça vaut mieux que de ne pas être protégé.

en: You don't look like one of my men. Speak your piece, $r.
fr: Vous n'avez pas l'air d'être l'un de mes hommes. Dites ce que vous avez sur le cœur, $R.

en: From the looks of things, we'll need to replenish our spores soon.
fr: D'après ce que je vois, nous allons avoir bientôt besoin de reconstituer notre stock de spores.

en: Back so soon? Have you found the missive?
fr: Déjà de retour ? Vous avez trouvé la missive ?

en: Have you any fish to contribute to our stores?
fr: Vous avez trouvé du poisson pour augmenter nos réserves ?

en: How goes the hunt, friend?
Were you able to get a sample of the soil in the Dead Mire?
fr: Vous avez pu obtenir un échantillon de terre de Morte-bourbe ?

en: It pains me to kill the creatures of the Dead Mire, but they are beyond saving. The best we can do is work to restore the area and nurture a new generation.
I could still use some more plant parts.  With the lakes losing their water, I've a feeling the number of invasive species is on the rise.  I need more numbers to back up my theory, however.
Have you spoken to the ancients yet, $N?
Have you examined the Boha'mu Ruins? Can you imagine what they were like in their full splendor?
Do you have the idols?
fr: Avez-vous les idoles ?

en: Did you find my belongings, $N?  The cave is not far from Umbrafen, near the border with Nagrand.
The clefthoof of Nagrand are a good challenge.  I've bagged myself quite a few.$B$BHow are you doing with that?
Did you manage to gather any diaphanous wings?
fr: Avez-vous réussi à récupérer des ailes diaphanes ?

en: Have you been successful in your marshfang hunt?
How may I help you?
fr: Que puis-je faire pour vous ?

en: <Kialon eyes you suspiciously.>$B$BI don't know you, $R. Do you have business with me?
fr: <Kialon vous dévisage d'un air soupçonneux.>$B$BJe ne vous connais pas, $R. Avez-vous une affaire à traiter avec moi ?

en: What have you got there?
fr: Qu'avez-vous donc là ?

en: Hello, $c.  Do you have those flowers yet?
fr: Bonjour, $C. Avez-vous déjà les fleurs ?

en: <Elementalist Lo'ap makes two fists and shakes his head in disapproval.>$B$BOgre sized...
fr: <L’élémentaliste Lo’ap montre ses mains et secoue la tête d’un air désapprobateur.>$B$BDes poignées d’ogre…

en: Have you gathered the reagents?
fr: Avez-vous rassemblé les composants ?

en: Did you find any plant parts, $N?
fr: Avez-vous trouvé des morceaux de plantes, $N ?

en: Did you speak with the Feralfen elder?
fr: Avez-vous parlé avec l’ancien de Tourbe-farouche ?

en: Use the Nagrand cherries before delving too deeply into the lake.
With great shame I tell you that it is my own kin who seek to drudge up the waters of Nagrand and create marshland.
fr: À ma grande honte, je dois vous avouer que ce sont mes congénères qui tentent de bloquer les eaux de Nagrand et de créer des marécages.

en: You're back, $N.  Did you obtain the fertile spores?
We can always use more fertile spores, $R. Tallstalks are incredibly useful mushrooms. Being able to grow them lets us do many things with them.
Did you find any glowcaps, $N?  They're literally everywhere in the marsh.$B$BYou can spot their bright glow from far away if you pay attention.
I'll take more glowcaps if you have them.  Our village can always use more of them.
The Earthen Ring will help in any way possible.\n
You seek audience with me?  I do not recall hearing of an appointment.
I was told a visitor from Quel'Thalas was coming. I was expecting a blood elf, to tell you the truth.$b$bWhat news do you bring?
Yes, $C?
Have you got the mushrooms, mon?
fr: Z'avez les champignons, mon pote ?

en: Do not leave any tainted muck behind!
fr: Ne laissez aucune boue souillée derrière vous !

en: <Witch Doctor Tor'gash grins.>$B$BDid the lil' Lost Ones like their gift?
You're here to claim the bounty for Fyashe? That's the best news I've heard all day.
Do they sleep?
What do you have there, $N?
fr: Qu'avez-vous là, $N ?

en: Gordawg eats this rock. Gordawg finds usurper. Bring rock!
fr: Gordawg manger le rocher. Gordawg trouver usurpateur. Apporter rocher !

en: Have you found proof of the ogres' intentions?
fr: Avez-vous découvert une preuve des intentions des ogres ?

en: The threat of the Ango'rosh looms over us. Have you eliminated their leader?
The readings, $N. Did you complete them?
fr: Alors, $N, ces relevés… vous avez réussi à les faire ?

en: Have you obtained the ghostly essences I require, $N?
Alturus entrusted you with this information? That old fool.$B$BI suppose the damage is done, we might as well make use of you. I suppose you will cooperate?
fr: Vous connaissez l’Œil pourpre ? Votre visage ne me dit rien.

en: What is it you have there, $N?
What is it you have there, $N?
I hope to demonstrate the uses of bleeder venom to Anchorite Ahuurn and the others at Telredor. That's going to require me to double my supply.
fr: J'espère pouvoir démontrer les usages du venin de suce-sang à l'anachorète Ahuurn entre autres à Telredor. Pour cela, il faut que je double mon stock.

en: Have you obtained the fragment, $c?  You would do well not to waste any time in this matter
How goes your search for the key fragments, $N?
Have you made progress in securing the roads?
Does $N have hides for Maktu?
fr: $N a des peaux pour Maktu ?

en: How goes the fight against the Ango'rosh?
Who are you and what do you want?
fr: Qui êtes-vous, et que voulez-vous ?

en: Is it done? Have you dealt with Overlord Gorefist?
The sound seems to have receded into the distance. Is that wishful thinking or have you really done something about the problem?
Have you managed to scare up some of those marshfang blades?
fr: Avez-vous réussi à vous procurer ces lames de crocs-du-marais ?

en: Keanna's log... did you find it?
fr: Le journal de Keanna… L'avez-vous trouvé ?

en: I dread to ask, $N. What has become of the situation inside Karazhan?
Is it safe for me to fish again?
Have you gathered those totems?
fr: Avez-vous récupéré ces totems ?

en: Were you able to summon the Feralfen spirit?
fr: Avez-vous pu invoquer l'esprit des Tourbe-farouches ?

en: Did your search of Daggerfen Village yield the information I need in order to get to the bottom of this poison puzzle?
fr: Alors, vos recherches à Tourbedague vous ont-elles permis de découvrir les informations dont j’ai besoin pour tirer au clair cette histoire de poison ?

en: Gordawg wants the boulder returned.
fr: Vous rendez son rocher à Gordawg.

en: You think the clefthoof bulls are just going to fall dead at your feet here in front of the campfire?
A warm fire and a woman at your side for idle chit-chat is something you can get at home. Here we hunt big game or die trying.
fr: Un feu bien chaud et une femme à vos côtés pour discuter gentiment, vous pouvez avoir ça à la maison. Ici, on chasse du gros gibier ou on meurt en tentant de le faire.

en: There's no shame in admitting that you haven't the spine to hunt the mightiest of animals this land has to offer, $N.
fr: Il n'y a pas de honte à admettre que vous n'avez pas le courage de chasser le plus puissant des animaux que cette terre a à offrir, $N.

en: Gordawg eat Gurok power.
fr: Gordawg manger le pouvoir de Gurok.

en: Have you come to know the peace that comes with knowing your place in nature?  Are you the hunter or the hunted?
Have you learned yet to calm the beating of your heart?  To be as still as a calm lake and patient, waiting for the right moment to strike down your quarry?
Have you faced Gutripper yet?
fr: Avez-vous déjà affronté Arrache-tripes ?

en: I'm just going to lay here a little while longer.  I should be fine soon.
I don't suppose...<cough>... you've taken care of those...<cough>... thorngrazers yet?
You have... the hoof?
fr: <Harold vous regarde, l'air très faible, mais parvient à sourire.>$B$BVous avez...<tousse>... le sabot ?

en: Give it here! Quickly!
fr: Donnez-moi ça ! Vite !

en: The air spirit claims that the Murkblood are searching for something at Sunspring...
Do this for us because we cannot do it for ourselves.
fr: Faites-le pour nous, car nous ne pouvons pas le faire nous-mêmes.

en: For each of my kin that they slew, ten of them must die!
Bring me their leader's head, $N.
fr: Rapportez-moi la tête de leur chef, $N.

en: <Garrosh barely acknowledges your presence. He appears deeply depressed.>
What is it?
fr: Qu'est-ce que c'est ?

en: What is it?
fr: Qu'est-ce que c'est ?

en: Remember, $N, Ortor is a shaman of great power.
The orcs will not understand what we are doing but it must be done. For the good of both orc and Broken.
fr: Les orcs ne comprendront pas ce que nous faisons, mais cette tâche doit être accomplie. Pour le bien des orcs et des Roués.

en: You have something to show me?
fr: Avez-vous quelque chose pour moi ?

en: Murkblood are a nefarious tribe of Broken, $N. They may look like Kurenai but they are most assuredly savage, murdering beasts.
Have you retrieved the crystal fragments I asked of you, $N?
You've got more crystal fragments?  Make sure you're not taking any that are still attached to the mountain; we wouldn't want to stir up trouble with the naaru.
I submit! I submit!
Have you obtained any more warbeads? You'll find plenty of ogres to the far north, near the border with Zangarmarsh.
How are those ogres treating you, $N? Tough bunch, aren't they?
Have you located and dealt with Lord Klaq?
Have you encountered Boglash?
Did you manage to get the stinger? Remember, it's useless to me if it's damaged.
fr: Avez-vous réussi à récupérer l'aiguillon ? Attention, s'il est abîmé, je ne peux rien en faire.

en: Kristen is a very nice...<cough>... person to share her skins, wouldn't you agree?
fr: Kristen est vraiment une… <tousse>… personne très gentille pour accepter ainsi de partager ses peaux. Vous ne trouvez pas ?

en: My luck is about to change - I can feel it.
fr: La chance va tourner, je le sens.

en: There's no changing his mind, I swear. I think I'm going to have to ask Shadow Hunter Denjai for a transfer back to Zabra'jin.
You've returned, $r.  Is Gava'xi dead?
Did you manage to track down Sporewing?
I am ashamed that I cannot do more to help my enslaved brethren. but at least we have prevented more needless deaths.
Have you "retired" old Mragesh?
I take it Terrorclaw lives no more?
Long time ago, Maktu might have used Mragesh's hide to make strong armor. Mragesh far too old for that now. Hide too soft for good armor.
I'm sending out a small organized search party for the rest of the villagers.
They must be reminded that we are a force to be reckoned with in this region.
Respect from fear! It is as good as any other kind.
fr: Le respect obtenu par la peur en vaut un autre !

en: <The watcher blinks several times in surprise.>$B$BWhere did you get that... thing?
fr: <La gardienne semble franchement déconcertée.>$B$BOù avez-vous eu ce… truc ?

en: It's ivory that I'm after, not excuses.  Of course, if you'd rather, we can renegotiate your percentage of the profits.  I doubt that you'd be pleased with the result.
fr: C’est de l’ivoire que je veux, pas des excuses. Bien sûr, si vous voulez, nous pouvons renégocier votre pourcentage sur les profits, mais je doute que le résultat vous plaise.

en: I still have a need for more pairs of ivory tusks from the wild elekk that roam this land.  Unfortunately, my budget will no longer handle your cut of the profits.  If you continue to provide me what I need, however, you will be ingratiating yourself with the Consortium.
The children might be able to go a day without feeling hunger pangs.
fr: Les enfants pourraient peut-être passer une journée sans avoir le ventre qui crie famine.

en: Have you found any new information?
fr: Avez-vous découvert de nouvelles informations ?

en: He'll probably be asleep on a ridge.
You've something to show me, $N?
We have only recently taken back Telaar. We will not lose it again!
Beware the elementals in the basin, $N.
That boy...$B$B<Arechron shakes his head in disapproval.>$B$BHe'll be the death of me.
Did you find him?
Did you take care of the voidspawn, $N?
<Lantresor's eyes open in bewilderment.>Is it done?
We will ignite a hatred heretofore unseen between the two clans!
fr: Nous allons provoquer une haine telle qu’il n’y en a jamais eu entre deux clans !

en: Can you predict what will happen next?
fr: Vous pouvez prédire ce qui va arriver, maintenant ?

en: Do you now understand why you could never win a war against me?
fr: Comprenez-vous pourquoi vous ne pourrez jamais me faire la guerre et me vaincre ?

en: Peace you say?
fr: La paix, dites-vous ?

en: <Garrosh seems unmoved by the offering.>
fr: <Garrosh ne semble pas ému par l'offrande.>

en: Are you here to collect a reward?
Are you here to collect a reward?
For the Mag'har!
Waste no time! Durn must be stopped!
Are you here to collect a reward?
Are you here to collect a reward?
This is merely one step in a long process. Ogres, like dogs, must be shown the difference between right and wrong. Telling them does no good.
He will undoubtedly be heavily guarded.
fr: Il sera sans nul doute entouré d'une garde impressionnante.

en: <Ungriz sighs.>$B$BI know it's a lot to ask for, $N; but bring them back alive...
Rokag has told me about his plan. You have the eyes?
We should never have invited them to dinner.  That much is certain!$B$BOr, at least, we should have insisted upon a couple of courses before the dessert that they brought.
Where's Corki?
I feel so stupid. Arechron's son, Corki, asked me what happened and I told him. Now he's gone missing again!
fr: Je me sens si bête. Corki, le fils d’Arechron, m’a demandé ce qui s’était passé, et j’ai été assez sotte pour le lui dire. Et maintenant, il a encore disparu !

en: The fight's over when you or your opponent are dead on the floor.
fr: Le combat se termine quand vous ou votre adversaire êtes mort sur le sol.

en: The fight's over when you or your opponent are dead on the floor.
fr: Le combat se termine quand vous ou votre adversaire êtes mort sur le sol.

en: Do you have my samples?
fr: Avez-vous mes spécimens ?

en: The fight's over when you or your opponent are dead on the floor.
fr: Le combat se termine quand vous ou votre adversaire êtes mort sur le sol.

en: Have you discovered anything yet?
The fight's over when you or your opponent are dead on the floor.
fr: Le combat se termine quand vous ou votre adversaire êtes mort sur le sol.

en: The fight's over when you or your opponent are dead on the floor.
fr: Le combat se termine quand vous ou votre adversaire êtes mort sur le sol.

en: The fight's over when you or your opponent are dead on the floor.
fr: Le combat se termine quand vous ou votre adversaire êtes mort sur le sol.

en: It's good to see you again, $N. Have you done as I asked?
Welcome back, $N. Have you dealt with the arakkoa leaders?
What news do you bring, $N?
Never flown on the back of a nether drake, eh?
I've started a seed collection, but I'm going to need some help before I have enough to send back to the park in Stormwind.
fr: J'ai commencé à collecter des graines, mais je vais avoir besoin d'aide pour en avoir assez et pouvoir les envoyer au parc de Hurlevent.

en: Do you have any seeds for me?
fr: Avez-vous des graines pour moi ?

en: You look concerned. What is it, $C?
You look concerned.  What is it, $C?
Report. What news do you bring from Firewing Point?
Report. What news do you bring from Firewing Point?
I take it Bertelm sent you to hamper the efforts of their peons?
Back so soon?
fr: Déjà de retour ?

en: I was about to send a message back to Rokag recommending an attack, but I see that won't be necessary.
Avoid the overseers at all costs. They must not be let on to your presence. The results could be disastrous!
fr: Évitez les surveillants à tout prix. Ils ne doivent surtout pas savoir que nous sommes là. Ce serait un désastre !

en: The activity in the camp continues to escalate. Have you carried out your mission?
The longer we permit them to make preparations, the more difficult it will be to root them out. Have you killed the liaison?
<Sal'salabim rubs his head.>$B$B[Demonic] Ik il romath sardon.
fr: <Sal'salabim se frotte la tête.>$b$b[Démoniaque] Ik il romath sardon.

en: Was your attack successful?
Tell me I wasn't wrong to trust you with this mission...
You no come back without Sal'salabim golds!
fr: Vous pas revenir sans or de Sal'salabim !

en: Is it done?
fr: Est-ce fait ?

en: What is it you have there, $N?
What is it you have there, $N?
You have those codes yet?  You saw what happened to the druids at the Cenarion Thicket.$B$BDo you want that to happen to Stonebreaker Hold?
I see you've managed to survive the rigors of the forest. Have you brought any tails for my cloak?
fr: Je vois que vous avez réussi à survivre aux rigueurs de la forêt. M'apportez-vous des queues pour ma cape ?

en: Have you obtained the venom sacs, $N? These refugees can't wait much longer.
fr: Vous êtes-vous procuré les glandes à venin, $N ? Les réfugiés ne peuvent plus attendre longtemps.

en: Were you able to find all the pelts that I need?
Many refugees still need treatment for their poisonous wounds. Have you brought more venom sacs for me to use, $N?
Have you obtained the blood, $N?  Without it, Zahlia may never see her son again.
Have you completed your task, $N?
fr: Votre tâche est-elle achevée, $N ?

en: Has old Ironjaw gotten the better of you, too, friend? Or have you managed to outsmart the old fellow?
fr: Alors, est-ce que le vieux Gueule-de-fer vous a ajouté à son tableau de chasse, mon ami ? Ou vous êtes-vous montré plus rusé que lui ?

en: The spirit awaits, $N. Have you the pelt of the wolf patriarch?
fr: Les esprits attendent, $N. Avez-vous la fourrure du patriarche des loups ?

en: Have you obtained the basilisk eyes for Voren'thal's elixir?
It takes many basilisk eyes to make even a small dose of Voren'thal's elixir. Bringing me more would certainly incur the Scryers' favor.
Have you cleared the warp stalkers from the vicinity of the stronghold?

Keb'ezil wants to know if it's safe to hurl a fireball without embarrassing himself again.$B$B<The imp makes a few clicking sounds and the warlock turns toward him.>$B$BNo, it wasn't my shadow bolt! Take it back, you overgrown pixy!
Were you able to find any intact vessels?
fr: Avez-vous pu trouver des calices intacts ?

en: What's this? Who are you?
fr: Qu'est-ce que c'est ? Qui êtes-vous ?

en: $N? What brings you back to me? Did you deliver the bones of the restless to Ramdor as I requested?
I suppose you're after the bonelasher bounty too?
Is that bonelasher blood on your hands that I smell?
You have the feather? Am I to reward you for your foolhardy bravery?
fr: Vous avez la plume ? Dois-je vous récompenser pour votre intrépidité ?

en: Did you kill him? Is Torgos dead?!$B$BYou have proof?
<Seth tugs on your cloak.>$B$BDid you find the eels? Didja?
fr: <Seth tire sur votre cape.>$B$BVous avez trouvé les anguilles ? Hein ?

en: You speak with all of them yet? What did they have to say?
You speak with all of them yet? What did they have to say?
Well, what did ye find out, $glad:lass;?
Well, what did you find out?
Please, sit down, dear.
Hello, dear.
The cries seem somehow... fainter than they were before. The Light grant it's more than wishful thinking.
fr: Les cris semblent plus… lointains qu’avant. Fasse la Lumière que ce soit bien le cas !

en: What I asked of you is a terrible thing to request of anyone. But what you must understand is many of the men won't go near the ruins. The memories and the pain are too fresh, but we can't allow the spirits to continue to wander.$B$BThe longer they persist, the more they shed their remaining ties to their past life and give themselves over to malevolence.
Were you able to find any usable materials out there underneath all the dust, ash, and char?
fr: Avez-vous réussi à trouver des matériaux utilisables sous la poussière, la cendre et la braise ?

en: Were you able to overcome the officers at the ruins?
I thought I asked you not to bother me. What is it?
fr: Je croyais vous avoir demandé de ne pas m'ennuyer. Qu'y a-t-il ?

en: Have you managed to clear some of the ravagers in the area?
Have you managed to clear any of the mutated tanglers?
fr: Avez-vous réussi à éliminer des noueurs mutés ?

en: Have you begun to clear the fouled water spirits?
Have you mastered Corruption?
The crystalline powder from the mountain is infused within the earthen core of this region.$B$B
fr: La poudre cristalline de la montagne est imprégnée d’énergie par le noyau terrestre de la région.

en: This base was the primary draenei research facility for the study of naaru crystals.$B$BWhat we have discovered is a veritable goldmine of research notes about the crystals from the "diamond" mountain, Oshu'gun. It would seem that everything in this region carries with it some residual powder of the Oshu'gun crystals. If you find any powder while adventuring in this region, return it to me and I shall reward you with a token of my appreciation which you may use to make purchases from the quartermaster.
fr: Cette base était le principal centre de recherche où les draeneï étudiaient les cristaux naaru.$B$BNous avons découvert une véritable mine d’or sous la forme de notes consacrées aux cristaux de la « montagne de diamant », Oshu’gun. On dirait que tout, dans la région, contient une parcelle de pouvoir des cristaux d’Oshu’gun. Si vous trouvez de la poudre lorsque vous sillonnerez la région, remettez-la-moi. En échange, je vous donnerai un petit quelque chose qui vous permettra de faire des achats auprès de notre service d’intendance.

en: The crystalline powder from the mountain is infused within the earthen core of this region.
fr: La poudre cristalline de la montagne est imprégnée d’énergie par le noyau terrestre de la région.

en: This base was the primary draenei research facility for the study of naaru crystals.$B$BWhat we have discovered is a veritable goldmine of research notes about the crystals from the "diamond" mountain, Oshu'gun. It would seem that everything in this region carries with it some residual powder of the Oshu'gun crystals. If you find any powder while adventuring in this region, return it to me and I shall reward you with a token of my appreciation which you may use to make purchases from the quartermaster.
fr: Cette base était le principal centre de recherche où les draeneï étudiaient les cristaux naaru.$B$BNous avons découvert une véritable mine d’or sous la forme de notes consacrées aux cristaux de la « montagne de diamant », Oshu’gun. On dirait que tout, dans la région, contient une parcelle de pouvoir des cristaux d’Oshu’gun. Si vous trouvez de la poudre lorsque vous sillonnerez la région, remettez-la-moi. En échange, je vous donnerai un petit quelque chose qui vous permettra de faire des achats auprès de notre service d’intendance.

en: You seem to be in good spirits. Has burning Horde siege machinery put the spring back in your step?
fr: Vous avez l’air de bonne humeur. Est-ce parce que vous avez brûlé les engins de siège de la Horde ?

en: Tell me the shaking's over and my boys can get back to work... please?
You do not need a potion to see spirits, $N.
Move as the wind, $N.
So how did the salvage mission go? Did you find anything useful?
fr: Alors, comment se passe la mission de récupération ? Vous avez trouvé quelque chose d’utile ?

en: I've been looking for the telltale signs of burning cannons -- smoke plumes, or the cries of burning fel orcs...$B$BAny luck on your mission?
fr: J’ai cherché les signes révélateurs de canons en train de brûler… Un panache de fumée, ou les cris de grangr’orcs en feu…$B$BVous en êtes où, dans votre mission ?

en: Yes? What can I do for you, $C?
$N, you bring news from the Shadow Labyrinth? Is the danger there finally dealt with?
What?  Back so soon?  How did it go?
Did you find her, $N? Was she still being held within the halls?
The relics of Terokk have been absent from Skettis for too long. Were you able to recover them from the Sethekk?
fr: Il y a trop longtemps que les reliques de Terokk ont disparu de Skettis. Avez-vous réussi à les reprendre aux Sethekk ?

en: I'm almost afraid to ask. Seeing you come out of the mine alive means one of two things: either you killed the bastard, or you lost your nerve. Well, which is it?
$N, return to me when you have aided in the capture of each of the forts!
Got gas?
fr: Vous avez du gaz ?

en: Return to me after you have helped capture each fort!
Did I mention my love for eggs? Completion
fr: Je vous ai dit que j'aimais les œufs ?

en: Hmm, is my memory improving?
fr: Hmm, la mémoire serait-elle en train de me revenir ?

en: Have you seen what the Daggerfen have done? Now you understand why we must isolate them from the other Lost Ones.
So you wish to claim the bounty on Chieftain Mummaki?
fr: Vous venez pour la prime du chef Mummaki ?

en: So you wish to claim the bounty on Chieftain Mummaki?
fr: Vous venez récupérer la prime pour le chef Mummaki ?

en: The only thing the Daggerfen understand is swift and brutal action. They should know that we will not let them have their way.
I saw you speaking with Orion - it must be important business...
fr: Je vous ai vu parler avec Orion - ce doit être une affaire importante…

en: Thrallmar is safe so long as the arcanist and his bloodmages remain at the front.
If you missed during your first pass, take another...
fr: Si vous n’y êtes pas arrivé du premier coup, réessayez.

en: You have eliminated the colossal menace?
fr: La menace des colosses est-elle ramenée à ses vraies proportions ?

en: That's a big crystal you have there.  Did you get that while you were up at the ridge killing colossi?$B$BLet me take a look at it.
fr: C'est un bien gros cristal que vous avez là. Est-ce que vous l'avez eu en haut de la crête quand vous êtes allé tuer des colosses ?$B$BLaissez-moi y jeter un coup d'œil.

en: Destiny calls, $N. Arazzius the Cruel has eluded justice long enough. Let his death be a message to all those who would oppose the Horde. You are next.
Thank the Light you made it here safely. Honor Hold needs all the seasoned warriors it can muster.
fr: Remerciez la Lumière d'être arrivé ici vivant. Le bastion de l'Honneur a besoin de tous les guerriers expérimentés qu'il peut réunir.

en: Honor Hold is safe so long as the archers guard our skies.
I wish I could be there to watch the fire display.  Those explosives pack a big punch!
fr: Je regrette de ne pouvoir y aller pour admirer le feu d'artifice. Ces explosifs sont drôlement costauds !

en: This is a vital mission, $N.  It's one I would not trust to just anyone.
fr: Cette mission est d'une importance vitale, $N. Je ne la confierais pas à n'importe qui.

en: How fares your attempt to clear Thornfang Hill?
Did you find enough of the parts? If not, I might have to use that frying pan Legassi keeps waving around. Then, I'd have to rename the zeppelin the "Flying Skillet."
fr: Avez-vous trouvé assez de pièces ? Sinon, il va falloir que j’utilise cette poêle à frire que Legassi n’arrête pas de brandir. Et il faudra que je rebaptise le zeppelin « La poêle volante ».

en: Show them that not even the skies are safe!
fr: Montrez-leur que pas même le ciel n'est sûr !

en: Show them that not even the skies are safe!
fr: Montrez-leur que pas même le ciel n'est sûr !

en: Save the spirits, $N.
I don't like to "share."
fr: Je n'aime pas "partager."

en: You've returned, haven't you done enough?
fr: Vous êtes de retour, $N. Vous n'en aviez pas fait assez ?

en: <D'ore's spirit hums.>$B$BGreetings, $N.
<Mother Kashur is visibly upset.>These naaru are wise beyond all manner of life on this world.
fr: <Mère Kashur est visiblement troublée.>$B$BCes naaru sont plus sages que toute forme de vie de ce monde.

en: The smell of herbs and spices fills the air around the pot.
<Greatmother Geyah is lying down.>
I will not rest until Archmage Vargoth's staff is restored to him. Were you able to wrest it from the demon's grasp?
fr: Je n'aurais de cesse d'avoir rendu son bâton à l'archimage Vargoth. Avez-vous réussi à le tirer des griffes du démon ?

en: At last, we meet.
What have you found, $N?
Busy, busy.  No time to waste!  There's a rocket ship to be built!$B$BWhat do you want?
It pains me to know there is so little to be done for our comrades.
Have you managed to clear out some of the mana creatures from the village ruins?

Does it look like the X-52 Nether-Rocket is ready for liftoff?  Am I cruising the Twisting Nether in the comfort of my command chair?  Exploiting strange new worlds?  Seeking out new technology and business opportunities?  Boldly going where no goblin has gone before?$B$BNo!$B$BSo, I hope you have those crystals that I sent you after.
fr: Est-ce que la fusée-de-néant X-52 a l'air prête à décoller ? Est-ce que vous me voyez parcourir le Néant distordu bien assis dans mon fauteuil de commandant de bord ? Exploiter d'étranges nouveaux mondes ? Rechercher de nouvelles technologies et ouvertures commerciales ? M'aventurer courageusement là où aucun gobelin n'a encore posé le pied ?$B$BNon !$B$BAlors j'espère que vous avez ces cristaux que je vous ai demandé de récupérer.

en: If I am to be free of the tower's curse, I must have the sigil.
fr: Pour être libéré de la malédiction de la tour, il me faut ce cachet.

en: Did you obtain the items I asked of you, $N?
Have you recharged the battery in that blaster yet?
fr: Avez-vous fini de charger la batterie de la pétoire ?

en: Back so soon?$B$BIs everything okay with the Maxx A. Million Mk. V?!
Have you brought the book?
fr: Avez-vous apporté le livre ?

en: How goes it, $N? Got any news? What have you done for me lately?
Have you obtained the outfit pieces I asked of you?
fr: Avez-vous les pièces d'uniforme que je vous ai demandées ?

en: How goes the eavesdropping, $N? You'd best hurry. I'm getting antsy here.
If I can drain the venom from enough of those nether ray stingers, I think we might just have the most explosive fuel ever devised!
fr: Si je peux prélever du venin sur suffisamment de ces aiguillons de raie du Néant, je crois que nous pourrions obtenir le carburant le plus explosif jamais inventé !

en: Well, do you have the test results?
Isn't this place great? And everyday yields something new and exotic!$B$BWhat a stroke of luck that we nearly destroyed the town digging down here.
fr: Cet endroit n'est-il pas super ? Et chaque jour nous apporte du nouveau et de l'exotisme !$B$BQuelle chance que notre excavation ait presque détruit la ville.

en: Did you investigate the bloodgems used by the Sunfury magisters, $N?
It's over then? Warp-Raider Nesaad is dead?
Back with their tech so soon?  You better not just be pulling my leg here, $C.$B$BThe success of the X-52 project out here depends upon you getting us that stuff a.s.a.p.!
fr: Vous avez déjà récupéré leur technologie ? J'espère bien que vous n'êtes pas en train de me faire marcher, $C.$B$BLe succès du projet X-52 dépend de la vitesse à laquelle vous arriverez à tout récupérer !

en: The Legion won't be prepared for the surprise you have for them, eh $N?
Have you secured the Stone of Glacius?
fr: Avez-vous la pierre de Glacius ?

en: The stories of men are ephemeral, $N. The stories of cities last well into the years.
This device has over a dozen buttons, none of which look familiar to you.
Hello, little flesh beast.
Have you taught the Unyielding the consequences of defying the Forsaken?
Have you saved us from the depredations of Dr. Boom? I promise this time there won't be any exploding wagons, though that was a lot of fun!$B$BWe really should do that more often.
fr: Sommes-nous à l'abri des déprédations du Dr Boum ? Je vous promets que cette fois il n'y aura pas de chariot explosif, même si on avait bien rigolé !$B$BIl faudrait vraiment faire ça plus souvent.

en: Is it done, $N? Have you avenged the fallen of Kirin'Var Village?
Have you finished the task, $N?
You have all of those essences yet?
fr: Vous avez toutes les essences ?

en: Um, hi. I'm a little busy here. What's that you have there?
fr: Euh, bonjour. Je suis un peu occupé, là. Qu'est-ce que c'est ?

en: You have the power from those elementals yet? Oh, don't hurry or anything. It's just my life and career on the line.
fr: Vous avez récupéré la puissance de ces élémentaires ? Oh, ce n’est pas la peine de vous dépêcher, hein. C’est juste ma vie et ma carrière qui sont en jeu.

en: What is this?  A book carried by an Unyielding spirit?  How strange.  Let me study it.  Perhaps I can learn the history of the Unyielding.
fr: Qu'est-ce que c'est ? Un livre qu'avait sur lui un esprit inflexible ? Comme c'est étrange. Permettez-moi de l'étudier. Je pourrai peut-être apprendre quelque chose de l'histoire des Inflexibles.

en: We must help the Unyielding soon.  If we can convince them to join us the Horde will have gained a powerful ally.
fr: Nous devons aider les Inflexibles sans tarder. Si nous parvenons à les convaincre de nous rejoindre, la Horde aura gagné un allié puissant.

en: Whaddya want?
fr: Qu'est-ce vous voulez ?

en: I sure hope that you're up to that tussle with the Burning Legion.$B$BThere aren't many things that I hate worse than those that renege on a deal, or <cough> gnomes, but demons are certainly one of them!
Smoke rises from the Sunfury Hold fortifications. Is that your handiwork?
You have those parts yet?  With the Burning Legion moving in on each of our claims around here one at a time, we unfortunately have little time.
fr: Vous avez les pièces ? La Légion ardente qui s'installe au fur et à mesure sur tous nos emplacements ne nous laisse pas beaucoup de temps.

en: Dealt with Doomclaw yet?
fr: Vous vous êtes déjà occupé de Griffe-funeste ?

en: Did you find some spare parts for my shredder?  I really want to get it fixed so I can get back to mining.  I have to make a living somehow, if only so I can buy a one-way ticket back to Booty Bay.
fr: Avez-vous trouvé des pièces de rechange pour mon déchiqueteur ? J'ai vraiment hâte de le réparer pour pouvoir retourner miner. Il faut bien que j'aie un moyen de gagner ma vie, ne serait-ce que pour pouvoir acheter un aller simple pour Baie-du-Butin.

en: Have you saved my peons yet? Please hurry, I'm afraid they are going to be eaten and they probably won't taste very good. If they taste really bad the fel orcs might get really mad at me.
Were you able to gather any of their energy sources?
fr: Avez-vous pu leur prendre des sources d'énergie ?

en: Have you activated all the runes? I'm eager to see if we can't improve upon the blood elf method here. Anything one of Kael'thas's men can do. real Kirin Tor can do better.
fr: Avez-vous activé toutes les runes ? Je suis impatient de voir si nous ne pourrions pas améliorer la méthode des elfes de sang. Tout ce que les hommes de Kael'thas peuvent faire, le véritable Kirin Tor peut le faire mieux.

en: Have you completed your task, $N?
fr: Votre tâche est-elle achevée, $N ?

en: Welcome to Spinebreaker Post.  How might my talents serve you?
fr: Bienvenue au poste de Brise-échine. Comment puis-je vous être utile ?

en: The symbols scrolling in front of you look alien and unintelligible.
Let us see what you've brought to us, $N.
Have you completed your task, $N?
fr: Votre tâche est-elle achevée, $N ?

en: What did you think?  Still needs some tweaking, eh?
fr: Qu'en pensez-vous ? Encore quelques réglages à faire, hein ?

en: Have you blown the horn by the siege tower yet?  We must do this soon.  Who knows when Thrallmar will have need of the Unyielding.
fr: Avez-vous sonné le cor près de la tour de siège ? Il faut le faire rapidement. On ne sait pas quand Thrallmar pourrait avoir besoin des Inflexibles.

en: Levixus's army grows in size and power with each second that passes. You must hurry.
fr: L'armée de Levixus grandit en nombre et en puissance à chaque seconde qui passe. Vous devez faire vite.

en: Who are you and what do you want? Oh... It's YOU.
fr: Qui êtes-vous, et qu'est-ce que vous voulez ? Oh… C'est VOUS.

en: Do you have the results of the experiment?
fr: Avez-vous les résultats de l'expérience ?

en: Did you obtain the keystone?
I hope that you're here concerning the wanted ad that I placed!
fr: J'espère que vous êtes ici au sujet de mon avis de recherche !

en: Is it done? Have you wiped the Zaxxis scum from the face of Outland and brought me their insignia?
fr: Est-ce fait ? Avez-vous balayé la vermine Zaxxis de la surface de l'Outreterre ? M'avez-vous ramené leurs insignes ?

en: I get the impression that the prince is looking for a particular crystal, but I'm not certain what it is.$B$BHave you already recovered the one from the dreadlord?
fr: J'ai l'impression que le prince recherche un cristal en particulier, mais je ne sais pas vraiment de quoi il s'agit.$B$BAvez-vous déjà récupéré celui du seigneur de l'effroi ?

en: Do you have possession of the surveying equipment which the blood elves defaulted on?
fr: Avez-vous repris possession de l'équipement topographique que les elfes de sang ont refusé de payer ?

en: Approach.
fr: Approchez.

en: Hello, traveler. You come to Hazzin because you are in need of my goods?
fr: Bonjour, voyageur. Vous venez trouver Hazzin pour vous procurer des marchandises ?

en: Are you prepared to discuss business now, $N?
I'm certain you have many questions, all of which will be answered in due time.
Were you able to gather the eggs?
This Marid is a fool, or shall I say, was a fool.
Have you challenged and defeated Veraku?
You wish to buy or sell?
fr: C'est pour un achat ou vente ?

en: Hello again, my friend. How fare your efforts to find the crystal?
Do not return until you have at least a rudimentary understanding of what is happening.
fr: Ne revenez pas me voir avant d'avoir au moins une connaissance rudimentaire de la situation.

en: Have you managed to use my experimental device yet?  I think my unstable warp rift generator will work out there so close to the abyss.
fr: Avez-vous déjà pu utiliser mon appareil expérimental ? Je pense que mon générateur de faille dimensionnelle instable fonctionnera là-bas si près des abysses.

en: <The musical tinkling of the naaru's speech fills your mind.>$B$BI sense that you have something of great power with you, $R.  What is it that you bring to me?
Who are you?
fr: Qui êtes-vous ?

en: <Erozion nods.>
I saw you speaking with Duron over there.  You must be on an important mission!
fr: Je vous ai vu parler avec Duron là-bas. Vous devez être sur une mission importante !

en: A report from Orion? Give it here, quickly!$B$B<Frowning, General Krakork quickly scans the tattered document.>$B$BDamn, it's just as we feared. Orion and his warriors could be overrun at any moment!
fr: Un rapport d’Orion ? Donnez, et vite !$B$B<Sourcils froncés, le général Krakork parcourt le document déchiré.>$B$BDamnation ! C’est exactement ce que nous redoutions. Orion et ses guerriers peuvent se faire submerger n’importe quand !

en: I understand the dangers of gathering farahlite are great, but so are the opportunities. A merchant who isn't willing to take the risk may as well close his doors and save himself the trouble.
fr: Je sais bien que les dangers de la collecte de farahlite sont considérables, mais on peut en dire autant des opportunités. Un marchand qui n'est pas prêt à prendre de tels risques peut tout aussi bien fermer boutique.

en: You're still alive, which means you've either got the core, or you've changed your mind. Which is it?
fr: Vous êtes toujours en vie, ce qui ne peut vouloir dire que deux choses : soit vous avez le noyau, soit vous avez changé d'avis. Alors ?

en: You have done it then?  You have the shards that we need?
fr: Vous avez donc réussi ?? Vous avez les éclats dont nous avons besoin ?

en: Have you destroyed Void Baron Galaxis yet?
fr: Avez-vous déjà détruit le baron du Vide Galaxis ?

en: You may only use one chrono-beacon per pocket of time.
Have you succeeded in your task, $N?
Have you managed to find some suitable crystals for a new headpiece for the archmage's staff?
fr: Êtes-vous parvenu à trouver des cristaux dignes de couronner le bâton de l'archimage ?

en: Have you recovered the oculus?
fr: Avez-vous récupéré l'oculus ?

en: I am working on a solution I think may be effective with the strange creatures. I just need more time.
There are too many of them... We must whittle them down or else the survivors will have no chance against them.
What have you found, $N?
What have you found, $N?
What have you found, $N?

The Consortium is keenly interested in wiping out all of the Zaxxis rebels at the Heap to the south.$B$B$C, if you would like to ingratiate yourself further with us, go back down there and bring back more of their affiliation insignia.
My eyesight must be going from all of the nether radiation. You have that fel reaver's heart yet?
fr: Ma vue doit souffrir de toutes ces radiations du néant. Vous avez déjà le cœur de saccageur gangrené ?

en: How may I help you?
fr: Que puis-je faire pour vous ?

en: Were you able to find the registry?
fr: Avez-vous pu trouver le registre ?

en: Have you performed the measurements I asked for, $N?
What have you discovered, $N?
How many nethermancers have you managed to fell?
What news do you bring from Manaforge Ara? Did you deal with Foreman Sundown?
You must recover Naberius's phylactery before we can attack him. Otherwise, he will be invulnerable.
fr: Vous devez récupérer le phylactère de Naberius avant que nous l'attaquions. Sinon, il sera invulnérable.

en: Have you destroyed the lich of that wretched Naberius?
Have you completed your task yet, $N?
Have you completed your task yet, $N?
Have you completed the task I asked of you, $N?
fr: Avez-vous terminé la tâche que je vous ai confiée, $N ?

en: The buck hides are rugged and strong, making for very tough flesh - almost inedible, but we can use them for other purposes.
fr: Les peaux des chevreuils sont raides et épaisses, et leur chair est coriace, presque immangeable, mais nous pouvons leur trouver d'autres usages.

en: Do you bear any of our enemies' insignias, $N?
fr: M’apportez-vous les insignes de nos ennemis, $N ?

en: Do you bear more of our enemies' insignias, $C?  The Burning Legion continues to be a threat and we continue to pursue them anywhere that we find them.
I'll take any leftover marks you might have.  Do not worry; your actions will be duly noted.
Did you have any luck with the briefings from Manaforge Duro?
Did the plan work? I was half-expecting you to get blown up, to tell you the truth.
fr: Le plan a-t-il fonctionné ? Je m'attendais à moitié à ce que vous vous fassiez pulvériser, pour tout vous dire.

en: Have you completed your task yet, $N?
Did you have any luck finding my hammer?
fr: Avez-vous réussi à trouver mon marteau ?

en: <There appear to be tears in the apprentice's eyes as he speaks.>$B$BHave you... dealt with Master Rhonsus?
<The cow looks at you distrustfully, but stands its ground.>
fr: <La vache vous regarde d’un air méfiant et refuse de bouger.>

en: That was fast. You must be a very efficient person to have placed all three of those markers already.
fr: C'était rapide. Vous devez être remarquablement efficace, sans quoi vous n'auriez pas déjà placé ces trois marqueurs.

en: Have you killed all of the demons at the Ruins of Farahlon yet?
Did you complete the shut down? You should hurry before I change my mind about the whole deal.
fr: Vous avez réussi à tout fermer ? Dépêchez-vous avant que je ne reconsidère notre accord.

en: Well done, fleshling...
Have you completed your task, $N?
fr: Votre tâche est-elle achevée, $N ?

en: You have enough of that shale yet? I'm going to need a lot of it to extract the amount of oil that'll be needed for the X-52 Nether Rocket's fuel.
fr: Vous avez ramassé assez de lauze ? Il va m'en falloir beaucoup pour en extraire la quantité d'huile nécessaire pour le carburant de la Fusée-de-Néant X-52.

en: Did you find the remains of the weapon Kael'thas used against the village?
fr: Avez-vous trouvé des restes de l'arme que Kael'thas a utilisée contre le village ?

en: Any luck in finding Ya-six?
fr: Avez-vous pu trouver Ya-six ?

en: There are still plenty of targets on the Abyssal Shelf, $N. Grab a gryphon when you're ready for another run.
fr: Il reste encore plein de cibles sur la Saillie abyssale, $N. Attrapez un griffon quand vous serez prêt à retenter votre chance.

en: The Legion must not think they are safe high atop the Abyssal Shelf.  We must hit them repeatably!
fr: La Légion ne doit pas penser qu’elle est en sécurité sur la Saillie abyssale. Nous devons la frapper en permanence !

en: Have you managed to gather the herbs?
fr: Avez-vous pu cueillir les plantes ?

en: Is that a piece from the giant crystal shard up on Fallen Sky Ridge?
fr: Est-ce un morceau de l'éclat de cristal géant de la crête Tombeciel ?

en: Did it work?  What did you learn?  Did you find out who or what is behind what happened at Fallen Sky Ridge?
fr: Cela a-t-il fonctionné ? Qu'avez-vous appris ? Savez-vous qui ou quoi est derrière ce qui s'est passé à la crête Tombeciel ?

en: If you have the sixty pieces of wool cloth on you and are ready to donate them, I'm able to take them from you now.
note: D=anglais_base_ac_non_verifie | indice de l'archive (anglais_base_ac_non_verifie, 1 candidat) : « Nous acceptons actuellement les dons pour des tissus en laine.  Un don de soixante morceaux de tissu de laine vous rapportera la pleine reconnaissance des exilés de Gnomeregan pour vos actions généreuses. en: Status, fleshling? What is your status?

A benevolent gift such as silk, might I add, would certainly increase your local standing in the community! If you have the sixty pieces of silk cloth on you and are ready to donate them, I'm able to take them from you now.
Were you able to gather the samples?
fr: Avez-vous pu réunir les échantillons ?

en: If you have the sixty pieces of mageweave cloth on you and are ready to donate them, I'm able to take them from you now.

$n, you've been a tremendous contributor to our cloth drive. As we work hard to replenish our reserves, one form of cloth remains critically low - runecloth. We are in absolutely dire need of it, and we hope that you will be able to help us as you have in the past!$b$bIf you are willing, please bring me what runecloth you can spare. We'll initially accept a single donation of sixty, and then we'll go from there.
Whenever you are ready to hand in the stack of runecloth, I'll accept it.

en: Did you obtain the key, $N?
fr: Vous êtes-vous procuré la clé, $N ?

en: Tell me, $N.  Have the Dreghood elders been released?
fr: Dites-moi, $N. Les anciens crapuches ont-ils été libérés ?

en: Is it done, $N?  Is Arzeth dead?
fr: Est-ce fait, $N ? Arzeth est-il mort ?

en: Have you succeeded in your task, $N?
Have you recovered the data cell?
fr: Avez-vous récupéré la cellule de données ?

en: Have you recovered the relay data?
fr: Avez-vous récupéré les données des relais ?

en: Well, $C - have the terrorfiends been defeated?
Move quickly, $C, we've got to shut down Forge Camp: Mageddon before the demons finish its construction!
fr: Faites vite, $C, nous devons fermer le camp de forge Mageddon avant que les démons n'achèvent sa construction !

en: The Legion could start shelling us at any time, $N! You need to destroy those blasted cannons!
Hurry, $N. Every second that warp-portal stands open, another foul demon is brought into this world!
I have little time to waste, $C. What is this you pester me with?
fr: Je n'ai que peu de temps à perdre, $C. Pourquoi venez-vous m'ennuyer ?

en: Don't tell me your getting cold feet, $C? If they finish construction on that Forge Camp, you'll have more to worry about than just those Fel Reavers! Get to it!
What is it, $C? I sense you've found something that speaks of a coming doom.\n
The Legion could start shelling the Horde at any time, $N! You need to destroy those blasted cannons! \n
You close down that war-portal yet, $N? While you're here shuffling your feet, there are more demons entering Outland! \n
fr: Avez-vous déjà fermé le portail de guerre, $N ? Pendant que vous êtes ici à remuer nerveusement, de nouveaux démons entrent en Outreterre !

en: I sense a growing darkness within your heart, $C. Have you faced your fear? Or does it still await you at the Pools of Aggonar?  \n
fr: Je sens les ténèbres grandir dans votre cœur, $c. Avez-vous affronté votre peur ? Ou bien vous attend-elle encore aux bassins d'Aggonar ?

en: Tell me, $N, has the deed been done? Has the Legionlord been vanquished? \n
Have you recovered the wrapping?
fr: Avez-vous récupéré le linceul ?

en: He must succeed!
Have you obtained Socrethar's teleportation stone, $N?
Is... Is he really dead? Destroyed?
Light be with you, $C.
What troubles you, child?
Both the sludge and waste are extremely toxic. They will form into a congealed void horror if left unchecked!
fr: Le rebut et la vase sont tous deux extrêmement toxiques. Ils se transformeront en horreur du Vide figée si vous ne les en empêchez pas !

en: Go on, $N.  Speak.
fr: Parlez, $N.

en: Hrm, you look a bit dirty... What have you gotten yourself into?
Even the smallest contribution to our cause is noted, $N.  Our enemies are many, but we shall prevail!
What have you done for us lately, $N?  The war against Kael'thas is not going to fight itself, you know?
Have you obtained an arcane tome yet, $N?
Did you get the diagnostic results?
fr: Avez-vous les résultats du diagnostic ?

en: Have you put the creatures out of their misery? Don't get me wrong, I'm really an animal lover, but not when the animals are biting the hand that feeds and shelters them.
Have you obtained any more arcane tomes, $N?
Have you obtained any fel armaments yet, $N?
fr: Avez-vous déjà trouvé des armes gangrenées, $N ?

en: Have you run into any fel armaments lately?  Let the Light do its work, $N.  Do not allow these foul objects to remain in this world.
Did you find Tyralius?
Did you get those diagnostics?
fr: Avez-vous les diagnostics ?

en: Yes?
fr: Oui ?

en: Did you try focusing the dome's energy?
fr: Avez-vous essayé de focaliser l'énergie du dôme ?

en: Were you able to tag enough of the talbuk?
fr: Avez-vous pu marquer assez de talbuks ?

en: Did you get the sample from the monstrous hydra?
fr: Avez-vous l'échantillon de l'hydre monstrueuse ?

en: It looks like you've got the prototype. Did Ghabar send you?
fr: On dirait que vous avez le prototype. Est-ce Ghabar qui vous envoie ?

en: Well?  What did Theledorn have to say?
fr: Eh bien ? Qu'est-ce que Theledorn avait à dire ?

en: Have any pelts to sell me?
fr: <Shauly élève la voix pour attirer l'attention des éthériens qui se trouvent dans les parages.>$B$BVous avez des fourrures à me vendre ?

en: Did you collect everything?
fr: Avez-vous tout réuni ?

en: Have you cleared the test area?
Have you collected enough fragments?
fr: Avez-vous réuni assez de fragments ?

en: Did you hit the mark?
What of the void lord?
I've asked the impossible of you, yet I expect you to succeed.  Much depends on it.
fr: Je vous demande l'impossible, et pourtant j'attends votre victoire. Beaucoup de choses en dépendent.

en: Lieutenant Meridian has been keeping us apprised of the situation at Firewing Point. Is everything okay?
Sergeant Chawni has been keeping us apprised of the situation at Firewing Point. Is everything okay?
It is my honor to serve the wishes of the Horde.  How might I aid you?
fr: Je suis honorée de répondre aux désirs de la Horde. Comment puis-je vous aider ?

en: Did you face the bonechewers, $N.  I hope their blood was spilled in great gouts!
You found sister Wilda?

Did I not speak the truth? The grovestalker lynxes have become a menace not only to those who would travel the path here, but also to Sylvanaar itself.$B$BTheir deaths are regrettable, but the whole point of our creation of the Living Grove is so that Sylvanaar can be surrounded by a defensive region of natural beauty and tranquility.
I cannot stress strongly enough the need for those Thunderlord dire wolves to be dealt with. Their very existence endangers the stability of the Living Grove and all of our work here.
fr: Je ne saurais trop insister sur la nécessité d'une solution au problème que représentent ces loups redoutables sire-tonnerre. Leur existence même met en danger la stabilité du Bosquet vivant et tout notre travail ici.

en: How fares the bolstering of the Living Grove's defenses?$B$BWith the intentions of the arakkoa at Veil Lessh unknown, and the Horde just on the other side of the ravine, I fear that if we do not move quickly we will find ourselves in a poor situation to protect our new home and our work in the grove.
fr: Comment se passe le renforcement des défenses du Bosquet vivant ?$B$BVu que nous ignorons les intentions des arakkoa du Voile Lashh, et avec la présence de la Horde de l'autre côté du ravin, je crains que nous ne devions agir rapidement si nous ne voulons pas nous trouver en position de perdre notre nouveau foyer et notre travail au sein du bosquet.

en: I fear that this land may be without hope.
fr: Je crains qu'il n'y ait plus d'espoir pour cette terre.

en: You continue to serve us well, $N.
fr: Vous continuez à bien nous servir, $N.

fr: Partout où il y a des nagas, on trouve presque toujours des esprits de l'eau torturés.

en: Soon, we will speak with the spirits.
fr: Bientôt, nous parlerons aux esprits.

en: The Bonechewers appear in large numbers, $N. Slay them or the fel orcs may overrun us!
Reporting from Honor Hold, $n?  That's good -- our campaign against the demons and the fel orcs is running thin on able bodies!
fr: Vous venez du bastion de l’Honneur pour vous mettre sous nos ordres, $N ? C’est bien. Notre campagne contre les démons et les gangr’orcs est rendue plus difficile par notre manque de troupes valides !

en: Do you have the talismans, $N?  It pains me to know that those cursed orcs possess our soldiers insignias...
fr: Vous avez les talismans, $N ? Il me pèse de savoir que ces satanés orcs possèdent les insignes de nos soldats.

en: Do you have Morkh's shattered armor?  Have you braved Zeth'Gor again?
fr: Vous avez l'armure brisée de Morkh ? Vous avez réussi à braver Zeth’Gor une nouvelle fois ?

en: Our survival here depends upon our ability to concentrate our efforts against those that truly matter, not the mere bladewing bloodletters.$B$BYou are here again, so this must mean that you have dealt with the matter at hand?
It would seem that the Alliance is determined to follow us wherever we go. Let us teach them that we are not intimidated by their presence.$B$BDo you have that which I have requested?
fr: On dirait que l'Alliance est déterminée à nous suivre où que nous allions. Nous allons leur montrer que nous ne sommes pas intimidés par leur présence.$B$BAvez-vous ce que je vous ai demandé ?

en: How fares the bolstering of our Thunderlord dire wolve's defenses?
fr: Comment se passe le renforcement des défenses de nos loups redoutables sire-tonnerre ?

en: What's that you have there? You're a strong one!
fr: Qu'est-ce vous avez là ? Vous êtes du genre costaud.

en: Have you brought me what I requested of you, $N?
Have you obtained the items I require, $N?
You're ready to perform the trade?

You're back, $N. You must tell me all about what you've found out. But first let us arrange for your reward.
