As per our deal, are you ready to hand over your Wildheart pieces in exchange for your new Feralheart Cowl and Vest?
As per our deal, are you ready to hand over your Magister's pieces in exchange for your new Sorcerer's Crown and Robes?

Our scouts have reported that the Bloodmaul ogres have begun to creep up the switchback, which leads up to the Living Grove from their hold.$B$BIt is unfortunate that we cannot find a way to live together in peace with the ogres, but then, when have we ever been able to do so?

Our scouts have reported that the Bladespire ogres have established a camp even closer to the switchback, which leads from their hold up to us here.$B$BIt is unfortunate that we cannot simply subjugate these ogre scum to our will, but if it's a fight that they want, they will find the Horde more than accommodating.

Bloodmaul or Bladespire, it doesn't matter. All of the ogre clans fight against each other, vying for the dominance that comes with having the favor of Gruul the Dragonkiller.$B$BEach is still our enemy, regardless of who that favor has fallen to.

Bladespire or Bloodmaul, it matters not. All of the ogre clans fight against each other, vying for the dominance that comes with having the favor of Gruul the Dragonkiller.$B$BEach is still our enemy, regardless of who that favor has fallen to, and we will drive them before us!
Any luck out there? I know that it's dangerous work to be doing this amongst the Bloodmaul ogres, but if we can avoid the killing of any more animals, I'll be happy.
fr: Vous vous en sortez ? Je sais bien que c'est dangereux d'accomplir cette tâche au milieu des ogres de la Masse-sanglante, mais si nous pouvons éviter de tuer davantage d'animaux, je me sentirai mieux.

en: Is it done, $N?
fr: Est-ce fait, $N ?

en: Have you obtained Socrethar's teleportation stone, $N?
Isn't this exciting?  After all of the dirt and insects of Silithus, this place is like a paradise.
fr: N'est-ce pas exaltant ? Après toute la saleté et les insectes de Silithus, cet endroit est comme un paradis.

en: It's getting pretty dry around here.  How am I supposed to enjoy my vacation without something to drink?
fr: Il commence à faire sec par ici. Comment pourrais-je profiter de mes vacances sans quelque chose à boire ?

en: What's the word? Are the Bladespire ogres as indiscriminate as the Bloodmaul, or did it nearly kill them like it did me?
fr: Alors, qu’est-ce que cela donne ? Est-ce que les ogres Flèchelames boivent n’importe quoi, comme les Masse-sanglante ? Ou est-ce que cela a manqué de les tuer, comme pour moi ?

en: Get me those tubers!
fr: Donnez-moi ces tubercules !

en: No mercy!
$C, do you have my sword and shield?$B$BWhile I could leave at any time, it would be embarrassing for me to return to Sylvanaar without my trappings.
fr: $C, avez-vous trouvé mon épée et mon bouclier ?$B$BJe pourrais effectivement partir dès maintenant, mais il serait embarrassant de retourner à Sylvanaar sans mon équipement.

en: What was all of that noise? Was that you dealing with Gorr'Dim?
What brings you to me? Surely not more trouble with the Bloodmaul ogre clan?
fr: Qu'est-ce qui vous amène à moi ? Tout de même pas d'autres ennuis avec le clan ogre Masse-sanglante ?

en: Be patient and listen, $N.
Any luck?
fr: Alors, qu'est-ce que ça donne ?

en: You have succeeded?
fr: Vous avez réussi ?

en: Do I know you?
fr: Je vous connais ?

en: What did you see? Tell me, I must know where it is!
fr: Qu'avez-vous vu ? Dites-moi, il faut que je sache où elle se trouve !

en: The significance of these artifacts eludes you, I am sure.$B$BWhen we have all five, our right to the ownership of Thunderlord Stronghold will be secured through the appeasement of its dead spirits.$B$BDo you begin to grasp now why this is so important? Do you understand why I have little patience for niceties?
fr: L'importance de ces artefacts vous échappe, j'en suis sûre.$B$BQuand nous les aurons tous les cinq, l'apaisement des esprits de ses morts garantira notre contrôle du bastion des Sire-tonnerre.$B$BCommencez-vous maintenant à entrevoir l'importance de tout cela ? Comprenez-vous pourquoi je n'ai que peu de patience à accorder aux politesses d'usage ?

en: Ar'tor hovers lifelessly before you.
fr: Ar'tor flotte sans vie devant vous.

en: Fear not, hero. When the time is right, I will assist you...
fr: N'ayez crainte, héros. Lorsque le moment viendra, je vous aiderai...

en: Do you have the boiled blood, $N? I am eager to study it without an interruption this time...
The cipher must be recovered!
fr: Il faut retrouver la formule !

en: <A single tear rolls down Oronok's cheek.>
fr: <Une larme coule le long de la joue d'Oronok.>

en: Hey, you got me hookah and those brews yet?
fr: Hé, vous avez déjà mon narguilé et mes bibines ?

en: You think T'chali likes being this way? No!$B$BSo, have you exacted me revenge yet? Are Grimnok and Korgaah dead?
T'chali does not want to speak again until $N has used the fetish to curse the buildings and towers of both the Bladespire and Bloodmaul clans!
fr: T'chali veut pas parler avant que $N a utilisé le fétiche pour maudire les bâtiments et les tours de Flèchelame et de Masse-sanglante !

en: Tell T'chali... did the brew work? Did the Bladespire ogres like it?
fr: Dites à T'chali… la bière a marché ? Les ogres Flèchelame ont aimé ?

en: <Tobias raises an eyebrow.>$B$BBloodthistle? Never heard of it... Are you a peacekeeper? You know you'd have to tell me if you were... I've got rights!
fr: <Tobias hausse un sourcil.>$B$BChardon sanglant ? Jamais entendu parler... Vous êtes un garde-paix ? Vous savez qu'vous devriez m'le dire si c'était l'cas... J'ai des droits !

en: How's the head hunting?
Do you have the bloodthistle?
fr: Avez-vous le chardon sanglant ?

en: From the crude pictographs on the pages of the aged tome, you discern that a large number of Lashh'an feathers will be needed when casting the spells contained within.
fr: Les grossiers pictographes tracés sur les pages de ce vieux livre vous font comprendre qu'il vous faudra un grand nombre de plumes lashh'an pour lancer les sorts qui y sont consignés.

en: This is exciting! I can't wait to examine the workings of the spell.
fr: C'est très excitant ! Je meurs d'impatience d'étudier le fonctionnement de ce sort.

en: Don't be afraid! This is for science, and science is painful!
Have you tired already, $c?
What did you discover?
fr: Qu'avez-vous découvert ?

en: Have you found a way to destroy the Legion's infernal stockpile?
fr: Avez-vous trouvé un moyen de détruire les réserves infernales de la Légion ?

en: The Vekh'nir arakkoa have been benign for many years, but now something has stirred them.
fr: Les arakkoa vekh'nir n'ont représenté aucun danger pendant des années, mais quelque chose les a éveillés.

en: I eagerly await your results, $N.
Once the Harbinger is aware of your attack upon his flock, he will be quick to respond.
fr: Une fois que le messager aura remarqué que vous attaquez son vol, il ne mettra pas longtemps à réagir.

en: Have you found the tablets yet, $N?
fr: Avez-vous découvert les tablettes, $N ?

en: What have you discovered?
fr: Qu'avez-vous découvert ?

en: Be quick about it, $Gboy:girl;.
fr: Faites vite, gamin.

en: Any news yet, $N? Time is not on our side.
fr: Quelles nouvelles, $N ? Le temps joue contre nous.

en: <You hand the materials to the wing commander.>
fr: <Vous tendez les matériaux au chef d'escadrille.>

en: Have you obtained the four medallion fragments, $N?
fr: Avez-vous les quatre fragments du médaillon, $N ?

en: It's far too complicated, $R. You wouldn't understand.
fr: C'est beaucoup trop compliqué, $r. Vous ne comprendriez pas.

en: The disguise is delicate. Almost any action, aside from walking, will disrupt the magic holding it together.
You must act quickly!
fr: Faites vite !

en: Have you cleared a way into the Deathforge yet?
Did you find any sign of Flanis in the Deathforge?
fr: Avez-vous vu la moindre trace de Flanis dans la Forgemort ?

en: This line of research we have going with the electromentals is exciting! Just think of it... intelligent electrical creatures that we can create at will and that will follow our every instruction!
fr: Cette piste de recherche que nous avons avec les électromentaires est passionnante ! Réfléchissez… Des créatures électriques intelligentes que nous pouvons créer à volonté, et qui obéissent à nos instructions !$B$BFranchement, qu’est-ce qui pourrait aller de travers ?

en: We cannot afford to let their production continue. Have you put an end to the summoning ritual?
fr: Nous ne pouvons laisser la production continuer. Avez-vous mis fin au rituel d'invocation ?

en: What news do you bring from the Deathforge?
fr: Quelles nouvelles rapportez-vous de la Forgemort ?

en: Have you completed the task I asked of you, $N?
fr: Avez-vous terminé la tâche que je vous ai confiée, $N ?

en: Is it done?
fr: Est-ce fait ?

en: We must find a way to destroy the rest of those infernals, $N. We've come far, but failure could still cost us everything.
fr: Nous devons trouver un moyen de détruire le reste de ces infernaux, $N. Nous avons déjà beaucoup accompli, mais un échec pourrait nous coûter la totalité de la campagne.

en: Have the Scourge crumbled beneath your weapon?
Do you have something for me, $R?
Given that you are alive, I can only surmise you were lucky enough to receive wisdom rather than death from Lady Sylvanas.
Well, do you have the measurements from the singing crystals that I asked for?
fr: Alors, avez-vous les mesures des cristaux chantants que je vous ai demandées ?

en: Have you tired already, $c?
What did you discover?
fr: Qu'as-tu découvert ?

en: <You hand the materials to Gulmok.>
fr: <Vous tendez les matériaux à Gulmok.>

en: Have you found a way to destroy the Legion's infernal stockpile?
fr: Alors, tu as trouvé un moyen de détruire les réserves infernales de la Légion ?

en: Have you cleared a way into the Deathforge yet?
Did you find any sign of Kagrosh in the Deathforge?
fr: Avez-vous vu la moindre trace de Kagrosh dans la Forgemort ?

en: We cannot afford to let their production continue. Have you put an end to the summoning ritual?
fr: Nous ne pouvons laisser la production continuer. Avez-vous mis fin au rituel d'invocation ?

en: What news do you bring from the Deathforge?
fr: Quelles nouvelles rapportez-vous de la Forgemort ?

en: A Legion presence in our midst is intolerable! We must find a way to deal with it before they can renew their assault.
fr: Une présence de la Légion à proximité est intolérable ! Nous devons trouver un moyen de la repousser avant qu’ils ne puissent relancer une attaque.

en: Did you get that manual?
fr: Avez-vous le manuel ?

en: What is this $N? What do they believe he will do? Where do they believe he will lead them?
Have you cleared those crystal flayers out of the Singing Ridge yet? We can't get started on my research until you do.

You have them? You have the three drake essences that I so dearly need to continue my research?$B$BYou know that those nether drake eggs used to be black dragon eggs? It's a fact! But when Draenor blew apart, the resultant nether that raced across what was left mutated the eggs.
fr: Vous les avez ? Vous avez les trois essences de drake dont j'ai tant besoin pour poursuivre mes recherches ?$B$BVous saviez que ces œufs de drake du Néant étaient des œufs de dragon noir ? C'est un fait ! Mais quand Draenor a explosé, le néant qui a traversé ce qui en restait a fait muter les œufs.

en: Did you get that manual?
fr: Avez-vous le manuel ?

en: You're back, so I'll assume the operation went well. What've you got to report?
You're back, so I'll assume the operation went well. What've you got to report?
A swift and sure hand is needed for the harvesting. I hope you will be successful.
fr: Des gestes sûrs et rapides, voilà ce qu'il faut pour la récolte. J'espère que vous y arriverez.

en: The wings are quite delicate, but can be inlaid as a decorative element in many of our designs.
fr: Les ailes sont assez fragiles, mais elles peuvent servir d’éléments de décoration dans de nombre de nos créations.

en: Have you completed the task I requested of you, $N?
Those stalkers cleared out yet? We've had a few of our people who headed north disappear.$B$BIf it's because of the stalkers, I want to make sure that it doesn't happen again.
What have you got there?
fr: Qu'avez-vous donc là ?

en: Have you done what I asked of you, $N? Trust is not easily found around these parts.
What have you got there?
fr: Qu'avez-vous donc là ?

en: What do you mean? I'm going to make something out of the ash - obviously.
fr: Que voulez-vous dire ? Évidemment, je vais utiliser la cendre.

en: If you lose your goggles, let me know and I will craft another pair.
fr: Si vous perdez vos lunettes, venez me voir et je vous fabriquerai une nouvelle paire.

en: Did you capture those prototypes?
fr: Avez-vous pris les prototypes ?

en: Did you capture those prototypes?
fr: Avez-vous pris les prototypes ?

en: Did you manage to find my keys?  I'm sure one of my felhounds ate them.  It's probably the one I sent with you.  Probably.
fr: Vous avez réussi à trouver mes clés ? Je suis certain que l'un de mes gangrechiens les a mangées. C'est probablement celui que je vous ai confié. Probablement.

en: Is he dead yet? I'm too scared to look.
How's that collection of teeth coming along?$B$BI'm sure that you're going to do a fine job of getting them for us. While you're doing that, we'll just hold down the outpost here.
fr: Alors, comment se passe la récupération de dents ?$B$BJe suis certain que vous vous débrouillerez très bien. Pendant que vous faites cela, nous nous chargerons de tenir l’avant-poste.

en: Fly to Netherwing Ledge to recover the piece.
fr: Volez jusqu'à l'escarpement de l'Aile-du-Néant pour récupérer l'armure.

en: You must use the Spectrecles if you wish to see the spirits of Shadowmoon.
fr: Vous devez utiliser les Lunectoplasmes si vous souhaitez voir les esprits d'Ombrelune.

en: You must use the Spectrecles if you wish to see the spirits of Shadowmoon.
fr: Vous devez utiliser les lunectoplasmes si vous souhaitez voir les esprits d'Ombrelune.

en: Have you completed the task I asked of you?
Have you slain the demoness?
Aye, a duality exists... I can feel it.
fr: Si fait, il y a une dualité... je le sens.

en: If you lose your goggles, let me know and I will craft another pair.
fr: Si vous perdez vos lunettes, venez me voir et je vous fabriquerai une nouvelle paire.

en: What's that you say?
Here ta collect a reward, mon?
fr: Z'êtes là pour une récompense, mon vieux ? Non ?

en: I hope you've done somethin' special, $Glad:lass;. Otherwise, buzz off!
fr: J’espère que vous avez fait quelque chose de spécial, ma fille. Autrement, fichez-moi le camp !

en: Have you obtained the book, $N?
Have you completed what I asked of you, $N?
Do you bear any of our enemies' insignias, $N?
fr: M’apportez-vous les insignes de nos ennemis, $N ?

en: Do you bear more of our enemies' insignias, $C?  The Burning Legion continues to be a threat and we continue to pursue them anywhere that we find them.
I'll take any leftover marks you might have.  Do not worry; your actions will be duly noted.
Go on, $N.  Speak.
fr: Parlez, $N.

en: The trick to using the repolarized magneto sphere is to know when to turn it off before you end up getting truly fried.$B$BOf course, you need to balance that against how many of those flying serpents you want to have to face.$B$BSpeaking of which, have you managed to charge up the sphere?
fr: L'astuce pour utiliser la magnéto-sphère repolarisée, c'est de savoir la débrancher avant de finir complètement grillé.$B$BBien sûr, il faut aussi prendre en compte le nombre de serpents volants qu'on est prêt à affronter.$B$BEn parlant de ça, vous avez fini de charger la sphère ?

en: What have you done for us lately, $N?  The war against Kael'thas is not going to fight itself, you know?
Even the smallest contribution to our cause is noted, $N. Our enemies are many, but we shall prevail!
Spleens! I need spleens!
fr: Des rates ! Il me faut des rates !

en: Spleens! I need spleens!
fr: Des rates ! Il me faut des rates !

en: What brings you here, $C? I don't get many visitors.
What brings you here, $C? I don't get many visitors.
Did you get those materials?
fr: Vous avez le matériel ?

en: Were you able to smuggle a manacell out of the Mechanar.
Have you retrieved the book?
Have you secured the underworld loam?
Is the Illidari lieutenant dead?
You've returned.  Has Xeleth been slain?
fr: Vous êtes de retour. Xeleth a-t-il été tué ?

en: Were you able to wrest the gem from the grip of O'mrogg?
You have my pound of flesh? What, you didn't think that was funny?
fr: Vous avez ma livre de chair ? Quoi, vous ne trouvez pas ça drôle ?

en: Listen, I do not have the time nor the inclination to explain what any of this means. Just tag those diemetradons.
Snap to it! That gnome's appetite knows no limit!
fr: Quelle plaie ! Ce gnome a un appétit sans bornes !

en: I take it that since we're speaking, you have the light orbs from the Razaan's Landing? It'll be interesting to take a look at them and see what the ethereal are up to.
fr: Je suppose que si vous revenez me voir, c’est que vous avez les orbes de lumière du Point d'ancrage de Razan ? Ce serait très intéressant d’y jeter un coup d’œil pour voir ce que préparent les éthériens.

en: Have you dealt with that soul-stealing bastard, Razaan yet?
fr: Vous êtes-vous déjà occupé de cette crapule de voleur d'âmes de Razaan ?

en: Special of the day: Gizzard.
fr: Spécialité du jour : du gésier.

en: Special of the day: Felspine's hide.
fr: Spécialité du jour : la peau de Gangréchine.

en: Have you quenched the sword in the lava of the Hand of Gul'dan?
Is everything okay?
Have you found the tablets yet, $N?
fr: Avez-vous découvert les tablettes, $N ?

en: Any news yet, $N? Time is not on our side.
fr: Quelles nouvelles, $N ? Le temps joue contre nous.

en: Have you obtained the four medallion fragments, $N?
fr: Avez-vous les quatre fragments du médaillon, $N ?

en: Have you completed the task I asked of you, $N?
fr: Avez-vous terminé la tâche que je vous ai confiée, $N ?

en: Have you completed the task I asked of you?
What can I do for you today?
Have you completed what I asked of you, $N?
What? What?! Be quick about it... there's so much to do around here.$B$BI want to get this thing off the ground some day, you know?
Return to me when the wilds are safe for our caravans to traverse.
Return to me when the wilds are safe for our caravans to traverse.
<A'dal's voice vibrates melodically through your mind.>$B$BYou have returned.  Do you bring with you the two shards of the Arcatraz key?
fr: <Les vibrations mélodiques de la voix d'A'dal résonnent dans votre esprit.>$B$BVous êtes de retour. Apportez-vous les deux pièces de la clé du satellite d'Arcatraz ?

en: You've returned, $N.
Don't worry, $n! Worry never got anyone anywhere!
What? You don't want to perform the experiment? Don't fret, $n! I'm behind you all the way!
Hello hello! My clo-... I mean, my cousin Tally told me you'd be dropping in. Do you have something for me?
fr: Salut salut ! Mon clo… je veux dire mon cousin Tally m'a dit que vous feriez un saut. Vous avez quelque chose pour moi ?

en: Have you protected the trees? Are the hewers cut down?
What have you learned, $N?
You have all of the venom glands? If not, begone and waste no more of my time until you do.
fr: Vous avez toutes les glandes à venin ? Si ce n'est pas le cas, filez et ne venez plus me faire perdre mon temps tant que vous n'aurez pas terminé.

en: How's the procurement of nets coming along?  From what I've seen, those nets that the poachers use should be strong enough for the task at hand.
fr: Comment se passe l'obtention des filets ? Pour ce que j'ai pu en voir, ces filets utilisés par les braconniers devraient être assez résistants pour ce travail.

en: What's that you have there?  Is that a blood stain on that note?
fr: Qu'est-ce que vous avez là ? C'est du sang, cette tache sur votre papier ?

en: Is it done?
fr: Et la marmotte ? Elle a mis le poison dans les tonneaux ?

en: Back so soon? Have you come to deliver that which Rexxar owes me?
fr: Déjà de retour ? Vous venez m'apporter ce que Rexxar me doit ?

en: What news do you bring? Do you know what the wyrmcultists are up to?
The Bloodmaul ogres will trouble us no longer when this task is done.
fr: Les ogres de la Masse-sanglante ne vous ennuieront plus quand ce travail sera terminé.

en: It will be good to have Leokk's aid once again.
fr: Leokk nous a apporté la tête de l'un des dragons noirs de la Fin des dragons. Grâce à elle, nous pourrons rendre furieux Goc, le gronn qui l'a capturé, et le pousser à se battre.

en: Only through the deaths of Goc and Gorgrom the Dragon-Eater will we free the Mok'Nathal.
Did you run into much trouble snatching the whelps? I hope you didn't get singed!
fr: Avez-vous eu du mal à attraper les dragonnets ? J'espère que vous ne vous êtes pas fait roussir !

en: You've dealt with Maxnar the Ashmaw already?$B$BAre you having trouble finding him? As I understand it if you head to the right once you enter their caverns, it will eventually curve around and lead you to him.
$C, you are back so soon? Do you have the poison?
fr: $C, vous êtes déjà de retour ? Vous avez le poison  ?

en: What have you to report, soldier?
fr: Qu'avez-vous à dire, soldat ?

en: What have you to report, soldier?
fr: Qu'avez-vous à dire, soldat ?

en: Have you delivered the hand of justice?
You've something to show me, $N?
You've something to show me, $N?
What is this?
fr: Qu'est-ce que c'est ?

fr: Avez-vous les matériaux que je vous ai demandés ?

What have you to report. soldier?

fr: Qu'avez-vous à dire, soldat ?

en: You have returned!
fr: Vous êtes de retour !

en: Soon I will sleep the deep sleep of the forest. Before I dig my roots deep and close these old eyes forever I hope to know that those wretched imps suffered and perished.
Is it done?  Did you return some life to my ancient home?
fr: Est-ce fait ? Avez-vous rendu un peu de vie à mon ancienne demeure ?

en: What have you to report, soldier?
fr: Qu'avez-vous à dire, soldat ?

fr: Qu'avez-vous à dire, soldat ?

fr: Qu'avez-vous découvert ?

fr: Qu'avez-vous à dire, soldat ?

en: You have returned!
fr: Vous êtes de retour !

en: Have you recovered the totem from Asghar?
fr: Avez-vous pris le totem à Asghar ?

en: Did you manage to get the rod?
fr: Avez-vous réussi à vous procurer le bâtonnet ?

en: Have you gathered the feathers for the staff?
fr: Vous avez rassemblé les plumes pour le bâton ?

en: <A'dal greets you.>
fr: <A'dal vous salue.>

en: Have you returned with the imbued headpiece?
fr: Êtes-vous de retour avec le bourdon imprégné ?

en: Have you destroyed the Bloodmaul Camp yet?
Did you recover whatever was in that gronn's sack for Sablemane? What has he given us?
fr: Avez-vous récupéré ce qui se trouvait dans le sac de ce gronn pour Sablecrin ? Que nous a-t-il donné ?

en: We have come a long way in a short time, you and I. I dare say that you are the most capable ogre hunter that I have ever known.$B$BI trust then that you will deal with the Boulder'mok ogres soon?
Reestablishing ties with the wolf spirit is just the beginning of my journey, not the end.
fr: Le rétablissement de liens avec l'esprit du loup n'est que le début de mon voyage, et non sa fin.

en: Zeth'Gor must burn, $N! Speak with me again when your task is complete.
<General Auralion is floating in the middle of the crystal.>$B$BWha... What are you doing here?
fr: <Le général Auralion flotte au milieu du cristal.>$B$BQue... Que faites-vous ici ?

en: I cannot express strongly enough how important it is that you kill Dorgok as quickly as possible.
Have you destroyed the Bloodmaul Camp yet?
Hello, $Glad:lass;, what news do you bring?
fr: Salut, mon gars, quelles nouvelles apportez-vous ?

en: You have all of the venom glands? If not, begone and waste no more of my time until you do!
fr: Vous avez toutes les glandes à venin ? Sinon, partez et ne gaspillez plus mon temps jusqu'à ce que ce soit le cas !

en: You are before me again, $C. This must mean that you've procured the sack out from underneath Grulloc's nose.
fr: Vous êtes une nouvelle fois devant moi, $c. Cela signifie probablement que vous avez pris le sac sous le nez de Grulloc.

en: Did the baron fashion us a trap? One powerful enough to kill a gronn?
fr: Le baron nous a-t-il fabriqué un piège assez puissant pour tuer un gronn ?

en: Has the message been delivered?
fr: Le message a-t-il été envoyé ?

en: I dare say that you are the most capable ogre hunter that I have ever known.$B$BI trust then that you will deal with the Boulder'mok ogres soon?
I cannot save them by myself, $N!
Have you managed yet to decimate the Bladespire ogres at Gruul's Lair?$B$BDo not come to me with excuses, $gboy:girl;! Get the job done!
In time, all the sons of Gruul will be destroyed.
fr: À terme, tous les fils de Gruul seront détruits.

en: Have you completed the task I requested of you, $N?
Is it done, $N? Have you stopped the dark conclave from completing their ritual?
fr: C’est fait, $N ? Avez-vous empêché le sombre Conclave d’accomplir son rituel ?

en: Report, $N. Is that Bleeding Hollow blood I see on your sleeve? I hope so!
Don't be bothering me! Can't you see I'm trying to unlock mysterious powers?
fr: Cessez de m'importuner ! Ne voyez-vous pas que j'essaye de mettre à jour des pouvoirs mystérieux ?

en: I cannot believe my eyes.
The orcs of the Bleeding Hollow Clan were dark allies long ago... and even darker enemies now.
fr: Les orcs du clan de l’Orbite-sanglante étaient autrefois de sombres alliés... avant de devenir des ennemis encore plus sombres.

en: Allow me to finish telling you my tale.
Hail, $N. What news do you bring?
Hail, $N. What news do you bring?
My patience is tiring, why have you not finished them?
Are you looking to join my list of those expendable? Get those keys and silence Doomcryer!
Even the smallest contribution to our cause is noted, $N. Our enemies are many, but we shall prevail!
What have you done for us lately, $N? The war against Kael'thas is not going to fight itself, you know?
Go on, $N. Speak.
$C, do you feel that?  I sense something unnatural and evil nearby.
fr: $C, le sentez-vous aussi ? Je perçois quelque chose de contre-nature et maléfique tout près d'ici.

en: Do you bear any of our enemies' insignias, $N?
fr: M’apportez-vous les insignes de nos ennemis, $N ?

en: Do you bear more of our enemies' insignias, $C? The Burning Legion continues to be a threat and we continue to pursue them anywhere that we find them.
I'll take any leftover marks you might have. Do not worry; your actions will be duly noted.
The evil that is inhabiting the trees is beginning to seep into every natural thing in the woods.$B$BYou must act quickly, $N, before all is lost!
Have you created the primal mooncloth sample?
fr: Avez-vous créé l'échantillon d'étoffe lunaire primordiale ?

en: Did you get the nether-wraith sample?
Have you used the crystal's power to deepen your attunement to the Altar of Shadows?
The evils of the Bleeding Hollow orcs know no bounds, and are rivaled by only their Shattered Hand cousins.
fr: La malveillance des orcs de l’Orbite-sanglante est sans borne, et n’est rivalisée que par celle de leurs cousins de la Main brisée.

en: Good day, $N. And how is your stay in Hellfire Peninsula? I trust it has been fruitful...
fr: Salutations, $N. Comment se déroule votre séjour dans la péninsule des Flammes infernales ? J’espère qu’il a été fructueux...

en: Is it done? I can only hope that it is not too late...
I require nethervine crystals.
fr: J'ai besoin de cristaux vignéants.

en: Do you have the reading? Has your mission with the Demonaic Scryer been successful?
fr: Vous avez le relevé ? Votre mission avec le scrutateur démonien s’est bien déroulée ?

en: Darkness surrounds us. What have you to say about Veil Skith?
fr: Les ténèbres nous entourent. Qu'avez-vous à dire à propos du Voile Skith ?

en: How many ethereals have you destroyed? I hope it will be enough to drive them from the Tomb of Lights.
You have saved us all. What can we do to thank you?
fr: Vous nous avez tous sauvés. Comment pouvons-nous vous remercier ?

en: The Mok'Nathal do not accept failure, or make excuses. Either you vanquish your foe, or he kills you!$B$BSince you are standing before me, you must have killed Gnosh Brognat already.

Though you will not further yourself in my eyes, there is no shame in admitting that you aren't up to the challenge of slaying the mother of the Singing Ridge nether drakes.$B$BIs that what you are here to tell me?
We have many enemies. Some we have chosen, and some, such as the Vehk'nir, we have not.$B$BRegardless, we shall slay all of their chieftains until none stand before us.
You have returned, $C. What news do you bring?
fr: Vous êtes de retour, $C. Quelles nouvelles apportez-vous ?

en: Evil grows in Veil Rhaze. Put it down, $r.
You have traveled far and bear news for me.
fr: Vous venez de loin et vous m'apportez des nouvelles.

en: You uncover an opening through which fuel is loaded into the fel reaver.
Have you gone to Bladespire Outpost and taken their totems from them?
fr: Êtes-vous allé à l'avant-poste Flèchelame ? Leur avez-vous pris leurs totems ?

en: I'm bored, there's nobody to play with. Have you found my friends?

The drakes of the Singing Ridge may pose a threat to us, but I think they are majestic creatures.$B$BOr, at least they were.  I hope that you will be able to save their spirits.$B$BAnd if you are in need of more totems, I have a few to spare.
fr: Les drakes de la Crête chantante sont peut-être une menace pour nous, mais ce sont aussi des créatures majestueuses.$B$BDu moins, ils l'étaient. J'espère que vous pourrez sauver leurs esprits.$B$BS'il vous faut plus de totems, j'en ai quelques-uns en réserve.

en: Waste no time, we have much work to do!
fr: Ne perdez pas de temps, nous avons beaucoup à faire !

en: Did you try out my little experiment, $N?
How goes it? Did you get a chance to show the Legion a lesson or two?
Is it done then? Are the teleporters shut down?
fr: C'est donc fait ? Les téléporteurs sont fermés ?

en: Have you collected all of the Razaani Light Orbs that are needed?
fr: Avez-vous collecté tous les orbes de lumière razaani dont nous avons besoin ?

en: Have all of the ingredients yet?  Talking about it with you has made my mouth water!
fr: Vous avez tous les ingrédients ? J'en ai déjà l'eau à la bouche !

en: Have you done your bidding? Quash the evil before it is too late!
The Demonaic Scryer is not yet appeased, $N. Return to me after you have reaped the souls of Shattered Hand orcs.
<Karynaku groans.>
Have you done it? Are the souls of our ancestors safely recovered from the evil of the ethereals?
How many arakkoa have slain $N?  Did they run from you?  Did they run and hide when you stormed into their camp?
How many arakkoa have you slain $N?
Did you find our missing people?
Veil Shalas must be silenced!
Have you faced the Hand of Kargath, $N?
fr: Avez-vous affronté la Main de Kargath, $N ?

en: Do you have the Dread Relic?  We must have it.
fr: Vous avez la relique de l'effroi ? Il nous la faut.

en: Have you done what I asked of you, $N? I fear for our lives.
This is no time for idle chatter, $N. We're under attack! Hold off the invaders!
You wish to show me something, $N?
Have you retrieved the relics, $N? We cannot allow the Shadow Council to use their power for dark purposes.

<A'dal focuses his attention upon you, his gaze almost unbearable.>$B$BAndorrian, perhaps you do not understand the magnitude of your mission? There is no time to waste... gather yourself a group of compatriots and enter the Arcatraz.$B$BPut an end to Harbinger Skyriss.
<A'dal greets you.>
fr: <A'dal vous salue.>

en: <A'dal greets you.>
fr: <A'dal vous salue.>

en: <A'dal greets you.>
fr: <A'dal vous salue.>

en: Yes, $N?
fr: Oui, Silhantcat ?

en: <A'dal greets you.>
fr: <A'dal vous salue.>

en: Is she dead?$B$B$N, if we're to have a fighting chance here, we need you to sow confusion into their ranks by killing Draaca Longtail!
How can I help you?  You bring news from Evergrove?
fr: Comment puis-je vous aider ? Apportez-vous des nouvelles du Bosquet éternel ?

en: Time is crucial, $N. We need those guard towers burned!
fr: Le temps nous est compté, $N. Il faut faire brûler ces tours de garde !

en: Have you destroyed the worst of the infestations?
Are you sure about this, $N? Specializing in potions will prevent you from pursuing other specializations.
What brings you here?
fr: Qu'est-ce qui vous amène par ici ?

en: Are you sure you want to become a master transmuter? If you specialize in this field you will find it impossible to specialize in potions or elixirs.
With the cudgel reformed, I shall break free of my bonds and return to Serpentshrine to exact vengeance on Vashj and her minions!
fr: Si le gourdin est reformé, je pourrai me libérer de mes liens et retourner au sanctuaire du Serpent, afin de me venger de Vashj et de ses sbires.

en: The essences! Do you have them?
Do you have the cannonballs yet?
fr: Avez-vous déjà les boulets de gangrecanon ?

en: The fel spirits of the Shattered Hand orcs are a blight to poor Jules' soul.  Tell me, $N... has he been appeased?
fr: Les esprits gangrenés des orcs de la Main brisée sont une pestilence pour l’âme du pauvre Jules. Dites-moi, $N... l’avez-vous apaisé ?

en: Have you destroyed both of the warp-gates yet?
fr: Avez-vous détruit les deux portails dimensionnels ?

en: It is over then? Has the danger at Death's Door been averted?
fr: C'est donc fini ? Le danger qui nous menaçait à la Porte de la mort a donc été évité ?

en: It's a terrible thing to ask, I know...
fr: Je sais que ce n'est pas une demande facile…

en: Take no prisoners!
fr: Pas de prisonniers !

en: You must destroy the ancient evil before it has regained its powers.
Have you found the prayer beads, $n?  Their powers are crucial to many holy rites... including the rite of exorcism.
fr: Avez-vous retrouvé mon chapelet, $N ? Ses pouvoirs sont cruciaux pour bien des rituels sacrés... y compris le rituel d’exorcisme.

en: Do you bring the feathers I asked for, $N?

Skettis's lapdogs still keeps a close watch over us, outcasts.  The moment any of us sets foot outside Shattrath we'll be as good as dead.$B$BBring me more feathers as proof of your victory over them.
Fei Fei looks at you expectantly...
I can feel the poison flowing through my veins. The naaru call to me, I can see the light. Are the dreadfang widows defeated?
Has Terokkarantula been slain?
You get paid when the job is done, $Gsonny:missy;.
Has Teribus the Cursed been purged from the skies of Terokkar?
fr: Les cieux de Terokkar ont-ils été débarrassés de Teribus le Maudit ?

en: Did Zeppit cooperate enough for you to get all the blood I'll need?
fr: Zeppit a-t-il coopéré suffisamment pour que vous récupériez tout le sang dont j’ai besoin ?

en: I swore I told Sentinel Moonwhisper to give direct orders. Are you not obeying them?
I swore I told Grunt Grahk to give direct orders. Are you not obeying them?
We think the one that popped up at the dig was actually a baby worm!
fr: Nous pensons que la créature qui est apparue pendant les fouilles n’était qu’un bébé ver !

en: Take a friend with you!
fr: Emmenez un ami !

en: Go to Anchorite Barada, $n.  He must succeed with his ritual if the colonel is to be saved.
fr: Allez voir l’anachorète Barada, $N. Il faut qu’il réussisse son rituel si nous voulons sauver le colonel.

en: Is the drillmaster dead? Hmm, maybe my scouts are wrong?
I see that you have managed to complete a deck of Blessings! Congratulations!
I see that you have managed to complete a deck of Storms! Congratulations!
fr: Je vois que vous avez réussi à réunir une suite de Tempêtes ! Félicitations !

en: I see that you have managed to complete a deck of Furies! Congratulations!
I see that you have managed to complete a deck of Lunacy! Congratulations!
Is the deed done, $N?  Illidan is not a patient master!
Have you retrieved the phylactery yet, $N?
Yes, $N?
fr: Oui, Silhantcat ?

en: Yes, $N?
fr: Oui, Silhantcat ?

en: Have you brought the ingredients for the draught? Take care not to get pollen on me, please. I sneeze uncontrollably in its presence.$B$B<Morthis sniffs at the indignity represented by a sneeze.>
You think it's true what they say about the Caverns of Time?
If what they say about the Caverns of Time is true, then it must be a place of great power.
<You prepare to administer the potion to the sleeping $C.>
Be quick, $r. If these creatures escape the barrow, Clintar Dreamwalker will not be the only one in danger.
It is good to see you again, $C. I trust that you and young Dornaa had a wonderful time together?
It is good to see you again, $C. I trust that you and young Salandria had a wonderful time together?
Any luck?
fr: Alors ?

en: Have you recovered any I.D tags?

I am in need of more I.D. tags, $N. What I've discovered thus far is that this is not just a way to catalogue prisoners but it also documents locations!$B$BOnce this code is broken we'll be able to pinpoint exactly where all of our allies are held and free them with minimal hostile action received.
I know it's asking a lot but think of the lives that could be saved!
You made it! Any luck?

We're at an impasse here, $n. The data you've collected has given us enough information to save our allies being held at the smaller prisons of Netherstorm but we must press forward and eradicate the larger Ethereum threats here at Bash'ir's Landing.$b$bJoin the battle against the Ethereum! Bring Ethereum prison keys to me and I shall forge Ethereum stasis chamber keys for you to use on the stasis chambers of Bash'ir.
This will be your most daunting task, $N.
I would understand if you chose not to continue, $N.
Did Clintar help you recover the relics?
<Arthorn looks at you hopefully.>$B$BWere you able to track down any information about the book?

Only the most steadfast and battle-hardened of adventurers will take me up on this offer, $n. Should you wish to face the horrors of the second stasis chamber in the Mana-Tombs, I am able to synthesize a key. Bring me a mark of the Nexus-King and I will make it so.
<Xi'ri acknowledges your presence.>
Did you catch one of the sparrowhawks?
Did you recover enough of the Book of the Raven for me to reconstruct it?
<The sparrowhawk seems to speak with Arthorn's voice.>$B$BDid you succeed in freeing the essence of the eagle spirit?
<Once again, Arthorn's voice issues from the sparrowhawk.>$B$BDo you have the falcon's essence?
Did you overcome the hawk's guardian and win its essence?
I've been waiting for word from Arthorn. What have you discovered?
You look like you've been through quite an ordeal. Was the moonstone really that hard to find?
Is Grulloc no more?
fr: Grulloc a-t-il succombé ?

en: Do you have the chest?
fr: Avez-vous le coffre ?

en: Do you return with Slaag's standard in hand?
fr: Me rapportez-vous l'étendard de Skori ?

en: Have you summoned forth Vim'gol the Vile and taken the grimoire from his dead clutches?
fr: Avez-vous invoqué Vim'gol l'Infâme et arraché le grimoire aux griffes de son cadavre ?

en: Have you taken Skulloc's soul yet?
fr: Vous avez déjà pris l’âme de Crânoc ?

en: What news from Sethekk Halls? Have you defeated Anzu?
For the first time - in as long as I can remember - there is silence.
For the first time - in as long as I can remember - there is silence.
Have you obtained the dust, $N?
Is the deed done, $N? I'd kill those blasted birdmen myself if it weren't for my injuries.
It looks like the commander was not delirious after all. Bring me more dust and I'll prepare another elixir for you.
You heard my call? Yes...
Did you finish your assignment yet?
You take out their stacks of fel cannonballs yet?
fr: Alors, ces piles de boulets de gangrecanons, elles sont détruites ?

en: <Mor'ghor grunts.>$B$BYou're late...
fr: <Mor'ghor pousse un grognement.>$B$BTu es en retard…

en: Nether crystals are used for lots of things. Mainly makin' weapons and armor...
fr: Les cristaux du Néant nous servent à beaucoup de choses. Principalement à fabriquer des armes et des armures…

en: We use the flayer hides for armor lining and structural tarps.
fr: Les peaux d'écorcheurs nous servent à capitonner les armures et à fabriquer des bâches.

en: Like I said, netherdust pollen is used by our spell casters.
fr: Comme je le disais, c'est nos lanceurs de sorts qui utilisent le pollen de pruinéante.

en: Gug over there is gonna use the ore to reinforce our weapons and armor.
fr: Gug utilisera le minerai pour renforcer nos armures et réparer nos armes.

en: It is dirty work, $N.
fr: C'est un sale boulot, $N.

en: You've something to show me?
How goes the bombing run?
fr: Alors, ça bombarde ?

en: You have the smell of Skettis on you! Explain yourself!
fr: Vous portez l'odeur de Skettis ! Expliquez-vous !

en: As you come to a understand the shards and crystals, you will be better able to assist us in protecting ourselves and our ogre brethren below.$B$BThe shards themselves get their name from an ancient and now-extinct arakkoan civilization, which used to live atop the mountains here.$B$BDo you have the shards with you?
fr: Comprendre les éclats et les cristaux vous permettra de mieux nous aider à assurer notre sécurité et celle de nos frères d'en bas.$B$BLes éclats doivent leur nom à une ancienne civilisation arakkoa aujourd'hui disparue, qui vivait autrefois au sommet de ces montagnes.$B$BAlors, avez-vous les éclats ?

en: We trust that you've used the banishing crystal to send a whole slew of those Burning Legion things packing?!

Da demons of dat camp fixes da transporter all da times. Gahk say $n smash dems better dis time!$b$bBut, Gahk need another darkrune ta make da crystalforged darkrune.$b$bIf little $r not have a darkrune, you talk with Kronk. Him try ta make one darkrune every day! Maybe yous get one in his grab bag?!
The book, $N. Have you obtained it?
fr: Le livre, $N. Est-ce que vous l'avez ?

en: You have that magic flask, yet? It will mean the world to little Torkus Jr.
fr: Vous avez le flacon magique ? Il est très important pour le petit Torkus Junior.

en: You've decided against your previous choice?  I suppose I can help you reverse it.  In the end Dalaran cares more about your loyalty than how you choose to show it.$b$bIt won't be cheap.  And of course, I will need your old ring back.

You've decided against your previous choice?  I suppose I can help you reverse it.  In the end Dalaran cares more about your loyalty than how you choose to show it.$b$bIt won't be cheap.  And of course, I will need your old ring back.

You've decided against your previous choice?  I suppose I can help you reverse it.  In the end Dalaran cares more about your loyalty than how you choose to show it.$b$bIt won't be cheap.  And of course, I will need your old ring back.

You've decided against your previous choice?  I suppose I can help you reverse it.  In the end Dalaran cares more about your loyalty than how you choose to show it.$b$bIt won't be cheap.  And of course, I will need your old ring back.
Dead orcs tell no tales, $N. Make sure those Dragonmaw transporters do not escape.
fr: Les orcs morts ne parlent pas, $N. Ne laissez pas les transporteurs Gueules-de-dragon s'échapper.

en: Is that the delivery from Old Orok?
That crate has the look of a master gnomish engineer about it. Did Bossi send you?
fr: Cette caisse ressemble à un truc de maître ingénieur gnome. C’est Bossi qui vous envoie ?

en: Who dares approach Mor'ghor? This had better be important.
fr: Qui ose s'adresser à Mor'ghor ? Il vaudrait mieux que ce soit important.

en: How goes the egg hunt?
fr: Comment se passe la chasse aux œufs ?

en: We don't need those eggs to get into the wrong hands,$N. Bring me any additional eggs that you may find.$B$BJust remember to keep a low profile AND avoid raising suspicion!
A seasoned pro such as yourself shouldn't be having any difficulty banishing demons. You're not having any difficulties, right, $R?
fr: Un professionnel expérimenté comme vous ne devrait pas éprouver de difficultés pour bannir ces démons. Vous ne rencontrez aucune difficulté, n’est-ce pas, elfe de la nuit ?

en: There's peons to be disciplined, $N! Hurry it up!
It's all in the wrist, $N.
fr: Tout est dans le poignet, $N.

en: You've returned, $N. I was beginning to think you'd given up on me.
fr: Vous êtes de retour, $N. Je commençais à me demander si vous ne m’aviez pas laissé tomber.

en: Have you learned how to use the apexis relic yet? Both we and the Sha'tari Skyguard just to the north are interested in what you learn about them.
We abhor violence, but at least the construct that we have sent you against isn't a living being.$B$BSpeaking of which, do you have the head?

Da demons are making da Forge Camp: Wrath bigger. Soon, dey be too big and crush us. You crush dem first!$b$bShartuul's transporter is da key, but it protected by a magic shield and a demon called a degrader. Us powerful $c, and make special darkrune dat give you control of da degrader. $r give Gahk darkrune, us give $r crystalforged darkrune back.$b$bTake control of da degrader and possess as many of da demons dat come through da gate as you can ta stop dem!
That sorcerer's flask is sure to make my boys more intelligent than they already are, and that should help immensely with what they'll need to do once they're in the Sha'tari Skyguard.
You wrangle me some aether rays yet? You look like you might have some skill with rope, so it shouldn't take you too long.
You're doing great work for us, $N. I want you to know that we really appreciate everything that you're doing to keep us stocked up in fresh mounts!
fr: Vous faites un excellent boulot, $N. Je veux que vous sachiez à quel point nous apprécions tout ce que vous faites pour que nous disposions toujours de montures fraîches !

en: Trope defeated some of my best riders. Don't let the filthiness fool you.
Mulverick is the most gifted rider I've ever seen. The only thing holding him back from the top orc spot is his recklessness.
Second place isn't that bad, $N. You can take Mulverick's spot on the line-up...
Have you completed your task, $N?
fr: Votre tâche est-elle achevée, $N ?

en: Is it done, $N? Has Terokk been defeated?
I require a token from each of the descendants of Terokk's greatest adversaries.  Only then will we be ready to summon Terokk.
Have you gathered the cargo?
fr: Vous avez récupéré la cargaison ?

en: How's that flayer infestation problem coming along?
How fares yer mission, $N? I needn't tell ye how important this be ta our continued ability ta fly around up here.
Yous have da whip?
fr: Vous avoir le fouet ?

en: Do you have the emanation from the apexis relic about you?
What's this?
fr: Qu'est-ce que c'est ?

en: Well? What's taking so long?
fr: Eh bien ? Pourquoi est-ce que ça prend si longtemps ?

en: Is the problem "solved"?
Yes, $N?
fr: Oui, Silhantcat ?

en: It was our lord, after all, that banished the demons from Outland and closed their portals. All should bow down to the magnificence of Illidan.
Have you gathered the components required to fashion the soul cannon?
fr: Avez-vous réuni tous les composants nécessaires à la construction du canon à âmes ?

en: Is it done?
fr: Est-ce fait ?

en: You're back! Did your ray behave well?
fr: Vous êtes de retour ! Votre raie a été sage ?

en: Settle down, child.
fr: Bienvenue, mon enfant.

en: <Hobb nods.>
fr: <Hobb hoche la tête.>

en: Have you completed your task, $n?
Did you crush them under your boot, commander?
fr: Les avez-vous écrasés sous votre botte, commandant ?

en: You've something for me, lad?
fr: Vous avez quelque chose pour moi, mon gars ?

en: Settle down, child.
fr: Bienvenue, mon enfant.

en: <Arcus nods.>
fr: <Arcus hoche la tête.>

en: Did you crush them under your boot, commander?
fr: Les avez-vous écrasés sous votre botte, commandant ?

en: You take out their stacks of fel cannonballs yet?
fr: Alors, ces piles de boulets de gangrecanons, elles sont détruites ?

en: The power within your ring is malleable, though reversing your choice is not easy.  Are you sure you want to replace its current form?
The power within your ring is malleable, though reversing your choice is not easy.  Are you sure you want to replace its current form?
The power within your ring is malleable, though reversing your choice is not easy.  Are you sure you want to replace its current form?
The power within your ring is malleable, though reversing your choice is not easy.  Are you sure you want to replace its current form?
You've had quite an adventure, $n.
Were ya drunk enough to see the little buggers?
Are those pesky pink elekks gone yet?
Ya clear up that little problem we talked about?
I need those kegs! So, what are yeh waitin' for!?!
Have you driven the deserter agents from Theramore?
Did you manage to find and capture the remaining propaganda leaflets?
fr: Avez-vous réussi à trouver et à prendre les pamphlets de propagande restants ?

en: Did you find Kyle?
<Budd eyes the note suspiciously.>$B$BWhat have you there, $C?
$N, you promised to save the children!
Ahh yes, $n, isn't it?$b$bHave you recovered my map yet?
fr: Humm, $N, c’est bien ça ?$B$BAvez-vous déjà retrouvé ma carte ?

en: I thought I heard laughter coming from the barracks. Did you distribute those leaflets I gave you?
fr: J'ai cru entendre des rires en provenance de la caserne. Avez-vous distribué les pamphlets ?

en: Have you completed your assault on the deserter base?
fr: Avez-vous pris d'assaut la base des déserteurs ?

en: Were you able to track down their leader?
fr: Alors, avez-vous pu trouver leur chef ?

en: Well met, $c. What brings you out here?
fr: Un plaisir de vous rencontrer, $C. Qu'est-ce qui vous amène par ici ?

en: Let's see what you managed to "borrow" from the Defias.
fr: Voyons voir ce que vous avez réussi à "emprunter" aux Défias.

en: Did your search of the wreckage reveal anything about the Defias cargo?
fr: Est-ce que votre inspection des débris a révélé quoi que ce soit sur la nature de la cargaison des Défias ?

en: Were you able to find any trace of the orders?
fr: Avez-vous réussi à retrouver la trace de ces ordres ?

en: Did you manage to free the captives at Blackhoof Village?
Did you capture those raptors?
fr: Alors, vous avez capturé ces raptors ?

en: Have you set the raptors loose in Blackhoof Village?
Did you get those weapons from Blackhoof Village?
fr: Avez-vous trouvé des armes à Sabot-noir ?

en: Have you put that torch to good use?
fr: Avez-vous fait bon usage de cette torche ?

en: Did you lay the wreath?
We're talking again are we? That must mean that you've done it! You've shown those rotten Northsea pirates a thing or two!$b$bRight?
Please tell me that you have the darkclaw guano?!
fr: Dites-moi que vous avez le guano de sombregriffe…

en: There's nothing as sumptuous as the tender meat carved from the flanks of a shoveltusk!
fr: Rien ne surpasse la viande tendre prélevée sur les flancs des brochepelles !

en: Have you made any progress in stopping the Grimtotem attacks?
How go your efforts?
<Brogg looks at you hopefully.>$B$BYou bring Brogg feathers?
fr: <Brogg vous lance un regard plein d'espoir.>$B$BVous avez plumes de Brogg ?

en: Brogg must know, have you brought peace to the violent spirits of the Stonemaul?
fr: Brogg veut savoir, vous avez donné la paix pour les esprits des Cognepierres ?

en: You bring Stonemaul banner?
fr: Vous apportez bannière cognepierre ?

en: Do you have the essences? Brogg must have them to avenge his friends!
fr: Vous avez les essences ? Brogg en a besoin pour venger ses amis !

en: Brogg will have his revenge!
fr: Brogg veut sa vengeance !

en: Hurry, mon!$B$BBudd be sendin' me into Zul'Aman alone to test his mask if I don't be givin' him those tusks soon!
fr: Grouille-toi !$B$BBudd va m'envoyer tout seul à Zul'Aman pour tester son masque si j'lui file pas les défenses bientôt !

en: I trust that my hand-crafted disguises have given you adequate protection in Zul'aman.$B$BHave you scouted those areas for me? Or shall I begin looking for your replacements?
Have you obtained the containers, $n?
fr: Vous êtes-vous procuré les conteneurs, $N ?

en: Have you obtained the toxin glands I seek, $n?
fr: Avez-vous les glandes à toxines dont j'ai besoin, $N ?

en: Have you had any luck testing the totem?
fr: Êtes-vous tombé sur quelque chose en testant le totem ?

en: You're back!
fr: Vous êtes de retour !

en: I hope you appreciate the magnitude of the opportunity I've given you, Diedthreexs.$B$BHave you taken care of old Malacrass yet?
Did you get that venom? Morlann's going to discover that it's gone any moment now...
fr: Vous avez le venin ? Morlann peut se rendre compte de son absence à n'importe quel moment maintenant...

en: Did you make any progress against those oozes?
fr: Êtes-vous parvenu à quelque chose contre ces limons ?

en: <Budd tries to mask his displeasure at your presence.>$B$BYou again....$B$BI don't know how else to say it - I'm simply too busy with my preparations to hold your hand any longer.$B$BTrust me, $N, it's all for the best. Perhaps, by some miracle, you might eventually build a name for yourself.$B$BIf so, you'll be able to say that you got your start from the incomparable Budd Nedreck!
fr: <Budd essaye de cacher son mécontentement à vous voir.>$b$bEncore vous...$b$bJe ne vois pas comment vous le dire autrement : je suis vraiment trop occupé avec mes préparatifs pour continuer à vous tenir la main.$b$bCroyez-moi, $N, ça vaut mieux comme ça. Peut-être que, par miracle, vous arriverez un jour à vous faire un nom.$b$bSi ça arrive un jour, vous pourrez dire que c’est l’incomparable Budd Truducou qui vous a mis le pied à l’étrier !

en: What have you learned from the spirits haunting this place?
Were you able to gather any of the herb? We must work quickly, before whatever evil is behind this infestation consolidates its hold on this area.
fr: Vous avez pu cueillir certaines de ces plantes ? Nous devons nous mettre au travail rapidement, avant que le mal caché derrière cette infection ne consolide son emprise sur la région.

en: How fare your efforts against the meddlesome handlers, little one?
Is it over?
fr: C'est terminé ?

en: You look pretty satisfied with yourself. Come to claim the bounty on that monstrous raptor?
What is that you're carrying, $C?
fr: Que m'apportez-vous, prêtresse ?

en: What is that you're carrying, $c?

It is unfortunate that the captain had to have you go rile up the proto-drakes. Though they seem to lack the intelligence of some of the dragons we know, they still seem to be noble creatures. Not to mention the situation it places us in.$B$BDare I ask if you have dealt with the situation?
We're runnin' dangerously low on rounds 'round here, $c. Our enemies need poundin', especially Skorn!$B$BYa got more balls fer us?
fr: On est salement près de manquer de munitions, $c. Nos ennemis ont bien b’soin qu’on leur en r’mette une dose, surtout Mörg !$b$bVous avez des boulets pour nous ?

en: Were you able to get any of that thresher oil?
fr: Avez-vous pu vous procurer de cette huile de batteur ?

en: What'll it be today? The snook is quite good.
fr: Qu'est-ce que je vous sers aujourd'hui ? Le brochet est très bon !

en: Hey, $N! I hear ya been workin' yer way into Budd's crew. Ya won't live to regret that move, friend, I can promise ya that.$B$BWhatcha got there, mon?
Make your report.
What did your search of Blackhoof Village reveal?
fr: Que vous a appris votre fouille du village de Sabot-noir ?

en: Were you able to find any trace of the orders?
fr: Vous avez pu trouver la trace des ordres ?

en: It's hard to tell from all the way over here exactly what's happening down there. Did you manage to put those plague tanks to the torch?
Have you put that torch to good use?
fr: Avez-vous fait bon usage de cette torche ?

en: <Moxie looks frantic with worry.>$B$BDid the cargo survive? Did you find any of it?
fr: <Moxie semble trembler d'inquiétude.>$B$BAlors, la cargaison est encore intacte ? Vous en avez retrouvé ?

en: Yes?
fr: Oui ?

en: Remember, the deal is "don't come back until something bites you."
fr: N'oubliez pas que la consigne, c'est « ne revenez pas tant que vous ne vous êtes pas fait mordre ».

en: Did you find any of the wyrmtail?
fr: Avez-vous trouvé de la queue de wyrm ?

en: Construction on this place seems to be a never-ending task. I just hope that you're able to get us what we need to continue.
fr: Les travaux de construction ne s’arrêtent jamais. J’espère que vous pourrez récupérer ce dont nous avons besoin pour continuer.

en: The Horde's children need you! Do not abandon them!
fr: The Horde's children need you! Do not abandon them!

en: Are you back with your report, $n?
This is quite a blow to our efforts. I don't even want to know what they discovered down there.$B$BIt's enough to keep me awake at night just trying to imagine what it could be.
Did you feed this little rascal here yet?
With the prisoners at Gjalerbron freed, the vrykul will be unable to continue their unholy rites.$B$BYou're our only hope of stopping them.
The cannons, $n. Is someone going to take care of them?
Are the Alliance leaders dead, $N? Do not return until they are.
Are you sure that you killed Mezhen and his necrolords, $c?
What?! Plans for an attack upon the keep?$B$BA FROST WYRM?!!!
fr: Hein ?! Un plan d’attaque du donjon ?$b$bAVEC UN WYRM DE GIVRE ?!!!

en: Is the attack averted? Are the frost wyrm and its master destroyed?$B$BDid you retrieve the horn?
fr: L’attaque a-t-elle été stoppée ? Le wyrm de givre et son maître ont-ils été détruits ?$b$bVous avez récupéré le cor ?

en: The Holy Light moves through your actions and in all things.$B$BNo creature, no place, no matter how wicked, can escape its wrath!
You have something for me, good $N?
The fate of the world may very well rest with us.
Find those scouts!
Getting too close to those towers is certain death as long as those casters are up there.
One thing that I know for certain is that I don't want to see any of these bigguns standing back up after we've knocked 'em down!
May I suggest that when we set the buildings ablaze, we not tarry too long inside of them?
Yes? How may I help you, my child?
fr: Oui ? Comment puis-je vous aider, mon enfant ?

en: I gather that since you're here, Skorn is no more?
Good to see you're well, $n.$b$bWe've had about as many casualties as we can handle.
You've something to show me, $c?
fr: Vous avez quelque chose à me montrer, druide ?

en: Put some backbone into it, $n! People's lives are at stake here!
These vrykul have strange customs, would you not agree, $n?
I suggest that when we set the buildings ablaze, we not stay inside of them. The fire spirit will not spare us in its thirst to destroy.
Getting too close to those towers is certain death as long as those casters are up there.
Yes? How may I help you, child?
fr: Oui ? Comment puis-je vous aider, mon enfant ?

en: What news do you bring of Skorn, $n?
fr: Quelles sont les nouvelles de Mörg, $N ?

en: Gird up, $r.$b$bThere's much work to be done. This is just the tip of the iceberg, so to speak.
fr: Préparez-vous, $r.$b$bNous avons beaucoup à faire. Et ce n’est que la partie émergée de l’iceberg, si je puis dire.

en: How is the fight at Gjalerbron coming?
With the prisoners at Gjalerbron freed, the vrykul will be unable to continue their rituals.
What?! Plans for an attack upon our camp?$b$bFROM A GREAT WYRM IN THE SKY?!!!
fr: Hein ?! Un plan d’attaque de notre camp ?$b$bPAR UN GRAND WYRM DANS LE CIEL ?!!

en: Is the attack averted? Is the great death wyrm and its master destroyed?$b$bDid you retrieve the horn?
fr: L’attaque est-elle évitée ? Le grand wyrm mort et son maître ont-ils été détruits ?$b$bAvez-vous récupéré le cor ?

en: Have you destroyed the walking dead at Gjalerbron?
Have you brought any of that down? I could really use it...
fr: Alors, vous m’avez rapporté ce duvet ? J’en ai vraiment besoin…

en: I don't care how many giants, dragons or kobolds you've killed before. Get this job done and come back when you're finished.
Have you gathered any of the down?
fr: Avez-vous ramassé ce duvet ?

en: It is good to see you again, $n. Unless you haven't killed that aberration of an elf yet, in which case I'd get going if I were you.
Have you brought any suitable horns?
fr: Avez-vous trouvé des cornes adéquates ?

en: Check every nook and cranny!
fr: Cherchez dans les moindres recoins !

en: You're back!
fr: Vous êtes de retour !

en: Without those samples, how am I to tell if this latest strain of the plague can be expanded for use on all sorts of creatures?
fr: Sans ces échantillons, comment dire si notre dernière souche de peste peut-être modifiée pour contaminer toutes sortes de créatures ?

en: Well, out with it! Did our little experiment work?$B$BDid the proto-drake like its snack? Did it dissolve from the inside?
Did you get a chance to test that horn?
You kill them vrykuls? They sure is tough!
You done with the killings yet? Winterskorn town right across from here!
You done burning everything? Make sure you not leave something not burned.
How many artifacts have you managed to gather from this Steel Gate?
fr: Combien d’artefacts avez-vous réussi à récupérer à la Porte d’acier ?

en: <Ares is unconscious.>
fr: <Arès est inconscient.>

en: By the Light!
fr: Par la Lumière !

en: Have you recovered the Dragonflayer battle plans?
fr: Avez-vous déjà récupéré les plans de bataille des Écorche-dragons ?

en: Valgarde has not fallen? That's a surprise.$B$BMust be due to your help. It sure wasn't because of Keller.
fr: Valgarde n’est pas tombée ? Étonnant.$b$bCe doit être grâce à votre aide. En tout cas, ce n’est sûrement pas grâce à Keller.

en: I hope you haven't returned empty-handed. I thought we had a deal.
fr: J'espère que vous ne revenez pas les mains vides. Nous avions un marché.

en: Have you finished spreading the word about Brewfest? But more importantly, did you let people know about the Barleybrews?
Did you let everyone know that the Thunderbrews are here at Brewfest?

I hold out hope that my hunting force is still alive.$B$BThe sting of the widows is slow to be fatal. They like to keep their victims alive long enough that their babies will be able to gorge themselves when they hatch.
Did you get those kegs or not?
fr: Alors, vous avez ces tonneaux, oui ou non ?

en: Daegarn? The cipher?
fr: Daegarn ? Le code ?

en: Did you get those brains? If not, I want my saw back. You'd better not walk off with that saw.
fr: Alors, vous avez ces cerveaux ? Si c’est non, rendez-moi ma scie. Pas question de vous laisser filer avec ma scie.

en: Yes, $n?
fr: Oui, $N ?

en: Have you obtained the sample I require, $n?
fr: Avez-vous l'échantillon dont j'ai besoin, $N ?

en: How is your experiment going, $n? Let me know if you have any questions behind the science involved!
fr: Comment se passe votre expérience, $N ? Si vous avez des questions sur les phénomènes scientifiques en jeu, n'hésitez pas !

en: You get my components yet?
fr: Alors, vous avez mes pièces détachées ?

en: Are you done with the cleanup in Halgrind?
Have you culled the elementals?
Have you recovered any of the cores?
fr: Avez-vous récupéré ces noyaux ?

en: Were you able to heal any of my sisters using the pendant?
Have you returned from the Vibrant Glade?
Have you seen the horrors of the Twisted Glade for yourself?
Did you find inner peace at the shrine? Is your turmoil gone?
Were you able to handle the speed?
The Twisted Glade is a terrible place. I never imagined our homes could become something so loathesome.
What's happening hot stuff? Got something for me?
Did you find inner peace at the shrine? Is your turmoil gone?
$n, you have returned. What news of Ulfang?
fr: Vous voilà de retour, $N. Quelles nouvelles de Garwal ?

en: $N, you have returned. What news of Ulfang?
fr: Vous voilà de retour, $N. Quelles nouvelles de Garwal ?

en: That place looks like a nightmare. Vrykul or not, no one deserves to be the victim of the Royal Apothecary Society.$B$BGlad I'm standing safely over here. You find that package yet?
fr: Cet endroit est un vrai cauchemar. Vrykuls ou pas vrykuls, personne ne mérite d’être victime de la Société royale des apothicaires.$b$bHeureusement, moi, je suis tranquillement à l’abri ici. Vous avez trouvé ce paquet ?

en: Yeah, whadya want ...hic?
fr: Ouais… quoi que voul… vous… voulez ?

en: You look like you're still in one piece. Get any of that bait?
fr: On dirait que vous êtes toujours en un seul morceau. Vous avez ces appâts ?

en: Those plague tanks destroyed, yet? That new plague looms over our heads like certain death, $c!
Have you found my reagent pouch?
fr: Avez-vous trouvé ma bourse de réactifs ?

en: Tell me, $n. What news do you bring from the front?
fr: Quelles nouvelles rapportez-vous du front, $N ?

en: Tell me, $n. What news do you bring from the front?
fr: Quelles nouvelles rapportez-vous du front, $N ?

en: Tell me, $n. What news do you bring from the front?
fr: Quelles nouvelles rapportez-vous du front, $N ?

en: Tell me, $n. What news do you bring from the front?
fr: Quelles nouvelles rapportez-vous du front, $N ?

en: You're back already.  Do you bring news of victory?
You're back!  Do you bring news of victory?
You're back already. Do you bring news of victory?
You're back already. Do you bring news of victory?
What have you discovered?
fr: Qu'avez-vous découvert ?

en: What have you discovered?
fr: Qu'avez-vous découvert ?

en: Have you recovered the book?
fr: Avez-vous récupéré le livre ?

en: Have you tried the rune?
Have you returned with those tools?
fr: Êtes-vous de retour avec ces outils ?

en: Have you recovered the book?
fr: Avez-vous récupéré le livre ?

en: Have you returned with those tools?
fr: Revenez-vous avec les outils ?

en: Have you tried the rune?
The riding crop please.
fr: La cravache, s'il-vous-plaît.

en: What have you found?
Have you discovered what lodestone attracts the giants?
Do you bring news of Megalith's downfall?
Hello, $N. Have you been perfecting your fire fighting techniques? Don't forget about the practice area to the north!
Have you dowsed any fires, $n?  The training area is west of Razor Hill's western exit.
We are speaking again... you must have the stave.
fr: Vous revenez me voir… C’est que vous devez avoir le bâton.

en: I have heard it whispered that the warchief has weapons in place of his hands. Is this true?
fr: On murmure que le chef de guerre a des armes à la place de ses mains. C’est vrai ?

en: You have returned. The centurions all lay dead?
What have you found?
Have you discovered what lodestone attracts the giants?
Do you bring news of Megalith's downfall?
I trust that you know of a way to preserve the heart in transit?
fr: Je suppose que vous connaissez un moyen pour conserver le cœur durant la livraison ?

en: We're speaking again because you have the egg? Outstanding, let me see it!
fr: Vous revenez me voir parce que vous avez l’œuf ? Extraordinaire, montrez-le moi !

en: My customer grows restless. I believe he wishes to plumb the depths of the warlord's tactical thinking to help with one of his ongoing conflicts.
fr: Mon client s’impatiente. Je crois qu’il souhaite étudier en profondeur les pensées tactiques du seigneur de guerre pour l’aider dans l’un de ses conflits.

en: How fares your fight against the coilfang myrmidons?
The time of the chieftain's ceremony grows near.
fr: L'heure de la cérémonie du chef approche.

en: Not many know that the source of Shaffar's magic rests solely within his amulet. Without it he is powerless.$B$BThen again, if you have it that must mean that he is dead.
Can you imagine being trapped within a gem for all eternity?

I'm not even certain what form a whisper is supposed to take in the physical world, but the professor assures me that you'll know it when you see it.$B$BPerhaps it is something akin to the being's voice box?
The instructors, they are all dead? No?$B$BDid I not say not to return unless you had killed them all?
Do I smell something tasty?
fr: Est-ce que je sens l'arôme d'un mets délicieux ?

en: The head of the Epoch Hunter... how does one come to the decision that they want it mounted on their wall?$B$BAnd even then, to not hunt the beast yourself, what does one say to their friends when asked how the fight went?$B$BHe'll lie, I suppose.
fr: La tête du chasseur d’époque... Comment peut-on arriver à la décision de la mettre sur un mur ?$B$BEt quand bien même, le faire sans avoir chassé soi-même la créature, que dire ensuite aux amis qui demanderont le récit du combat ?$B$BJe suppose qu’il se contentera de mentir.

en: Any luck with my little experiment?
fr: Comment marche ma petite expérience ?

en: Any luck, friend?
fr: Vous avez trouvé, l'ami ?

en: What smells so good?
fr: Qu'est-ce qui sent si bon ?

en: If I were you, I would be very careful with time-travel. You wouldn't want to accidentally do something, like kill one of your ancestors, and then accidentally erase yourself from the present!
We are speaking, but I sense that all of the rift lords are not yet dead.$B$BReturn again when they are, $C.
Did you lose your way to the Botanica? You can't miss it... it's at Tempest Keep off of the eastern edge of the Netherstorm.
fr: Vous vous êtes perdu en allant à la Botanica ? Vous ne pouvez pas la rater... C’est au donjon de la Tempête, derrière le bord est du Raz-de-Néant.

en: How can it be that we are speaking when the channelers are not all lying dead?
It's not that projector technology is something special in and of itself, but the range of this particular model is a true breakthrough!
fr: Ce n’est pas que la technologie du projecteur soit quelque chose de particulièrement innovant, mais la portée de ce modèle est vraiment une percée !

en: <The nether-stalker cocks his head in apparent confusion at your presence.>$B$BThe destroyers have not all been destroyed.
It must be a very dangerous thing to do to meddle directly in the affairs of the Old Gods.$B$BBetter you than me!
fr: Ce doit être particulièrement dangereux de se mêler des affaires des Dieux très anciens.$B$BJe vous laisse vous en charger !

en: Do you not know how to get to Tempest Keep and the Arcatraz? East through the Netherstorm and then fly or fall, the choice is yours.
Eh? You finished with all of that hauling?
Gargoyles?! I saw them out there! Did ya take care of 'em all?$B$BWhat's the world comin' to when a dwarf cannot even dig without being attacked.
I don't know, $c, it doesn't look like you've destroyed enough of them yet.
What an odd-looking device you have there, $c. Let me have a closer look at it.
fr: Quel étrange appareil vous avez là, $c. Laissez-moi le regarder de plus près.

en: I don't know, $n. I think you need to take out a few more of those things.
That's interesting, when last I looked it didn't appear as if you'd destroyed enough of them yet. Perhaps you might redouble your efforts?
What's that you have there, $c? Let me have a closer look at it!
fr: Qu'avez-vous donc là, $c ? Laissez-moi regarder ça de plus près !

en: You still haven't destroyed enough scourging crystals. No reward until you do so.
Is that an "Honorary Brewer" stamp you've got on your hand?
fr: Est-ce là un Tampon de "Brasseur honoraire" que vous avez sur la main ?

en: This dirt has been recently disturbed. Earthworms lie in the topsoil, squirming to escape the dark depths beneath them.
fr: La terre a été retournée récemment. Des vers se tortillent en surface en tentant de s'enfoncer vers les obscures profondeurs.

en: Have you finished spreading the word about Brewfest?
Have you finished spreading the word about Brewfest? But more importantly, did you let people know about the amazing troll brew?
Have you got a handle on riding racing rams?
I'm itching to try out the new bait.$b$bHave you had any luck with Frostfin?
Did you see the mess that goblin made? I hope you didn't do too much reckless off-roading.
What's happening hot stuff? Got something for me?
<A low growl rises from Ulfang's throat.>$B$BBjomolf and Varg are not dead!
You have the eyes of the eagle?
fr: Vous avez les yeux de l'aigle ?

en: You have the eyes of the eagle?
fr: Vous avez les yeux de l'aigle ?

en: Did Aderan's charm work?
Is that an "Honorary Brewer" stamp you've got on your hand?
fr: Est-ce là un Tampon de "Brasseur honoraire" que vous avez sur la main ?

en: Did you find the manual?
fr: Avez-vous trouvé le manuel ?

en: Is Wyrmskull up in flames?
<One of Old Icefin's dead fish-like eyes studies you, clearly looking for signs of his son's trident.>
fr: <L’un des yeux de poisson mort du Vieux Nageglace vous étudie. Il vous examine à la recherche du trident de son fils.>

en: The scrolls, $n? Did you obtain them?
fr: Eh bien, $N, avez-vous trouvé ces documents ?

en: Got my bones then?
fr: Alors, vous avez mes os ?

en: Did you locate the mechanism?
fr: Vous avez localisé le mécanisme ?

en: What is this? Do I look like a babysitter?
fr: Qu'est-ce qu'il y a ? J'ai une tête de garde d'enfant, peut-être ?

en: Have you rid the Twisted Glade of Keeper Witherleaf?
Still alive, I see. Clearly you're not trying hard enough.
fr: Encore en vie, à ce que je vois. De toute évidence, vous ne faites pas assez d'efforts.

en: Were ya drunk enough to see the little buggers?
$N, I find it implausible that you have dealt with enough of the dormant vrykul. Come back when you have done so.
I find it unlikely that you have dealt with enough of the dormant vrykul. Come back when you have done so.
Did you obtain my relics, $N?  Nobody gets by in this life on good looks alone... not even me!
fr: Avez-vous récupéré mes reliques, $N ? Personne ne peut gagner sa vie en comptant que sur son physique... même pas moi !

en: <Zorek raises an eyebrow at you.>
Hello, $n.  Have you been perfecting your fire fighting techniques?  Don't forget about the practice area to the south!
Hello, $n. Have you been perfecting your fire fighting techniques? Don't forget about the practice area to the west!
Did you find those supplies?
fr: Vous avez trouvé ces fournitures ?

en: <Stanwad grumbles.>
fr: <Stanwad grommelle.>

en: Have you dowsed any fires, $n? The training area is west of Brill.
Have you dowsed any fires, $n?  The training area is south of Falconwing Square.
Oh, is that a poem?
fr: Oh, est-ce là un poème ?

en: $n, what news do you bring?
$n, what news do you bring?
Ye got the bear musk for me, matey?
fr: Vous avez mon musc d'ours, moussaillon ?

en: Have you obtained the meat we need?
fr: Avez-vous la viande dont nous avons besoin ?

en: It's good to see you again, $r.
fr: C'est bon de vous revoir, $r.

en: Have you done what I asked of you, $n?
This is an important exercise, $n. If you are to become a falconer you must learn how to feed your bird.
You're back.  Did you get what's owed to me?
fr: Ah, vous revoilà. Avez-vous mon dû ?

en: Your falcon must be constantly fed or else it will eat the prey that you are sending it to kill.
fr: Votre épervier doit toujours être bien nourri, sans quoi il mangera la proie que vous l’envoyez tuer.

en: Did you get what's mine, $N?
fr: Avez-vous retrouvé ce qui m'appartient, $N ?

en: Did you find the treasure, $N?
fr: Avez-vous trouvé le trésor, $N ?

en: Your falcon must be constantly fed or else it will eat the prey you are sending it to kill.
fr: Votre épervier doit toujours être bien nourri, sans quoi il mangera la proie que vous l’envoyez tuer.

en: Where's that blubber? An' don't try to tell me he ain't got none either.$B$BThat Big Roy's so damned big it's a wonder he can still galumph around!
fr: Elle est où, cette graisse ? Et pas la peine d'essayer d'me raconter que vous avez rien trouvé.$b$bLe Gros Roy est si gros que j'me demande comment il peut encore se traîner !

en: You are in control now, $n. Guide your falcon and bring me those eggs.
fr: Vous avez la main, $N. Guidez votre épervier et rapportez-moi ces œufs.

en: Well, $N.  Did you get Jonah's spyglass?$B$BI can't just take your word for the assassination, you know?  I am a pirate after all.

Do you have the key?$b$bNo, I don't care about any of these others. I just want to get out of here!

Well?

fr: Avez-vous réussi, $r ? Les kvaldirs sont des guerriers cruels. Ils ne feront pas de quartier.

en: Is he dead?
fr: Est-il mort ?

fr: Dépêchez-vous, $c, utilisez le fétiche sur moi avant qu'il ne soit trop tard.

fr: Vous rentrez plus tôt que je ne l'aurais pensé. Qu'avez-vous appris ?

en: Lok'tar, $c. You could not possibly have slain everything at Magmoth in such a short time!
We must get into that necropolis if we're to break through the Scourge and clear a path for the villagers.
fr: Il faut réussir à pénétrer dans cette nécropole si nous voulons nous frayer un chemin à travers les créatures du Fléau et libérer la voie pour les villageois.

fr: Quand vous aurez les granules, j'y combinerai un fragment de mon essence. Le résultat nous permettra de trouver ce qu'il vous faut.

en: Why is it that I don't believe you've collected everything on my list?
fr: Mon petit doigt me dit que vous avez pas tout rassemblé, hein ?

en: Well? What happened?
You sure that you tested the blaster on enough of those monstrous beasts?
How... how did you find me?
fr: Comment… Comment m'avez-vous trouvé ?

en: By blood and honor you must serve... Return the tuskarr relics.
fr: Par le sang et l'honneur que vous devez servir... Rapportez les reliques des roharts.

en: Is it done? Are the ships ablaze?

We'll need lots of their clothes if this is going to work. I'm no seamstress... we'll just have to find something to fit you!$B$BAnd then I'll just add a touch of my engineer genius, and poof, you'll look the part you need to play.
fr: Il nous faut plein de vêtements si on veut que ça marche. Je suis pas couturière… Alors il va falloir qu'on trouve quelque chose qui vous va !$b$bEnsuite, il suffira d'y ajouter une petite touche de génie mécanique, et pouf, vous aurez exactement le physique du rôle.

en: What's the catch of the day, $glad:lass;?

fr: Avez-vous marqué les emplacements des puisards ?

en: Greatfather Mahan tells me you have agreed to help collapse the tunnels.
fr: Grandpère Mahan me dit que vous avez accepté de nous aider à détruire les tunnels.

en: Have you searched the farms?
$N, you return!
I need more time! Keep those swine off my kodos!
Get them out of those Scourge infested fields!

fr: Avez-vous récupéré les morceaux du cor ? La légende est-elle vraie ?

en: You got all of that stuff?
fr: Vous avez tous mes trucs ?

en: Hello there.

fr: Est-ce que vous avez ces relevés ? Si je n’ai pas ses données chéries, le gnome va encore me crier dessus.

What have you uncovered?

Is the Borean Butcher slain?
Have you charged the totem?
Did you get that cured caribou hide for me?

fr: Nous ne devons pas permettre à Saragosa de vivre !

fr: L’équilibre naturel est bouleversé de plus en plus gravement.$b$bJ’espère que vous pourrez nous aider à survivre à la transformation radicale de nos modes de vie.

en: Is that Loguhn's blood or your own, $r?
How many pups could you have possibly saved in so short a time?
fr: Combien de louveteaux avez-vous pu sauver en si peu de temps ?

en: The totem, $r.  Do you have it?

en: What do you have there?

Have you done what I asked of you, $N?

en: Did you meet with Keristrasza?
