fr: Combien de graines avez-vous réussi à acquérir jusqu'à présent ?

en: What were the results? Are they destroyed?$B$BI need answers!
Did you break yourself off a piece?
It is done then?
fr: Est-ce fait ?

en: I certainly don't feel like a winner...
fr: Je ne me sens pas vraiment victorieux...

en: Have you recovered Thel'zan's phylactery?
fr: Avez-vous déjà récupéré le phylactère de Thel'zan ?

en: Hello there!
fr: Salut !

en: What news do you bring? What happened at the Bronze Dragonshrine?$B$BDid you find out who the leader of the Infinite Dragonflight is?
<Yorik lets out a sigh of relief.>$B$BWe thought you might not show up, $N.
fr: <Yorik pousse un soupir de soulagement.>$b$bNous pensions que vous ne viendriez peut-être pas, $N.

en: Have you recovered the Onslaught map?
fr: Vous avez récupéré la carte de l'Assaut ?

en: Clear out the Onslaught Base Camp, $N.
Did you find a copy?
fr: Avez-vous trouvé un exemplaire ?

en: Have you searched Frostmourne Cavern?
Assassination work isn't as glamorous as it's made out to be.
Hail, $N.
fr: Salutations, $N.

en: You get those ingredients for 'ol Prigmon, $n?
Whatcha got there, $r?
$n, your face has a grim set to it. Do you have dire news?
Hey $N, your face is all smudged! Have you been to Blackrock Depths?
Destroy the Scourge at Galakrond's Rest before it is too late!
fr: Détruisez le Fléau au Repos de Galakrond avant qu'il ne soit trop tard !

en: What news from our posts, $r?
Perhaps you could destroy a few more?
I'll need more of them to report back in than that.
What's this all about?
fr: De quoi qu'il s'agit ?

en: What did you see, $r?
What's that you have there?
fr: Qu'avez-vous donc là ?

en: How about killing a few more?
Do you have the precious fluids?
fr: Avez-vous les fluides précieux ?

en: Have you rescued our veterans, $N?
I was unbeatable, in those days... proud, and rightly so. No challenger ever won this fine hat...$B
fr: J'étais imbattable à cette époque… et j'avais de bonnes raisons d'être fier. Aucun adversaire n'a jamais pu gagner ce magnifique chapeau…

en: Do you have all of the fungus?$B$BOh, and watch out for the basilisks lurking over there.
fr: Avez-vous tous les champignons ?$b$bOh, et prenez garde aux basilics qui rôdent dans le coin.

en: I was unbeatable, in those days... proud, and rightly so. No challenger ever won this fine hat...
fr: J'étais imbattable à cette époque… et j'avais de bonnes raisons d'être fier. Aucun adversaire n'a jamais pu gagner ce magnifique chapeau…

en: Is it over?$B$BDid the modified mojo work?$B$BDid you deliver vengeance for Sseratus by slaying his prophet?
I see that you have managed to inscribe a deck of Rogues! I'm impressed.
fr: Je vois que vous avez réussi à créer une suite de Voleurs ! Impressionnant !

en: I see that you have managed to complete a deck of Mages! Congratulations!
You get those medals for me, $r?
fr: Vous m'les avez trouvées, ces médailles, $r?

en: Did you master the rhinos, or are you throwing in the towel?
Well, were you able to get the engine? I just know that archmage who funded the expedition is getting nervous.
fr: Alors, avez-vous pu récupérer le moteur ? Je sais que l'archimage qui a monté cette expédition devient nerveux.

en: Did you get those parts?
fr: Avez-vous récupéré les pièces ?

en: Have you dealt with Swindlegrin and his bodyguard?
What's all this?$B$BBy any chance have you seen my no-good apprentice, Pestlepot?$B$BI sent him on an errand quite some time ago and he has yet to return!
fr: Qu'est-ce que tout cela ?$b$bEst-ce que par hasard vous n'auriez pas vu mon bon à rien d'apprenti, Potpilon ?$b$bJe l'ai envoyé faire une course il y a déjà quelques temps et il n'est toujours pas revenu !

en: You still alive! Hardknuckles not eat you yet?$B$BMaybe they eat you later.
What you want, slave?
I not ask for you, $r. What you want?
fr: Moi vous a pas demandé de viendre, $r. Vous veut quoi ?

en: You catch chickens?
fr: Vous attrape des poulets ?

en: You learn the hunt?
You smell like wasp things.
fr: Vous sent la guêpe.

en: Almost ready for long journey. Gekgek come back with crocolisk just moment ago.
fr: Presque prêt pour un long voyage. Gekgek revient avec crocilisque y'a pas longtemps.

en: They tell Zepik you good hunter for not being Frenzyheart.
Zepik think this go much better with partner. You strong for not Frenzyheart.
We best hunters of basin!
You see, $N, there is far more to true alchemy than mixing a few ingredients....
We must know -- do you bring fangs?
fr: Nous doit savoir : vous ramène crocs ?

en: Well, have you consulted the native oracle?
Leave nothing for the Lich King to resurrect!
Those who would threaten life... have they been dealt with?
<The rune-shaped slot on The Etymidian's chest appears to glow with faint power.>
fr: <L'emplacement en forme de rune sur le torse de l'Etymidian semble briller faiblement.>

en: Have you tested your skills against the dreadsabers?
How goes the tracking?
Did you make the kills?
No, $c, you're not quite done. I know for a fact that there are still necromagi walking around at Kolramas.
Those spinnerets have to be intact if I'm going to be able to put them together into a device that you can use.
fr: Il faut que les filières soient intactes si je veux pouvoir les utiliser pour vous fabriquer une machine.

en: I look forward to mounting his head on a pike. Let's see him come back from that!
fr: J'ai hâte de mettre sa tête sur une pique ! On verra comment il arrivera à revenir, après ça !

en: You sure you brought down enough of those things? Do I look like I want the plague?!
Did you kill the beast?
fr: Avez-vous tué la bête ?

en: Have you become accustomed to my laboratory, $c?
Have you taken on Shango?
fr: Avez-vous affronté Shango ?

en: You're back, little one. I was beginning to worry about your well-being.
Did you bring all the ferns we'll need?
fr: Vous avez apporté toutes les fougères dont j'ai besoin ?

en: Do not waste my time, mortal. The titans' creations must be defended!
If I may suggest, you might want to take care of a few more of those Drakkari water binders.
What news from our posts, $r?
Have you collected the water-poppies, $n?
<Zim'Abwa stares inscrutably to the north and the south.>
fr: <Zim'Abwa fixe le nord et le sud de façon énigmatique.>

en: <Zim'Abwa's stony visage pierces your soul.$B$BZim'Abwa is pleased, but wants you to show more appreciation and respect by giving him more Drakkari offerings.$B$BHe will reward you in kind.>
Did our plan work?
fr: Notre plan a-t-il fonctionné ?

en: Who you? You stink of puppy-men.
<High-Oracle Soo-say seems to stare right through you.>
Hello dryskin. You get along with Lafoo good?
fr: Bonjour, peau-sèche. Vous bien entend avec Lafoo ?

en: Puppy-men play nice now?
Dumb puppy-thieves.
fr: Stupides voleurs-chiots.

en: They always want fight! We no want fight, but we need to protect sacred stuffs.

Soo-say fumbles a bit, but he's not dumb. I do think he's been far too forgiving though... the puppy-men are not going to stop or leave us alone. The only way to stop them is to kill them... there is no "peace."$B$B<Moodle puffs up his chest and points to himself.>$B$BThat I am good at.
The Mosswalkers were good people... they did not deserve this.
fr: Les Marchemousses étaient de braves gorlocs… Ils ne méritaient pas ce sort.

en: I wish I had known how key the pillars and the stones were much earlier... perhaps I could have prevented this.
<The phylactery rests ominously on the ground next to Artruis's dead form.>
Do you have the parts? Huh? Do you?
fr: Vous avez les pièces ? Dites, vous les avez ?

en: Yes, $c?$b$bPlease tell me that you have the saronite that we requested Captain Rupert to acquire?
Ya got the wood fer a fire, $r?
fr: Z'avez le bois pour la flambée, mort-vivant ?

en: What news from our posts, $r?
Satisfied with the results?
Care to count 'em up?
fr: Oubliez pas de les compter, hein !

en: Have you met with each of my captains, $r?
Have you collected the water-poppies, $n?
Have you sealed the nerubian tunnels, $N?
Ya got the wood fer a fire, $r?
fr: Z'avez le bois pour la flambée, mort-vivant ?

en: Have you tested your skills?
Have you secured the bait we'll need to get the broodmother's attention?
fr: Avez-vous récupéré l'appât dont on a besoin pour attirer l'attention de la mère des couvées ?

en: Have you freed our soldiers from the clutches of the nerubians?
Everything taken care of?
Have you collected the reagents I need, $c?
Have you finished collecting those bat wings for Finklestein?
fr: Avez-vous réussi à trouver ces ailes pour Finklestein ?

en: Is it done, $N?
fr: Est-ce fait, $N ?

en: Well, you're alive. How did you fare?
<You can feel the eyes of the Mother of Prosperity upon you. She is wondering what a $r such as yourself is doing standing before her.>
fr: <Vous pouvez sentir les yeux de la Mère de la prospérité sur vous. Elle se demande ce qu'un $r tel que vous fait devant elle.>

en: What have you discovered?
fr: Qu'avez-vous découvert ?

en: Have you destroyed the trespassers, $N?
fr: Avez-vous détruit les intrus, $N ?

en: <Zim'Torga looks on impassively. She wonders if you seek her continued blessings by presenting more Drakkari offerings to honor her.>
The runeblade is an extension of your being. A death knight cannot battle without a runeblade.
fr: La lame runique est une extension de votre être ! Sans lame runique, vous ne pourrez pas vous battre.

en: Have you taken care of the cultists, $N?
We have little time. The Scourge is preparing for a final push.
The $c must be back talkin' to Ahunae because the $c has all that treasure.
fr: Si l' $c il revient voir Ahunae, c'est que l' $c il a tous les trésors, hein ?

en: The ring, $N!  Please... tell me you've found it!
fr: L'anneau, $N ! S'il vous plaît... Dites-moi que vous l'avez trouvé !

en: I am still unable to make contact. The ritual of the medicine men is still intact.$B$BPlease go back there and disturb each of their cauldrons.
Have you brought me the components I asked for, $n?
How's that boot holding up, $r?
There are more of my offspring that you must free from their torment!
Did you have luck winning any of that fruit from those darn tall and stingy trees?
fr: Avez-vous réussi à obtenir des fruits de ces satanés arbres ?

en: The Drakkari are so busy destroying themselves, it would be a shame if the historical significance of their empire were to be likewise lost.
fr: Les Drakkari sont trop occupés à se détruire entre eux, ce serait dommage si toutes les traces d'un empire de cette importance historique devaient se perdre.

en: Yes, $r?
fr: Oui, mort-vivant ?

en: Yes, $r?
fr: Oui, mort-vivant ?

en: I hope that you've returned with enough. The attacks from the Pools of Jin'Alai have become more desperate after what you did to them.
fr: J'espère que vous en rapportez assez. Les attaques des bassins de Jin'Alai deviennent de plus en plus désespérées après ce que vous leur avez fait.

en: You have a few more of those rifts to seal before we be talkin' again, $N.
Our assault upon the Scarlet Crusade will become legend.
fr: Notre assaut contre la Croisade écarlate entrera dans la légende.

en: Have you brought the components I asked for, $n?
Well, how did it turn out?
fr: Alors, ça donne quoi ?

en: Don't keep me waiting, $N. What are the results?
Quickly, $r, do you have my mojo?
fr: Vite, $r, avez-vous mon mojo ?

en: If you do not put an end to my suffering soon, $N, all may be lost.
Well, $n?$b$bDid you purchase that flask?
fr: Alors, $N?$b$bAvez-vous acheté le flacon ?

en: Well, $n?$b$bDid you purchase that flask?
fr: Alors, $N?$b$bAvez-vous acheté le flacon ?

en: There is no comprehending the Drakkari. They are brutal savages who have sunk to a new low.
fr: Les Drakkari sont incompréhensibles. Ce sont des sauvages brutaux, et là ils tombent de plus en plus bas.

en: Yoo dun feed da goolz?
Did you find Pitch?
fr: Avez-vous trouvé Poix ?

en: <You sense that Zim'Rhuk does not trust you. He is attempting to call out to one of his guardians.>
fr: <Vous sentez que Zim'Rhuk ne vous fait pas confiance. Il tente d'appeler un de ses gardiens.>

en: <Zim'Rhuk is impressed and frustrated that once more you seem to have dodged his guardians. At least for now.>$B$B<Place the offerings before him and he will grant you his blessing again.>
Do you have those eggs?
fr: Me rapportez-vous les œufs ?

en: Ahunae know there be no way that $N scalp that many of the Heb'Drakkar so quickly.
Is it done, $N?
fr: Est-ce fait, $N ?

en: Have you earned their commander's trust, $N?
He's not dead. I can still hear him yelling from here!
You an' me gunna take Gundrak, mon.
Have ya taken in da battlefield yet, mon?
What seems to be the delay, $N?
I never imagined that it would come to this. The Drakkari are truly lost.
fr: Je n'aurai jamais imaginé qu'on en arriverait là. Les drakkari sont vraiment perdus.

en: Why do you return when your task is not yet complete? Do you not realize that I can destroy you with but a thought?$B$BGo now, little $r. Complete that which I commanded of you!
Please, $N, tell me you haven't blown your cover....
Yes, $N?
fr: Oui, Silhantcat ?

en: What a shame that Har'koa didn't send you along sooner. Then again, she and I never did get along.$b$bShe probably held back your help just long enough for this to happen.
fr: Quel dommage que Har'koa ne vous ait pas envoyé plus tôt. Enfin, elle et moi ne nous sommes jamais entendues.$b$bElle vous a probablement retenu suffisamment longtemps pour que ceci puisse se produire.

en: Ya got my underlings whipped into shape, $n?
DO YOU THINK THAT I'M A FOOL?$B$BTHEY'RE NOT DEAD!
You've returned, $n.
fr: Vous êtes revenu, $N.

en: Were you successful in clearing those scourgewagons, $N?
Welcome back, $n.$b$bWere you able to steal any samples of Drakuru's crystals?
fr: Bienvenue, $N.$b$bAvez-vous pu voler des échantillons des cristaux de Drakuru ?

en: This is the opening sonata, $c. The Scourge death march begins with the eradication of the front lines.
fr: C'est la sonate d'ouverture, $c. La marche mortelle du Fléau commence par l'éradication des lignes de front.

en: The trajectories they are firing at would have most of the arrows land at or near the Havenshire Farm, south of us.
fr: Suivez la trajectoire de leurs flèches. Elles ont dû atterrir aux fermes de Havre-comté ou aux alentours, au sud de notre position.

en: You don't want to walk forever, do you?
Were you able to find any of the twisted talons?
fr: Avez-vous trouvé des serres déformées ?

en: Did you get those samples?
fr: Avez-vous récupéré ces échantillons ?

en: I wish that there were something that we could do to bring Mam'toth back to life, but there isn't.$b$bWe can honor him and his sacrifice by continuing the fight against the Drakkari.
fr: J'aimerais pouvoir faire quelque chose pour ramener Mam'toth à la vie, mais ce n'est pas possible.$b$bNous pouvons l'honorer et respecter son sacrifice dans la lutte contre les drakkari.

en: What brings you back to me, $N?
Has Darmuk paid for his failure, $n?
You must take the deathcharger by force, $c!
Did ya smash da trolls, $n?
The stone coffer does not budge.
fr: Le coffre de pierre ne bouge pas d'un pouce.

en: One small note: miners don't always become ghouls. Sometimes they turn into enraged spirits, hell-bent on killing you.
You find anything yet, $N?
fr: Vous avez trouvé quelque chose, $N ?

en: Death knights know no fear!
fr: Les chevaliers de la mort ne connaissent pas la peur !

en: Chickens not get far usually... if wasps not eat them, maybe we just let them stay on field next time.
fr: Poulets va pas loin normalement... Si guêpes mangent pas eux, peut-être nous laisse dehors, la prochaine fois.

en: So many big-tongues to kill! So fun, eh?
Never enough shinies... Great Rain Stone good to us, we need be good to Great Rain Stone.
fr: Jamais assez de trucs brillants... Pierre à Pluie toute-puissante est bonne pour nous, nous doit être bon pour pierre à Pluie toute-puissante.

en: Thank you for help dryskin. You very good to us.
I was certain you wouldn't make it back here in one piece, death knight. Perhaps there is more to you than I first surmised.
fr: J'étais certain que vous ne reviendriez pas ici en un seul morceau, $c. Peut-être que je vous avais sous-estimé.

en: What? You done already?$B$BDid you enact wooly justice upon those sorry ice trolls?
Surely you couldn't have dealt with all of the enchanted tiki warriors so quickly?
Perhaps you carry the caches within your pack even as we speak?
fr: Vous transportez peut-être les caches dans votre sac au moment où nous parlons ?

en: Have ya gone ta witness my creations, $N?
I cannot stress how important it is that you acquire the warlord's key no matter the cost.
fr: J'insiste sur l'importance d'acquérir la clé du seigneur de guerre, peu importe ce que ça nous coûte.

en: Have you faced Drakuru in battle, $n?
Have you gathered the materials I requested?
fr: Avez-vous rassemblé les matériaux que je vous ai demandés ?

en: The plague cauldron stands idle.
fr: Le chaudron de peste semble endormi.

en: The plague cauldron bubbles and churns its toxic brew, spewing a thick gas all around.$B$BDo you have more Crusader skulls to place inside?
fr: La mixture toxique bouillonne dans le chaudron de peste, répandant une épaisse fumée aux alentours.$b$bAvez-vous plus de crânes de croisés à y jeter ?

en: There is nowhere to run!
fr: Aucune issue de secours !

en: Use the persuaders on Scarlet Crusaders. One of them will eventually... crack.
fr: Utilisez les Éloquentes sur les croisés écarlates. L'un d'entre eux finira bien par... craquer.

en: What happened?
fr: Que s'est-il passé ?

en: Like lambs to the slaughter...
fr: Comme des agneaux à l'abattoir...

en: Tear the hold apart! The schedule is there!
fr: Mettez le fort à sac ! Le plan de route se trouve là-bas !

en: What of Koltira?
fr: Qu'est-il advenu de Koltira ?

en: Have you collected the data from Winterfin Caverns yet, $N?
Do you have that which is required, $N?

I can only offer you the warmth of my words and the encouragement that comes with them.$B$BTake what time you need to steel and prepare yourself, but I implore you not to take too long or the prophet will surely descend upon us.
You bring Rejek gift?
fr: Vous apporte un cadeau à Rejek ?

en: Have you completed Death's Challenge?
You blood Rejek's blade?
fr: Vous met le sang sur la lame de Rejek ?

en: You play cleansing song yet, $N?
You feel smart yet, $r?
How does it feel?
If you're back here talking to me why do I still see my people falling to their deaths?
You bring Rejek true power of elements?
fr: Vous apporte à Rejek la puissance véritable des éléments ?

en: How does it feel?
How does it feel?
How does it feel?
How does it feel?
How does it feel?
How does it feel?
How does it feel?
How does it feel?
How does it feel?
You're going to miss the courier and then I'm going to be forced to kill you. By forced I mean I will take great pleasure in ending your life.$B$BHURRY UP!
fr: Vous allez rater le courrier et ensuite, je serai forcé de vous tuer. Par forcé, je veux dire que je prendrai un grand plaisir à mettre fin à votre vie.$b$bDÉPÊCHEZ-VOUS !

en: Where have you been? You are two hours late. We were about to send a courier out to the High Commander.
fr: Où étiez-vous ? Vous avez deux heures de retard. Nous étions sur le point d'envoyer un courrier au haut-commandant.

en: <Orbaz laughs.>$B$BWhat is this? Some child's coloring book?
fr: <Orbaz rit.>$b$bQu'est-ce que c'est ? Un cahier de coloriages d'enfant ?

en: You did what?
fr: Qu'avez-vous fait ?

en: You bring Rejek's new helmet?
fr: Vous rapporte Rejek le nouveau casque ?

en: Kind of messy! But still so fun.
Vekgar teach you super secret, eh? Only strongest Frenzyheart get to know secret.
fr: Vekgar apprend vous un gros gros secret, hein ? Seuls les Frénécœurs les plus forts apprend le secret.

en: Very powerful. Puppy-men not know about power of Great Ones. Dumb puppy-men.
Good to have you here to help us. Long fight.
fr: Bon de vous est ici avec nous pour aide. Long combat.

en: Hello, $n. A stouter $r I never did see! The trials of Outland have made you tough, brother. You do your race proud!
fr: Bonjour, $N. Je n'ai jamais vu $r plus robuste ! Les épreuves d'Outreterre vous ont rendu plus fort, mon frère. Vous rendez honneur à votre race !

en: $n, my son. Once again we are pulled into a conflict that may sunder all we know. It is good to have a $c of your talents lend his strength to this world tree's defense.
fr: $N, mon fils. Une fois encore, nous sommes entraînés dans un conflit qui pourrait détruire tout ce que nous connaissons. Il est bon de voir un $c de votre talent prêter sa force pour la défense de cet arbre-monde.

en: $n, it's good to see you. Your strength and skills are a boon during this time of tribulations.
fr: $N, je suis content que vous soyez là. Votre force et vos capacités sont une bénédiction en ces temps de tribulations.

en: My son, the lands of the humans and orcs have treated you well. Such strength now swells within you...
fr: ma fille, les terres des humains et des orcs vous ont réussi. Une telle puissance se dégage de vous...

en: Kill them all...
I see you have a special voucher. Give it to me and I will offer you something in exchange.
fr: Je vois que vous avez un bon spécial. Donnez-le-moi et je vous offrirai quelque chose en échange.

en: Welcome to Orgrimmar, $n. Grand Apothecary Putress sent word ahead of you... do you have the infected brain?
Welcome to Thunder Bluff, $n. Grand Apothecary Putress sent word ahead of you... do you have the infected brain?
fr: Bienvenue aux Pitons du Tonnerre, $N. Le grand apothicaire Putrescin nous a prévenus de votre arrivée… Avez-vous le cerveau infecté ?

en: Salutations, $n. You come from Shattrath? You have instructions from Grand Apothecary Putress?
fr: Salutations, $N. Vous venez de Shattrath ? Vous avez des instructions du grand apothicaire Putrescin ?

en: Welcome to Silvermoon, $n. Grand Apothecary Putress sent word ahead of you... do you have the infected brain?
I sense that you haven't yet tested out both of the teleport crystals.$B$BThat's alright, take your time.
Greetings, $c.
fr: Salutations, $c.

en: Greetings, $c.
fr: Salutations, $c.

en: Greetings, $c.
fr: Salutations, $c.

en: You've returned, $n.
fr: Vous êtes de retour, $N.

en: I see that you have managed to complete a deck of Swords. Excellent.
fr: Je vois que vous avez réussi à réunir une suite d'Épées. Excellent.

en: Good day, $r.$b$bHave you collected the ectoplasm Finklestein asked for?
fr: Bonjour, $r.$b$bAvez-vous récupéré l'ectoplasme qu'a demandé Finklestein ?

en: <Highlord Mograine nods.>
fr: <Le généralissime Mograine hoche la tête.>

en: Did you get those steaks?
fr: Avez-vous rapporté ces steaks ?

en: Have you recovered the elementals' energy, $N?
Hello, $n! Look at you! I see you have grown precisely one-point-seven-three microspans since last I saw you. The airs of Outland have had an effect on you, I am certain of it.
It's not glamorous work, but it is necessary.$B$BNow why is it that we are talking again before you are done, $c?
fr: Ce n'est pas un travail très reluisant, mais il est nécessaire.$B$BMaintenant, pourquoi sommes-nous en train de discuter alors que vous n'avez pas terminé, $c ?

en: Salutations, $n. You come from Shattrath? You have instructions from Grand Apothecary Putress?
fr: Salutations, $N. Vous venez de Shattrath ? Vous avez des instructions du grand apothicaire Putrescin ?

en: Surely you're not done so soon?
fr: Vous n'avez certainement pas encore fini, non ?

en: What took so long? Are their gryphons slow? We'll have to do something about that.
What you back so soon for? I know I can still see those Onslaught boys still flyin' around down there!
fr: Bien joué ! Et vous savez, il faut que ça soit fait chaque jour que nous sommes ici.$b$bJ'espère que vous reviendrez demain. Votre griffon d'os vous attendra.

en: Have you investigated the invasion yet? There's no time for dawdling!
fr: Avez-vous déjà enquêté à propos de l'invasion ? Ce n'est pas le moment de se tourner les pouces !

en: Have you investigated the invasion yet? There's no time for dawdling!
fr: Avez-vous déjà terminé votre enquête ? Ce n'est pas le moment de traîner !

en: We have to have something we can use to insulate our engines against this cold... think, Jeer, think!$B$BOh hey! Did you get some of that wreckage for me?
fr: Nous devons prévoir quelque chose pour isoler nos moteurs de ce froid... Réfléchis, Gouaille, réfléchis !$b$bOh hé! Avez-vous récupéré quelques-uns de ces décombres ?

en: If Janks were here, I could have just sent him on this errand. Oh... on second thought... I'm not sure I told him where the safe path is anyway.$B$BGood thing I have you resourceful adventure types around, eh?
fr: Si Janks était là, c'est lui que j'aurais envoyé faire cette course. Hmm… après réflexion… je ne pense pas lui avoir dit quel était le chemin le plus sûr.$b$bC'est une bonne chose que j'ai des aventuriers pleins de ressources sous la main, pas vrai ?

en: You got some of their gross little snobold buddies too I hope?
Even magnataur should know not to mess with goblins.
fr: Même un magnataure devrait savoir qu'il ne faut pas se frotter aux gobelins.

en: Nothing strikes fear into the enemy quite like a goblin sapper!
That explosive bundle is my baby... it took me weeks to perfect it. WEEKS!$B$BThat's a long time... okay.
Jeer finished the mines? Dandy.
fr: Gouaille a terminé les mines ? Épatant.

en: Hey there again! My belly's rumbling... how'd it go?
fr: Encore vous ! Mon estomac gargouille... Comment ça s'est passé ?

en: I know my plan was brilliant. Don't even worry about it.$B$BDoes it feel good to be in the presence of greatness? A little tingly maybe?
fr: Je sais que mon plan était brillant. Ne vous inquiétez pas.$b$bQu'est-ce que ça fait d'être à côté de tant de grandeur ? Ça vous fait frissonner, peut-être ?

en: Be careful near that dispenser! Those things are dangerous.
Ya have some ore for me?
fr: Vous avez des échantillons pour moi ?

en: <The Injured Goblin Miner writhes in pain.>
fr: <Le mineur gobelin blessé se tord de douleur.>

en: I take it that things went well at the cavern? Was Tore decent to you?
Boom! Ha ha!
I like Ricket cause she's sooo delicious!$B$BOh, hey there again! How goes the pest control?
You have information for me?
fr: Vous avez des informations pour moi ?

en: Scarlet Onslaught intel is to be delivered to Aurochs Grimbane.$b$b<The lord-commander gives you an expectant look by way of a dismissal.>
fr: Les renseignements de l'Assaut écarlate doivent être donnés à Morneplaie des aurochs.$b$b<Le seigneur-commandant vous jette un regard plein d'attente en signe de congé.>

en: Where is Grand Admiral Westwind?
My runes, $N?  Do you have them?
Do not waste time, $N. We are on the brink of apocalypse!\n
Did you find our men, $N?
Any luck with our equipment, $N?
Yes?
fr: Oui ?

en: Two lives, one key... Do not fail me, $N.
fr: Deux vies, une clé... Ne me décevez pas, $N.

en: Have you survived the battle, $N?
Did you find Brann's camp?
fr: Avez-vous trouvé le campement de Brann ?

en: Who are you?
fr: Qui êtes-vous ?

en: Was your mission successful, $gbrother:sister;?
Poor Ragemane. He was gift from brother-in-law.
fr: Pauvre Crin-de-rage. C'était cadeau de beau-frère.

en: Did you complete the disk?
fr: Avez-vous assemblé le disque ?

en: Hrm, put fires out?
Did you try using the disk? What did you find?
fr: Avez-vous essayé d'utiliser le disque ? Qu'avez-vous découvert ?

en: You rescue Rageclaw?
Hello.
fr: Bonjour.

en: These birds have been loyal to us for a long time... we get on pretty well.
Persistent buggers... can't ever seem to rid ourselves of all of them. They breed like rabbits.
We'll get this harpy problem taken care of... the eagles will be free to soar the skies again soon.
fr: Nous allons nous occuper de ce problème de harpies... Les aigles seront bientôt à nouveau libres de voler dans le ciel.

en: It's too cold here the usual pests... we get harpies. Lucky us.
This is completely out of control.
fr: Ceci est totalement hors de contrôle.

en: Did ya find some o' dem relics for me?
fr: Z'avez trouvé certaines de ces reliques pour moi ?

en: Hello there!
fr: Salut !

en: Well, don't just stand there, show me the shell!
fr: Eh bien, ne restez pas là sans rien faire, montrez-moi la coque !

en: Ye've come back to me. Have ye come back to me victorious?
Were the scouts right? Were there dwarves down there?
Hello, $r.$b$bI am pleased that you have opted to utilize your tongue over your blade when making my acquaintance. I have found that a more and more rare quality among your kind of late.
fr: Bonjour, $r.$b$bJe suis ravi que vous ayez opté pour la parole plutôt que pour la lame pour faire ma connaissance. C'est une qualité qui se fait de plus en plus rare parmi vos semblables.

en: Someone is using the Forge of Wills to create this army... Ulduar is no longer safe. $R, did you recover the core?
Hey there, $glad:lass;! Good to meet ya in person. Did you find it?
fr: Salut, jeune homme ! C'est bien de vous rencontrer enfin. L'avez-vous trouvé ?

en: Were you able to find the relics of which I spoke?
fr: Avez-vous pu trouver les reliques dont je vous ai parlé ?

en: Drakuru, eh? I've heard the name before...
fr: Drakuru, hein ? J'ai déjà entendu ce nom...

en: What have you got there, $r?
fr: Qu'est-ce que vous avez là, mort-vivant ?

en: Begone!
fr: Disparais !

en: The Ocular still stands! Thassarian was a fool to trust you.$B$BWhoever you are, don't return again until it is destroyed. My position here must not be compromised!
<You open SCRAP-E's access panel.>
fr: <Vous ouvrez le panneau d'accès de FERRAILL-E.>

en: When you've managed to acquire that which I have asked of you, I will fashion the device, with a few modifications for our purposes, and we'll be on with our business.
fr: Quand vous aurez réussi à obtenir ce que je vous ai demandé, je créerai l'objet, avec quelques modifications pour nous aider dans notre but, et on pourra y aller.

en: The Ocular still stands! Koltira was a fool to trust you.$B$BWhoever you are, don't return again until it is destroyed. My position here must not be compromised!
You have NOT turned them yet. Do not insult my intelligence, $c!
Did you have any luck finding Bronzebeard's camp?
fr: Avez-vous pu trouver le campement de Barbe-de-bronze ?

en: I ask you, $N, why would we be speaking again if General Lightsbane yet exists?
Did you find the hides yet?  You'll find yeti in the hills below.
fr: Vous avez les peaux ? Vous trouverez les yétis en bas, dans les collines.

en: I really don't know if this plan will work, $N. Just bring me the scrap metal and I'll do what I can.
fr: Je ne sais vraiment pas si ce plan va marcher, $N. Rapportez-moi ces bouts de ferraille, je ferai ce que je pourrai.

en: You're doing the world a favor, friend. These monsters must be stopped!
Is it done? I hope you didn't slay too many of the mongrels. We need the manpower.
You're back. Did you kill the insubordinate pig?
It's about time.
fr: J'ai failli attendre.

en: Who... who're you?
Without the plasticizers and stabilizers I'll never be able to make the explosives necessary to break your friend out of jail.
fr: Sans émollient ni stabilisant, impossible de fabriquer les explosifs dont vous aurez besoin pour sortir votre ami de prison.

en: Does Fjorn still live, $c?
I am a giant of my word, little one.
Have you brought the wind's voices?
fr: M'avez-vous apporté les voix du vent ?

en: You are most generous.  The least I can do is to teach you the skills of gem perfection.
What is going on? Are our enemies dead?
What did you find out?
The surface of the anvil is scalding, in sharp contrast with the wintry air.
fr: La surface brûlante de l'enclume contraste fortement avec l'air hivernal.

en: Did you destroy the blighted eggs?
Did you complete the disk?
fr: Avez-vous assemblé le disque ?

en: Did you try using the disk? What did you find?
fr: Avez-vous essayé d'utiliser le disque ? Qu'avez-vous découvert ?

en: Did you find Noragannon's shell?
fr: Avez-vous trouvé la coque de Norgannon ?

en: Were you able to find any of the earth?
fr: Avez-vous pu trouver de la terre ?

en: How goes the battle?
fr: Comment se passe la bataille ?

en: Have you healed the fallen defenders?
fr: Avez-vous soigné les défenseurs blessés ?

en: Perhaps you could go back and challenge a few more?
Did you punish our wayward brethren?
My scouts inform me that Ufrang yet lives.$B$BDo you not know how to read, $r?
Do you have it?
fr: Vous l'avez ?

en: These will do. I shall teach you the skills of gem perfection.
fr: Cela fera l'affaire. Je vais vous apprendre à tailler des gemmes parfaites.

en: Yes?
fr: Oui ?

en: No payout until the fight's over, $gman:woman;.
Why are you here?$B$BGo and humiliate them!
What have you there, little one?
fr: Qu'avez-vous là, petit ?

en: Have you freed the slaves of the stormforged?
Do you have a Blood Jade Amulet for my Undermine shipment?
fr: Avez-vous une amulette en jade de sang pour ma livraison à Undermine ?

en: Do you have a Glowing Ivory Figurine for my Undermine shipment?
fr: Avez-vous une figurine luminescente en ivoire pour ma livraison à Undermine ?

en: Do you have a Wicked Sun Brooch for my Undermine shipment?
fr: Avez-vous une broche du soleil pernicieux pour ma livraison à Undermine ?

en: Do you have an Intricate Bone Figurine for my Undermine shipment?
fr: Avez-vous une figurine complexe en os pour ma livraison à Undermine ?

en: Do you have a Bright Armor Relic for my Undermine shipment?
fr: Avez-vous une relique de l'armure éclatante pour ma livraison à Undermine ?

en: Do you have a Shifting Sun Curio for my Undermine shipment?
fr: Avez-vous un bibelot du soleil changeant pour ma livraison à Undermine ?

en: What have you discovered about the ore?
fr: Qu'avez-vous découvert à propos du minerai ?

en: Is it true? Does Valduran possess powerful relics of the titans? Did you destroy them?
fr: Est-ce vrai ? Valduran possède de puissantes reliques des titans ? Les avez-vous détruites ?

en: Were you able to lead Snorri to another victory, $c?
Did you find Yulda?
You're back.
Keep it down, the others might start getting suspicious.
Yes, $N?
fr: Oui, Silhantcat ?

en: My pardons, $glad:lass;! I got all caught up in tha moment and I neglected ye entirely.
Have you found the pieces of Hodir's Horn?
fr: Avez-vous trouvé les morceaux du cor de Hodir ?

en: You have brought the fragments of Hodir's Horn, $r?
fr: Vous m'avez rapporté les fragments du cor de Hodir, mort-vivant ?

en: Strong gusts of wind swirl around the horn, causing its sound to echo throughout the surrounding mountains.$B$BTo any unknowing passersby, it might seem to be blowing itself....
Have you taken the hammer to the irons at Nidavelir?
fr: Avez-vous apporté le marteau aux fers à Nidavelir ?

en: What is it you have there?
fr: Qu'avez-vous là ?

en: What did you learn?
fr: Qu'avez-vous appris ?

en: A luminous blue glow surrounds the anvil.
fr: Une lueur bleue chatoyante entoure l'enclume.

en: Certainly there are more of my death knights to be loosed from their cages?!
fr: Il y a certainement encore des chevaliers de la mort à libérer de leurs cages, non ?!

en: Did you find a matriarch?
Valduran must be dealt with before the refuge falls.
Have you collected the final components I seek, $r?
fr: Avez-vous trouvé le dernier composant que je cherchais, mort-vivant ?

en: Have you returned with the knowledge that I seek, $r?
Have you mounted Hodirs Helm, $r?
fr: Avez-vous placé le heaume de Hodir, $r ?

en: Were you able to hamper them by sabotaging the forges?
You've returned!
Have you decimated the iron colossus' workforce?
Dems vrykuls not killed!
Did you find the documents we're looking for?
fr: Avez-vous trouvé les documents que nous cherchons ?

en: The frostworg denmother looks at you curiously.
Oh now, $N, I don't think you're quite done yet.
fr: Oh, en fait, $N, je ne crois pas que vous ayez déjà fini.

en: How did it go with the yeti?
Hail, $Gbrother:sister;.
Tell me that the heart didn't fall into enemy hands.
Did you bring the furs?
fr: Avez-vous apporté les fourrures ?

en: Have you gathered the materials for the spear, $r?
fr: Avez-vous rassemblé les matériaux pour la lance, mort-vivant ?

en: Dis is what I been lookin' for.  Now I be learnin' you Gem Perfection.
fr: C'est c'qu'je cherchais. Maintenant, je vas vous apprendre à faire des gemmes parfaites.

en: Your donation is much appreciated.  Let me teach you of gem perfection.
fr: J'apprécie beaucoup. Je vais vous apprendre l'art de taillers des gemmes parfaites.

en: Hail, $N! What news do you bring?
fr: Je vous salue, $N ! Quelles nouvelles m'apportez-vous ?

en: Frost is thickening on the helm as you watch, and icicles are beginning to form around its edges...
fr: Le givre s'épaissit sur le heaume sous vos yeux et des stalactites se forment sur ses extrémités…

en: Have you defeated the iron colossus and spared the refuge from destruction?
Have you freed the webbed crusaders?
How have your efforts fared, $c?
Back again, little $r?
Have you slain Jormuttar?
fr: Avez-vous tué Jormuttar ?

en: What have you learned from the records of Camp Tunka'lo?
It's good to see you again, $N.
fr: C'est bon de vous revoir, $N.

en: What is it you have brought from the tomb?
fr: Qu'avez-vous rapporté de la tombe ?

en: Don't give up, $N!
Have you recovered the venom glands, $r?
fr: Avez-vous récupéré les glandes à venin, $r ?

en: Do you have the Chalcedony yet?
fr: Avez-vous déjà la calcédoine ?

en: You have not finished what I asked of you.$B$BPlease leave and do not return until you have done so or I will be very cross.
fr: Vous n'avez pas encore fini ce que je vous ai demandé de faire.$B$BVeuillez repartir et ne pas revenir avant que ce ne soit fait, ou je serai dans une colère noire.

en: You recovered the doctor's tome, but you didn't finish him off using the flesh giant?$B$BGet back in there and kill him before it's too late!
With each minute that passes their chance of survival decreases.
fr: Chaque minute qui passe réduit leurs chances de survie.

en: Ach, $N!  It's good to see you, little one.
Have you attuned the Lorehammer to the time period of Stormhoof?
fr: Avez-vous réglé le Marteau de la connaissance sur la période temporelle de Sabot-tempête ?

en: Have you found Stormhoof's weapon and armor?
fr: Avez-vous trouvé l'arme et l'armure de Sabot-tempête ?

en: Did you obtain the eggs, $N?
You back, mon?
fr: Hé mec, déjà là ?

en: Have you done it? Is the true timeline restored?
fr: Vous l'avez fait ? La ligne de temps est restaurée ?

en: I sense that you haven't yet defeated Thane Illska. Does something stay your hand?
fr: Je sens que vous n'avez pas encore vaincu le thane Illskar. Y a-t-il quelque chose qui retient votre bras ?

en: Hear my words, $r.
Tsk, tsk... you haven't shot down your fair share of proto-drakes today!
What? Vile not see lots of fire!!!$B$B$N, go back and make more fire!
It is good to see that you are safe. Have you recovered the acorns?
fr: C'est bon de vous voir sain et sauf. Avez-vous récupéré les glands ?

en: Well met, $c. I knew that you would return, despite my warnings, but I'm pleased that you heeded my desire to not risk anyone else.$B$BWhy have you come back to me?
fr: Salutations, $c. Je savais que vous reviendriez en dépit de mes avertissements, mais je suis heureux de voir que vous avez respecté mon désir de n'impliquer personne d'autre.$b$bPourquoi êtes-vous revenu me voir ?

en: Ah, dear Dahlia. I do miss you so.
fr: Ah, chère Dahlia. Vous me manquez tellement.

en: You have returned yet again, $c. Why do you risk yourself so?
fr: Vous revoilà à nouveau, $c. Pourquoi risquer ainsi votre vie ?

en: He has departed, hasn't he? I felt a small bit of light leave the land.
fr: Il est mort, n'est-ce pas ? J'ai senti un petit morceau de Lumière quitter cette terre.

en: You have more work to do.
The screams of the dying will haunt me forever! Help them!
WHERE IS MY MEAT!
fr: OÙ EST MA VIANDE ?!

en: The lads need meat for their stew.
fr: Les hommes ont besoin de viande pour leur ragoût.

en: The stew awaits...
fr: Le ragoût attend…

en: When the meat is present, the stew will be prepared.
fr: Quand vous amènerez la viande, je pourrai préparer le ragoût.

en: My reading of the bones tells me that you're not quite done.
fr: Ma lecture des ossements me dit que vous n'avez pas encore tout à fait fini.

en: I find it remarkable that these beings ever held sway over the world when they utilized such primitive magic.
fr: Je trouve remarquable que ces êtres aient pu dominer le monde alors qu'ils utilisent une magie si primitive.

en: Bring me more vrykul bones and we will influence the fates in your favor.
fr: Rapportez-moi plus d'os de vrykuls et nous pourrons influencer le destin en votre faveur.

en: Please, $n, tell me you've found Berinand's research....
fr: S'il vous plaît, $N, dites-moi que vous avez trouvé les documents de Berinand...

en: Please, $n, tell me you've found Berinand's research....
fr: S'il vous plaît, $N, dites-moi que vous avez trouvé les documents de Berinand...

en: Has Akali's death been avenged, $r?
You find da Drakkari history tablets, mon?
fr: Les tablettes, vous les avez trouvées, mec ?

en: Do you have any food for me?$B$BI never seem to be able to get away from the shop, even for a minute.
fr: Est-ce que vous avez de la nourriture pour moi ?$b$bJ'ai l'impression de ne jamais avoir le temps de quitter le magasin, même pas une minute.

en: Where is my food, I will have conventioneers here any minute!
fr: Où est ma nourriture ? Les participants à la convention seront là d'une minute à l'autre !

en: I've got hungry people down here!  We need some stew.
fr: J'ai des gens affamés ici ! Nous avons besoin de ragoût.

en: Have you seen a servant with my wine and cheese platter.   I am quite peckish!
fr: Avez-vous vu un serviteur avec mon plateau de vin et de fromages ? J'ai le ventre creux !

en: I am almost ready to go, I just need the food and for my mates... er... my fellow mages to arrive.
fr: Je suis presque prêt, j'ai seulement besoin de nourriture et que mes copains... euh... mes collègues mages arrivent.

en: Has justice been brought to Loken?
fr: Loken a-t-il goûté à la justice ?

en: Has Volkhan been extinguished, little $r?
fr: Volkhan a-t-il été anéanti, petit $r ?

en: It is a grim task, $N, but it must be done.
You get me a piece of dat golem, mon?
fr: Z'avez rapporté un bout de golem, mec ?

en: Do you have something for me? I so rarely get away from my shop.
fr: Vous avez quelque chose pour moi ? Je sors si rarement de mon échoppe.

en: Where is my food? My guests will be here soon!
fr: Où est ma nourriture ? Mes invités seront bientôt là !

en: Make sure there isn't any gnome in the stew this time!
fr: Assurez-vous qu'il n'y ait pas de gnomes dans le ragoût cette fois-ci !

en: Have you seen a servant with my wine and cheese platter.  I am quite peckish!
fr: Avez-vous vu un serviteur avec mon plateau de vin et de fromages ? J'ai le ventre creux !

en: Make sure the wild mustard dogs are 100% rhino and have no Gnome in them!
fr: Vérifiez bien que les saucisses de mes hot-dogs à la moutarde contiennent 100% de rhinocéros et pas le moindre morceau de gnome !

en: Have you found the source of the skeletons?
Do not waste time, $N.
Are the summoning altars in ruins?
fr: Les autels d'invocation sont-ils en ruine ?

en: Have you placed those orbs?
You return with no information at all! Is this how you repay my help to you and the Knights of the Ebon Blade?$B$BBegone and do not return until you have the knowledge which I seek!
fr: Vous revenez sans information ! Est-ce ainsi que vous me remerciez de vous avoir aidés, vous et les chevaliers de la Lame d'ébène ?$B$BPartez et ne revenez pas tant que vous n'avez pas le savoir que je recherche !

en: Scourgestones will help us find our enemy.
fr: Les pierres du Fléau nous aideront à trouver notre ennemi.

en: Finish them, $N!
So, it is done!
Has Mage-Lord Urom been dealt with?
Do you bring news of Belgaristrasz?
<hic>$b$bWhutcha got there, pal?
fr: <hips> $b$bQuoi qu’y gn’a, mon pote ?

en: Are you lost?
fr: Vous êtes perdu ?

en: How'd yeh fare in thar, $gmatey:ma;?
fr: Comment vous z'en êtes sorti, matelot ?

en: Ya find the one in charge here, $r? Did ya make 'em suffer?
Where is the ancient hero?$B$BWe do not have time to chat. Go to the Halls of the Ancestors and find him before it is too late!
Have you done as I asked?
Did you get the crystallized energy?
fr: Avez-vous récupéré l'énergie cristallisée ?

en: What is that vile thing?
fr: Qu'est-ce que cette vile chose ?

en: You have yet to defeat the ancient hero!
Have you smelted those fragments yet?
fr: Avez-vous déjà fondu les fragments ?

en: Stand easy, $N. What have you to report?\n
fr: Repos, $N. Qu'avez-vous à me rapporter ?

en: Were you able to capture those rune plates?
fr: Avez-vous pu récupérer ces plaques runiques ?

en: Overthane Balargarde is not dead. Did you have problems finding his fortress?
I'm sure their masters don't go easy on them, but there's no way these things would forget the lessons we lashed into their skins. They'll fear those sigils for as long as they crawl this land.
Have you destroyed the completed abominations?
Flying may be a bit more graceful, but there's no way we could get in as close as the stalker without being detected.
Did they even see it coming?
Predictable louts.
What brings you here?
fr: Qu'est-ce qui vous amène par ici ?

en: Have you unleashed the doctor's creation against him?
So, did you find the armor?
fr: Alors, avez-vous trouvé ces armures ?

en: How was the hunting? I've heard rumors the place is haunted, though I never venture out there myself.
fr: Comment s'est passé la chasse ? J'ai entendu dire que cet endroit est hanté, c'est pourquoi je n'y vais jamais.

en: I hope you didn't pull up any of the lashers by mistake! They gave Private Doane quite a whipping last week.
fr: J'espère que vous n'avez pas attaqué de flagellants pour rien ! Le soldat Doane a reçu une sacrée correction la semaine dernière.

en: Is it over? Were you able to withstand the assault?
Almost too easy.
Is it done?
fr: Est-ce fait ?

en: Are we rid of her?
Is he dead?
fr: Est-il mort ?

en: Are we finally free of that Arthas want-to-be?
Acherus will be ours!
Is it done, $c? Has the traitor king finally met his end?
fr: Est-ce fait, druidesse ? Ce traître de roi a-t-il enfin succombé ?

en: The options of subterfuge made available to us with the eyes are obvious.  These will be very useful tools.
No need to be wasteful - those hounds will serve whoever bothers to feed them.
Hard to lookout for what can't be seen.
Are those crystals out of the way? I don't want them to prove a nasty surprise for my gryphons.
Have some fun of it, eh?
Did you bring back what I requested?
fr: M'avez-vous rapporté ce que j'ai demandé ?

en: Well, have you completed your mission?
Well, have you completed your mission?
Well, have you completed your mission?
Well, have you completed your mission?
Do you bring word of victory?
Were you able to rid our home of the scourged eggs?
What news do you bring?
fr: Quelles nouvelles apportez vous ?

en: Have you destroyed their siege vehicles?
There is no time to waste, have you destroyed their siege vehicles?
Have you overcome the faceless ones, $c?
You have mere moments to live.
fr: Vous n'avez plus que quelques instants à vivre.

en: An interesting turn of events.
fr: Les événements prennent une tournure intéressante.

en: Were you able to burn a Watcher's corpse, $r?
Well? Did you manage to find the embers or did the Alliance beat you to it and leave you crying?
Did ya bring da armor, mon?
Back so soon? Drat, I was hoping to catch a moment's rest.
Were you able to recover the herbs? The sick and wounded increase by the hour.
I hope you didn't pull up any of the lashers by mistake! They gave Private Doane quite a whipping last week.
fr: J'espère que vous n'avez pas attaqué de flagellants pour rien ! Le soldat Doane a reçu une sacrée correction la semaine dernière.

en: How was the hunting? I've heard rumors the place is haunted, though I never venture out there myself.
fr: Comment s'est passé la chasse ? J'ai entendu dire que cet endroit est hanté, c'est pourquoi je n'y vais jamais.

Do you have the fey dust?
Did it work?
fr: Est-ce que ça a marché ?

en: As long as the sails keep turning, everything will be fine.$B$BOh... do you need something?
The baker's main ingredient is flour. Do you have it yet, you sweet tooth?
It's important that the goods you bring me are fresh.
Patience... the main ingredient for anything in this life is always patience.
Any luck? My livelihood depends on that medallion...
Yes?
fr: Oui ?

en: Please tell me you have his head.
Have you found the key?
Tell me you bring good news, please...
Those trout can resist even the finest fisherman... have you caught them?
<Holga's breathing is shallow and ragged.>$B$BYou came back... Are the rifts closed? Do the Horned Ones still walk in that cave?
Word from Galdaern Village, then? Speak.
Do you have the boar meat?
Are you done? Did you bring the feathers?
Dorothy...?
If one goes out looking for wool, they'd best make sure they don't come back shorn.
What is that you're carrying? Is it for me?
Do you have the herbs? The venom... it's beginning to spread.
The spirits of the trees are crying out. Have you brought them peace?
<Deirdre seems far too busy with her own business to spare you a glance.>
Listen, listen.
Have you smashed those masks to bits yet, or did you lose your nerve at the sight of them?
Well?
fr: Eh bien ?

en: Did you do it?
Where is that blasted book?
<A crackling silhouette, wreathed in tongues of fire and curtains of black smoke.>
That is the seal of Senator Anvilmar. Speak, $c. What news do you bring to Ada-Gumbad?
I do not recommend entering Scadeald at this time.
<The captain appears concerned.>
The crows... If you had not noticed before, I am sure you have now.$B$BScadeald is full of them.
Can I help you with something?
fr: En quoi puis-je vous aider ?

en: Jornan Thalor, at your service. I am the bailiff of this village.$B$BCan I help you with something?
Have you brought something for me?
Back already?$B<It seems Durak has been drinking in your absence.>
I shall forgive your lack of decorum, and the absence of a bow on your part, provided you have brought me the warg pelts.
What have you brought me?
Can I help you with something?$B$B<An ugly rash covers part of the woman's face, her neck, and the backs of her hands. She has scratched so much that her skin is raw.>
Moooo?
What have you got there?
fr: Qu'avez-vous donc là ?

en: Have you found the parts? Precision is everything.
Did you get the logic core from that machine?
How is the field test going? Is the Lootbot collecting?
An application? From a gnome? Let me see it.
Got my parts? Time is money, friend.
Is that runaway machine still running around?
How many samples so far?
An application? From one of the Cartel? Let me see it.
You've returned...and you've brought me back my vial. Good.
An' you've brought my vial back. I know what this means. Thank you lad.
Aye lad, Talos has already returned. Thank you.
Absolutely wonderful. Brim has returned!
Lok'tar, $N. You have done well.
You have not failed me, nor have you failed Keed. Thank you, $N.
Impressive. Who did you say had this tome again?
Impressive. Who did you say had this tome again?
You be doin' good, mon. Who did you say had this tome again?
You have done well, $N.
You have done well, $N.
Welcome back. Have you done what I asked?
Welcome back. Have you done what I asked?
<You place the ingredients on the ritual circle>
Why have you returned?
<You place the ingredients on the ritual circle>
<You place the ingredients on the ritual circle>
<You place the ingredients on the ritual circle>
You have returned.
You have returned.
You have returned.
Aye, lad. You've done it.
Yay, you've done it!!
Have you had any luck finding the pendant, $N?
You're a true scrapper!
Have you found the scrap yet?
Have you found the scrap yet?
Have you found the scrap yet?
Have you completed the task, $N?
Have you laid waste to the quilboars, $N?
Ahh, you've returned.
Ahh, you've returned.
Ahh, you've returned.
Ahh, you've returned.
You have returned, wow!
Find anything yet? Come on, there's gotta be something there!

Um, be careful, as I said, Nylrisa is pretty dangerous so...look, we don't have time to gather an army so this is all on you!$B$BNo pressure...scrap that, lots of pressure, all the pressure, come on, get moving!
I'm sure he'll tell you, but, better clear out the troggs to be sure...I really don't feel like waiting for an escort to Kharanos
Watch out for that yeti, ye hear?

Brother Jun'Kon cast Old Mirsinth out, said Old Mirsinth traitor for questioning old feuds and vengeance.$B$BBut Old Mirsinth cannot help wish her brother did not need die...make it quick for Old Mirsinth.
I can only hope another flower has grown since that day.
note: D=anglais_inconnu | indice de l'archive (anglais_inconnu, 1 candidat) : « Je ne peux qu'espérer qu'une autre fleur ait poussé depuis ce jour. »

en: You may have to search the cave for one strong enough for my purposes. Don't do anything reckless.
I can only hope they keep some form of record.
You search for shinies? Yes, yes, yes, come back with shinies, maybe not eat you!
Crush, destroy, show true queen power! Make sisters never speak betrayal again, then tell you secrets of Avianna's Rose, yes, yes, yes!
You still here? Eat you soon, yes, yes, yes, leave now or eat you soon, one day not eat you, no more!
Lenore still walks free? Then the caravans are still bleeding. Find her, $N, before she slips away again.
Any luck at the old tower? Every night we wait, the Defias carry off more of what little we have left.
You find the egg? Tell me you got to it before they cracked it open.
Invincible's Grave is a much longer journey than the others, I do apologize for that.
That poor family deserves their rest. I hope we can at least grant them that much.

He loves any Duskbat meat, but I'm sure that big one is especially juicy.$B$BDon't give him the whole thing at once though, he doesn't need that much even if he'll tell you otherwise! A piece should be plenty.
What is it now? I’m busy. Unless you’ve brought me something useful or dead, don’t waste my time.
What are you still doing here? I already gave you the elixir. Use it. Get moving. Or would you rather I test it on something slower?
What are you talking to me for? Get out and fight!
What are you talking to me for? Get out and fight!
What are you talking to me for? Get out and fight!
What are you talking to me for? Get out and fight!
What are you talking to me for? Get out and fight!
Have you received any results thus far? I understand, such research takes much time, we can discuss it further once you've finished.

Have you dealt with the orc? More importantly, do you have my missing page? I can feel its absence like a splinter in my spine. If you carry it now, bring it forth at once. If not, then what exactly are you waiting for?
Have you gotten an egg yet? Jasper is still fast asleep, so it doesn't look like there's any rush.

Ah, you are back. Do you have those bizarre ingredients? I know it sounds more like something you would feed to a wild beast than a wounded fighter. Scorpid venom, raptor blood, and boar tusks… what a combination. Still, I swear it works. If it does not cure them, it will at least kick their heart into gear hard enough that they forget they were ever hurt.
I don't know if the bandits would have left anything valuable, but maybe there's something he'll recognize.

He won't say anything, but I'm certain it's him. I'd thought maybe, before you have got here, he...\n\nI know. It's rare that worgen retain even a trace of who they once were. It was just a selfish hope, nothing more.
Well? Is that naga still slitherin' around behind the ridge, $r?
Do you bring the ssssands, $r? Time ssslips away from usss with every moment you delay.
Of course it'll still work if it got dragged ta hell. Don't ya know goblin tech's nothin' if not reliable?!
You're standin' in my port, so I hope you're here with good news. Did Snazzy's goods reach the right hands?
You have news about that tannery, $N? Out with it.
You got my cigar shipment yet?
<You'll need to destroy that cloud serpent before you can get a good look at this battery.>
Found anything yet?
Well?
fr: Eh bien ?

en: These rings, I've...seen them before...
Did you find the gems? I won't blame you if you didn't, those ogres are quite frightening.
Have something for me?
What do you need, friend?
Ya' back! Did ya get dat drum yet?
Have you taken the totems back from the harpies? The rite cannot move forward without them.
You have the logs? Or at least some progress to show? I am running out of ways to stall the foreman.
Still breathing? Or did Icehide just let you crawl back to tell the tale?
I sense the primal fury awakening within you, $N. So you wish to learn the barbarian's path of rage and wilderness combat?
The crimson arts have called to you, $N. So you wish to master blood magic, to wield life itself as your weapon?
Time itself bends around you, $N. So you wish to study chronamancy, to manipulate the very streams of temporal reality?
The whispers grow stronger in your presence, $N. So you wish to serve the Old Ones and learn the cultist's forbidden arts?
Fel energy radiates from your soul, $N. So you wish to become Felsworn, to command demonic power?
Your protective aura shines brightly, $N. So you wish to become a Guardian, to shield others from all harm?
Shadow and honor both call to you, $N. So you wish to join the Knights of Xoroth, to wield darkness in service of light?
The spirits of the dead whisper around you, $N. So you wish to become a Necromancer, to shepherd souls between worlds?
The elements respond to your presence, $N. So you wish to become a Primalist, to command the raw forces of nature?
The wilderness calls to your heart, $N. So you wish to become a Ranger, to protect Teldrassil's sacred groves?
Life and death flow through you equally, $N. So you wish to become a Reaper, to harvest souls when their time comes?
Ancient power stirs in your presence, $N. So you wish to become a Runemaster, to carve magic into stone and steel?
The stars shine brighter when you are near, $N. So you wish to become a Starcaller, to channel celestial magic?
Thunder rumbles at your approach, $N. So you wish to become a Stormbringer, to command wind and lightning?
Holy light radiates from your being, $N. So you wish to become a Sun Cleric, to heal with the power of dawn?
Divine justice burns within you, $N. So you wish to become a Templar, to serve as a holy warrior?
Innovation sparks in your mind, $N. So you wish to become a Tinker, to blend magic and machinery?
The balance of toxin and antidote calls to you, $N. So you wish to become a Venomancer, to master poison and cure?
Righteous fury burns against corruption in you, $N. So you wish to become a Witch Hunter, to cleanse evil from the world?
Did you find one? A real diary? Not a forgery. I will know, $N.
The ground still trembles beneath the dunes. They still feed.
The sand still calls. Have you faced the vortex?
Did you manage to find him...?
Did you find it?
<The Archivist blanches at the smell wafting from your pockets.>
Have you found the pages?
The way is shut…
The way is still shut, mortal...$B$BAn eternal Dark Night of the Soul.
Learned anything?
Don’t worry about me; I can’t follow, but I can still hold my ground.
<The goblin is, beyond any doubt, irreversibly dead.>
And just who in blazes are you?
Warmed up yet? Nothing like a good brawl to survive the mountain cold!
Back in Anvilmar? And without my son… I take it you didn’t find him. Oh, woe is me!
With those mutagen samples, I’ll be one step closer to unraveling the mystery of radiation.
You’re… done…?
<The elf shows you a mouthful of yellow, jagged teeth. Let that be warning enough.>$b$bOnly those who survive the Carrion Path are welcome in the Nest of the Vulture’s Cult.
<The empty sockets of Aegya’s eyes fix on you with a gaze that cuts deeper than any blade.>
Time is short, and the Great Vulture grows restless. Even now he circles overhead, watching you…
The communion is about to begin. You have yet to sanctify the flesh of tribute?
Did you reach them in time? Were they still alive?
What ya want, stranger?
<The troll lies broken, her life hanging by a thread that bears too heavy a weight.>
The Witch will pay for her betrayal.
You’ve returned. I was waiting.
The spirits grow restless.$B$BWe must stop the Witch now!
If only I could ease your burden with a few words of comfort.
Have you purified my family’s remains? If only my sister’s name were among those niches…
Got the key fragments? Don’t tell me we made it too hard for you…
I trust you’ve done the job. Otherwise, you wouldn’t be standing here so casually, talking to me… right?
Did you find anything of value in there?
Done with the shopping yet?
Did I summon you here? Begone from my sight!
Yes?
fr: Oui ?

en: Still haven’t brought what we need for the disguise?$B$BYou may have bested fifteen warriors already, but you will not survive an entire village united against you.
You again… an ill omen. Did you find Nauchol? Were you discovered?
<Before the altar looms a creature of hazy outline, barely visible, as though it does not belong fully to the world of flesh.>
<Before the altar looms a creature of hazy outline, barely visible, as though it does not belong fully to the world of flesh.>
Can I help you with something, child?
I be trustin’ ya done broken some o’ dem masks.
Have you granted the censor both death and freedom?
Did you kill him? Is he still breathing? Make sure he suffers!
The abomination… is it dead?
De spirit… I can feel it slither, feel de wings beat. What kinda beast be dat?
I think I heard the beast howling in the distance. End it quickly, please.
<The hyena sniffs the air, then fixes its gaze on the sky.>$B$BThe vulture… have you finished him?
Did you bring the spores?
note: D=anglais_inconnu | indice de l'archive (anglais_inconnu, 1 candidat) : « Avez-vous apporté les spores ? »

en: Have you… you know… taken care of that matter?
note: D=anglais_inconnu | indice de l'archive (anglais_inconnu, 1 candidat) : « Avez-vous… vous savez… pris soin de cette affaire ? »

en: <Delcard shakes his head slowly, as if to himself.>
Yes? What business brings you to the Spada estate?
Did you find the mirror shards?
Leave none of those vermin alive, or Goldshire will cave in under their tunnels.
Can I help you?
fr: Je peux vous aider ?

en: <The elder closes his eyes, a gesture of deep focus and endless patience.>
Just imagine the money we can make!
I wouldn't mind a swig of cold water myself…
Another young tauren. This village teems with promising warriors.
Have you quenched the flames?
The curling smoke grows faint. The incense is nearly spent…
Yes, $c?
fr: Oui, $c ?

en: Have you dealt with the vultures?
Have you finished off the termites? Did they give you much trouble?
Got the hops?
How are things in there?
Don't worry about the target. Blast 'em good!
<The elf's eyes wander, clouded with worry.>
Have you learned to ride yet, $N?
Have you learned to ride yet, $N?
Have you learned to ride yet, $N?
Have you learned to ride yet, $N?
Have you learned to ride yet, $N?
Have you learned to ride yet, $N?
Have you learned to ride yet, $N?
Have you learned to ride yet, $N?
Have you learned to ride yet, $N?
Have you learned to ride yet, $N?
Da harvest be callin' you, $N. You bring me da letter?

Most impressive, $N... the claw of Sharptalon could not have been easy to get! The Ashenvale Hunt goes well for you!$B$BSharptalon had long terrorized the peons from the lumber camps near its path as they tried to travel here to Splintertree Post. No doubt once the word gets out that it was you who put down the beast, many rousing songs of your bravery will be heard at campfires and lumber mills across Ashenvale!
fr: Très impressionnant, $N... la griffe de Serres-tranchantes n'a pas dû être facile à se procurer ! La Chasse d'Orneval se déroule bien pour vous !$B$BSerres-tranchantes terrorisait depuis longtemps les péons du camp de bûcherons qui essayaient de voyager entre ici et le poste de Bois-brisé. Dès que les gens sauront que c'est vous qui avez défait cette bête, ils composeront sans doute des chants sur votre bravoure, et ils seront chantés dans tous les camps de bûcherons et toutes les scieries d'Orneval !

en: You need some Crab Cakes, do you? Well I might be able to cook some up for you...
fr: Ah ! Vous voulez des gâteaux au crabe, n'est-ce pas ? Bien, je peux peut-être en préparer quelques pour vous...

en: Hah - you caught him! You've done Elwynn a great service, and earned a nice bounty!
fr: Ah ! vous l'avez eu. Vous avez rendu un grand service à Elwynn, et gagné une belle prime !

en: Well done, citizen. Those kobolds are thieves and cowards, but in large numbers they pose a threat to us. And the humans of Stormwind do not need another threat.$B$BFor defeating them, you have my gratitude.
fr: Bien. Ces kobolds sont des voleurs et des lâches, mais en grand nombre ils deviennent dangereux. Et les humains de Hurlevent n'ont pas besoin d'une menace de plus.$B$BVous avez toute ma gratitude pour les avoir détruits.

en: Oh? A letter? Wonderful news! I've been waiting on word from my dear old mother in Deathknell. Such a saint, she is. I wonder how she's holding up.$B$BWhat? Too cheery? Not buying it, are you?$B$BWell, get lost then... it's really no business who the letter's from anyway. Go on! Get lost!$B$BCome back when you've got some coin to spend... loafer.$B$BNext thing you know, you'll be coming back to rest after a long days adventure or some stupid thing like that.
fr: Comment ? Une lettre ? Magnifique ! J'attends justement des nouvelles de ma chère mère qui habite au Glas. C'est une sainte. Je me demande comment elle va.$B$BHein ? Trop gaie ? Vous ne me croyez pas, hein ?$B$BMêlez-vous de vos affaires alors... Ça ne vous regarde pas. Allez ! Ouste !$B$BRevenez quand vous aurez de l'argent à dépenser... Tire-au-flanc !$B$BVous verrez, vous reviendrez bien vite vous reposer quand vous en aurez assez de courir l'aventure ou après avoir fait des choses aussi stupides dans le même genre.

en: Good work, friend. You have earned your pay well. Who knows, perhaps Westfall will prosper once again.
fr: Beau travail. Vous avez bien mérité votre paye. Qui sait, peut-être qu'un jour la marche de l'Ouest prospérera à nouveau.

en: He was a good goblin, young Scrimshank.  Let's hope that his demise was not in vain by what he was able to record with his surveying equipment.$B$BIt seems as though we have quite the situation on our hands here with these bugs.  They're way too cunning for their own good, and the research we've done so far is shaping up to indicate that they might even be under the controlling influence of a third party!  If this is the case, then it bodes ill for not only Gadgetzan, but the whole desert!
fr: C'était un brave gobelin, ce jeune Scrimshank. Espérons que les enregistrements de son équipement topographique rendront sa mort moins vaine.$B$BIl semble que le problème des insectes soit encore plus grave que nous le pensions. Ils sont bien trop astucieux pour des insectes et les recherches que nous avons faites jusqu'ici nous amènent à penser qu'ils seraient contrôlés par quelqu'un ! Si c'est le cas, c'est un mauvais présage non seulement pour Gadgetzan, mais pour le désert entier !

en: I see you've been busy! You have our thanks, $N.
fr: Je vois que vous avez été sacrément occupé ! Vous avez tous nos remerciements, $N.

en: Well done, $N. My scout witnessed your valiant acts. You are proving yourself quite well so far.
fr: Bien joué, $N. Mon éclaireur a été témoin de votre courage et de votre vaillance. Vous avez largement fait vos preuves.

en: Your worth to The People's Militia has been validated by your brave acts thus far.
fr: Vous avez prouvé votre valeur à la Milice du peuple par vos actes de bravoure.

en: When I left the tainted lands of Lordaeron I returned to a grim state of affairs here in my homeland. But there is hope for Westfall yet. As proven by your valor in battle, it is obvious to me that you serve our cause with honor. It is with great pride that I induct thee into The People's Militia. May the Light shine upon you.
fr: Quand j'ai quitté les terres impures de Lordaeron, je suis venu faire ce macabre travail, ici, chez moi. Mais il y a encore de l'espoir pour la marche de l'Ouest. Comme vous l'avez prouvé au combat, il est incontestable que vous êtes de notre côté, et que vous servez notre cause avec vaillance. Et c'est avec un grand honneur que je vous accueille au sein de la Milice du peuple. Que la Lumière vous protège.

en: I don't like hearing of all these kobolds in our mine. No good can come of this. Here, take this as payment, and when you're ready, speak to me again. I would like you to go back to the mines one more time...
fr: Je n'aime pas ça, tous ces kobolds dans nos mines. Rien de bon ne peut en sortir. Tenez, prenez ceci comme paiement, et quand vous serez prêt, revenez me voir. J'aimerais que vous retourniez une fois de plus dans les mines...

en: Thanks, $N! And come back if you want to trade again.
fr: Thanks, <name>!  And come back if you want to trade again.

en: Well done $N, you've proven your worth once again! The caps will be an interesting study, yon verily!$B$BAnd now, as promised, enjoy a taste of one of my more potent restorative brews from my personal stock...$B$BIf you are a skilled alchemist, then perhaps we might have some additional business to conduct. Regardless, I thank you for your assistance!
fr: Bon travail, $N, vous avez prouvé encore une fois votre valeur ! Cela va vraiment être intéressant d'étudier ces champignons !$B$BEt maintenant, comme promis, appréciez un de mes breuvages les plus revigorants, de ma réserve personnelle...$B$BSi vous êtes un alchimiste compétent, j'aurai peut-être une autre mission pour vous. Quoi qu'il en soit, merci de votre aide !

en: Back with some bandanas, I see. The Stormwind Army appreciates your help.
fr: Je vois que vous revenez avec les masques. L'armée de Hurlevent apprécie votre aide.

en: Tharil'zun was a vicious, crafty orc. Well done - I'm sure he didn't go down easy. Here is your reward, $N.
fr: Tharil'zun était un orc vicieux et rusé. Bon travail ! Je suis certain que cela n'a pas été de tout repos. Voici votre récompense, $N.

en: That makes for a lot fewer orcs to worry about, thanks.
fr: Cela fera autant d'orcs en moins dont se soucier, merci.

en: Once again, you have earned my respect, and the gratitude of the Stormwind Army. There may yet be kobolds in the mine, but I will marshal others against them. We have further tasks for you.
fr: Une fois encore, vous avez gagné mon respect et toute la gratitude de l'armée de Hurlevent. Il se peut qu'il reste quelques kobolds dans la mine, mais je vais envoyer d'autres personnes contre eux. J'ai d'autres tâches plus importantes pour vous.

en: These are just perfect, $N! Thank you so much. Farmer Saldean and I are going to feast tonight. And here is a little something for you, for the hard work. You didn't think I was going to let a $c like you go hungry, did you?
fr: These are just perfect, <name>!  Thank you so much.  Farmer Saldean and I are going to feast tonight.  And here is a little something for you, for the hard work.  You didn't think I was going to let a <class> like you go hungry, did you?

en: Ah, the paw of Ursangous! Your skill is impressive, $c; he is credited with numerous kills. The crescent on his paw is no doubt a sign that he was trained by the night elves that skulk about Ashenvale. Ursangous is... was one of the mightiest bears you'd find in these parts. To have bested such a creature is a testament to your will and resolve.$b$bYour ancestors would be proud!
fr: The paw of Ursangous!$B$BHave you any idea what trouble this beast has caused us over the years? Those days are over now, thanks to you.$B$BI shall forward this trophy on to Orgrimmar to be put on display, along with your account of its death.$B$BCongratulations!

en: A victory for $N in the Ashenvale Hunt! Well done - the head of Shadumbra is a fitting trophy to claim for such an impressive fight, no doubt.$b$bShadumbra's savagery was well known throughout the post here. Any trip to the west, especially on foot trying to get out to the Zoram Strand, was wrought with danger because of this tiger. Thanks to you, this danger has abated.
fr: La tête de Shadumbra ?$B$BNul ne saurait dire combien de nos frères de la Horde ont été les victimes de cette bête au cours des années. Grâce à votre bravoure, nul autre ne connaîtra ce destin.$B$BLe chef de guerre Hurlenfer entendra parler de vos exploits, $C.

en: Yeah, I heard that someone tore up the lake out there like a dust devil through the Barrens. From the sound of it too, we might be able to set up a possible observation area out there to keep an eye on our Alliance friends. Well, that is if we can keep it on the down low...$B$BLooks like you ended up being quite useful after all; the transports between here and Stonetalon should have an easier time of it. Take this - you've earned it.
fr: Oui, j'ai entendu que quelqu'un avait ravagé les alentours du lac, comme un diable de poussière dans les Tarides. D'après ce que cela m'inspire, nous devrions être capables d'installer un point d'observation dans cette zone, de manière à garder un œil sur nos amis de l'Alliance. Il faut juste faire cela discrètement...$B$BIl semblerait que vous ayez prouvé votre utilité, au bout du compte. Les transports entre ici et les Serres-Rocheuses ne devraient s'en porter que mieux. Prenez ceci, vous l'avez mérité.

en: Salutations, young $c; the time has come for you to know our aquatic form. It is one that lets you move freely and indefinitely through water. You will find this aspect a useful tool and a blessing... but it is one that must be earned before it is mastered.$B$BYou will face two trials to overcome. The first will test your ability to work in water under pressure. The second will test your resolve to understand the aspects of the form itself.$B$BStand ready, as the time of testing is now upon us.
fr: Salutations, young $C; the time has come for you to know our aquatic form. It is one that lets you move freely and indefinitely through water. You will find this aspect a useful tool and a blessing... but it is one that must be earned before it is mastered.$B$BYou will face two trials to overcome. You will find this aspect a useful tool and a blessing... but it is one that must be earned before it is mastered.$B$BYou will face two trials to overcome. The first will test your ability to work in water under pressure. The second will test your resolve to understand the aspects of the form itself.$B$BStand ready, as the time of testing is now upon us.

en: Well now. it looks like yet another druid has successfully completed the Trial of the Lake! Well done. my young friend - well done.$B$BAs I've said. my name is Tajarri. It is my duty and my privilege to serve as a warden for Moonglade. and specifically this shrine. Keeper Remulos guides the Cenarion Circle in preservation of nature and balance. and his shrine serves as a lasting tribute to such. By using the bauble here. it serves as a nod to the importance of this place within the Circle.
fr: Well now, it looks like yet another $C has successfully completed the Trial of the Lake! Well done, my young friend - well done.$B$BAs I've said, my name is Tajarri. It is my duty and my privilege to serve as a warden for Moonglade, and specifically this shrine. Keeper Remulos guides the Cenarion Circle in preservation of nature and balance, and his shrine serves as a lasting tribute to such. Keeper Remulos guides the Cenarion Circle in preservation of nature and balance, and his shrine serves as a lasting tribute to such. en: You've completed the Trial of the Sea Lion, $N - congratulations.$B$BEach task in acquiring the pendant shows that both agility and endurance are necessary to act in harmony with what you desire to do underwater. Neither can exist without the other, and both cannot be done without you willingness to embrace the aspect of the sea lion.$B$BRemember these lessons well, and count on them once you have gained your aquatic form.
fr: You've completed the Trial of the Sea Lion, $N - congratulations.$B$BEach task in acquiring the pendant shows that both agility and endurance are necessary to act in harmony with what you desire to do underwater.  Neither can exist without the other, and both cannot be done without your willingness to embrace the aspect of the sea lion.$B$BRemember these lessons well, and count on them once you have gained your aquatic form.

en: Very impressive, $N. Your ancestors would be pleased with your progress! You're ready to learn your aquatic form, and it is my pleasure to teach it to you.$B$BAlso, in recognition of your achievement during the two trials, I give you this item. I hope you'll find it to be a welcome addition to your gear as a protector of nature and a keeper of the balance.

This report... I've dealt with these beasts before. Fizzledowser was wise to send this. and you, to me.$b$bThese creatures will consume the Tanaris desert rapidly; they are nothing short of one of the greatest menaces we all will ever face. Familiarize yourself with this name, $N: silithid. The insects mentioned here are the silithid, and they are the tools of one of the greatest threats that both the Horde and Alliance face.$b$bIf only we were smart enough to see that before.
'Twas a grim task, friend, but you held up your part of the bargain.\r\n\r\nI have some things here you might want - take your pick!
fr: Ça n'a pas dû être facile ! Je n'en peux plus d'attendre pour cuisiner cette viande de loup...$B$BJ'ai des choses ici qui peuvent vous intéresser : faites votre choix !

en: Finally the menace is laid to rest! Thank you, $N, you have done me a great service. The garden shall be in full bloom this season!
fr: Enfin, ce danger public a disparu ! Merci, $N, vous m'avez rendu un immense service. Le jardin va être plein de fleurs cette saison !

en: Yes, murlocs have settled in and around the streams of eastern Elwynn. We don't know why they are here, but they are aggressive and at least semi-intelligent.
fr: Oui, les murlocs se sont installés sur la rive est de l'Elwynn. Nous ne savons pas pourquoi ils sont là, mais ils sont agressifs et ont une certaine forme d'intelligence.

en: That Verna was always such a sweet lass. We'll miss her here in Westfall but between you and me, she's a city girl at heart and Stormwind will suit her just fine. But enough gossip! Now we can make Westfall Stew!
fr: Verna a toujours été une bonne amie. Elle nous manquera, mais de vous à moi, c'est une citadine dans l'âme et Hurlevent lui conviendra parfaitement. Bon, assez bavardé ! Maintenant nous pouvons faire du ragoût de la marche de l'Ouest !

en: Although much has been stripped from the corpse, strewn nearby is a medallion with the words: "Footman Malakai Stone" etched upon it.
fr: Bien que le corps ait été presque entièrement dépouillé, un médaillon se trouve à proximité, avec les mots "Fantassin Malakai Stone" gravés dessus.
