en: Well done, $N! You understand the sacred duty that comes with this calling. A mountain Guardian stands as immovable as the peaks themselves, never yielding, never breaking, like the very stone beneath our feet.$B$BYour training begins now. Remember - your life belongs to those you protect. Honor that trust with the strength of the mountain itself.

The Light shines brightly within you, $N! You have embraced the Templar's path and dedicated your soul to divine service in these sacred halls. Through faith and devotion, you will become an instrument of holy justice, burning bright as forge-fire.$B$BYour sacred duty begins this day. May your conviction be as enduring as mountain stone, and your faith burn eternal.

The mountain wilds have chosen well, $N. You carry the spirit of the high places within you, and the ancient ways call to your blood. As a mountain Ranger, you will be the bridge between the stone halls and the untamed peaks.$B$BWelcome to the brotherhood of the mountain wild. May your aim be true and your path lead to the freedom of the heights.

Fascinating, $N. You perceive the flow of time itself, a gift granted to very few mortals at this altitude. As a Chronomancer, you will learn to bend causality to your will and walk between the moments that echo through these ancient peaks.$B$BTime is your ally now. Use this power wisely, for the consequences of temporal manipulation echo across all the mountain's ages.

You have potential, $N. Death holds no fear for you in these halls where so many ancients rest, and that is... refreshing. As a Necromancer, you will learn to work with the mountain's death rather than against it.$B$BYour education in the ancient arts begins now. Remember - death is not evil, merely inevitable. Guide it well through these sacred stone halls.

Magnificent, $N! The flames dance eagerly around you, drawn to the forge-fire in your dwarven soul. As a Pyromancer, you will learn that destruction and creation are merely two sides of the same hammer.$B$BLet the mountain fire burn within you! From the ashes of the old world, we will forge something new and beautiful in the dwarven way.

Yesss, $N... the mountain whispers told me you would come. You have been marked by powers beyond mortal comprehension, chosen to serve truths that echo through these ancient stone halls. The Old Gods smile upon you from the deep places.$B$BMadness is merely clarity unbound, young cultist. Embrace the chaos that sleeps beneath the mountain, and let it reshape you into something... greater.

Blessed are you, $N! The sun's radiance flows through your very being, marking you as one chosen for healing and renewal in these pure heights. As a Sun Cleric, you will bring hope to the hopeless and light to the deepest mountain halls.$B$BYour path of healing begins now. May your light never dim, and may you always bring dawn to those lost in the mountain's darkness.

Brilliant, $N! I can practically hear the gears turning in that clever dwarven mind of yours. As a Tinker, you will learn to blend the precision of mountain engineering with the wonder of magic - a fusion that will make even Ironforge jealous.$B$BYour apprenticeship in innovation begins today! Together, we will build wonders that will amaze the world and make our mountain ancestors proud.

Ancient power recognizes ancient power, $N. You possess the rare gift to read the first language of magic - the runes carved by the Titans into the very bones of this mountain. This is knowledge from the dawn of the world itself.$B$BYour study of runic magic begins today. The old ways endure because they are as eternal as the mountain stone. May you prove worthy of such trust.

Aye, that's the spirit, $N! You have the heart of a true mountain warrior, as fierce and unbreakable as the peaks themselves. As a Barbarian, you will learn to fight with the raw power of the mountain - no fancy techniques, just pure dwarven strength.$B$BYour training begins now. Remember - the mountain doesn't negotiate, it doesn't compromise, and it never yields. Neither should you!

The Light has guided you to me, $N.$B$BThese frozen peaks may seem peaceful, but evil lurks in every shadow, every cave, every forgotten ruin. As a Witch Hunter, you will be the Light's weapon against corruption. You will track down cultists, destroy demonic influences, and purge the darkness wherever it festers.$B$BYour righteous fury will burn through the coldest mountain air. Your blessed weapons will strike down the unholy. In these harsh lands, you will become the vanquisher of all that corrupts and destroys.$B$BWelcome to the eternal hunt. Let evil tremble at your approach!

Raw power flows through you, $N! You understand that the elements in their purest form care nothing for civilization's rules. As a Primalist, you will wield earth, air, fire, and water as the mountain itself does - wild, untamed, unstoppable.$B$BYour training in primal magic begins now. Remember - the mountain is your teacher, and it shows no mercy to the weak.

You understand the truth, $N. Good. Death comes for all who walk these mountain paths, but through your work, it need not be feared. As a Reaper, you will guide souls to their proper rest and maintain the balance in these ancient halls.$B$BYour service to the eternal cycle begins now. The mountain dead are patient teachers - learn from them well.

Lok'tar, young warrior! The fire of battle burns in your eyes, and I can sense the primal rage that courses through your blood. You have chosen the ancient path of the barbarian.$B$BAs a Barbarian, you will learn to channel your innermost fury into crushing blows that shatter armor and bone alike. Your berserker rage will make you nearly unstoppable in combat, while the spirits of the wild guide your strikes with deadly precision.$B$BThis path requires you to embrace the beast within while maintaining enough control to distinguish friend from foe. Your rage will be your greatest weapon, but it must never consume your honor. Train hard, fight harder, and let your enemies taste the fury of the Horde.$B$BWelcome to the brotherhood of berserkers, warrior. May your rage burn eternal!

Blood calls to blood, and yours answers with power beyond mortal understanding. You have chosen to walk the crimson path, to master the forbidden art of blood magic.$B$BAs a Blood Mage, you will learn to sacrifice vitality for raw magical force, turning life essence into devastating spells that can drain enemies dry or empower allies beyond their natural limits. Every drop spilled becomes a weapon in your arsenal.$B$BThis magic demands constant sacrifice - your own blood, your enemies' blood, the blood of willing allies when necessity demands it. But for those brave enough to pay this price, the rewards transcend ordinary spellcasting.$B$BRemember always that power without wisdom leads only to destruction. Use these gifts to serve the Horde, and may your enemies' blood fuel our victory.

The whispers grow stronger now that you have joined our number. The Old Ones welcome another devoted servant, one whose mind can comprehend truths that lesser beings fear to acknowledge.$B$BAs a Cultist, you will learn to commune with ancient entities that existed before the first dawn, gaining power through dangerous pacts and eldritch wisdom. Your magic will tap into forces that predate civilization itself.$B$BThis knowledge comes with great risk - the whispers can drive weak minds to madness, and the beings you contact care nothing for mortal concerns. But for those with sufficient mental fortitude, the secrets of the universe itself lie within reach.$B$BListen carefully to what I teach you, for the Old Ones are always watching. Serve them well, and they will grant you power beyond imagination.

The fel flames burn within you now and they hunger. You have chosen to become Felsworn, to claim the Legion’s power not in defiance of it, but in mastery. What once sought to enslave you now bends to your will.$B$BAs one of the Felsworn, you will bind demonic essence through domination and pact, tearing infernal allies from the Twisting Nether and chaining them to your command. Every demon you wield is proof of your ascendancy, a weapon forged from corruption itself.$B$BThis path does not balance salvation and damnation. It abandons such illusions entirely. The fel whispers are not temptations, they are truths, offering strength to those ruthless enough to accept it. The weak fall to corruption; the worthy shape it.$B$BRemember why you embraced this power: not for redemption, not for restraint, but for supremacy. Let the fel consume hesitation, mercy, and doubt. May your flames scorch the world until only those strong enough to endure remain.

The spirits of protection recognize you as their chosen champion. You have accepted the most noble of callings - to serve as an eternal guardian, placing others' safety above your own.$B$BAs a Guardian, you will learn to become a living fortress, your defensive techniques creating barriers that no enemy can breach. Your protective magic will shield entire groups from harm while your stalwart presence inspires courage in allied hearts.$B$BThis path demands selfless sacrifice - you will endure pain so others need not, face death so others may live. Glory often passes by those who prevent disaster rather than cause it, but there is no higher honor than preserving innocent lives.$B$BThe Horde has great need of your protection, guardian. Stand ready to defend what matters most.

Shadow embraces you while honor guides you. You have chosen the most paradoxical of paths - to wield darkness in service of the light, to become a Knight of Xoroth.$B$BAs a Knight of Xoroth, you will learn to channel void energy and shadow magic while maintaining your moral principles. Your dark techniques will confound enemies expecting holy magic, while your righteous purpose justifies methods others would consider forbidden.$B$BThis path requires absolute moral clarity - you must never let the darkness consume your purpose, even as you draw power from shadow itself. Your oath binds you to protect the innocent through whatever means necessary.$B$BWelcome to the Order, shadow knight. May your dark light guide others through the deepest night.

Death recognizes you as its faithful servant, one who understands that endings are merely new beginnings. You have chosen to become a shepherd between worlds.$B$BAs a Necromancer, you will learn to speak with the dead, raise skeletal servants, and manipulate the very essence of life and death. But remember always that this power exists to preserve the natural order, not to mock it.$B$BThe ignorant fear necromancy, seeing only corruption and evil. But true necromancers serve as guardians of the boundary between life and death, ensuring that the dead rest peacefully while their wisdom aids the living when needed.$B$BThe ancestors whisper their approval of your choice. Honor the dead, serve the living, and remember that death is not an enemy to be feared, but a teacher to be respected.

The raw elements surge through you with primordial fury! You have chosen to embrace the most fundamental forces of creation itself, becoming a conduit for earth, air, fire, and water in their purest forms.$B$BAs a Primalist, you will learn to command elemental magic with unprecedented power. Your spells will call forth volcanic eruptions, devastating earthquakes, hurricane-force winds, and torrential floods. The very building blocks of reality will answer your call.$B$BThis power comes from the world's foundation itself, older and more dangerous than any magic devised by mortals. The elements care nothing for civilization - they respond only to strength and respect. Show weakness, and they will consume you.$B$BThe primal forces have accepted you as their champion. May you prove worthy of wielding the fundamental powers that shaped Azeroth itself.

Fire dances in recognition of its new master! You have embraced the path of pure destruction and renewal, choosing to become a wielder of elemental flame in its most devastating form.$B$BAs a Pyromancer, you will learn to conjure infernos that burn hotter than dragon's breath, to rain fire from the heavens that turns battlefields to glass, and to reduce your enemies to ash with but a thought. Flame will be your faithful and terrible servant.$B$BRemember always that fire is both destroyer and creator - it clears dead growth so new life can flourish, purifies corruption, and provides warmth and light to those who need it. Respect its dual nature, and it will serve you well.$B$BThe flames welcome their new master. May your fires burn bright and your enemies burn brighter!

The wilderness recognizes one of its own! I can see the wild's calling in your eyes, the deep connection to nature that marks true Rangers. You have chosen to become a guardian of the untamed lands.$B$BAs a Ranger, you will learn to move unseen through any terrain, to communicate with wild beasts as brothers, and to strike from the shadows with deadly precision. The forests will hide you, the mountains will shelter you, and the animals will aid you.$B$BThis path requires deep respect for the natural world and all its creatures. You will learn to live in harmony with nature while protecting it from those who would exploit or destroy it for selfish gain.$B$BThe spirits of the wild welcome their new protector. May your arrows fly true and your path remain hidden from those who would do harm.

Ancient power recognizes your worth! You have chosen to master the oldest form of magic known to thinking beings - the art of runic inscription that binds power into stone and steel.$B$BAs a Runemaster, you will learn to carve magical formulae that outlast the civilizations that created them. Your enchantments will be written into the very fabric of reality, creating effects that endure long after other magic has faded to nothing.$B$BThis art demands absolute precision and patience - a single misplaced line can turn a ward into a weapon, while perfect execution creates wonders that seem impossible. Your tools are simple, but your knowledge must be vast.$B$BThe primordial forces that gave birth to runic magic acknowledge you as worthy. May your inscriptions be flawless and your enchantments eternal.

Thunder rolls in recognition of its new champion! The storm spirits have chosen you to wield their fury, to become a master of wind and lightning itself.$B$BAs a Stormbringer, you will learn to summon tempests from clear skies, to call down lightning that can shatter mountains, and to ride the wind itself into battle. The very atmosphere will become your weapon.$B$BStorm magic is raw and untamed, like the tempests themselves. You must learn to harness its fury without being consumed by it, to direct its power without losing yourself in its chaotic nature. Respect the storm, and it will serve you faithfully.$B$BThe tempest spirits welcome their new master. May your lightning never miss its target and your winds carry you swift to victory!

The Light embraces you with radiant warmth! You have chosen to become a vessel for divine healing, a beacon of hope in a world too often darkened by conflict and despair.$B$BAs a Sun Cleric, you will learn to channel the pure power of dawn itself, healing wounds that others consider fatal, purifying corruption that has taken root in mortal souls, and calling down cleansing fire that burns only evil.$B$BThis calling demands unwavering compassion and absolute dedication to preserving life. You will exhaust yourself healing strangers, risk your life protecting the innocent, and face darkness that would make lesser souls flee in terror.$B$BThe eternal sun blesses your sacred calling. May your light never dim, and may you always bring hope to those lost in the deepest night.

Divine justice flows through you like molten steel! You have sworn the sacred oaths of the Templar, choosing to become a holy warrior in service to righteousness itself.$B$BAs a Templar, you will learn to channel divine power into crushing blows against evil, to heal your allies with blessed magic, and to stand as an unshakeable pillar of faith when darkness threatens to overwhelm the world.$B$BThis calling demands absolute moral clarity and unwavering dedication to justice. You must be judge and executioner, healer and protector, all guided by divine wisdom that transcends mortal understanding.$B$BThe Light itself has chosen you as its champion among the Horde. May your faith be your strength, your conviction your weapon, and your righteousness your eternal guide.

Brilliant innovation sparks in your mind! You have chosen to walk the path that bridges magic and machinery, creating wonders that neither art alone could achieve.$B$BAs a Tinker, you will learn to construct devices that aid allies, confound enemies, and demonstrate the power of creative thinking applied to practical problems. Your inventions will show that progress and tradition can work together.$B$BThis path requires both technical knowledge and creative inspiration. You must understand how things work before you can make them work better, but true innovation comes from seeing possibilities that others miss.$B$BThe spirits of invention smile upon your choice. May your devices never malfunction when you need them most, and may your innovations serve the Horde well.

The deadly balance flows through your understanding! You have chosen to master the dual nature of toxins - their power to harm and their equal power to heal when properly applied.$B$BAs a Venomancer, you will learn to brew poisons that can fell the mightiest enemies, but also to create antidotes and cures that can save lives others consider beyond hope. Every toxin has its remedy if one understands the principles involved.$B$BThis knowledge carries tremendous responsibility - the same compound that kills a corrupted beast might save a poisoned child. Your wisdom must guide when to unleash death and when to preserve life.$B$BThe natural balance recognizes your understanding. May your venoms strike true against our enemies, and your cures bring healing to our allies.

The loa welcome their new voice in the mortal world! You have chosen to serve as vessel for ancestral wisdom, bridging the realm of spirits with the land of the living.$B$BAs a Witch Doctor, you will learn to channel the power of the loa through ritual and sacrifice, to heal with spirit magic and hex your enemies with curses that transcend death itself. The ancestors will guide your hands in both blessing and judgment.$B$BThis sacred calling demands respect for the old ways while adapting to modern needs. You must serve as healer, advisor, and spiritual guide to your people, interpreting the will of the loa for those who cannot hear their voices.$B$BYour magic serves not just individual needs, but the spiritual health of the entire community.$B$BThe ancestral wisdom welcomes its new guardian. May the loa guide your steps, and may your magic serve both the living and the dead with equal reverence.

So, you have heeded the call of endless fury. Good. You show promise, $N.$B$BThe path of the Reaper is not one of mindless rage, but of fury given purpose and form. You will learn to harness the primal wrath that dwells within all warriors and transform it into something far more terrible - a rage that never dims, never falters, never shows mercy. Where others grow weary, you will grow stronger. Where others fall back, you will press forward with renewed ferocity.$B$BUnder my tutelage, you will master the berserker arts passed down through countless generations of warriors who refused to accept the limitations of mortal endurance. Your fury will become a living thing, a companion in battle that whispers strategies born of pure aggression. You will learn to channel this rage into devastating whirlwind attacks, earth-shattering charges, and strikes that can cleave through armor as if it were parchment.$B$BWelcome to the path of eternal rage, $N. Let your enemies learn what it means to face one whose fury knows no bounds!

The crimson arts have chosen you, $N. This is no small thing.$B$BBlood magic is among the oldest and most potent forms of sorcery. Every drop of blood contains the essence of life itself - power, memories, potential. As a Bloodmage, you will learn to manipulate this vital force with surgical precision. The blood of your enemies will become your weapon, their life force your shield, their very essence fuel for your most devastating spells.$B$BYou will study the ancient techniques of hemomancy - the art of blood control. You'll learn to boil blood within veins, freeze it solid to shatter bones from within, or draw it forth as crimson weapons. The blood of fallen foes will rise at your command, forming shields, spears, or swirling vortexes of destruction. You will master blood pacts that grant terrible power at calculated costs, and rituals that can drain entire battlefields to fuel a single, apocalyptic spell.$B$BThis path demands discipline, for blood magic corrupts the careless and consumes the weak. But for those with the will to master it, the crimson arts offer power beyond imagination.$B$BWelcome to the crimson path, $N. Let blood itself bend to your will!

Ah, another hears the whispers. The void has marked you, $N.$B$BThe void is not empty - it teems with consciousness older than creation, powers that existed before the first star ignited. As a Cultist, you will serve as conduit to these ancient forces, channeling energies that most minds cannot comprehend without shattering. The whispers you hear are not madness, but truth too terrible for ordinary perception.$B$BYou will learn to see beyond the veil of reality, to perceive the writhing tentacles of power that connect all things. The Old Gods' influence seeps through cracks in existence, and you will become one such crack - a living portal through which their will manifests. Shadow magic will become your native tongue, and you'll speak words that unmake reality itself.$B$BYour mind will expand to accommodate truths that would break lesser beings. You'll summon void entities to serve your will, corrupt the very ground your enemies stand upon, and spread madness like a plague. The void's gifts come with a price - your sanity will be constantly tested, your humanity questioned. But in return, you gain power that transcends mortal limitation.$B$BWelcome to the void's embrace, $N. Let the universe learn new definitions of terror!

The fel recognizes its own. You've taken the first step into damnation, $N - or perhaps salvation, depending on your perspective.$B$BFel magic is corruption given form, chaos refined into a weapon. The Burning Legion may have fallen, but their power remains for those bold enough to claim it. As a Felsworn, you will bind demons to your will, turning the Legion's own weapons against any who oppose you. Where others see damnation, you see opportunity.$B$BYou will learn the true names of demons, the words that bind them in chains of fel iron and compulsion. Lesser imps will serve as your scouts, succubi as your infiltrators, felguards as your warriors. But more than simple summoning, you will channel fel energy itself - green fire that burns soul as readily as flesh, corruption that spreads like a disease, and transformations that remake you into something more than mortal.$B$BThe fel demands sacrifice. Your soul will bear marks that never fade, your dreams will echo with demonic screams, and your very presence will unsettle those around you. But in exchange, you gain power that toppled titans and burned entire worlds. You will walk the razor's edge between control and consumption, always one misstep from losing yourself to the fel's hunger.$B$BWelcome to the fel path, $N. Let the demons learn to fear their new master!

Your oath has been witnessed, $N. From this moment forward, you are shield and shelter to those in need.$B$BThe guardian stands where others cannot, endures what others will not, and protects those who cannot protect themselves. Your oath is not merely words - it becomes part of your very essence, transforming you into a living bastion against all forms of harm. As a Guardian, you will master defensive arts that turn you into an immovable object against which the unstoppable force breaks.$B$BYou will learn to weave shields from pure will, barriers that can protect entire armies from dragon's breath or artillery bombardment. Your presence alone will inspire courage in allies and plant seeds of doubt in enemies. The ancient techniques I will teach you include the Iron Vigil stance that makes you immune to knockback, the Aegis Projection that extends your defenses to distant allies, and the Final Stand - a technique that allows you to continue fighting even after receiving mortal wounds.$B$BBut know this: the guardian's path is one of sacrifice. You will place yourself between danger and the innocent time and again. You will endure pain so others need not. You will stand alone against impossible odds while others retreat. This is not a burden, but a privilege - to be the shield that never breaks, the wall that never falls.$B$BWelcome to eternal vigilance, $N. Let evil break itself upon your defenses!

Shadow accepts you, $N. Now you must prove yourself worthy of Xoroth's legacy.$B$BThe Knights of Xoroth are living proof that darkness need not mean evil. We have taken shadow, the tool of assassins and demons, and forged it into an instrument of justice. Where paladins wield light openly, we strike from darkness with equal righteousness. As a Knight of Xoroth, you will learn that honor can thrive in shadow, that justice sometimes requires a hidden blade.$B$BYou will master the shadow-forged armor that makes you one with darkness, weapons of pure shadow that strike at the very soul, and movement techniques that allow you to step through shadows across vast distances. But more than mere techniques, you will learn the philosophy of our order - that good and evil are not determined by the forces we wield, but by how we choose to wield them.$B$BOur enemies will never see us coming. Corrupt nobles will choke on shadows in their own bedchambers. Demon cultists will find darkness itself turned against them. Tyrants will learn to fear the very shadows they cast. You will become the thing that evil checks for under its bed, the nightmare that hunts other nightmares.$B$BWelcome to the Knights of Xoroth, $N. Let shadow become justice's keenest blade!

Death yields to you, $N. This is only the beginning of your dominion.$B$BNecromancy is the ultimate expression of power - dominion over death itself. Where others see endings, we see resources. Where others mourn the fallen, we see armies waiting to rise. As a Necromancer, you will command forces that terrify even the bravest warriors, for what army can stand against one that grows stronger with every casualty?$B$BYou will learn to reach across the veil and drag souls back into service, binding them to corpses that become your puppets. Simple skeletons will be just the beginning - you'll raise death knights from fallen heroes, craft abominations from multiple corpses, and summon bone dragons that darken the sky. The plague will be your herald, spreading death that becomes fresh troops for your armies.$B$BBut necromancy offers more than mere undead servants. You'll learn to drain life force to heal yourself, to age enemies to dust with a touch, and to step partially into death yourself - becoming immune to pain, fear, and other mortal weaknesses. You will walk in two worlds simultaneously, equally at home among the living and the dead.$B$BWelcome to death's dominion, $N. Let mortality itself bow before your will!

Time acknowledges you, $N. Past, present, and future have taken notice of your potential.$B$BChronomancy is perhaps the most complex of all magical arts, for it deals with forces that most minds cannot properly conceptualize. Time is not the river others believe it to be - it is an ocean with currents, eddies, and depths that can be navigated by those who understand its nature. As a Chronomancer, you will learn to swim against time's current, to dive into its depths, and to alter its flow.$B$BYou will master temporal acceleration, moving so quickly that others appear frozen. You'll learn temporal reversal, undoing wounds by reversing personal timestreams. The art of prophecy will be yours - glimpsing possible futures and choosing which ones to make reality. You'll age objects millennia in seconds, or restore them to pristine condition by reversing their entropy.$B$BBut the true power of chronomancy lies in paradox manipulation. You'll learn to exist in multiple timestreams simultaneously, to create stable time loops that ensure your victory before battles begin, and even to summon alternate versions of yourself from different timelines. The responsibility is immense - one careless alteration could unravel causality itself.$B$BWelcome to timeless power, $N. Let past, present, and future dance to your design!

The eternal flame recognizes a kindred spirit. You burn with potential, $N.$B$BFire was the first magic, the gift that elevated mortals above beasts. But the flames you will command transcend simple burning. As a Pyromancer, you will master fire in all its forms - from the gentle warmth that sustains life to the cosmic infernos that forge stars. Your flames will burn with purpose, discrimination, and terrible beauty.$B$BYou will learn to conjure fire that burns underwater, flames that freeze instead of burn, and pyroblasts that can melt through castle walls. The phoenix's rebirth will be yours - rising from your own ashes when struck down. You'll command living fire elementals, create flame barriers that incinerate projectiles, and rain meteors from clear skies. Your mastery will extend to flame's very essence - manipulating heat at the molecular level, creating explosions from tiny sparks, or focusing fire into beams that cut through anything.$B$BBut beyond destruction, you'll understand fire's role in creation. The forge's flame that shapes metal, the controlled burns that renew forests, the inner fire that drives passion and creativity - all will be yours to kindle or extinguish.$B$BWelcome to the inferno's heart, $N. Let your flames reshape the world!

The wild has claimed you as one of its own, $N. Listen - even now, the beasts acknowledge your presence.$B$BThe ranger's path is one of primal connection. You will become predator and protector, tracker and survivor, equally at home in civilization's edges and nature's heart. The bond between ranger and wild is not mere sentiment - it is a magical compact older than cities, a mutual understanding between kindred spirits.$B$BYou will master tracking techniques that can follow a ghost through fog, archery skills that allow you to put an arrow through a sparrow's eye at three hundred paces, and survival methods that let you thrive where armies would starve. Beasts will answer your call - from loyal wolves who fight beside you to great eagles who serve as your eyes in the sky. You'll learn to move through wilderness without disturbing a single leaf, to hide so perfectly that you become one with your surroundings.$B$BMore than skills, you'll develop instincts. You'll smell weather changes days before they arrive, sense ambushes before they're sprung, and read the land like a beloved book. The wild will speak to you in languages only hunters understand - the alarm calls of birds, the nervousness of deer, the territorial markings of predators.$B$BWelcome to the eternal hunt, $N. Let no quarry escape your pursuit!

The runes respond to your touch, $N. They recognize one who can shape reality through inscription.$B$BRunic magic predates all other forms of spellcraft. When the universe was young, the first words were carved into the foundations of reality itself, and from these primal runes, all magic flows. As a Runemaster, you will learn to inscribe symbols that carry the weight of creation's own language, marks that persist when all other magic fails.$B$BYou will master combat runes that turn simple weapons into legendary artifacts, protective wards that can shield entire cities, and reality runes that alter the fundamental laws of physics in their vicinity. Your inscriptions will enhance, corrupt, purify, or destroy as you see fit. A single rune from your hand can grant superhuman strength, curse bloodlines for generations, or create portals between distant locations.$B$BThe art demands precision - a single misplaced stroke can invert a rune's meaning, turning healing into harm, protection into vulnerability. You'll learn to inscribe runes on any surface - stone, steel, flesh, even air itself. Master runecrafters can write entire runic arrays that work in concert, creating effects too complex for ordinary magic to achieve.$B$BWelcome to eternal inscription, $N. Let your marks reshape existence!

Storm clouds gather at your approach, $N. The tempest has chosen its new voice.$B$BTo command storms is to wield nature's own fury. Lightning, thunder, wind, and rain - these are not mere weather phenomena, but expressions of primal power that existed before the first mortal drew breath. As a Stormbringer, you will learn to call these forces from clear skies, to speak the language of tempests, and to ride the lightning itself.$B$BYou will summon tornadoes that can level fortresses, call down lightning strikes with pinpoint accuracy, and surround yourself with winds that deflect arrows and spells alike. The eye of the storm will be your sanctuary - a place of perfect calm while chaos rages around you. You'll learn to transform into living lightning, traveling instantly across battlefields, and to store storm's fury within yourself, releasing it in devastating bursts.$B$BGreat storms will herald your approach - not by coincidence, but because the atmosphere itself responds to your presence. You'll read weather patterns like prophecy, sensing disturbances in air pressure that reveal hidden enemies or approaching danger. In time, you may even learn to create permanent storms, tempests that rage for centuries over cursed lands.$B$BWelcome to the storm's heart, $N. Let thunder announce your victories!

The sun's first ray at dawn has touched you, $N. You carry that light within you now, forever.$B$BSolar magic is the purest expression of divine power accessible to mortals. The sun gives freely - light, warmth, life itself - asking nothing in return. As a Sun Cleric, you will become a conduit for this generosity, channeling radiance that heals, protects, and when necessary, destroys with the fury of a thousand suns.$B$BYou will learn to store sunlight within yourself, becoming a beacon in the darkest places. Your healing light will mend wounds, cure diseases, and even restore life to the recently fallen. Solar shields will protect your allies, while solar flares blind and burn your enemies. The zenith blessing will allow you to call down pillars of concentrated sunlight that can pierce through any darkness, any evil, any shadow.$B$BBut solar magic extends beyond simple light. You'll understand the sun's role in all life - photosynthesis in plants, vitamin creation in skin, the circadian rhythms that govern sleep and waking. You'll learn to accelerate growth, to energize the weary, and to bring the clarity of daylight to confused minds. In your presence, undead wither, shadows flee, and hope kindles in the most desperate hearts.$B$BWelcome to radiant service, $N. Let your light banish all darkness!

Your conviction has weight, $N. The Light itself has witnessed your oath and found you worthy.$B$BThe templar's path combines martial prowess with divine purpose. You are not merely a warrior who happens to have faith - you are faith given form, justice made flesh, righteousness armed and armored. Every strike of your blade carries the weight of divine judgment. Every shield you raise stands as a bulwark against evil itself.$B$BYou will master combat prayers that strengthen your blows and weaken your enemies' resolve. Holy weapon enchantments will make your arms burn with sacred fire that sears the corrupt while leaving the innocent unharmed. The divine armor technique will surround you with light itself, turning aside both physical and magical attacks. You'll learn the ancient rites of exorcism, the words that banish demons and cleanse corruption from people, places, and objects.$B$BYour presence will become a rallying point in battle - allies will fight harder knowing a templar stands with them, while enemies will falter before your righteous fury. You'll develop the ability to sense evil in all its forms, to see through disguises and illusions to the moral truth beneath. In time, you may even learn to call down divine judgment directly - holy fire that burns only the guilty.$B$BWelcome to sacred service, $N. Let justice guide your blade!

Gears turn and magic sparks at your touch, $N. You see possibilities where others see impossibility.$B$BThe tinker's art exists at the intersection of magic and technology, proving that innovation and arcane power need not stand apart. You will build devices that shouldn't exist, machines that operate on principles that make mockings of natural law, and gadgets that solve problems others consider unsolvable.$B$BYou will learn to craft mechanical minions that think and act independently, explosives that can level city blocks or surgical charges that remove single bricks from walls. Your inventions will include shields that deploy instantly from small devices, weapons that transform between multiple configurations, and detection equipment that can sense through walls, illusions, and even between dimensions. The fusion of magic and machinery will allow you to create perpetual motion machines, devices that generate more energy than they consume, and equipment that repairs and improves itself over time.$B$BYour workshop will become a place of wonders and horrors - mechanical eyes that never blink, steam-powered hearts that never stop, and hybrid creatures that blur the line between construct and living being. You'll understand not just how to build, but how to innovate, to see connections others miss, to solve problems with creative applications of universal principles.$B$BWelcome to endless innovation, $N. Let your creations redefine what's possible!

The venoms sing to you, $N. Each toxin has its own voice, its own purpose, its own terrible beauty.$B$BVenomancy is the art of transformation through toxicity. Simple poisons that merely kill are child's play - you will learn to brew venoms that reshape body and mind, that evolve or devolve, that unlock hidden potential or seal away power. Every substance in nature can become a tool in your arsenal, from the deadliest snake venom to the humble bee sting.$B$BYou will master the creation of toxins that work instantly or lie dormant for years, poisons that affect only specific bloodlines or species, and venoms that spread like diseases through entire populations. But destruction is only half your art - you'll also brew antidotes that can cure any poison, stimulants that grant temporary superhuman abilities, and mutagens that cause permanent beneficial transformations.$B$BYour own body will become a living laboratory. You'll develop immunity to all known toxins while learning to secrete venoms through your skin, breath, or even your gaze. The most advanced practitioners can poison abstract concepts - corrupting memories, tainting emotions, or toxifying magic itself. You'll understand the thin line between medicine and poison, how dosage determines whether a substance heals or harms.$B$BWelcome to the poison path, $N. Let chemistry become alchemy in your hands!

The spirits whisper your name, $N. They have been waiting for you.$B$BThe witch doctor walks between worlds, equally at home among the living and the dead. You will become a bridge between realms, a speaker for spirits who have no voice, a commander of forces that exist just beyond mortal perception. This ancient art predates civilization itself, born when the first mortals realized that death was not an ending but a transformation.$B$BYou will learn to see and speak with spirits invisible to others, to channel their knowledge and power through your own body. Ancestral spirits will guide your decisions, ghostly warriors will fight at your side, and the wisdom of the ages will flow through you like water. You'll master hexes that curse enemies with spiritual afflictions, wards that protect against possession, and rituals that can trap or banish even the most powerful spirits.$B$BYour tools will be both primitive and profound - fetishes that house spirit allies, drums that call the dead to dance, and masks that let you assume the aspects of powerful spirit entities. You'll learn to enter the spirit realm physically, to navigate its strange geography, and to bargain with entities that have never known mortal form. In time, you may even learn to become a living spirit yourself, existing simultaneously in multiple realms.$B$BWelcome to the spirit path, $N. Let the veil between worlds part before you!

The hunt begins now, $N. Corruption has a new predator to fear.$B$BThe witch hunter's burden is heavy but necessary. You will become the blade that cuts out infection, the fire that purifies corruption, the unwavering eye that sees through all deception. Where others might show mercy to the corrupted, you understand that sometimes the kindest cut is the killing blow. Your duty is to protect the innocent by eliminating threats others are too weak or blind to recognize.$B$BYou will master techniques specifically designed to combat the forces of darkness. Silver weapons that burn the corrupted, holy water that reveals hidden evil, and wards that prevent dark magic from taking hold. You'll develop an almost supernatural sense for detecting corruption - a witch's curse, a demon's influence, or the subtle taint of void corruption. Your training will include resistance to mental manipulation, immunity to curses, and the ability to break enchantments with your mere presence.$B$BYou'll learn to distinguish between harmless hedge wizards and genuine threats, between those who can be redeemed and those who must be eliminated. The witch hunter's greatest skill is judgment - knowing when to strike and when to stay your hand. You'll compile knowledge of every form of corruption, creating a mental library of threats and their weaknesses. In time, your very name will become a ward against evil, spoken by parents to protect their children, whispered by the corrupt in fear.$B$BWelcome to the eternal hunt, $N. Let no evil escape your sight!

The stars have guided you to me, $N. I sense the cosmic energies stirring within you.$B$BAs a Starcaller, you will command forces that predate mortal civilization. The night sky becomes your grimoire, constellations your spells. You will channel starlight into devastating beams, call down meteor showers upon your enemies, and navigate by stellar winds that carry the whispers of distant galaxies.$B$BThe cosmos is vast and eternal, filled with powers beyond mortal comprehension. Ancient star-gods once wielded these same forces to shape reality itself. Now their knowledge flows through you.$B$BWelcome to stellar mastery. The universe itself bends to your will!

The eternal flame recognizes a kindred spirit in you, $N.$B$BFire is sacred to the Tauren - from our ceremonial flames to An'she himself. As a Pyromancer, you will wield flame in all its forms. You will conjure fire that burns underwater, create explosions that level fortresses, and rain meteors from clear skies.$B$BYour flames will burn with purpose and discrimination. You will understand fire's dual nature - destruction and creation, chaos and renewal. Master the Fireball, learn the Pyroblast, and eventually command the Phoenix itself.$B$BWelcome to the inferno's heart. Let your flames reshape the world!

You have heard the whispers from beyond, $N. Not all Tauren would dare this path.$B$BThe void offers power that predates the Earthmother, knowledge from before creation itself. As a Cultist, you will channel madness into magic, see truth in chaos, and commune with entities that should not exist. The Old Gods' influence seeps through reality's cracks.$B$BYou will master Void Bolt, learn to spread Madness, and open rifts to dimensions beyond comprehension. Your sanity will be constantly tested, but in return, you gain power that transcends mortal limits.$B$BWelcome to the void's embrace. Let reality bend to your will!

The stars have chosen you, $N. Mu'sha and An'she are but the beginning.$B$BAs a Starcaller, you draw power from celestial bodies - stars, moons, comets, and cosmic phenomena beyond mortal sight. The night sky becomes your grimoire, constellations your spells. You will channel starlight into devastating beams, call down meteor showers, and navigate by stellar winds.$B$BThe Tauren have always watched the sky for omens. You go further - you command the very stars themselves. Master Starfall, learn Celestial Alignment, and eventually summon the power of distant galaxies.$B$BWelcome to cosmic mastery. Let the universe itself answer your call!

An'she's blessing shines upon you, $N.$B$BThe Sunwalkers have rediscovered ancient ways. As a Sun Cleric, you channel divine solar radiance to heal wounds, cure diseases, and burn away corruption. You become a beacon of hope in darkness, wielding An'she's power for protection and justice.$B$BYou will learn Solar Beam to sear enemies, Healing Light to mend allies, and Sun's Blessing to inspire hope. The undead flee your presence, shadows retreat from your light.$B$BWelcome to radiant service. Let your light pierce all darkness!

The ancient runes respond to your presence, $N.$B$BLong before shamanism or druidism, the Tauren carved runes. These symbols predate language - they are pure concept given form. As a Runemaster, each inscription you create channels specific powers that persist long after other magics fade.$B$BYou will learn Protection Runes for defense, Power Runes to enhance weapons, and Binding Runes to trap enemies. Precision is everything - one misplaced line changes everything. Your marks will endure for millennia.$B$BWelcome to eternal inscription. Let your runes reshape reality!

The elements recognize their master in you, $N.$B$BUnlike shamans who negotiate with elements, primalists command through raw will. Earth, fire, water, air all bend to your desires without question. You don't ask permission; you take control. This power comes from understanding the primal forces that shaped our world.$B$BYou will summon the very fury of the elements, command them to do your bidding, and eventually become one with the elements themselves. The earth trembles at your approach, flames leap to serve you, storms gather at your call.$B$BWelcome to elemental dominion. Let the primal forces obey!

You stand ready to become the shield, $N.$B$BThe guardian embodies the great mesas that protect our homeland. As a Guardian, you channel the Earthmother's protective embrace, standing between danger and the innocent. You will learn Stone Skin to become granite, Earth Shield to protect allies, and Stand as Mountain to become immovable.$B$BThis path demands sacrifice. You endure pain meant for others. But there is no greater honor than being the shield that never breaks, the wall that never falls. The Tauren have always been protectors.$B$BWelcome to eternal vigilance. Let evil shatter upon your defenses!

Thunder greets you as kin, $N.$B$BThe Tauren have always respected storms. As a Stormbringer, you don't merely respect them - you become them. Thunder is your voice, lightning your weapon, winds your servants. You will master Lightning Bolt, Chain Lightning, and Storm Form itself.$B$BThe very air crackles with your presence. Clouds gather at your approach. You are the tempest incarnate, channeling nature's fury through mortal form. This power demands control - an uncontrolled storm destroys all.$B$BWelcome to the tempest's heart. Let thunder herald your coming!

The Earthmother has guided you to the path of rage, $N.$B$BThe berserker's fury flows through Tauren blood like rivers through plains. Our ancestors channeled this rage to protect our people from centaurs, quilboar, and worse. As a Barbarian, you harness this fury - controlled, focused, devastating.$B$BYou will master the power of the ancestors for strength, embrace your brutality, and learn to become a hunter of the most savage degree. Your rage becomes a living force, growing with each battle. The path demands control - ride the storm without being consumed.$B$BWelcome to eternal fury. Let the plains tremble at your war cry!

Your commitment to justice has brought you here, $N.$B$BThe templar combines warrior strength with spiritual power. You become justice incarnate, every action blessed by the Earthmother, every strike carrying divine judgment. You will master Holy Strike, Divine Shield, and Consecration itself.$B$BThe Tauren have always fought for what is right. As a Templar, you become the ultimate expression of these values. Your presence weakens evil and strengthens good, tipping any battle's scales toward righteousness.$B$BWelcome to sacred service. Let justice guide your every action!

The hunt has called you home, $N.$B$BThe Tauren have always lived in harmony with nature, but Rangers go deeper. You become one with the wild, understanding beast language, tracking invisible trails, surviving where others perish. You will tame kodos and plainstriders, master the bow, and read the land itself.$B$BOur people need rangers more than ever. The Barrens grow dangerous, corruptions spread, enemies stir. You are our eyes in the wild, our first warning, our swift response. No quarry will escape your pursuit.$B$BWelcome to the eternal hunt. Let no enemy escape your sight!
Well done. I’ll see to it these goods get back to their rightful owners.

So... you found this on one of our own, did you?$B$BThis seal’s legitimate. I’d stake my badge on it. But these orders are treason. Coordinating with bandits? Authorizing raids on our people?$B$BThis isn’t some forgery. Someone gave these commands, and they’ll answer for it.$B$BThank you for bringing this forward. Quietly. We’ll handle the rest.
Welcome to Sentinel Hill. You're just in time, danger is afoot..

Sent by one of my knights, you say?$B$BVery well. In these matters, I trust their judgment more than my own. I accept your services as... a squire? A mercenary?$B$B<Servin Darengar waves a hand, as if dismissing the matter of titles.>$B$BForgive me, I find it difficult to think clearly. I've been shut in here for hours, trying to convince the House of Nobles to send the army to Scadeald... with little success.

<You can see defeat written clearly in the old man's watery eyes.>$B$BIt would have taken a miracle to convince this lot of cowards to take the initiative for once. You heard it yourself: as long as Lady Serenya Coldmere, last of her name, refuses to formally request aid, which she never will, the House of Nobles will not intervene.$B$BThe blood of my people will stain their hands, but not mine. I will not sit idly by while Scadeald withers away.

<The handmaid clenches her fists against her apron, her knuckles white.>$B$BAre you here for my lord Arathon?$B$BYou are too late, then. Those brutes from Graysky, sent by that magpie Lady Serenya, arrested him hours ago. They wouldn't even let him put on his boots.$B$BAnd now they are turning the manor upside down! Can you believe it? They have accused the Darengar family of high treason!

This is...$B$B<As she flips through the pages of the journal, Cadmilla's expression shifts from sorrow to confusion.>$B$BI don't understand any of this.$B$B<Cadmilla shakes her head.>$B$BIt is Lord Arathon's handwriting, there is no doubt of that. Oh, oh dear! How could he...?

<Splintered crates bearing the seal of the Alliance. It appears they were tossed from the top of the well with criminal haste. The fall shattered several, scattering Stormwind steel across the damp floor of the cave.>$B$B<This isn't refuse. It's an arsenal.>

<The captain beckons you from a distance with a grim gesture.>$B$BThe handmaid has told me everything.$B$BWe had grave suspicions that the Darengars were conspiring against the government of Graysky, but to think they would dare go this far...$B$BThey were arming the Ealdir! I imagine their intent was to deepen the crisis facing Scadeald, further undermining Lady Serenya's rule.

<Even through the veil obscuring Serenya's face, you feel the coldness of her eyes, piercing through you like twin arrows.>$B$BA turn of events worthy of House Darengar. I shall personally see to it that history remembers their name as a synonym for betrayal.$B$BAs for your involvement, you have the gratitude of Scadeald. Someone of your caliber could be of great service to this province.

You come recommended by Lady Serenya, do you?$B$B<Draewyn strikes you as one of those men who need not raise their voice to command respect. His gray eyes size you up from head to toe.>$B$BScadeald is generous in two things: rain and trouble. The Light knows we need every soul we can muster. Very well! You look competent. Diligent. That's already more than I can say for most here!

Yes, yes, don't tell me. Hilma sent you.$B$BYou're the fourth this month. She could afford an escort and come herself, but since our last spat, she prefers to keep her distance. It's her way of punishing me.$B$BRegardless, you are not to blame. Here, take this; the payment for your services.$B$B<Durghain bows his head politely.>$B$BThese are lean times for Scadeald, and for my pockets as well; I cannot offer you work. But the guard is always eager to recruit new blood. If you have the stomach for war, I suggest you report to Sir Draewyn, Commander of the Guard.

So, they finally deigned to send someone! Better late than never, I suppose; even if you are just a sellsword.$B$BForgive me for taking my frustration out on you. It's been a fortnight since I dispatched my report to Sir Draewyn, and I've had naught but silence from Graysky ever since.$B$BI know the guard is stretched thin with the Ealdir and the Frostmane trolls, but something has happened in this village that should worry us far more than a roadside ambush.

A new recruit?$B$BYou must be something exceptional, if the Lord Commander believes one more pair of hands will tip the scales in our favor.$B$BWhat do you know of the Frostmane trolls? Do you have any idea what you're stepping into? Cutting down bandits or dealing with savages in loincloths is one thing. The battlefield is another entirely.$B$BAnd the Frostmane trolls are implacable foes.

Sent by Sir Draewyn, are you?$B$BGood, good. I know things are not going well in Graysky. The troll threat, the Kingsway being cut off...$B$B<The priest heaves a weary, nervous sigh.>$B$BThe crypts. I wrote to the Lord Commander regarding the crypts, but it would be best if you saw them with your own eyes.

So, the chaplain from Graysky sends you. What was that man's name? Centhis? Contis? Cuntir? Bah!$B$BTruth be told, the Graysky Guard would do little more than get in the way here at the abbey. We are better off as we are.$B$BBut since you are here, I can think of a thing or two you might help with.

The Light is present here, in the sermons and the prayers. But it was also present in the screams, the blood, and the tears of the initiates you challenged.$B$BYou have done them a favor. 'Spare the rod, spoil the child,' my father used to say. He used to say many things, mostly nonsense, but in this... In this, he was right.

Father Amrod sent...? Agh!$B$B<Diallos has lost too much blood. He seems barely conscious of his surroundings.>$B$BThese troggs are not like the others. They ambushed us. A trap. All of it.$B$BI am the only one left alive...

The trogg filth is history. Good.$B$BDo not let their deaths weigh on you any more than the deaths of the crusaders I sent to deal with them weigh on my conscience.$B$BOn one hand, troggs lack souls. And on the other, the crusaders swore to sacrifice their lives in service to the Light.

What have we here?$B$B<Enharon inspects the artifact with a gaze that is equal parts curiosity and repulsion.>$B$BThose abominations! I never imagined they could possess a religion of their own; that they would have sufficient intelligence. This is detestable. A faith bound to the radiation of Gnomeregan, no less.$B$BIt cannot be a coincidence. Nothing survived Gnomeregan unchanged. If my suspicions are correct, then the radiation mutated these troggs: it granted them a certain degree of intellect.$B$BKilling them was an indulgence.

A king? <Father Amrod laughs heartily, a loud, mocking roar.>$B$BThose animals. They don't even deserve the air they breathe. A king. A king! What will be next? Princesses? Troubadours? Priests?$B$B<His tone changes, hardening. His countenance turns dark.>$B$BDeath is the only remedy that works on those beasts.

Oh, thank you, thank you so much! You've recovered more than I dared hope for; enough to save me from ruin, at least.$B$BI'll try to repair the wagon, and as soon as Tito recovers, I'll resume my journey toward Graysky.$B$BI don't know how I can ever pay you back, but I am forever in your debt.

You return stained in red. Good.$B$BThese woods are a little safer thanks to you. The Stormwind Guard is committed to keeping this area protected; even so, proceed with caution if you plan to continue your journey toward Scadeald.$B$BReports have reached us from the Graysky Guard, warning about the Ealdir. It seems their attacks are becoming increasingly frequent.
A bite! I'm sure it's thanks to you.$B$BThank you very much for your help. I don't have much to offer, but please accept this as a token of my gratitude.

<The fisherman takes the plants and begins to rub them between his hands. Once they reach a paste-like consistency, he applies it directly to his wounds.>$B$BAgggh! You've no idea how it stings... but if it nips, it heals...$B$BThank you so much. I can already feel the sensation returning. I think I can manage on my own from here, but before you go, take this in thanks for your help.
You... you did it!? Woooaaah!$B$BI wish I could be as brave as you when I grow up. Thank you so much!$B$BHere, keep this. In the sewers... I won't be needing it.

<Despite appearances, the creature before you retains a vestige of humanity in its eyes that makes it difficult to perceive it entirely as a monster.>$B$BWait! Wait. I. I not like others. Still think. Speak. We speak? Yes?$B$BMiners. Mining. Cave. Yes? Cave-in! Rocks and dead. Miners trapped. Hunger. Bad hunger. We eat dead. Then... then claws grow. Hair grow. Teeth grow.$B$BTurn into monsters! Many lose mind. Others no. Others like me. Others scared.

A new face, and you aren't carrying pitchforks and torches, for a change. Not a bad start. Tell me, what brings you to me?$B$B<You recount the story of Alto Bilberg and the curse the miners seem to have suffered, transforming them into gnolls.>$B$BTypical. They fear and despise you until the day they suddenly need you. But for all these years, I have lived in 'otherness,' condemned to the contempt and constant suspicion of the people of Dunshire.$B$BWhy should I help them?

It didn't work, did it? I can see it on your face.$B$B<Beldred twists her face into a grimace of disgust. It seems to be a genuine sentiment.>$B$BI'm afraid there is nothing more I can do, then. I would consult my coven, but they are far away and busy fighting a pointless war against Graysky. And in any case, the price they would demand for their help is far beyond your means.$B$BAlthough...

<Amaranthe's gaze carries a certain sense of nakedness. Her eyes are two wells of deep memory.>$B$BA soldier's burden is a heart heavier than their sword. I know what brings you before me. Your effort is noble, and your intentions pure.$B$BBut I cannot help you.$B$BThe Gilded Vale endures dark days, and my power wanes alongside the vitality of the forest.$B$BI'm afraid I cannot be of assistance. Not until we thwart the threat that looms over us all.
The wind isn't blowing today... You'll have to wait until we finish grinding what we already have.$B$BThen you can grind your wheat.
Look at that! You've brought plenty of flour, fantastic.$B$BThat's one less ingredient to worry about for the famous Dunshire Pie.

We have everything!$B$BDo you want me to start preparing it now, or has your hunger not kicked in yet, you sweet tooth?$B$BBah, what a question... as soon as the smell hits you, your mouth will be watering!

Right now, you are the envy of all Scadeald. Seriously; do you have any idea how many people would love to be in your shoes? Tasting the Dunshire Pie for the very first time...$B$BSavor the moment. Eat without haste. Fill your belly. You never forget that first bite!

The amulet, you found it!$B$BYou have no idea what a tight spot you've gotten me out of. Now I can focus on preparing the shipment. And I'll be able to get some sleep at night, for a change.$B$BI'll let you know when everything is ready, if you're willing. I believe you've earned the right to see the Gilded Vale with your own eyes.

A new face. Hm. Judging by the pack upon your back, I take it you carry my order. Darond sent you, then.$B$BWell, friend, take a breath and set your mind at ease. You will find no evil in this Sanctuary that you did not bring with you.
The people of Cresthairn thank you.$B$BThe death of these bears will bring peace to the region, and their furs will provide warmth when the winds of Dun Morogh blow.

Stop. Get down, or you'll get us both killed. Up ahead are the Ealdmaine caverns, an Ealdir den if ever there was one.$B$BIn Graysky, they were offering a handsome sum for the head of the Ealdmaine leader. My mouth started watering at the thought.$B$B<Randec clenches his teeth to stifle a groan of pain. An arrow is buried in his knee.>$B$BDammit.

You.$B$B<Raigh Anramor stops you, placing a hand on your shoulder. Immediately after, he brings his nose close to the stolen furs of your disguise. His face wrinkles into a grimace.>$B$BYou reek of death. But I do not know your face. The Ealdmaine caverns are not the pathetic little village where you were born. Real Ealdir come here. Those with the hearts of warriors. To train. To kill.

Impressive! And you've only just arrived.$B$BIf every Ealdir fought like you, we would win this war in the blink of an eye.$B$BYou have earned the right to be here. Consider the Ealdmaine Caverns your new home from now on. We have much to do.

You've done well. More than well. If all the Cresthairn militiamen were like you, this civil war would have ended years ago.$B$BYou've chosen the right side, friend. Not like my brother. I tried to make him see reason, believe me. But there was no way.$B$BI did what I had to do. Yes, sir. I did the only sensible thing.

<Aralia's face is the very image of pain, devastation, and ruin. Something breaks inside her, behind her kind eyes. Something that will never heal. Never. Not in this life, nor in the next, nor in any other.>$B$BI... Why? Why me? Why my sons?$B$BAbellon. Oh, Abellon. Dead. Dead at the hands of his own brother.$B$BWhat did I do wrong?

Have you done it?$B$B<Despite the circumstances, Aralia manages to offer a faint, tiny smile of gratitude.>$B$BI cannot pay you for what you have done for me. I could not, even if I were the wealthiest woman in the province.

Have you dealt with the undead?$B$BThank the Light! And thanks to the Lord Commander for sending you! And to you, of course, for doing the deed.$B$BI still do not understand how this could have happened. What manner of spell must those witches have conjured to profane the sanctity of those graves and raise their guests as undead?

But I have a knowledge of herbs and alchemy. All I need is the help of someone willing to do what I cannot.$B$BWhat do you say? Will you aid a weakling and a coward?

en: I know the Horde values strength and courage, but as someone without either, I do not like asking you to face against a demon of such power for my sake. Still, I thank you. It is my hope now that this can lead us to a cure. Not right now, maybe, but I am young yet.$B$BGive me a moment, I’ll likely have more requests.

A crude drawing seems to depict the flower Sakari spoke of, next to a winged elf woman. Several more crude drawings next to it show the winged elf woman carrying various ores and gems. Perhaps whatever is being depicted knows more about the flower, and would value ores and gems.

You bring shinies, yes, yes, yes! Shinies! Shiny-bringer not food today, yes, yes, yes, tomorrow maybe, not today!$B$BShiny-bringer wants something in return, yes, yes, yes! Want harpies to leave, want help in fight, yes, yes, yes, I know your kinda well! Shiny buys day as not-food, no more. But more, yes, do more, do favor, and I tell all you wish, yes, yes, yes!

Sisters fear, sisters submit! True queen known, served, served by not-harpy even, yes, yes, yes! You will know of flower now!$B$BStory say harpy mother Avianna die, blood drop grow to single flower, spread long, many years, grow even here, yes, yes, yes! Not know if story is true, story not matter. Avianna’s Rose have great power, remove many curses, many!$B$BStory say harpy use magic with flower, remove curse, not wings, wings not curse, but others, harpy becomes greatest smartest queen, yes, yes, yes! Other curses too maybe, many curses, maybe demon curse too! Special magic, maybe other ways.

You talked to a harpy?!$B$BI believe you, of course, you have the honor not to deceive me, I’m sure. They’ve just not been receptive. Of course, we haven’t tried to talk much. Well, if you found out the flower’s properties, I can get started.

Lenore the Hoarder, dead at last. You have no idea how many sleepless nights she has cost this militia.$B$BWith her gone, the Defias lose one of their best suppliers, and our caravans might actually reach the outposts for once. Westfall owes you a debt, $N.

Food, bandages, tools... this is more than I dared hope for. You went right into their nest and came back with it.$B$BThis will keep the militia on its feet a while longer. The Defias took it from us, and you took it back. Thank you, $N.

That is it. That is the one. Warm and whole, not a scratch on the shell. I would hug you if I were not covered in swamp water and croc spit.$B$BYou did good. Really good. This little one might just have a chance now.

I thank you for this. My love for this world and the people in it makes this pain bearable, but I am still wielding a power that now fights against my very being. There are days I can almost forget it, but sometimes I must remain here and conserve my strength.$B$B...Invincible's grave has been opened?! By the light! Has Arthas not caused enough suffering already that he will not even let that poor horse rest in peace?$B$BI am sorry, thank you for bringing me the news at least, and for making this journey in my stead.

So they can finally rest. I am most grateful, you are truly kind, or perhaps you simply accept any job you are offered. The outcome is the same. It is a small difference amidst all the restless souls left behind by the Scourge, but still, I am glad.
There you go, see, he'll love you forever now.$B$BI'll take the rest of it off your hand, he can have it later.

He's dead? Excellent news!$B$BWithout him, I doubt we'll have much to worry about. Some low ranking fodder won't be doing much more than holding down the camp against the local wildlife.$B$BNow, let's see that face of his...$B$BNot bad, not bad at all, I can work with this.

It's done? Good, good. We'll keep an eye on them from here and see how well it spreads.$B$BScience always takes a few tries, but even if it doesn't actually wipe out those Scarlet wretches here and now, it should at least trim down their ranks and soften them up for when we get a proper team together for an attack on the monastery.
Hah! I knew you had it in you to be a real fighter. Don't worry, Lowfang's only the beginning, we've got plenty of more seasoned competitors lined up.

You finally got rid of that harpy! Anyone can fight who's willing, but she'd gotten most of the crowd cheering against her. Not that I mind, builds investment if people care how the fight goes.$B$BWonder who that Queen Erethina she always yells about is, but that sounds more like a problem for you than me.

Thought for sure you were gonna splatter when that club came down on you. Guess you are tougher than you look. The crowd loves an underdog, so this works out just fine.$B$BYou gave them a show. More importantly, you gave them a winner.$B$BHey, if I go start up my own ring, you should sign up. I'll give you a better challenge, promise.

So it was the totems letting her heal herself up, was it?$B$BOf course I knew that! Anyone with half a brain could figure up something was up with those, but not my place to ruin the surprise. It's more exciting if the fighters have to figure it out on their own, you'd be surprised how many don't.$B$BGuess you've got brains and not just brawn.

Now that was a fight! Things haven't been the same around here since the champion retired, don't blame him though, no one wanted to fight when they knew they'd lose. But this, this will make things interesting again, and they're fighting for more than active champion.$B$BSuppose you're not sticking around though, are you? A shame, but I know how you adventurer lot are, not like I've got anything left to throw at you.

This one wandered over here not too long ago, I take it he was the only one you had any luck with?$B$BGiven the nature of this research, I can count us fortunate even one of this lot was able to break free. For that matter, it is more fortunate for this one in particular, for he seems quite willing to aid in my research.$B$BAn expert on the necromantic arts...this might just be precisely what I need to achieve better results. Yes, this will do just fine.

Well it sure is good to see a friendly face out here. I don't suppose you saw another gnome while you were in the tower, did you? No?$B$BMaybe it really wasn't Morganth finding a way to hide him from the eye then...$B$BI'm sure I'll find him, Azora's power is on my side after all. Since you saved me the trouble of scouting this place, maybe I could help you with something in return?$B$BI am always pleased to share the wisdom of Azora with travelers like yourself.

I am whole once more!$B$BYou have done me a great service, and so it is only fair I reward you with a small portion of my secrets, but only a taste, for now. You are inexperienced yet, and I do not wish to damage your mind.$B$BWe shall meet again, perhaps not soon, for I have much left to share with the others of this tower, but the time will come, of that I am now certain.

Yes, that will work perfectly. You have a good eye.$B$BJasper woke up briefly but he fell asleep again before I could get halfway through explaining the basic principles of Arcane Missiles.$B$BThe only good thing about having such a lazy student is that it gives me plenty of time for my own research, as long as I can focus through his snoring.

Yes, yes, that is perfect. You will not believe how quickly this concoction brings them back on their feet. One sip and they are practically ready to tear through a wall.$B$BThank you. With these, we might just get through the next round of injuries without losing anyone. Just… never drink it yourself unless you enjoy waking up days later not knowing where you are.

See what I mean now, might be talking a bit, but he ain't saying anything useful.

Got a name out of him you say? Julie? That's more than we've got I reckon.

Now where've I heard that name before...

<The woman looks to be on the verge of tears, but she composes herself some as you approach.>

Hello. May I help you with something?

A worgen spoke my name...?

Arvis, is this what you've become? Sorry...I need a moment...

That old book...so it survived then? Arvis was trying to write a book in whatever spare time he had after managing the farm...he had a whole series in mind actually...

<Tears stream down the woman's cheek.>

I'm sure he'll recognize it. He has to. If there's anything still left of him, he has to.
You brought the Nectar? Great, I suppose it's about time we start.

Looks like it went feral again. A shame, would've talked to it myself some, but I figured the wife had a better chance.

We'd been thinking the worgen here were just wild beasts that used to be men, but that one mentioned something about a "Wolf Cult", and a leader. Ain't that something?

Seems we might've been going about this all wrong. I'll make sure word gets back to our people in Darkshire, if the worgen have an actual goal we'd better stay vigilant.
A talkin' naga that just wants to be left alone? Long as it stays out of my water and away from my alchemists, it can sing sea shanties for all I care.$B$BGood work, $r. Here, ya earned this.
Yesss... I can feel the flow of time within it. Thisss is only the beginning, but it is more hope than my people have had in an age.$B$BAccept my gratitude, $r, and this token of it.
Right. It was a pleasure doing business with ya!$B$BGlad yer one of the understandin' types, and with our stories straight I think we'll be just fine.

Snazzy already filled me in. Who knew he was so good at slaying sea giants? Good thing he was there to save your hide huh?$B$BAnyways, great work. Maybe one day you'll make a fine sailor. Or dock worker, not sure, just follow your dreams kid.
<Arvon glances at the logbook in your hand and the color drains from his face.>$B$BWhere did you get that? Keep your voice down. Let's talk about this like reasonable people.
A Bloodsail spy in my own port, running a tannery right under my nose! You have done Booty Bay a great service, $N. The Steamwheedle Cartel will not forget it.
Smart choice. Here's your gold, as promised. You never saw that logbook, and I never saw you.
Now that's what I'm talkin' about! Dry, fresh, and not a single one missin'. You're makin' a habit of bein' useful, kid. Here, for your trouble.

I can see the primal fury awakening in your blood, $N! You have chosen the ancient path of the barbarian, embracing the wild rage that flows through the veins of those who refuse to be tamed.$B$BAs a Barbarian, you will learn to channel your innermost fury into devastating combat techniques. Your enemies will flee before your berserker rage, while your allies draw strength from your untamed courage.
