The crimson art flows through you now, $N. I can sense the power in your veins, the willingness to sacrifice life itself for greater magical might. You have chosen the dangerous path of blood magic.$B$BAs a Bloodmage, you will learn to manipulate the very essence of life, turning blood into raw magical energy. Your own vitality will fuel spells of incredible power, while your enemies' life force becomes your weapon. This is magic at its most primal and dangerous.$B$BRemember always that every spell cast comes at a cost. Your own blood, your enemies' blood, the blood of sacrifice - all become components in your dark art. But for those brave enough to pay this price, the rewards are beyond ordinary comprehension.$B$BThe crimson path is now yours to walk. May your power grow with each drop spilled.

Time itself shifts around you, $N! You have chosen to study the most complex and dangerous of all magical arts - the manipulation of temporal reality itself. Few mortals possess the mental discipline required for chronamancy.$B$BAs a Chronomancer, you will learn to slow your enemies until they move like statues, accelerate your allies to superhuman speed, and even glimpse echoes of past and future events. The very fabric of time will bend to your will.$B$BThis magic demands perfect precision and unwavering focus. A single miscalculation could trap you in temporal loops, age you decades in seconds, or worse. But master these techniques, and you will become nearly untouchable in battle.$B$BThe streams of time await your command. Let us begin with the fundamental principles of temporal manipulation.

The whispers grow stronger now that you have joined us, $N. I can hear the Old Ones speaking of your potential, their ancient voices carried on winds that normal minds cannot perceive. You have chosen the path of forbidden knowledge.$B$BAs a Cultist, you will learn to commune with entities that exist beyond mortal understanding, gaining power through dangerous pacts and eldritch wisdom. Your magic will tap into forces that predate civilization itself.$B$BThis knowledge comes with great risk. The whispers can drive weak minds to madness, and the beings you contact care nothing for mortal concerns. But for those with the strength to endure, the secrets of the universe itself lie within reach.$B$BListen carefully to what I teach you. The Old Ones are always watching, and they do not tolerate failure from those who serve them.

The fel energies recognize you now, $N. Your soul bears the mark of one willing to embrace demonic power without hesitation. In an age ruled by fire and ruin, only those strong enough to claim corruption survive.$B$BAs one of the Felsworn, you will bind demonic essence through domination and pact, tearing infernal allies from the Twisting Nether and bending the fires of the Burning Legion to your will. This power was never meant to be restrained. It exists to be taken.$B$BMany who walk this path are consumed by corruption because they lack the will to command it. You will not. The whispers of demons are not warnings but revelations, truths offered only to those ruthless enough to listen.$B$BThe fel flames burn within you now. Let them consume doubt, mercy, and weakness. Power is its own justification. May this gift remake the world in your image.

The sacred ward strengthens around you, $N! You have accepted the most noble of callings - to serve as an eternal guardian, placing the safety of others above your own without question or hesitation.$B$BAs a Guardian, you will learn to become a living fortress, your body and magic forming an impenetrable barrier between your allies and harm. Your defensive techniques will make you nearly invulnerable, while your protective spells shield entire groups from danger.$B$BThis path requires selfless dedication. You will endure pain so others need not, face death so others may live. Glory and recognition often pass by those who prevent disaster rather than cause it. But know that there is no higher honor than preserving innocent lives.$B$BTeldrassil itself blesses your vow of protection. Stand ready, guardian - the world has great need of your sacrifice.

The shadow embraces you while honor guides you, $N. You have chosen the most paradoxical of paths - to wield darkness in service of the light, to become a Knight of Xoroth.$B$BAs a Knight of Xoroth, you will learn to channel void energy and shadow magic while maintaining your moral principles. Your dark spells will confound enemies who expect holy magic from a paladin-like figure, while your righteous cause justifies methods others would consider forbidden.$B$BThis path walks the razor's edge between salvation and damnation. You must never let the darkness consume your purpose, even as you draw power from the shadows. Your oath binds you to protect the innocent through whatever means necessary.$B$BThe void whispers promises of easy power, but your honor must be stronger than any temptation. Welcome to the Order, dark paladin.

Death recognizes you as its servant, $N, but not as its master. You have chosen to become a shepherd between worlds, guiding souls to their proper rest and commanding the power of undeath for righteous purposes.$B$BAs a Necromancer, you will learn to speak with the dead, raise skeletal servants, and manipulate the very essence of life and death. But remember always that this power exists to preserve the natural order, not to mock it.$B$BMany fear necromancy, seeing only the corruption it can bring. But true necromancers serve as guardians of the boundary between life and death, ensuring that the dead rest peacefully and that their knowledge aids the living when needed.$B$BThe spirits of the departed whisper their approval of your choice. Use this power wisely, and may you always remember that death is not an end, but a transition.

The raw elements surge through you now, $N! You have chosen to embrace the most primal forces of creation itself, becoming a conduit for earth, air, fire, and water in their purest forms.$B$BAs a Primalist, you will learn to command elemental magic with unprecedented power and fury. Your spells will call forth volcanic eruptions, devastating earthquakes, hurricane-force winds, and flash floods. The very building blocks of reality will answer your call.$B$BThis power comes from the world's foundation itself, older and more dangerous than any magic devised by mortals. The elements care nothing for civilization's concerns - they respond only to strength and respect. Show weakness, and they will consume you.$B$BThe primal forces have accepted you as their champion. May you prove worthy of wielding the fundamental powers of creation itself.

The wilderness recognizes one of its own, $N! I can see the forest's blessing in your eyes, the call of the wild that marks true Rangers. You have chosen to become a guardian of nature itself.$B$BAs a Ranger, you will learn to move unseen through any terrain, to communicate with wild beasts as brothers, and to strike from the shadows with deadly precision. The forests will hide you, the animals will aid you, and your enemies will never see death approaching.$B$BTeldrassil's sacred groves have much to teach you. You will learn to read the signs that others miss, to track prey across any surface, and to survive in the harshest wilderness. Your bow will sing death songs, and your blade will taste the blood of those who threaten the natural world.$B$BThe forest spirits welcome their new protector. May your arrows fly true and your path remain hidden from those who would do harm.

The eternal harvest calls to you, $N. You have chosen to serve the cycle of life and death itself, becoming a reaper of souls when their appointed time arrives.$B$BAs a Reaper, you will learn to sense when a being's time has come, to guide souls gently to their rest, and to harvest the life force of those who refuse their natural fate. Your magic draws power from the boundary between life and death itself.$B$BThis is not the path of a murderer, but of a divine agent ensuring the natural order continues. You will learn to distinguish between a life that should be saved and one that must end, between mercy and necessary duty.$B$BThe cycle of existence itself has chosen you as its servant. May you always remember that your purpose is not to bring death, but to ensure that life's journey reaches its proper conclusion.

The ancient runes pulse with recognition, $N! You have chosen to master the oldest form of magic known to civilization - the power of symbols carved into stone and steel with perfect precision.$B$BAs a Runemaster, you will learn to inscribe magical formulae that outlast the civilizations that created them. Your enchantments will be carved into the very fabric of reality, creating effects that endure long after other magic has faded.$B$BThis art requires absolute precision. A single misplaced line can turn a protection ward into a death trap, while perfect execution can create wonders that seem impossible. Your tools are hammer and chisel, but your true weapons are knowledge and patience.$B$BThe primordial powers that gave birth to runic magic acknowledge your worth. May your inscriptions be flawless and your enchantments eternal.

The stars themselves shine brighter in your presence, $N! You have chosen to study the celestial arts, drawing magical power from the distant lights that wheel overhead through the endless night.$B$BAs a Starcaller, you will learn to read the cosmic patterns written across the sky, to channel stellar energy into devastating spells, and to glimpse the future through astrological divination. The very heavens will become your source of power.$B$BElune's blessing has prepared you well for this path, but you will learn to draw upon all the stars, not just our moon goddess. Each constellation offers different gifts, each celestial body provides unique energies for those who understand their nature.$B$BThe cosmic forces welcome their new student. May the starlight guide your spells and the celestial wisdom illuminate your path through the darkness.

Thunder rolls across the heavens in recognition, $N! You have chosen to become a master of the storm itself, wielding the fury of wind and lightning as your weapons.$B$BAs a Stormbringer, you will learn to summon tempests from clear skies, to call down lightning that splits mountains, and to ride the wind itself into battle. The very atmosphere will bend to your will, becoming a weapon of devastating power.$B$BThis magic is raw and untamed, like the storms themselves. You must learn to harness its fury without being consumed by it, to direct its power without losing yourself in its chaotic nature. The storm respects only strength and determination.$B$BThe tempest spirits have marked you as their champion. May your lightning never miss its target and your winds never fail to carry you to victory.

The Light embraces you with radiant warmth, $N! You have chosen to become a beacon of healing and hope, channeling the pure power of dawn itself to banish darkness from the world.$B$BAs a Sun Cleric, you will learn to heal wounds that others consider fatal, to purify corruption that has taken root in mortal souls, and to call down cleansing fire that burns only evil. Your presence alone will bring comfort to the suffering.$B$BThis path demands unwavering compassion and absolute dedication to the welfare of others. You will exhaust yourself healing strangers, risk your life protecting the innocent, and face the darkness that others flee from.$B$BThe dawn itself blesses your sacred calling. May your light never dim, and may you always bring hope to those lost in the darkest nights.

Divine justice flows through you like molten gold, $N! Your sword will be guided by divine will, your shield empowered by righteous fury.$B$BThis calling demands absolute moral clarity and unwavering dedication to justice. You must be judge and executioner, healer and protector, all guided by divine wisdom that transcends mortal understanding.$B$BThe Light itself has chosen you as its champion. May your faith be your strength, your conviction your weapon, and your righteousness your eternal guide.

Brilliant innovation sparks in your mind, $N! May your inventions be marvels of both function and beauty, serving progress without abandoning the natural world.

The balance of life and death, poison and antidote, flows through you now, $N. The same compound that kills a corrupted beast might save a poisoned child. Your wisdom must guide when to unleash death and when to preserve life, for the power you wield cuts both ways.$B$BThe natural balance recognizes your understanding. May your venoms strike true against evil, and your cures bring healing to the innocent.

Righteous fire burns in your soul, $N! You have chosen to dedicate your life to the eternal hunt for corruption, becoming a Witch Hunter sworn to cleanse evil wherever it may lurk.$B$BAs a Witch Hunter, you will learn to identify supernatural threats that fool others, to wield blessed weapons specifically designed to destroy corrupted beings, and to resist the very temptations that doom your quarry. Your purpose is to stand guard against darkness that hides behind innocent faces.$B$BThis calling demands constant vigilance and absolute moral fortitude. You will face enemies who appear as friends, confront evil that wears the mask of virtue, and make choices that others will never understand. The burden of this knowledge will weigh heavily upon you.$B$BThe Light has blessed your sacred hunt. May your weapons never fail against corruption, your eyes never be deceived by evil's disguises, and your resolve never waver in the face of darkness.
An order from Bilgewhizzle, huh? Water for Gadgetzan, on the double. Fine, fine, I'll get the barrels movin'. Thanks for haulin' this all the way out here.

Oh... oh I see....$B$BI had a feeling, even if I tried to deny such a thing. Did my sister send you, by any chance?$b$bI already told her this isn't a good time; although honestly, there's never a good time to deal with her.$b$bAnyway, I'm in the middle of a discovery that... has me completely absorbed. Maybe you'd be interested in lending a hand?

The way is shut, mortal.$b$bThe dungeon is home to the Dead, and the Dead keep it so.$b$bJailers in life, prisoners in death... all of us, victims of her curse.$b$bThe way is shut.

You're not the first. But I trust you'll be the last.$b$bVery well. I will tell you about Sitis.

<Moroi listens to your account intently.>$b$bThey say the pen is mightier than the sword, and Sitis... fitting name. It means "thirst." I thank you for the warning, but my mind won't rest until I uncover the truth... no matter the risks you've mentioned.

You did it.... <he gasps for breath.>$b$bIt shames the uniform I wear with such pride that I had to turn to someone outside the army.$b$bIt should have been my duty to see it done, but, as you can see, I haven't the strength to even limp back to the Abbey.$b$bStormwind owes you thanks, Guardian... and so do I.

By my beard…! I nearly put a bullet through you. <The fits have grown worse. The gnome can barely keep one eye half open.>$B$BYou’re done? Splendid…$B$B<A string of bile hangs from his mouth. He’s been vomiting in your absence.>$B$BEver since I joined this lot… the sickness has only deepened. It doesn’t make any sense… does it?
Stop.$b$bI can feel you. I know you’re there. And I know you’re not one of us.$b$bWhat business brings you to the Vulture Cult Eyrie?

Communion is the most sacred moment for any initiate. In hers, Elydna will stake her very life. If what you seek, out of pity for her brother, is to see her survive the rite, well… perhaps you can be of use.

Ahh… I can almost taste it. And you’ve brought five? Yes… intact. I don’t know how you resisted sneaking a bite.$b$b<Aegya runs her tongue across her lips, slowly and obscenely: a black slug slick with slime.>$b$bThe Great Vulture… will feast tonight.
Rotten flesh… sanctified. The Great Vulture will savor this offering.$b$bThe time has come. Elydna Wingstroke’s communion begins.

A sublime fight. The Great Vulture is pleased.$b$bOh, don’t tell me you pity Elydna. <Aegya pouts mockingly.> Didn’t I warn you of the risks of the communion?$b$bYou either triumph, and rise as one of us… or you fail, only to rot in the Moonlit Ossuary.$b$bElydna had her chance. <The elf breathes in, catching the scent of the flower crown.>$b$bThey followed. Good.$b$bThe Great Vulture teaches many lessons, but to sacrifice such tender lives to the cruelty of its beak… that is a depravity I could never forgive myself.$b$bWhatever it takes, I will see these children safe.

I don’ recall ya face. But ya bringin’ somethin’ dat make me skin crawl…$B$BDis… “spiritual unrest,” ya say? Hah! So Esgramor be sendin’ ya. Da Witch already be knowin’ of da curse hangin’ ova da Valley o’ Trials. Even now, she be workin’ a ritual to fix it.$B$BHrmm… <The troll tilts his head, sizing you up.>$B$BSince ya come dis far, maybe ya can lend a hand wit’ da ritual.

Dey send you… to make sure I be dead. Ha…$B$B<The troll lies crumpled on the ground, each breath a ragged moan.>$B$BDe amulet… it didn’t work. Not all de way… De magic o’ dis cave tore me apart, inside an’ out. Was a trap. De Witch must’ve seen through my ambitions…$B$BBut dey didn’t count on me clingin’ to life like a leech. I will not die here!$B$BCome closer…<her voice falls to a whisper>. I tell you everyt’ing.

De essences…!$B$B<Despite her grievous wounds, the troll makes an effort to raise herself halfway, her torso trembling with the effort.>$B$BThree sacred signs, bound to de loa of de Siniestra Triad: Dambala, de serpent god of wisdom an’ intrigue; Hir’eek, de bat god of night an’ secrets; and Elortha no Shadra, de spider goddess of fate an’ deceit.$B$BIn anoder time, dis power you placed in my hands would be enough to slay de Witch. But… <the troll gives a weary smile> I must content meself wit weakenin’ her dark voodoo.

I was a fool. I should have known something darker was at work when I reached out to the elementals… and was met with silence.$B$BInstead, I sent you to seek the aid of the witch who, ironically, was the very cause of the spirits’ unrest.$B$BBut it is not yet too late to thwart her designs, whatever they may be. Hirsutta has made three dangerous enemies.

It is done. Hirsutta is dead.$B$BThe spirits rest once more. I believe the Witch sought to bind the souls of every orc and troll who fell here, and forge from them a twisted avatar of her dark gods.$B$BDambala is not the loa of cunning and wisdom, but of betrayal.$B$BHir’eek is not the loa of secrets and night, but of thirst and blood.$B$BAnd Shadra… She is no weaver of fate, but a murderer, a liar.$B$BImagine what sort of abomination her ritual would have birthed…
<The orc nods. The small gesture is all it takes to agree never to speak of it again.>

Anthon sent you? The last Forsaken he dragged in caused more trouble than he was worth… but your tendons seem better preserved. Perhaps you can actually do something useful for us after all.$B$BAllow me to introduce myself:$B$BI am Riscell Cain. Kobolds, you say? The lowest sort; vandals, scavengers, petty thieves. Let them rot! I’ll personally see their burrows choked with blight.$B$BAs for your work… I’m impressed. Our deathstalker stationed in the manor reports the spirits no longer wander its halls and chambers.$B$BDo you know what that means? We’re ready for our next move.
You have the key fragments?$B$BSplendid, I was beginning to get impatient.$B$BJust give me a moment…

<Riscell shakes his head slowly as you recount what you’ve seen.>$B$BThat creature… I’d heard the rumors, but even for my sister, they seemed too grotesque to believe.$B$BTo think Priscilla consorted with a demon… and bore that “thing”.$B$BIn any case, you’ve done the Heritage League a great service, and restored the dignity of my family name in the process. You have my “undying” gratitude.

<If greed had a color, it would be the yellow of this forsaken’s eyes.>$B$BA saucy painting… a crystal ball (likely cursed), a jewel we’d need appraised before celebrating, and a family signet whose worth, I’d wager, is purely sentimental.$B$BNot much, really. <She shrugs as if it were nothing. You’re back. And you’ve left quite the trail of corpses behind you.$B$BGood.$B$B<The forsaken grins at the thought of what he’ll be able to harvest from the bodies.>$B$BWith this, and a spark of electricity, the forsaken I know can stitch us together a friend. This isn’t just any gift... Seven manes, from seven warriors. A feat worth respect.$B$BI take it you were sent by my loyal Redhorn. If that is so, then it will be my honor to accept your service.

This ring…$B$B<The tauren falls silent for a long while. His gaze flickers restlessly, like a grasshopper in the brush.>$B$BDo you know what this means? Morriga has chosen you as her champion. I wonder what she saw in you… that I cannot.$B$BHm. No matter. We have work to do.
Do you bring all we need for the disguise?

My father… is dead?$B$B<Morriga’s eyes grow wet. Her look might be sorrow… or relief. Likely, a tear of both.>$B$BThat means I can return to Three Totems.$B$BAnd set things right.$B$B<Morriga’s tears vanish into the dimples of her smile. Suddenly, she no longer seems so gentle.>$B$BSet them right—my way.

<The hyena howls and laughs and weeps all at once, as though the task it set you was the greatest jest ever told.>$B$BWell done… oh, very well done!$B$BThe village spirits are in an uproar. They earned it; the humiliation they dealt me, the exile…$B$BMy smile is the smile of fortune. Now… enjoy it.

<The spirit of the hyena bares its teeth as you approach. You cannot tell if it is warning, or laughter.>$B$BMorriga, is it?$B$B<A jagged, manic laugh rakes through your skull.>$B$BI am pleased. That tauren always finds a way to amuse me. She never tires of serving.$B$BVery well. I’ll take her scraps.

<The priest listens intently as you recount the events.>$b$bAn interesting discovery.$b$bIt is curious... almost every saint to whom we ascribe visions suffered some form of blindness.$b$bIn any case <he tosses the murloc eyes into the waste bin> only the Light knows what the future holds.$b$bWhatever you think you saw in these heretical creatures was nothing but deception. Murlocs are an insult to the human spirit. Best you put this curiosity of yours to rest.

At last! Silence! Blessed silence! I near forgot what it sound like.$B$BHope dem masks din’t give ya too much trouble. Spirits be fickle, sometimes violent… but mostly harmless.$B$BDey do love ta talk, tho. Jus’ never got nothin’ worth sayin’.

The fire cannot burn forever without someone to indulge its whims.$b$bBy killing him, you've set him free. Now the flames must content themselves with licking his bones until both are dust and ash.$b$bBut these chambers hold more than dust and ash... Choose your reward, mortal.

<The dwarf listens closely, barely able to contain a toothless grin.>$B$BDid you kill that bastard?$B$B<Her leprous face lights up.>$B$BYou gave him what he had coming. In return, I’ll give you what you deserve: a reward worthy of the satisfaction you’ve given me.
The abomination… is it dead?$b$b<The elf glances over your garb, splattered with bits of bloody mucus.>$b$bThe abomination is dead.$b$bSplendid.

De cave, it be changin’… ya done slain de guardian spirit, eh?$B$BGood. Maybe you be havin’ a chance ‘gainst de witch, den. An’ thanks ta you, I be havin’ one too.$B$BHere, take dis. A small token o’ me gratitude.

The hound… it’s dead?$B$B<The Forsaken shakes his head, heavy with sorrow.>$B$BA shame. Rot has twisted so many minds, it’s safer not to take chances.$B$BWho knows… perhaps this dog might’ve been different.$B$BHere. You’ve earned it.

At last!$B$BThe scavenger turned to carrion. Delicious. His father will rage when he learns I conspired to kill one of his countless bastards.$B$BAnother grievance to add to our long, bloody tally.$B$B<A final, triumphant cackle ends the spirit’s rant.>$B$BWell then, a promise is a promise. Choose your reward wisely.

<The Forsaken hums a sinister tune in a voice like a cracked instrument, his focus pinned to the experiment in his hands.>$B$BAnd you are…?$B$BAh.$B$BVery well. I can wait, though never with idle hands. The flesh Eric promised me isn't the only ingredient needed to bring an abomination to life.

<The Forsaken inspects the samples with a clinician's eye; once they meet his standard, his gaze narrows, coldly patient, and a thin, condescending smile appears.>$B$BGood work, much to my surprise.$B$BThe spores radiate necrotic energy. A long curing awaits before their potential can be bent to the service of science…$B$BBut with this, and a few other pieces, you'll see soon enough: the dead flesh of my construct, stitched and patchworked by these expert hands, will spasm into life!
note:
D=anglais_inconnu | indice de l'archive (anglais_inconnu, 1 candidat) : « <Les Réprouvés inspectent les échantillons avec l'œil d'un clinicien ; Une fois qu'ils rencontrent son étendard, son regard se rétrécit, froidement patient, et un mince sourire condescendant apparaît.>

Bon travail, à ma grande surprise.

Les spores rayonnent de l'énergie nécrotique. Un long process… »

en: Is it done? Have you cleared out that traitorous rabble?$B$B<A flicker of a smile crosses Delcard Sading's face as you confirm his brother's death.>$B$BGood. Now no one will ever know the shame Alric nearly brought upon our family name.$B$BHe never accepted what he was—Forsaken. But when a problem has no solution, it ceases to be a problem and becomes something else: a reality to be faced.
note:
D=anglais_inconnu | indice de l'archive (anglais_inconnu, 1 candidat) : « Est-ce que c'est fait ? Avez-vous éliminé cette canaille traîtresse ?

<Un sourire éclaire le visage de Delcard Sading alors que vous confirmez la mort de son frère.>

Bien. Désormais, personne ne saura jamais la honte qu'Alric a failli causer à notre nom de famille.

Il n'a jamais accepté ce qu'il … »

en: My brother and the rebels were in contact with the Scarlet Crusade… and they were going to invite them in?$B$B<Delcard lets out a hoarse cackle that knocks a tooth loose; it clacks off the wall.>$B$BWell. Seems I dragged you into this for nothing. They were going to die either way; by your hand, or at the crusaders' mercy.$B$BHow naive. They were never a threat, after all.
Curiosity is not one of the Three Virtues we keep in the Cult of the Forgotten Shadow.$B$BBut it is their antechamber.

Did my lady Bianca send you?$B$B<Dulcinea dips into an awkward curtsy.>$B$BSo she’ll be delayed… I swear, that brother of hers is nothing but trouble.$B$BEither way, her mother’s medicine can’t wait. Would you be so kind as to help me with my errands?

Another errand-runner?$B$BI don’t know what Lady Bianca and Moroi think they’re playing at, but their mother,my lady Agria, doesn’t have much time left…$B$B<Aldia gives the old woman a pitying look. Swaddled in layers of sheets and shawls, she looks half-buried already.>$B$BThe ingredients… Do you have them? Good. I’ll see they’re handed to the alchemist.

So my instincts were right.$B$BThere’s no cure for old age, but with the curse broken, at least Lady Agria’s terrible pains should ease.$B$B<As he speaks, the years show: furrows cut deep in a lean face, watery eyes spent; he’s hardly younger than the lady he serves.>$B$BThank you for your diligent service.

<Clara the Mad holds an apple in her right hand, admiring it as if it were her most prized possession.>$B$BGoldshire is like this apple.$B$B<Slowly, she turns it to show a bite; inside—despite appearances—it’s rotten, worm-eaten.>
My people won’t forget Goldshire’s kindness.$B$BI trust that one day we’ll repay it in full.
I hope I didn’t bore you too much!

<The old orc listens to your account of the Valley of Trials with a half-lidded stare.>$B$BI never liked that Hirsutta. And I never trusted her voodoo. Shame time proved me right.$B$BIt's a blessing you managed to bring her down. But I fear the echo of her ambition won't die quickly. The consequences of her ritual are reverberating even here, in Razor Hill.

<Though the old orc's eyes remain shut, he senses your presence all the same.>$B$BThe naga are dead.$B$BI felt it in the earth; it whispered every step you took into my ear. The water told me too, reddened by their blood.$B$BYou have my thanks, $C.

<The goblin's eyes light up like a kid handed candy when he sees you hauling in the elven relics.>$B$BSplendid! Wonderful! Phenomenal!$B$BI'm gonna make a killing on this. At least… <he cuts himself off before naming a number. He puckers up and pretends to take a closer look.>$B$BMaybe I got a little carried away. Look at this, the condition's awful! No one's paying top coin for something this beat-up…$B$BAnyway. Can't say I don't keep my promises. Here's a little payment for the effort… symbolic, of course.
Don't ask me how, but I'd swear it's hotter in there than out here.$B$BHardly a day goes by without a peon keeling over.$B$BThey'll be grateful for the cool water you brought them.
Thank you for the company, $C.$B$BFew bother to listen to this old orc.

Oh, a new face.$B$B<The elder cups your cheeks with hands furred in grey and smiles, tenderly.>$B$BYou’re here about the fire in Bloodhoof Village, aren’t you? I warned the village shaman of the dangers tucked inside his fondness for flame.$B$BHe did not listen.

This is…$B$B<The tauren’s gaze warms with gratitude as he regards the amphora of water blessed by Ammus Grey-Eye.>$B$BCan you feel the power these waters give off? Few can, fully. It’s like a caress to the spirit; a hush after a long, noisy day.$B$BThese waters will help me restore the elemental balance Ardunno disturbed. Even so, I will still need your help.

The water’s blessing fades, but it has done its work.$B$BYou return unharmed.$B$BFew can say they’ve faced spirits of fire and lived to tell it.$B$BYou have done Bloodhoof Village a great service, $C.
The incense burns with renewed vigor. By this act, my dignity is restored.$B$BThe children of my children shall yet receive my blessing; in hope, and in words of heartening when the days grow dark.

Rest here a while, on the very edge of the cliff. In silence; at times, words do no more than paw at the truth.$B$BFeel this moment. Keep it, for as long as it lasts.$B$BTaste Life as it is: a force that outstrips flesh and speech alike.

Yes, $c? What business brings you to Dolanaar?$b$b<The druid gives your account his full attention. As your tale unfolds, his face darkens and the lines at the corners of his eyes deepen.>$b$bAegya… A name I'd hoped never to hear again. So they're here, then. In Teldrassil.$b$bThe audacity…$b$bForget the Cult, $n, and rest easy. I'll see to dismantling them myself.

So, the Vulture Cult…$b$b<Her eyes are deep wells of memory. Far below, an ancient rancor ferments.>$b$bI'll ready my Sentinels, impertinence or no from Tallonkai. He forgets that in politics—as in religion, in war, and in nearly everything that matters—it's the women who give the orders.
Is it done?$b$bGood work. My Sentinels will see to the rest, and they'll be ready to strike the Vulture Cult's nest and bring Lady Aegya to justice, once and for all.
Well fought, $C.$B$BMy sisters acknowledge your merits with admiration… and a touch of envy.$B$BWe Sentinels will see to exterminating the rest.
<Alenna’s gaze darkens. It seems the beauty of Dolanaar isn’t enough to chase off the dread conjured by that cult’s name.>

<The dwarf woman’s inquisitive brow softens when you mention Norhi and the message he asked you to deliver.>$B$BThat’s good news, <she says, without much enthusiasm.>$B$BI’ll see to it the shipment’s ready as soon as possible.

Hm… <Eyma inhales the aroma of the hops you gathered; her eyes flutter shut.>$B$BIntoxicating.$B$BI hope the wildlife didn’t give you too much grief. At this rate I’ll have to hire someone to patrol the grounds.

You survived!$B$BAnd you salvaged no small number of parts.$B$B<Ikoras coughs and bats away the thin plume of smoke puffing from the cave mouth, fidgeting as he does.>$B$BWith these, and a couple of stiff drinks at the distillery, I think I’ll recover the inspiration (and the nerve) to plunge into my next project: a second generation of automata, stronger and more obedient than the first batch.$B$BThanks!

By my mother’s beard! Now that was a show!$B$BYou saw it with your own eyes, eh? I sell only the finest kit.$B$BDo me a favor and spread the word, will you? In this line of work, nothing beats word of mouth.
Choose your enemies with care, $C.$B$BPlenty of dwarves pass through Kharanos eager to forge a legend… only to end up dropped into one of these niches.

<You open your hand, revealing Elydna's pendant. At the sight of it, Thariel's grief-stricken expression eases ever so slightly.>$b$bI suppose... in the absence of a body to mourn, this will have to do.$b$b<He takes the pendant with trembling hands and presses it to his chest.>$b$bElydna... what madness drove you to join those degenerates?
Here is your first mount, $N. Ride well.

So the pact found you. Good. The hunger in you is small yet, $N; we will make it obey before we make it grow.
You felt it too, didn't you? The air changes when the storm takes notice of someone. Let us see what it makes of you, $N.
You read the oath and came anyway. Then you already understand the price, $N. We begin now.
Stand here beside me a moment, $N, and look down at the lawn. Everything you can see is worth holding. That is where we start.
Welcome, $N. The Light has waited long enough for our people to return to it. We will not keep it waiting any longer.
Your pulse is quick, $N. Good. Fear makes the blood run faster, and fast blood is eager to be spent.
You found the camp without getting lost. That is a better start than most, $N. Sit, and we will see about that aim.
Ah, $N. Right on time. Well, one of the times. Let us begin.
You came all this way to stand beside a grave. Most of the living avoid them. That is the first thing we will change about you, $N.
There is heat in you already, $N. I can feel it from here. Let us teach it where to go.
Can you hear them yet, $N? No? You will. Stay close, and do not be afraid of what they say.
Look up, $N. Even in daylight they are there. Once you learn to feel them, you never stop.
Welcome, $N. You have the look of someone who has been waiting for the sun to rise. It has.
You made it without blowing anything up. That makes one of us today, $N. Come, take a look at this.
The spirit healer sends the dead back. I send them onward. Stand here with me a while, $N, and you will learn the difference.
A steady hand and a quick eye. Good, $N. The runes are patient, but they are not forgiving. Watch closely.
You came, and you did not flinch at the pact. Good. The others watch me as though the Legion walks beside me. Perhaps it does - but it walks on a leash, $N. Let me show you how to hold it.
The storm told me you would come; it has been restless all morning. Stand with me, $N, and listen. There is thunder in you, waiting to be called.
So you found me, and you came alone. Aldar would call that foolish, if he knew I was here. I call it resolve. We will see which of us is right, $N.
Good. Our people have need of every shield. Stand beside me a while, $N; I will show you how a Guardian stands.
The Light guided this vow to you, $N, and you to me. That is no small thing. Let us begin your service.
There you are - exactly when I saw you coming. Do not look so surprised, $N. Surprise is a luxury my students soon outgrow.
The dead told me you would come. They are rarely wrong, $N. Stand here with me, among them, and let us see whether you have the will for this path.
Ah, you felt it too - the heat in those pages. Good. Come closer to the fire, $N. We will start small.
You heard them too, didn't you? When you read the parchment. Do not be afraid, $N. They only whisper to those they have chosen.
Look up, $N. Those stars carried us here. Now let me show you how to make them answer.
Ah, the schematics found you. Mind the third page; the diagram is upside down. Deliberately, of course. Now then, $N - let us see what you can build.
... You read it. Good. Take up the scythe, $N. The rest will come.
Good. Feel the ground beneath you, $N - the life in it, the fire deep below. All of it is waiting to be told what to do. Let us begin.
You read the tablet. Did you notice the runes shift as you did? They were reading you, $N. They seem to approve. Sit; we have much to carve.

So Gornek be sendin' you to Zul’raja. Good.$B$BEvery soul be a crop, mon, and every crop got its season. A reaper learns when to cut and when to let it grow. You gonna swing da scythe for da Horde, and da spirits of da fallen gonna whisper where to strike.$B$BStay close. Da first lesson be waitin' for you.

You may not have expected such a task, $N. But it is important to understand that the Shadowlands call for those who are ready, and knowing when to claim a soul can be just as important as the reclamation of the soul itself.$B$BFor helping our friend out here, I will reward you with these boots. May they serve you well, as they are enchanted to allow you to walk on the surface of water itself.

A foul corruption has crept into Westfall.  While I was upholding my duty on the battlefields of Lordaeron these honest farms were overrun and made into hide-outs for thugs and murderers. The People's Militia needs your help.

Welcome to our humble abode!  It's always nice to see a friendly face.  And what strong arms you have.  My husband and I are always looking for help around the farm.  Now that most the good folk have left, it's hard to find an able body to help out.

Nothing but trouble in these parts.  I tried to tell that fool Saldean to get out while he still could be he won't hear of it.  But I ain't no fool.  Verna and I are gonna mosey on out as soon as we get this wagon fixed.

Sometimes I think there's a big gray cloud in the sky, just raining down bad luck upon us.  First, we're driven off our land, and now we can't even get out of Westfall.  Everything's a mess.  Something needs to be done.
Adventure from lands far and near $bMeeting with folks both odd and queer $bBut if of me a question you ask $bYou must first complete a simple task!
fr: Aventure depuis des terres lointaines et proches $bRencontre avec des gens à la fois étranges et queer $bMais si vous me posez une question $bVous devez d'abord accomplir une tâche simple !

en: Ach, it's hard enough keeping order around here without all these new troubles popping up!  I hope you have good news, $n...
fr: Ha, c'est déjà pas facile de maintenir l'ordre par ici sans rajouter tous ces nouveaux problèmes ! J'espère que vous apportez de bonnes nouvelles, $n...

en: Hey there, friend.  My name's Remy.  I'm from Redridge to the east, and came here looking for business, looking for business.  You got any...got any??
Aha!  Good day, good day, Master $C!  Come, sit down and have a drink.  You have an enterprising look in your eye, and I think you'll find speaking to me worth your time...
Hello, citizen.  You look like a $gman:woman; with a purpose - do you have business with the Stormwind Army?

At ease, $C.  If you are just passing though I suggest you stick to the roads and only travel by day. If your business is here in Darkshire, consider lending your abilities to The Night Watch.  Our skill is unquestionable but our numbers are small.
I have sensed your coming for quite some time, $n.  It was written in the pattern of the stars.
Welcome to the town of Darkshire.  Clerk Daltry at your service.  Can I be of some assistance?
Hello, hello!  Welcome to my kitchen, $g sir : m'lady;!  This is where all of the Scarlet Raven Tavern's finest delicacies are made.  Ah, just smell the wonderful aroma!
Keep the door closed, $C.  Never know when the Dark Riders will be passing through again.
Hello, good $gsir:lady,.  Have a seat, and a meal if you're hungry.  Don't fret if I look busy with my needlework - I'm listening to you...
Huh?!?  Oh.  You don't look like a Defias thief...or a member of the Night Watch.  Take pity on a poor soul, will ya?
Eh?  Greetings, young $C.  You're a brave one to find your way here with all those wandering creatures about!$B$BWell now that you are here, maybe you can help an old hermit...
Hail, traveler.  My eyesight may be poor but I can sense the footsteps of a $c from a mile away.  For years I defended Stormwind with pride but once my eyes failed me, I was forced to retire.
Welcome to the Tower of Azora, young $C.  I am Theocritus.$B$BDo you have business with me?  Or...do I have business with you, perhaps?
I don't have much time for idle talk, $N.  I've got to get this bridge rebuilt before the rains come.  I've finished every project on-time and under budget and I'm not about to start slipping now.
Hail, $N!  Welcome to my humble garden.  The weather has been perfect lately.  Let us hope it holds steady for a ripe harvest.

Who is this $c who goes before the Court of Lakshire in the Kingdom of Stormwind?  State your business within this township, $R.  The orc threat to the Kingdom is far too great to squander time in idle conversation.
Well met, $C.  If you're here for business, then get yourself a brew and we'll have ourselves a talk.
I don't have time to chat, citizen, but if you're willing to give us a hand against the orcs, then I'll find a use for you.

Do not be alarmed, $r.  I have long since passed from this land but I intend no harm to your kind.  I have witnessed too much death in my time.  My only wish now is for peace.  Perhaps you can help my cause.
Hey $Gbuddy:ma'am;, do you think you could give me a hand with something?  I'm really IN dire straits here...

Hail, $C.  Ill times these are, my friend, for our town is besieged!  The Blackrock Orcs attack from Stonewatch Keep, the Shadowhides loom over the Tower of Ilgalar, and the Redridge Gnoll Pack gathers strength.  I hope you're not here for a holiday...
Greetings, $c.  If you're a friend of Colonel Kurzen then I'll have you cut down where you stand! but if you've come to aid us, then lend an ear...
It's dark times that have come, $c... All too soon will we lose everything... When the Light will forsake all but those who truly walk under the Light.
There were thieves everywhere! $b$bIt was horrible.  The cave came down on us.  I think the mining company is all dead, including my brother, the Foreman.
Greetings. What business have you with the Carevin family? Do you seek to assist the Carevins in their battle against the undead?

The Carevin family fights for victory under the Light. My duty under the Light is to give my life in their battle against against the undead. Master Carevin has tasked me with the extermination of the vile worgen in Duskwood. Perhaps you would assit me?
Greetings, $c! Fine day for hunting, wouldn't you say? I've been having more than a little luck with boars, myself. Perhaps you'd like a shot?

Another fine day in the jungle!  It's going to be quite a hunt,  I can feel it.  Once Barnil is done cleaning the guns, I'm taking the hunting party deep into the twisting vines.  Not such a bad way for an old war vet to spend his retirement, eh?
You watch where you step around here, $Gson:lass;.  You might not be a part of our outfit, but that doesn't mean I won't take a cane to you if you fall out of line!

Well, hello there. You seem like you wouldn't be opposed to making some coin, hm? I can tell from the look in your eyes. I am Mogul Kebok, overseer of operations in Azeroth, and if it is riches you seek, perhaps I can make arrangements.
fr: Eh bien, bonjour. On dirait que vous ne seriez pas opposé à la fabrication de pièces de monnaie, hein ? Je peux le dire à ton regard. Je suis Mogul Kebok, superviseur des opérations en Azeroth, et si vous recherchez la richesse, je peux peut-être prendre des dispositions.

en: $C, eh? I am Krazek, Baron Revilgaz's secretary. I know everything about the goings on in this jungle and beyond. Perhaps you'd be interested in knowing the going price on oil in Ratchet? No? Looking for work, maybe? I can help you there.
fr: $C, hein ? Je suis Krazek, le secrétaire du baron Revilgaz. Je sais tout de ce qui se passe dans cette jungle et au-delà. Peut-être seriez-vous intéressé de connaître le prix actuel du pétrole à Ratchet ? Non? Vous cherchez du travail, peut-être ? Je peux vous aider là-bas.

en: Greetings, $g lad : girl;. I'm Grelin Whitebeard. I'm here to examine the threat posed by the growing numbers of trolls in Coldridge Valley. What have I found? It's a bit troubling...

Hello there, $c.  Normally I'd be out on the beat looking after the folk of Stormwind, but a lot of the Stormwind guards are fighting in other lands.  So here I am, deputized and offering bounties when I'd rather be on patrol...
What business brings you before the Court of Lakeshire and the Honorable Magistrate Solomon?

If there's one thing time has taught me it's that no assignment is a dull one.  Protecting the Thandol Span should have been an easy task.  But with the brunt of the army fighting alongside the alliance, we were overwhelmed here and Dun Modr has fallen.
Greetings, $n.
fr: Salutations, $n.

en: You know, I always wanted to be a Prospector, but I was born with a head for numbers and the Guild decided I would be best suited to keep the books! Studying, studying, every day of my youth...

Well hello there, citizen. The name's Bluntnose, Magistrate Bluntnose, to be precise. I'm charged with overseeing the well-being of Thelsamar, and believe you me, we could always use another strong set of arms around here!

If you're here for the food, then welcome!  You won't find finer dining in all of Stormwind...or Azeroth!$B$BIf you're here on other matters, then please be brief.  I have a dozen dishes in preparation, and must care for each.
If you're willing to endure tales that will shiver your timbers and sog your skivvies, then get yourself a drink and sit for a spell...
fr: Si vous êtes prêt à endurer des histoires qui vous feront frissonner et détremperont vos sous-vêtements, alors prenez un verre et asseyez-vous pendant un moment...

en: Troggs! I swear the gods put them in this land only to torment me! Four inches deeper into the mines, then two feet back from the troggs!

Welcome to the Thunderbrew Distillery, founded by dear ol' pappy, Arkilus Thunderbrew.  I've been keeping the place running ever since my older brother, Grimbooze, disappeared in a drunken haze a few harvests ago.
Greetings, $n.
fr: Salutations, $n.

en: Well, if it isn't a young, bristling $c, no doubt drawn here by talk of my exploits in fields of battle!$B$BNo time for stories now, for there are great, important deeds that need doing!  So if you're looking for glory, then luck shines on you today...
fr: Eh bien, si ce n'est pas un jeune et hérissé $c, sans doute attiré ici par le récit de mes exploits sur les champs de bataille !$B$BPas le temps pour les histoires maintenant, car il y a de grandes et importantes actions à accomplir !  Alors si vous recherchez la gloire, alors la chance brille sur vous aujourd'hui...

en: Although we're trudging through a slow period at these ruins, I'm confident it won't last long.  But in the meantime, I could use someone like you.  Would you like to aid the Dwarven Explorers' Guild?
I'm in the middle of a very important task.  Prospector business.  Unless you have something equally important to say, which I doubt, then you'll have to excuse me.
Curse that Brewers' League!  They have access to all the best ingredients, while we're stuck here grubbing for grain and hops!$B$BI really would like to give them some bitter tasting justice...
Driving a Steam Tank isn't for everyone.  It takes an iron grip and nerves of steel...lucky I have both!  How about you?  How's your mettle?  Want to prove it to me?
Greetings, $n.
fr: Salutations, $n.

en: You'll not find a greater cache of knowledge than in the Royal Library of Stormwind!
Greetings, $C.  Be wary as you travel east toward The Bulwark.  Recent surveillance reports indicate increased Scourge activity in that area, so exercise caution.
Ah, you there!  I have tasks to give, and I need not waste time explaining their crucial nature.  Listen close.
I hope you're well, all things considered.$B$BSit for a spell, and hear my tale.  It's a tragedy, of course, but one I hope will end in revenge!
The Scarlet Crusade is encroaching on our homeland.  The foolish zealots do not realize that the loyal servants of The Dark Lady shall see to their demise.
The Dark Lady has put forth the challenge.  It is up to us to meet it.
Greetings, I am Baros Alexston, City Architect of Stormwind.
Over here, you worthless...! If you want to do something useful, listen quick!
fr: Par ici, vous ne valez rien...! Si vous voulez faire quelque chose d'utile, écoutez vite !

en: This collection of scrolls contains various logistic and strategic information, as well as coded correspondences.
I am Bolvar Fordragon, Highlord of Stormwind.
fr: Je suis Bolvar Fordragon, généralissime de Hurlevent.

en: We spent so much of our lives in flight, memories of peaceful times grow evermore distant.
The Dark Lady has put the challenge forth.  Now it is up to the Royal Apothecary Society to develop a new plague.  We shall bring Arthas and his wretched army to their knees.
The Kirin Tor did not heed my warnings!  The Alliance is a sham.  Arugal is a wreckless fool.
My brother and I are on a vital mission, but we are holed up in this farmhouse.  The Deathstalkers need your help.
Hello, $C.  If you're here, then you must know that Silverpine is saturated with our enemies.  To survive, the Forsaken must drive them back!
I was bred and educated for public service. A representative of the people. My skill was not in arms or crafts, but in words and persuasion
The Royal Apothecary Society shall heed The Dark Lady's call to uncover the New Plague and drive Arthas and his heathen Scourge Army from the world once and for all.

This cauldron churns with thick, green bubbles.  Skulls, bones and organs of unknown creatures swim within its viscous broth...$B$BAnd rising lazily to the surface are the skulls of two, once mighty trolls:$B$BGan'zulah and Nezzliok.
The creation of Teldrassil was a grand achievement, but now the world must shift to regain its balance.
fr: La création de Teldrassil a été une grande réussite, mais le monde doit désormais changer pour retrouver son équilibre.

en: Greetings, $n.
fr: Salutations, $n.

en: Siege engines are the pride of every pilot!
Greetings, $c. I'm in a bit of a pinch right now, running very low on hides.
Information... With our scouts and agents, we control the flow of information in Lordaeron. Scourge movements, their holdings, all underneath our watchful eyes...
fr: Information... Avec nos éclaireurs et nos agents, nous contrôlons le flux d'informations à Lordaeron. Les mouvements du Fléau, leurs possessions, le tout sous nos yeux vigilants...

en: In order to serve the Dark Lady and Varimathras we need to advance the front on the Human Infestation.
We are but so close to developing the New Plague that our Dark Lady desires with such fervor.
fr: Nous sommes si près de développer la Nouvelle Peste que notre Dame Noire désire avec tant de ferveur.

en: To think, the place the Warchief was born and raised lies so close.
fr: Dire que l'endroit où le chef de guerre est né et a grandi est si proche.
note: fichier=release:DB_Communaute.lua;famille=prose;glossaire=apostrophe courbe (convention : droite) | correction mécanique du glossaire : apostrophe droite

en: I hope you're here to work, $C.  We have a lot to do and the Horde, the Syndicate and the Ogres aren't going to help us.

When I was first offered the title of Southshore Magistrate I was elated to have earned such a commission so early in my career.$B$BBut now that I'm here, I wonder if I'd have been better off shuffling papers in Stormwind.
I have a great deal of work to do.  Are you here to aid me with my research?
My family boasts the finest collection of jewelry and objects of fine art among all the nobles of Stormwind!$B$BAnd we are always wishing to increase the size our collection...
Ah, smell the fine salt air!  'Tis always nice to return to our home port of Booty Bay.
Eh?  You have business with Nimboya?
What what?!?  We all have profit to make... and we won't do it by standing idle.
fr: Quoi quoi ?!?  Nous avons tous des bénéfices à réaliser... et nous n'y parviendrons pas en restant les bras croisés.

en: Oy!  You here for a game of knuckles?
Hello!  The spirits say you here to aid my chief.  Say it loud, they do.
Yarrr... ye best not be trifling with my time, matey!
We at Refuge Pointe hold one of the few remaining patches of Stromgarde territory in the Arathi Highlands.  And we're losing ground...$B$BIf you have words for me, then I hope they are good tidings.
Thanks to the Warchief, even here in the ruins of our former prison, some hope remains, and the Horde rises anew.
fr: Grâce au chef de guerre, même ici, dans les ruines de notre ancienne prison, il reste un peu d'espoir et la Horde se relève.

en: This wooden board holds roughly-made wanted posters.
Back away!  Stay back!  I have a pack full of blastpowder and I'm not afraid to use it!  I'll blow us all away!$B$BOh, never mind.  I thought you were someone else....
Welcome to Bonegrip's Runes and Dooms, $c.  You may look, but do not touch.$B$BSome of the knowledge here is not meant for the...uninitiated.
You must be hard up to be wandering these Badlands, $c.  Hard up like me.$B$BOr maybe you're here because you're crazy.  Crazy, like me.
fr: Vous devez être $gun dur:une dure; à cuire pour errer ainsi dans les Terres ingrates, $c. Comme moi.$B$BOu peut-être que vous êtes $gfou:folle;. Comme moi.

en: It was quite a departure, let me tell you, $c. We were grabbing whatever wasn't nailed down or could be removed quickly. We're a little spare on supplies because of it.
Bastards came right at us at night, after we'd gotten a few drinks in us. Otherwise, we could've taken 'em, count on it.$B$BEveryone's dead now... except a few of us.

Hey there, $N.$B$BLotwil's not the most perceptive boss I've had. He actually gets really involved with his work. So much so that sometimes his servants don't eat, or get paid.$B$B<Lucien frowns over at Lotwil.>$B$BBut that doesn't mean you should suffer.

How perfect of you to come by, $c.$B$BMy name is Lotwil Veriatus, founding member of the Enlightened Assembly of Arcanology, Alchemy, and Engineering Sciences: we seek to blend the intelligent sciences of Azeroth together into one comprehensive school.
Corruption sneaks into nature's grove.  The forest must be protected at all costs.
Hail, $c. In my years I have seen many eager tauren who wish to prove their worth to the tribe. It should not be forgotten that eagerness is no substitute for wisdom and experience.
The Outrunners' duty is to ensure the safety of those who travel across the plains of Mulgore. Those that would threaten the safety of the tauren homeland risk punishment at our hands.
fr: Le devoir des Outrunners est d'assurer la sécurité de ceux qui traversent les plaines de Mulgore. Ceux qui menaceraient la sécurité de la patrie des Taurens risquent d'être punis de notre part.
note: fichier=textes_pnj.json;famille=prose;glossaire=apostrophe courbe (convention : droite) | correction mécanique du glossaire : apostrophe droite

en: The land has been good to our people, $c. We must be thankful for our good fortune.
fr: La terre a été bonne pour notre peuple, $c. Nous devons être reconnaissants pour notre bonne fortune.

en: The tauren are sons and daughters of the Earthmother, and we show respect to all her children.  Even the beasts we slay are cherished, as their bodies give nourishment and their skins provide warmth.
Throm'ka, $c. There is little time for talk and much work to be done.
There is something you wish to discuss, $c... come, sit by me.
The heft of an axe, the battlecry of your allies, the spray of blood in your face. These are the things a warrior craves, $n. I will carve out The Barrens with my sword in the name of the Horde.
The land, the water, and the sky are all as one. It is your eyes that deceive you with such separation. The Earthmother is all those things and more.
This had better be good....
The Barrens holds a wealth of substances for which we, the apothecaries or Lordaeron, may find use.
Thrall paid me and my boys well for helping out with the construction of Orgrimmar, so I decided to set up a port here. We do most of our business through Booty Bay and Baron Revilgaz.
fr: Thrall m'a bien payé, moi et mes garçons, pour avoir aidé à la construction d'Orgrimmar, j'ai donc décidé d'installer un port ici. Nous exerçons l'essentiel de nos activités par l'intermédiaire de Baie-du-Butin et de Baron Revilgaz.
note: fichier=textes_pnj.json;famille=prose;glossaire=Booty Bay→Baie-du-Butin | correction mécanique du glossaire : Booty Bay→Baie-du-Butin

en: For our people to survive, we must study the ways of nature and learn its secrets.
To hunt a beast, one must know that beast.  One must learn and respect its ways.$B$BTo do otherwise is not to hunt.  To do otherwise is merely to kill.
Yes yes yes!  You're just the $r I'm looking for!$B$BSit!  We have much to discuss!!
Something I can help you with, $n? There's a shipment I've got to see to otherwise.
fr: Quelque chose pour lequel je peux vous aider, $n ? Sinon, il y a une livraison dont je dois m'occuper.

en: I, Arynia Cloudsbreak, have been tasked with protecting the sanctity of the Oracle Grove.
fr: Moi, Arynia Cloudsbreak, j'ai pour mission de protéger le caractère sacré d'Oracle Grove.

en: Well met, $n. It is good to see that $cs like yourself are taking an active part in protecting the groves.
The wind whispers to those who listen...$B$BDo you hear it?
Dark forces encroach upon our borders, ancient taints resurface, and new evils emerge to topple the delicate balance of the land. In times of such darkness, we all must be vigilant.
Good day, $glad:lass;! Perhaps you could help me with some things that need to be taken care of.

Hmm... I can plug this wire in here and that will power the fizzletan gear, but then the hydrophlange will need an alternate power source... Maybe I can... Oh, hello! Hey, want to help me try a new invention?
We elves have a long history.  Let us hope this history does not return to haunt us.
Ashenvale is a lush forest, brimming with life. It is a pleasure to walk down its secret paths in search of herbs, but one must take care. The forest is not without its dangers.
fr: Orneval est une forêt luxuriante, pleine de vie. C'est un plaisir de parcourir ses sentiers secrets à la recherche d'herbes, mais il faut être prudent. La forêt n'est pas sans danger.

en: The balance of nature is a delicate one, and easily tipped.  Are you brave enough to make things right?
The spirits are restless!
You must listen, young $c.  Listen to the whisperings in the darkness, for they offer guidance in these troubled times.
The spirits of nature are powers to respect.  They offer great aid to the worthy, and mete out swift death to the foolish.
The spirit of Stonetalon weeps.  It weeps from its mountain peaks, to its rivers, to its severed, dying trees.

If I can get the proper ingredients, we can create some explosives that will not only allow me to damage the Venture's Co.'s operations, but also cause a distraction.$B$BI know you're impressed, but it gets better... I'll tell you more soon enough.
Hello, friend. What can I do for you?
Greetings, $n.
fr: Salutations, $n.

en: Greetings, $n.
fr: Salutations, $n.

en: Come a little closer.  We have important matters to discuss, you and I.$B$BAnd some of them we don't want everyone to hear...
Be careful where you put that foot of yours, $gmister:ma'am;.  We're not all blessed with the lofty height of a $r.
Greetings, $n.
fr: Salutations, $n.

en: No, Longears isn't my real name.  And I'm not going to tell you what it is, so don't ask.

The days grow long, and still no end to the conflicts of these lands can be seen. It takes no spell caster to know that much. Take up a blade while you can, $c. War can come to our doors at any time, and if I'm not mistaken, you look to be one who revels in it.
Greetings, $c.
fr: Salutations, $c.

en: Overlord Mok'Morokk boss. You do what I say.
fr: Patron du suzerain Mok'Morokk. Tu fais ce que je dis.

en: Greetings, $n.
fr: Salutations, $n.

en: We may not be in open war with the Alliance, but blood is still shed between us.
fr: Nous ne sommes peut-être pas en guerre ouverte avec l'Alliance, mais le sang continue de couler entre nous.
note: fichier=textes_pnj.json;famille=prose;glossaire=apostrophe courbe (convention : droite) | correction mécanique du glossaire : apostrophe droite

en: Some people think the swamp's no good... no good, they say.
Researching in Theramore is an interesting job, but it's sure hard to find a soft bed in this town!
If we are to make our place in this world, then we will do so through study, and through the will to ignore our fading human instincts.
fr: Si nous voulons faire notre place dans ce monde, nous le ferons grâce à l'étude et à la volonté d'ignorer nos instincts humains en déclin.
note: fichier=release:DB_Communaute.lua;famille=prose;glossaire=apostrophe courbe (convention : droite) | correction mécanique du glossaire : apostrophe droite

en: Nethergarde keep always needs more supplies - supplies to help our mages in their research, and supplies to keep our defenders in top fighting shape.
Don't let the heat bother you.  In the Badlands, heat is the least of your worries.
The Alliance has many stakes in Desolace, and our hold here is unstable.$B$BWill you help us?
The centaur clans rule the wastes of Desolace.  If united, they would be a terrible force.  It is then good that the centaur clans are not united but instead bicker and war amongst themselves.
This sty's a little shy of comfy, but it has history, so Stonard must be important to someone. I'd gamble that's why we stay here. It sure ain't for the view--it don't even look like home.
fr: Cette étable est un peu loin d'être confortable, mais elle a une histoire, donc Stonard doit être important pour quelqu'un. Je parierais que c'est pour ça qu'on reste ici. Ce n'est certainement pas pour la vue, ça ne ressemble même pas à la maison.

en: What do you ask of me?
Greetings, $n.
fr: Salutations, $n.

en: Pleased to meetcha, $c. Me name's Roetten. I lead Reclaimers Incorporated.$B$BMe guild and I specialize in aquiring lost goods. We usually hire brave adventurers and send them off to finish tasks for those who aren't able, or don't have the time.

I've got a lot going on out here in Desolace, $N. Roetten wants us to pick up some reagents for one of our clients as well as fetch some of these lost items.$B$BSeein' as you're here to help out, why don't we get started?

The main threat Thrall wishes dealt with is the Burning Blade--members of the Horde that have given their loyalty to the demons. They seek to practice their dark magic and care little for Thrall's vision of the Horde's future here in Kalimdor.
fr: La principale menace à laquelle Thrall souhaite s'attaquer est la Lame Ardente, des membres de la Horde qui ont prêté leur loyauté aux démons. Ils cherchent à pratiquer leur magie noire et se soucient peu de la vision de Thrall de l'avenir de la Horde ici à Kalimdor.

en: Our only hope is to create something good from an already bad situation.
fr: Notre seul espoir est de créer quelque chose de bon à partir d'une situation déjà mauvaise.
note: fichier=textes_pnj.json;famille=prose;glossaire=apostrophe courbe (convention : droite) | correction mécanique du glossaire : apostrophe droite

en: If we are to protect nature, then we must embrace its strength.  And we must show this strength to those who would harm the land.
I welcome you back, $n.
The earth calls to you, $N. Go to it, and know that your brethren are proud of you and all you will accomplish.
Some can't stand the heat of the Great Forge, but I think the heat is just right.  And it's the best place to do some serious smithwork.
I'm on quest.  A quest!  A quest for new alloys and harder metals for the greatest invention of all!!

You will be tested many times by the darkness that surrounds our lands, $N. But to ensure you are always prepared, we will often ask tasks of you so you are at the height of your own power.$B$BGo with the Light, and remain virtuous.
Many tests await a paladin of the Light, $N. Be assured, our paths will cross many times in the future if you remain passionate and hold to those virtues that we praise.

Where Troggs and Leper Gnomes roam stands our home - Gnomeregan.$B$BOur families lost, our homes displaced. Scattered.$B$BOh how I long for the days of carefree Gnomeregan life, but those days are no more. We must make our stand! We must save Gnomeregan!
For Gnomeregan!
fr: Pour Gnomeregan !

en: Whatcha need, $c?  I trust that you've come out to this wasteland for a reason other than idle chit chat.
Mathias found me left for dead by the Venture Co. in the Barrens. Had it not been for him, I'd have been prowler fodder.
My name is Dran Droffers, and this over here is my dummy son Malton.  If you need salvage, or are looking to sell salvage, then we're who you need to be talking to!
The name's Bilgewhizzle, and I am the chief engineer of the Gadgetzan Water Company.  What can I assist you with?
So few make it this far, even fewer make it past. Do not become a statistic, $N.
Some people wonder what we're doing out here in the desert.  Well... If I told you, then you'd stay and try to make our profits!
We're here to make a profit.  And having our goods stolen is no way to make a profit.
Hello, $N. Perhaps you have some time to chat?
Greetings, $N.
fr: Salutations, $n.

en: If you are here to beg for the privilege of working for me, then your company is quite welcome. Otherwise, there is little chance you are of any use to me.
fr: Si vous êtes là pour me supplier de vous accorder le privilège de travailler pour moi, alors votre compagnie est la bienvenue. Sinon, il y a peu de chances que vous puissiez m'être utile.

en: Dear $g boy:girl;, you have arrived just in time to assist the Kargath Expeditionary Force.\n
I never miss...
Stand at attention, soldier!$B$BWINKY! SOUND OFF!
The quest for wealth is the only goal for a respectable goblin.$B$BWell, maybe wealth... and a big, loud death!
Greetings, $R.
Welcome to Kibler's Exotic Pets! How can you help me today??
<Emberstrife acknowledges your presence.>
Whitereach Post started off as a small hunting camp... Now, everyone wants to set up shop and call this home.$B$B<Motega shrugs his shoulder>
We cannot take care of all the threats in this area alone. We could use another fighting hand, $n.
I never feel warm anymore...
fr: Je n'ai plus jamais chaud...

en: Greetings, $N. I am Duke Nicholas Zverenhoff of the Argent Dawn.
Desolace is not such a bad place, if you don't mind the constant harassments from the centaurs.
My business plan never accounted for housing giant kodos... maybe I should have gone into the underwater basket weaving business instead.
The Argent Dawn will turn away none who are willing to sacrifice for our cause.
The Lich King has brought war against us from the frozen north, and only we of the Argent Dawn stand in his way.
Good day to you, citizen. Have you come to aid us against the Scourge?
Good day to you, citizen. Have you come to aid us against the Scourge?
Greetings, $n. If you bring me necrotic stones from the undead invaders, I can give you access to the stores of the Argent Dawn.
Greetings, $n. If you bring me necrotic stones from the undead invaders, I can give you access to the stores of the Argent Dawn.

Greetings, $c. I am the Flamekeeper. During the Midsummer Fire Festival, it is my duty to keep this fire beside me burning brightly. It is an honor to be selected for such a task, I fill it gladly.$b$b How can I help you?
The Light does not yet shine on Skettis.
These shards glint with an unnatural sheen.  It is clear that they hide a deep power within.
Welcome to Cresthairn.$B$B<The bailiff gives you a long look, as though weighing you.>

When word reached us that the Frostmanes had overrun the Kingsway, the first question we asked ourselves in Dun Kazad was: 'Why? What has changed?'$B$BUntil recently, the trolls weren't so much a threat as they were a nuisance. A seasonal cold, if you will. They had never dared to be so bold.$B$BI have discovered the reason why.$B$BThe Horde has struck a bargain with them. They are supplying them, and they are calling the shots.
This collection of scrolls contains various logistic and strategic information, as well as coded correspondences.
